jobs.title: Founding Product Marketing Lead
jobs.excerpt: Parallel is a product and brand design studio.  Since 2013, we’ve built products and web experiences for ambitious startups, mostly in AI and B2B SaaS.
jobs.description:
Parallel is a product and brand design studio. Since 2013, we’ve built products and web experiences for ambitious startups, mostly in AI and B2B SaaS. Around 40 of us. All obsessed with craft.

Technical founders often have a compelling product and a website that doesn’t explain why it matters. We’re building a practice at Parallel to help them get that story right and turn it into websites that earn trust and drive action.

We work with early-stage technology founders, primarily in Silicon Valley, on their websites and marketing collateral. We often come in before they have a marketing team, when the product is moving quickly, and much of the company’s story still lives in the founder’s head.

You’ll build our positioning and website copy practice, working directly with client founders and alongside our designers and developers. You’ll own the work from the first product conversation through launch and improvement.

What you’ll do

  • Get into each client’s product: try it, read the documentation, speak with engineers, and understand the customer problem it solves.

  • Lead founder and customer interviews. Define positioning, differentiation, and messaging, then turn those decisions into website structure and final copy.

  • Partner with designers on the complete experience: visual hierarchy, product storytelling, proof, navigation, and calls to action.

  • Bring a conversion mindset to every page. Understand what visitors need before they’ll act, identify friction, and develop hypotheses to improve results.

  • Define meaningful website goals and measurement with the team. Use analytics, customer feedback, and sales insights to decide what to improve, including when traffic is too low for reliable A/B testing.

  • Extend the narrative into decks, launch materials, and sales collateral.

  • Build the practice: how we scope engagements, run discovery, review work, measure outcomes, and eventually hire and develop the team.

Who we’re looking for
You combine technical fluency, excellent writing, and strong design judgment. You can understand how a product works, decide which details matter to its audience, and help create a website that feels considered and makes the next step clear.

You may have studied computer science, worked as an engineer, built products yourself, or developed technical depth through product marketing. You should be able to explore a product independently and earn technical founders' confidence.

You’ll also bring

  • Work that shows you can turn a complex product into clear positioning and compelling website copy.

  • A strong eye for design, with the ability to explain why a layout, interaction, or visual strengthens or weakens the story.

  • Practical knowledge of conversion optimization and website analytics. You can connect visitor behavior to specific changes and distinguish useful evidence from a promising-looking number.

  • The judgment to challenge founders constructively and defend your choices.

  • Experience working closely with design and development to ship, learn, and improve.

  • The initiative to build a function while personally delivering the work.

Why join
You’ll shape the offer, process, quality standards, and team for a new practice at Parallel. You’ll work directly with technical founders at a stage when clearer positioning and a better website can materially improve how they reach customers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll initially run the interviews, write the pages, and help evaluate performance yourself. As the practice grows, you’ll build a team around that work.

jobs.description:
Build and run the GHL systems that turn leads into members and keep members coming back — and be the go-to support for the gym team using them.

About the Role

Seamless Assist places AI-fluent virtual assistants with growing businesses and builds the automation systems they run. We are hiring a GoHighLevel Specialist on behalf of our client, a US-based gym business. This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in India.

The gym runs its lead follow-up, trial bookings, member communication, and retention campaigns through GoHighLevel. This hire owns that platform end to end — building the automations that drive memberships and supporting the owner and front-desk team who use it every day.

Culture: owner-led, fast-moving fitness business. Clear ownership, proactive communication, and steady improvement over perfection.

Role Details

  • Industry: Health & Fitness — Gym
  • Reports to: Gym Owner
  • Type: Full-time · 40 hours/week
  • Hours: US Eastern Time (EST) business hours
  • Rate: TBD
  • Location: Remote — India
  • Tools: GoHighLevel (GHL), Zapier / Make / n8n, gym management software (e.g., Mindbody, ABC Glofox, PushPress, Zen Planner), Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Google Workspace

Role Overview

Every lead, trial, and member touchpoint at the gym runs through GoHighLevel. The GHL Specialist will design and maintain those systems — from the first ad inquiry to the membership renewal — and provide responsive, first-line support to the gym owner and staff.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between building and supporting in the same day: fixing a broken trial-booking workflow in the morning, walking the front desk through the pipeline after lunch, and documenting both so it doesn't happen twice. The right person treats every support request as a signal of what to systematize next.

Key Responsibilities

GHL Automation & Build

  • Build and maintain lead nurture workflows — speed-to-lead SMS/email, trial class and intro session booking, and follow-up for leads who don't book
  • Automate the member journey — class and appointment reminders, no-show follow-up, new-member onboarding, and milestone check-ins
  • Run retention and reactivation campaigns — lapsed and frozen members, expiring memberships, failed payments, and win-back offers
  • Set up and manage pipelines, calendars, forms, surveys, landing pages/funnels, custom fields, and tags
  • Build and send email and SMS campaigns — promotions, challenges, events, and monthly member newsletters
  • Automate review requests and referral campaigns to grow the gym's reputation
  • Integrate GHL with the gym's management software, payment tools, and ad lead sources (Facebook/Instagram lead forms) via native integrations, Zapier, Make, n8n, or webhooks

Customer Support

  • Serve as first-line GHL support for the gym owner and front-desk/sales staff
  • Manage and respond to member and lead inquiries in the GHL Conversations inbox (SMS, email, social DMs) within agreed response times
  • Troubleshoot issues: broken workflows, failed sends, calendar sync errors, A2P/10DLC and email deliverability problems, integration failures
  • Train gym staff on using GHL — pipelines, conversations, booking, and reporting — through live walkthroughs and short recorded videos
  • Escalate billing, platform-level bugs, or out-of-scope requests to the gym owner with a clear summary

Reporting, Documentation & Improvement

  • Build dashboards that track leads, trial bookings, show rates, conversions to membership, and retention
  • Write SOPs and how-to guides for every recurring build and support issue
  • Audit the account for broken, duplicate, or unused workflows and recommend clean-up
  • Track recurring issues and propose automations or fixes that remove them at the source
  • Use AI tools to speed up campaign copy, troubleshooting, and documentation

Who Will Succeed

"Builds it right, explains it simply, and fixes the root cause — not just the ticket."

  • Has built real GHL automations for live businesses — ideally gyms, studios, or other membership businesses
  • Understands how a gym makes money: leads, trials, memberships, retention
  • Patient and clear with busy, non-technical owners and staff — explains a workflow without jargon
  • Systems thinker who documents as they go and hates fixing the same problem twice
  • Takes initiative — spots what is broken or missing and raises it before the owner does

Experience & Skills

Required

  • GHL expertise: 2+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience building workflows, pipelines, funnels, and campaigns for live businesses
  • Customer support: 1+ year providing customer or technical support (tickets, live chat, calls, or client success)
  • Integrations: Working knowledge of Zapier, Make, n8n, or webhooks to connect GHL with other tools
  • AI fluency: Actively uses AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to build, write, and troubleshoot faster — specific tools and use cases confirmed at screening
  • Time zone compatibility: Able to work US Eastern Time (EST) business hours from India
  • Strong communication: Exceptional written and spoken English — clear, friendly, and concise with owners, staff, and members; assessed at screening
  • Deliverability: Understanding of email and SMS deliverability, including A2P 10DLC registration
  • Remote setup: Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated workspace

Preferred

  • Experience with gyms, fitness studios, or other membership-based businesses
  • Experience with gym management software (Mindbody, ABC Glofox, PushPress, Zen Planner, or similar)
  • GHL Admin certification
  • Familiarity with GHL Conversation AI / AI Employee features
  • Experience running Facebook/Instagram lead-gen campaigns into GHL

  • Draft and issue all new hire offers/contracts based on job descriptions, budget, and role-specific guidelines

  • Ensure all active job descriptions in Paycom with assigned position seats remain posted through a corresponding requisition at all times, even after the position is filled
  • Sponsor Indeed ads only for vacant positions
  • Screen all applicants daily with the goal of zero unscreened applicants at the end of each day; reject unqualified applicants and rate qualified applicants to build a strong candidate pool
  • Ensure continuity of services during personal absences by designating ranking staff to assume responsibilities beyond normal non-working hours
  • Respond to voicemails within 2 business hours
  • Acknowledge email inquiries within 1 business hour; if outside scope, warmly transfer to appropriate team member
  • Initiate resolution of intranet tickets within 4 business hours
  • Represent Enterprise Management at job fairs, career events, and community outreach activities
  • Maintain strong relationships with universities, training programs, licensing boards, and community partners
  • Collaborate with compliance and credentialing staff to ensure all hires meet required qualifications
  • Conduct workforce data analysis to monitor time-to-fill, turnover, and sourcing trends
  • Recommend enhancements to recruitment platforms, outreach efforts, and employer branding strategies
  • Assist the supervisor with any work-related tasks as requested
  • Be a “doer,” not just a “delegator”

UNSCHEDULED DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Maintain confidentiality of all records, especially those relating to client treatment or financial information

  • Assist with updating job descriptions, career pages, and hiring forms as needed
  • Support internal mobility programs and employee referral initiatives
  • Respond to applicant inquiries and ensure candidate experience standards are upheld
  • Assist with temporary staffing agency coordination and contract tracking
  • Participate in HR special projects such as policy rollouts or engagement campaigns

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer
  • Frequent meetings via video or phone; occasional in-person site visits

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • Remote
  • Fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with collaborative teams

COMPETENCIES AND SKILLS:

  • Knowledge of full-cycle recruiting processes
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities
  • Cultural competency and inclusive recruitment practices
  • Familiarity with applicant tracking systems and HRIS platforms
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize in a dynamic environment

LEVEL OF EDUCATION / TRAINING / QUALIFICATIONS:

  • SHRM certification
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred
  • Minimum 2 years of recruiting or talent acquisition experience required
  • Experience recruiting in healthcare, human services, or nonprofit settings strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with labor laws and EEO/AA regulations a plus
  • Ability to pass background and reference checks

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience recruiting for behavioral health, psychiatric rehabilitation, outpatient mental health, assisted living, skilled nursing, or other healthcare settings. Experience recruiting for roles in Maryland is a plus.
  • Solid experience in full-cycle recruiting, preferably within behavioral health, psychiatric rehabilitation, outpatient mental health, assisted living facilities, skilled nursing facilities, or other healthcare-related settings, with specific experience recruiting in the Maryland healthcare and behavioral health market strongly preferred.Familiarity with behavioral health and mental health job functions, including roles such as therapists, counselors, case managers, psychiatric rehabilitation staff, direct support professionals, medication technicians, caregivers, and other care team members.
  • Strong understanding of Maryland healthcare recruitment challenges, including high-volume hiring, credential-sensitive roles, shift-based staffing needs, licensing requirements, compliance standards, and candidate availability in competitive healthcare labor markets.
  • Demonstrated ability to source, screen, interview, and support hiring for clinical, direct care, administrative, and program-level roles in behavioral health or healthcare environments.

jobs.description:
About AdvantixxRCM
AdvantixxRCM provides comprehensive revenue cycle management services to healthcare providers, including medical billing, insurance follow-up, denial management, payment posting, credentialing, and revenue optimization.

We are seeking an experienced Accounts Receivable (A/R) & Insurance Follow-Up Specialist who understands that submitting a claim is only the beginning—the ultimate objective is obtaining accurate and timely reimbursement for our clients.

Position Summary

The A/R & Insurance Follow-Up Specialist is responsible for managing outstanding insurance accounts and aggressively pursuing appropriate reimbursement from Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care, and commercial insurance payers.

This individual will investigate unpaid, delayed, denied, rejected, and underpaid claims and take appropriate action until each assigned account reaches resolution.

We are looking for someone who can work an A/R aging report independently and take ownership of accounts from follow-up through resolution.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Insurance A/R Follow-Up

  • Work assigned insurance A/R aging reports daily.
  • Follow up on unpaid and outstanding insurance claims.
  • Research claim status through payer portals, clearinghouses, telephone calls, and other available resources.
  • Determine why claims remain unpaid.
  • Contact insurance companies regarding delayed or incorrectly processed claims.
  • Document every follow-up action accurately.
  • Establish appropriate follow-up dates and continue working accounts until resolution.
  • Prioritize high-dollar and aging accounts.
  • Identify claims approaching timely-filing or appeal deadlines.
  • Escalate significant reimbursement issues to management.

Denials & Rejections

  • Investigate rejected and denied claims.
  • Review CARC/RARC codes and payer explanations.
  • Determine appropriate corrective action.
  • Correct and resubmit claims when appropriate.
  • Submit reconsiderations and appeals.
  • Obtain supporting documentation when required.
  • Track appeals through final determination.
  • Identify recurring denial patterns and communicate them to management.
  • Work with billing, coding, credentialing, eligibility, and authorization teams to resolve root causes.

Underpayment & Reimbursement Review

  • Review EOBs and ERAs.
  • Identify potential underpayments.
  • Compare reimbursement against expected or contracted reimbursement when information is available.
  • Research incorrectly processed claims.
  • Request claim reprocessing when appropriate.
  • Identify coordination-of-benefits issues.
  • Research primary and secondary payer issues.
  • Escalate suspected payer reimbursement problems.

A/R Management

  • Work accounts across aging categories, including:

0–30 Days | 31–60 Days | 61–90 Days | 91–120 Days | 120+ Days

Special attention should be given to aging balances, high-dollar accounts, filing deadlines, and claims requiring immediate intervention.

Documentation

Every account worked must contain clear documentation describing:

  • Date of follow-up
  • Payer contacted
  • Claim status
  • Representative/reference information when applicable
  • Reason payment remains outstanding
  • Action taken
  • Documentation requested or submitted
  • Expected resolution
  • Required next action
  • Follow-up date

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years of medical billing, insurance follow-up, or healthcare A/R experience preferred.
  • Experience working insurance aging reports.
  • Experience communicating directly with insurance companies.
  • Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care, and commercial insurance.
  • Understanding of CMS-1500 professional claims.
  • Experience with EOBs and ERAs.
  • Knowledge of claim denials, rejections, reconsiderations, and appeals.
  • Familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, modifiers, and CARC/RARC codes.
  • Experience using payer portals and clearinghouses.
  • Strong research and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience with an RCM or medical billing company.
  • Experience handling multiple healthcare practices or clients.
  • CPC, CPB, CRCR, or related certification.
  • Medicare and Medicaid billing experience.
  • Experience with behavioral health, primary care, specialty medicine, or other outpatient services.
  • Experience with Availity, Office Ally, Waystar, Change Healthcare/Optum, or similar systems.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be measured using appropriate departmental KPIs, including:

  • Number and quality of accounts worked
  • A/R resolution
  • Reduction of aging balances
  • A/R over 90 days
  • Recovery of outstanding reimbursement
  • Follow-up turnaround time
  • Appeal/reconsideration completion
  • Documentation quality
  • Accuracy
  • Timely-filing protection
  • Compliance with company and client procedures

Quality and actual account resolution are more important than simply documenting a high number of touches.

You're the first person our customers talk to when something gets in their way. Every conversation is a chance to turn a blocked user into a happy one.

Company Overview: Celerity is a consulting firm specializing in utilities and energy sectors. Practice Overview: The Business Integration Services (BIS) practice is a high-growth technology consulting practice delivering enterprise-scale integration, digital transformation, and solution design engagements for complex, multi-stakeholder clients. The practice is in its third year of a structured build and scale phase, expanding from a founding team to a full-capability organization spanning four pillars: Project Management (PMO), Business/Technical Analysis, Solution Architecture, and Engineering.
The practice operates at the intersection of business strategy and technology execution, working closely with technology partners and vendors to deliver outcomes that are both architecturally sound and commercially meaningful. It is entering a pivotal phase of maturity, transitioning from practice-leads delivery to a structured operating model with defined build paths, methodology standards, and delivery governance.
Position Overview: The Senior Manager role is newly created role designed to build and run the operational backbone of the BIS practice. This person is also a people manager while owning the internal operating infrastructure that allows the practice to scale without losing delivery quality or team cohesion. The Senior Manager is an experienced professional including consulting background with over 10 years of hands-on experience driving and building delivery excellence, can build and sustain a high-performing team culture, and has the operational discipline to manage experienced professionals through a period of rapid growth.
This role demands strong operational leadership, industry knowledge, and technical fluency to drive results in complex client environments.
Key Responsibilities:
Practice Operations & Delivery Coordination:

  • Own the weekly resource coordination sync and alignment across multiple projects — aligning deployment to project demand, managing capacity constraints, and ensuring no engagement is under-resourced
  • Maintain a real-time view of utilization across all active engagements; proactively identify over-allocation, burnout risk, or skill mismatches and resolve before they affect delivery.
  • Build and maintain the practice's operational cadences: team meetings, delivery check-ins, onboarding sequences, and inter-pillar coordination mechanisms.
  • Escalate delivery risks that require leadership action; translate ground-level team intelligence into clear, actionable executive signals without filtering out critical information
  • Ensure the project teams have the tools, templates, methodologies, and standards they need to deliver consistently across different engagement types and client environments
Capability Building:
  • Partner with the project teams to define and maintain the practice's methodology: discovery frameworks, requirements standards, stakeholder engagement approaches, and deliverable quality benchmarks
  • Build a learning and development calendar for the team that reflects real engagement needs — not generic training — including cross-pillar exposure across all pillars.
  • Create and maintain a competency framework that provides clear, credible criteria for performance evaluation and career progression, recognizing that most team members are already highly experienced
  • Drive/support the development of BIS delivery playbooks, templates, and standards for discovery, change management, testing, cutover, and post-implementation support.
  • Identify patterns across engagements where capability gaps surface and systematically address them through targeted development rather than reactive support
  • Use insights from the quarterly coach roundtable to shape new hire onboarding for incoming cohorts, ensuring lessons from active delivery are embedded into how new team members learn the practice
People Leadership & Team Development
  • Lead structured onboarding for incoming new hires, ensuring they integrate into the practice culture and reach delivery readiness within 60-90 days.
  • Serve as a direct people manager for the reporting team that includes senior business analysis professionals with process, data, business/technical requirements and systems/product implementation skillsets.
  • Hold a quarterly coaching roundtable with cross-pillar coaches to aggregate team development signals and translate them into management action
  • Retain and support a team of experienced senior practitioners— understanding the difference between craft recognition and career progression for high-expertise individual contributors
Practice Strategy & Governance
  • Contribute to capacity planning working with leadership to project capacity needs against pipeline and growth targets
  • Partner with leadership on the design of the coaching model, cross-pillar development programs, and any structural adjustments as the practice scales
  • Maintain the operating model documentation: org structure, role definitions, operating norms, and governance processes that align with the team structure on implementation projects.
Continuous Improvement & Quality Assurance
  • Promote continuous improvement through lessons learned, feedback loops, and project retrospectives.
  • Ensure project deliverables meet established quality standards, conduct quality audits and reviews, and implement quality improvement processes.
Educational Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Management, or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • Advanced degree (MBA or Master’s) is preferred.
Required Skills and Experience:
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in technology consulting, professional services, or a related discipline, with demonstrated experience leading or managing teams of senior practitioners.
  • Proven track record as a people manager — comfortable owning performance reviews, difficult conversations, retention risk, and career development for experienced individual contributors
  • Experience working with Agile and Waterfall methodologies in SaaS companies or with system integrators.
  • Strong working knowledge of the four pillars as a discipline: what excellent discovery looks like and how requirements mature through an engagement
  • Experience managing resource deployment and capacity planning in a project-based or consulting environment
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust with experienced peers and direct reports who have strong professional identities and do not require or respond well to directive management styles
  • Comfort operating in a high-growth, structurally evolving environment where processes are being built while delivery is ongoing
  • Strong understanding of utility operations, asset management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Demonstrated experience in team building and leadership, with the ability to inspire and develop talent.
  • Excellent project management skills, including proficiency in project planning, execution, and risk management.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively engage clients and stakeholders at all levels.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage with clients effectively, collaborate with internal teams, and interact with management.
  • Ability to travel domestically and(or) internationally if required.
Preferred Skills:
  • Prior experience in practice operations, delivery management, or capability development role within a consulting firm or technology services organization
  • Familiarity with the cross-functional dynamics between PMO, BA, solution architecture, and engineering in integrated delivery engagements
  • Experience with coaching models, structured mentoring programs, or formal learning and development initiatives in a consulting context
  • Exposure to Big 4 or top-tier consulting operating models — particularly how those firms separate craft leadership from people management at scale
  • Experience hiring and onboarding senior practitioners in a compressed timeline.
  • Certifications: PMP/PMI-ACP, Prosci/Change Management, ITIL, SAFe/Agile or relevant certifications.

Working across AMS sales, account, services, delivery, operations, GPC, and partner teams, the Senior Manager maintains a clear view of pipeline, allocation, utilization, and portfolio health. The role removes execution blockers, leads partner business reviews, and connects in-market demand with global portfolio governance so that partner investments translate into measurable pipeline, customer outcomes, and return.

The role serves as the CEG geo interlock point for partner portfolio execution, connecting CEG demand, delivery fit, and partner capacity with GPC’s partner enablement and ecosystem readiness work while maintaining clear ownership boundaries between CEG delivery excellence and GPC partner capability-building.

  • Own day-to-day execution of the AMS partner portfolio and co-sell motion, aligning strategic partners to qualified customer and account opportunities.

jobs.description:
Skylight is a technology startup building the OS of the family. We make Skylight Calendar, the smart calendar loved by millions of families (plus Wired and Wirecutter). Calendar 2 launched earlier this year to rave reviews, and our newest product, Skylight Buddy, was just named one of TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026.

Our mission is to connect loved ones by creating the world’s simplest products and services that improve family life. Our founders are former venture capitalists and serial entrepreneurs who have scaled this business to $300M+ in annual revenue while being completely bootstrapped and profitable. We get to grow a happy, healthy company focused on making products our customers love without investors breathing down our necks.

Smart, hardworking people who care about making actually meaningful products love working here. People like you. We’re busy inventing new ways to simplify family life and help parents raise great kids – and we need your help! Come invent something new with us.

About the Role:

You are the operational spine of Skylight's logistics function. Where our Director of Logistics owns strategy carrier contracts, compliance posture, SLA frameworks, and systems design you own execution: making sure that every shipment moves as planned, every forwarder and drayage partner is held to their commitments, and exceptions are caught and resolved before they become problems. You'll be the connective tissue between our freight forwarders, 3PL partners, and internal teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with our freight forwarders on day-to-day bookings, exception escalations, and performance follow-ups. You are the primary operational point of contact.
  • Own the forwarder to drayage handoff: ensure cargo moves cleanly from vessel discharge to our FC’s (Reno NV and Indianapolis IN) with no gaps in ownership or communication.
  • Coordinate FC facility transfers, including inbound routing decisions, cross-dock timing, and delivery sequencing.
  • Audit forwarder rates, accessorials, and SLA performance on a recurring basis — flag variances and drive them to resolution.
  • Operate cargo tracking systems (TMS, Forwarder Systems, Internal trackers): maintain shipment visibility across all active lanes, escalate delays proactively, and keep stakeholders informed.
  • Own data and documentation workflows: ensure all shipping documents (commercial invoices, packing lists, BOLs, ISF filings) are captured, filed, and accessible and build the habits and systems that make this reliable at scale.
  • Lead exception and incident management: serve as the point person when things go wrong, a delayed vessel, a drayage no show, a CBP hold, a cargo claim and drive resolution to closure.
  • Provide compliance ops support to the Director of Logistics: assist with ISF filing coordination, CBP exam response, customs document collection, and UFLPA documentation workflows.
  • Continuously improve the processes, tools, and documentation that underpin operational consistency across all lanes and partners.

Requirements

This role is not for everyone. You will thrive here if you:

  • Can find the 1-2 things that actually drive outcomes or that will really make a difference for any given goal.
  • Feel comfortable in ambiguity. You don’t need a roadmap handed to you—you’ll make one.
  • Can both execute while designing repeatable processes that work in practice.
  • Care deeply. You show up with curiosity, vulnerability, and good intent.
  • Own the problem, fix the system. You don't patch the same issue twice — you find root cause and build a process that prevents recurrence.
  • Bridge ops and tech. You can look at a workflow, articulate what a system needs to do, and work with engineers or no-code tools to make it repeatable and scalable.
  • Own the problem, fix the system. Identify the root cause, prevent the recurrence
  • Bridge Ops and Tech - translate workflow needs into buildable requirements

Must-Haves:

  • 4–7 years of experience in freight forwarding, 3PL, or shipper-side logistics operations with hands-on carrier and forwarder management.
  • Strong working knowledge of international freight: ocean FCL/LCL, air freight, and domestic drayage operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to own exceptions, incidents, and escalations in a fast-moving environment you finish what you start.
  • Comfortable with data: you can work in Google Sheets or Excel, build trackers, and produce reporting without needing someone to set it up for you.
  • Baseline familiarity with customs and trade compliance workflows ISF, CBP entry process basics, document collection even if compliance is not your primary background.
  • Clear written communicator: you correspond professionally with carriers, forwarders, and 3PLs, and draft internal updates that are crisp and complete.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset: comfortable in fast-moving environments, able to deal with ambiguity, take ownership, and continuously improve.
  • Process design and systems thinking: spots what’s broken, designs something better, and sees it through to adoption — has translated an operational need into a tool, tracker, or automation, and can work alongside engineers or analysts to build it right.


Nice to Haves:

  • Experience working with major freight forwarders (Expeditors, Flexport, Crane Worldwide, or similar).
  • Familiarity with drayage and 3PL coordination in transpacific lanes to LA/LGB, or the Midwest
  • Experience with TMS or shipment visibility platforms (OSCA, Setlog, project44, FourKites, or similar).
  • Customs brokerage coordination experience (CBP holds, ISF corrections, entry review, standard customs documentation).
  • Experience in a consumer goods or eCommerce company with an omnichannel distribution model.
  • Prior experience managing or mentoring junior logistics staff.

Our Commitment:

We value diverse experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives—and we hire kind, thoughtful people who care deeply about their work. If you're reading this and think, “I don’t check every box,” but still feel excited about the role: Apply. We want to hear from you.

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package includes:

  • Competitive Salary + Equity Package
  • 401K matching
  • Wellness, learning, and home-office budgets
  • Health, Dental & Vision Medical Plans
  • Tremendous autonomy to set the direction of your work
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Company holidays on the first Friday of every month (Excluding November, December, and January)

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $110k-$130k per year. This range reflects the compensation Skylight reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, which may include experience, qualifications, skills, education, geographic location, and internal equity. Skylight also offers benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and paid time off.

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Principal Engineer

College Board - Technology 

Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office).

Type: This is a full-time position 

About the Team 

College Board Technology teams have a key role to play in the organization’s ability to deliver against its strategic priorities. To do this most effectively, we’ve developed a culture around a set of principles. In Technology, we are organized as teams dedicated to products. And we say products, not projects because in software, projects are subject to abandonware, but products get better over time. They get better because we wake up every day thinking about how to improve our products.

Engineers and architects at College Board exist as a group of poly skilled professionals working in swarms. And, while we may help to mentor and guide others, our critical work is to code, not manage. Our goal is to free creativity by removing dependencies between teams and we do that architecturally and infrastructurally so that one team’s innovation is not burdensome to other teams. We also make war on administrivia and context switching. This approach relies on our ability to hire, retain, and engage skilled talent.

We are committed to remaining current with new technologies, and this requires a focus on learning and development. We challenge all engineers and architects to keep learning because we know technology will not stop changing, and we are committed to supporting this growth. We’ll either fall behind or keep learning for the rest of our careers. We also know that elite technologists don’t want to work in backwaters, so we never again want to fall far behind in the technology we use.

About the Opportunity  

As the Principal Engineer, you will demonstrate success leading large, strategic, or complex areas that have clear impact to the domain. You are a highly skilled, experienced, and motivated Engineering Leader who will own setting architectural direction for a broader domain; help evolve systems toward it; and be able to influence and deliver initiatives with organizational impact and priority. Your expertiseand desire to maintain awareness and knowledge of the emerging technology trends within the industry will help support the College Board’s products.

Strategy & Design Leadership (60%)

  • Set architectural direction for domains and systems.
  • Deliver upon initiatives with organizational impact.
  • Define technical strategy that improves products, infrastructure, security, processes, and organization, while staying abreast of risks and opportunities that influence strategy.
  • Design and implement systems and frameworks that can succeed in the long-term.
  • Provide exceptional leadership and technical innovations to features that span boundaries across engineering teams.

Coaching & Collaboration (40%)

  • Be a great partner, working across technical teams to build sustainable contracts looking out for the good of system vs. what might be easiest for a sole product.
  • Work closely with development teams, product management, and other stakeholders to ensure that architecture supports the needs of all business units.
  • Foster strong working relationships with other technologists outside our team.
  • Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Security teams to ensure that the architecture integrates smoothly with all parts of the technology ecosystem.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence decision-making, and mentor developers.
  • Play a critical role in coaching and mentoring junior engineers.
  • Contribute content and facilitation for the Full Stack Technical Education program.
  • Support recruiting and hiring for various engineering teams and positions.

About you, you have:

  • 10+ years of experience in software systems, programming, database development, and infrastructure development and administration.
  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar experience with fundamentals
  • A track record of influencing and delivering initiatives with organizational impact.
  • An aptitude for directly engaging clients and users to gain strong understanding of their holistic needs.
  • An orientation towards teaching and developing junior employees.
  • A collaborative mindset prioritizing team success over individual accolades.
  • Passion for working in an iterative development environment.
  • Ability to solve complex problems using divergent thinking resulting in innovative solutions.
  • Authorization to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Technical athleticism:

  • An ability to break down complex initiatives into simple systems.
  • Evaluate and recommend tools, technologies, and processes to ensure the continuous improvement of software systems.
  • Deep technical domain knowledge: apps, services, systems, or frameworks
  • Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with a growing set of languages, with experience in JavaScript (especially React and Node), Python, and TypeScript
  • Strong knowledge of the AWS cloud platform and experience working with AWS resources such as Lambda, SNS, SQS, S3, Kinesis, Step Functions, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, DynamoDB

About Our Process 

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

About Our Benefits and Compensation

College Board offers a competitive benefits and compensation program that attracts top talent looking to make a difference in education. As a self-sustaining non-profit, we believe in compensating employees equitably in relation to each other, their qualifications, their impact, and the relevant market.

The hiring range for a new employee in this position is $220,000to $230,000.

College Board differentiates salaries by location so where you live will narrow the portion of this range in which you can expect a salary. Your salary will be carefullydetermined based on your location, relevant experience, the external labor market, and the pay of College Board employees in similar roles.College Board strives to provide our best offer up front based onthis criteria.

Your salary is only one part of all that College Board offers, including but not limited to:

  • A comprehensive package designed to support the well-being of employees and their families and promote education. Our robust benefits package includes health, dental, and vision insurance, generous paid time off, paid parental leave, fertility benefits, pet insurance, tuition assistance, retirement benefits, and more
  • Recognition of exceptional performance through annual bonuses, salary growth over time through market increases, and opportunities for merit raises and promotions based on increased scope of responsibility
  • A job that matters, a team that cares, and a place to learn, innovate and thrive

​

You can expect to have transparent conversations about benefits and compensation with our recruiters throughout your application process.

About Our Culture 

Our community matters, and we strive to practice and improve our culture daily. Here are some headlines: 

  • We are motivated to positively impact the educational and career trajectories of millions of students a year 
  • We prioritize building a diverse and inclusive team where every employee can thrive, and every voice is heard

  • We value learning and growth; we offer formal and informal ways to lead through your superpowers, sharpen your strengths, and meet your development goals

jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryAdvantixxRCM is seeking an experienced Patient Access Specialist to support the front end of the revenue cycle for our healthcare clients.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

AdvantixxRCM is seeking an experienced Patient Access Specialist to support the front end of the revenue cycle for our healthcare clients.

This position is responsible for insurance eligibility verification, benefits verification, prior authorization, referral requirements, patient coverage review, and identification of potential reimbursement issues before services are rendered.

The Patient Access Specialist plays an important role in preventing avoidable denials and ensuring healthcare providers have accurate insurance information before treating patients.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Verify patient insurance eligibility before scheduled services.
  • Confirm active coverage and effective dates.
  • Verify patient demographics and insurance information.
  • Verify primary and secondary insurance coverage.
  • Identify coordination-of-benefits issues.
  • Verify provider participation/network status when appropriate.
  • Review payer-specific requirements.
  • Determine whether prior authorization is required.
  • Determine whether a referral is required.
  • Submit prior authorization requests.
  • Obtain and submit supporting clinical documentation as required.
  • Follow up with insurance companies regarding pending authorization requests.
  • Track authorization status through determination.
  • Document authorization numbers, effective dates, approved services/units, and expiration dates.
  • Monitor existing authorizations to prevent expiration or exhaustion of approved visits/units.
  • Coordinate referral requirements.
  • Communicate authorization or eligibility problems to the client before services whenever possible.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of all verification and authorization activities.

Benefits Verification

The Patient Access Specialist may verify:

  • Deductibles
  • Copayments
  • Coinsurance
  • Out-of-pocket amounts
  • Coverage limitations
  • Service-specific benefits
  • Visit limitations
  • Authorization requirements
  • Referral requirements
  • Network requirements
  • Primary/secondary payer information

The employee must accurately document information obtained from payer portals or insurance representatives and avoid representing benefit verification as a guarantee of payment.

Prior Authorization

Responsibilities include:

  • Determine whether authorization is required.
  • Initiate authorization requests.
  • Submit required documentation.
  • Communicate with payer utilization management departments.
  • Follow up on pending authorizations.
  • Track authorization decisions.
  • Document authorization/reference numbers.
  • Track approved CPT/services when applicable.
  • Track approved visits or units.
  • Track authorization effective and expiration dates.
  • Request extensions or additional visits when appropriate.
  • Escalate authorization denials requiring clinical review or appeal.
  • Notify the appropriate client/team when services are not authorized.

Denial Prevention

A major responsibility of this position is preventing avoidable denials before claims are submitted.

The Patient Access Specialist should identify potential issues involving:

  • Inactive insurance
  • Incorrect member information
  • Incorrect payer
  • Coordination of benefits
  • Missing prior authorization
  • Expired authorization
  • Exhausted visits/units
  • Missing referral
  • Out-of-network provider
  • Service exclusions
  • Benefit limitations
  • Incorrect provider/service location information

Issues should be communicated promptly to the appropriate client or AdvantixxRCM department.

Internal Coordination

The Patient Access Specialist works closely with the:

Medical Billing Specialist for claim-related insurance information.

A/R Specialist for eligibility-related unpaid claims.

Denial Management Specialist for authorization and eligibility denials.

Credentialing Specialist for provider participation/enrollment concerns.

Client Account Manager for information needed from healthcare clients.

Operations Manager for escalated issues and payer trends.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 1–2 years of healthcare insurance verification, prior authorization, medical billing, patient access, or RCM experience preferred.
  • Experience verifying insurance eligibility and benefits.
  • Experience obtaining prior authorizations.
  • Familiarity with Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care, and commercial insurance.
  • Experience using insurance payer portals.
  • Understanding of healthcare insurance terminology.
  • Knowledge of deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, and out-of-pocket responsibilities.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to manage multiple pending authorizations and deadlines simultaneously.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous RCM or medical billing company experience.
  • Experience with multiple healthcare specialties.
  • Experience with Availity and other payer portals.
  • Familiarity with CPT/HCPCS terminology.
  • Experience working with Medicare and Medicaid.
  • Experience handling referrals.
  • Experience with medical necessity documentation.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated based on:

  • Eligibility verification accuracy
  • Prior authorization completion
  • Authorization turnaround
  • Follow-up timeliness
  • Documentation accuracy
  • Authorization tracking
  • Prevention of eligibility/authorization-related denials
  • Productivity
  • Client communication
  • Compliance with payer requirements

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who understands that successful revenue cycle management begins before the claim is submitted.

The Patient Access Specialist should proactively identify insurance, eligibility, authorization, and referral issues so they can be addressed before they become denials or lost revenue.

We need someone who takes ownership of pending authorizations and does not consider the job finished simply because an authorization request was submitted.

Why Join AdvantixxRCM?

AdvantixxRCM is building a comprehensive revenue cycle organization focused on improving reimbursement while preventing avoidable revenue loss for healthcare providers.

We value accuracy, accountability, urgency, communication, and problem-solving.

Position Summary

AdvantixxRCM is seeking an experienced Payment Posting Specialist responsible for accurately posting and reconciling insurance and patient payments for our healthcare clients.

This position manages ERAs, EOBs, EFTs, insurance payments, patient payments, contractual adjustments, unapplied payments, credit balances, and payment discrepancies while ensuring financial activity is accurately reflected in each client's practice management system.

The ideal candidate is highly accurate, organized, comfortable working with high transaction volumes, and able to identify reimbursement discrepancies that require additional investigation.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Post insurance payments from ERAs and EOBs.
  • Post EFT, check, and other payer payments.
  • Post patient payments when assigned.
  • Review electronic remittance files for accuracy.
  • Apply contractual adjustments according to payer requirements and established procedures.
  • Accurately allocate payments to the appropriate patient, encounter, claim, and service line.
  • Identify and research unmatched or unapplied payments.
  • Research missing payments and posting discrepancies.
  • Review zero-payment remittances.
  • Identify denials and route them to the appropriate billing or denial team.
  • Identify potential insurance underpayments.
  • Identify overpayments and credit balances.
  • Assist with refund research and processing according to company procedures.
  • Correct payment posting errors.
  • Review secondary insurance balances following primary payer processing.
  • Ensure patient responsibility is transferred accurately based on payer adjudication.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of posting and reconciliation activity.

Payment Reconciliation

The Payment Posting Specialist will also be responsible for helping ensure that money received matches money posted.

Responsibilities include:

  • Reconcile EFTs against ERAs.
  • Reconcile checks against EOBs.
  • Compare bank/payment information with system posting records when authorized.
  • Identify missing ERAs or EOBs.
  • Research unidentified deposits.
  • Research duplicate payments.
  • Identify incorrect adjustments.
  • Identify payments posted to incorrect accounts.
  • Maintain reconciliation reports.
  • Escalate unresolved discrepancies to the Operations Manager.

EOB & ERA Review

The successful candidate must understand:

  • Allowed amounts
  • Paid amounts
  • Contractual adjustments
  • Deductibles
  • Copayments
  • Coinsurance
  • Non-covered charges
  • Patient responsibility
  • Denial codes
  • CARC/RARC codes
  • Primary and secondary payer processing
  • Coordination of benefits

A/R & Denial Coordination

Payment posting is an important part of the overall revenue cycle.

The Payment Posting Specialist will communicate identified issues to the appropriate team, including:

A/R Specialist — unpaid or incorrectly processed claims

Denial Management Specialist — denied claims requiring investigation or appeal

Medical Billing Specialist — claims requiring corrections

Credentialing Specialist — enrollment-related payment issues

Operations Manager — significant payment, reconciliation, or payer discrepancies

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 1–2 years of medical payment posting, medical billing, or healthcare revenue cycle experience preferred.
  • Experience posting insurance ERAs/EOBs.
  • Understanding of healthcare reimbursement.
  • Ability to interpret EOBs and ERAs.
  • Understanding of deductibles, copayments, coinsurance, contractual adjustments, and patient responsibility.
  • Familiarity with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance.
  • Strong numerical and reconciliation skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong computer and data-entry skills.
  • Ability to maintain accuracy while processing high transaction volumes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience with an RCM or medical billing company.
  • Experience handling multiple practices or clients.
  • Medicare and Medicaid payment posting experience.
  • Experience with electronic remittance and EFT reconciliation.
  • Experience researching credit balances and unapplied payments.
  • Familiarity with multiple EHR/Practice Management systems.
  • Experience with clearinghouses and payer portals.
  • CPB or similar billing certification is a plus.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated based on:

  • Payment posting accuracy
  • Payment posting turnaround time
  • ERA/EOB processing
  • Reconciliation accuracy
  • Unapplied payment resolution
  • Adjustment accuracy
  • Identification of payment discrepancies
  • Documentation quality
  • Productivity
  • Compliance with client and company procedures

Accuracy is critical. AdvantixxRCM does not prioritize posting volume at the expense of financial accuracy.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who understands that payment posting is more than entering numbers.

The successful candidate should recognize when an EOB doesn't look right, identify discrepancies, determine whether the issue involves a denial, underpayment, adjustment, patient responsibility, or posting error, and route or resolve the issue appropriately.

We want someone who takes ownership of ensuring payments are posted accurately, reconciled properly, and accounted for completely.

Why Join AdvantixxRCM?

AdvantixxRCM is building a high-performance revenue cycle organization where accuracy, accountability, productivity, and financial integrity are essential.

This position provides exposure to multiple healthcare organizations, payers, specialties, and revenue cycle processes while providing opportunities for professional growth.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

jobs.excerpt: Build and run the GHL systems that turn leads into members and keep members coming back — and be the go-to support for the gym team using them.
jobs.description:
Build and run the GHL systems that turn leads into members and keep members coming back — and be the go-to support for the gym team using them.

About the Role

Seamless Assist places AI-fluent virtual assistants with growing businesses and builds the automation systems they run. We are hiring a GoHighLevel Specialist on behalf of our client, a US-based gym business. This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in the Philippines.

The gym runs its lead follow-up, trial bookings, member communication, and retention campaigns through GoHighLevel. This hire owns that platform end to end — building the automations that drive memberships and supporting the owner and front-desk team who use it every day.

Culture: owner-led, fast-moving fitness business. Clear ownership, proactive communication, and steady improvement over perfection.

Role Details

  • Industry: Health & Fitness — Gym
  • Reports to: Gym Owner
  • Type: Full-time · 40 hours/week
  • Hours: US Eastern Time (EST) business hours
  • Rate: TBD
  • Location: Remote — Philippines
  • Tools: GoHighLevel (GHL), Zapier / Make / n8n, gym management software (e.g., Mindbody, ABC Glofox, PushPress, Zen Planner), Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Google Workspace

Role Overview

Every lead, trial, and member touchpoint at the gym runs through GoHighLevel. The GHL Specialist will design and maintain those systems — from the first ad inquiry to the membership renewal — and provide responsive, first-line support to the gym owner and staff.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between building and supporting in the same day: fixing a broken trial-booking workflow in the morning, walking the front desk through the pipeline after lunch, and documenting both so it doesn't happen twice. The right person treats every support request as a signal of what to systematize next.

Key Responsibilities

GHL Automation & Build

  • Build and maintain lead nurture workflows — speed-to-lead SMS/email, trial class and intro session booking, and follow-up for leads who don't book
  • Automate the member journey — class and appointment reminders, no-show follow-up, new-member onboarding, and milestone check-ins
  • Run retention and reactivation campaigns — lapsed and frozen members, expiring memberships, failed payments, and win-back offers
  • Set up and manage pipelines, calendars, forms, surveys, landing pages/funnels, custom fields, and tags
  • Build and send email and SMS campaigns — promotions, challenges, events, and monthly member newsletters
  • Automate review requests and referral campaigns to grow the gym's reputation
  • Integrate GHL with the gym's management software, payment tools, and ad lead sources (Facebook/Instagram lead forms) via native integrations, Zapier, Make, n8n, or webhooks

Customer Support

  • Serve as first-line GHL support for the gym owner and front-desk/sales staff
  • Manage and respond to member and lead inquiries in the GHL Conversations inbox (SMS, email, social DMs) within agreed response times
  • Troubleshoot issues: broken workflows, failed sends, calendar sync errors, A2P/10DLC and email deliverability problems, integration failures
  • Train gym staff on using GHL — pipelines, conversations, booking, and reporting — through live walkthroughs and short recorded videos
  • Escalate billing, platform-level bugs, or out-of-scope requests to the gym owner with a clear summary

Reporting, Documentation & Improvement

  • Build dashboards that track leads, trial bookings, show rates, conversions to membership, and retention
  • Write SOPs and how-to guides for every recurring build and support issue
  • Audit the account for broken, duplicate, or unused workflows and recommend clean-up
  • Track recurring issues and propose automations or fixes that remove them at the source
  • Use AI tools to speed up campaign copy, troubleshooting, and documentation

Who Will Succeed

"Builds it right, explains it simply, and fixes the root cause — not just the ticket."

  • Has built real GHL automations for live businesses — ideally gyms, studios, or other membership businesses
  • Understands how a gym makes money: leads, trials, memberships, retention
  • Patient and clear with busy, non-technical owners and staff — explains a workflow without jargon
  • Systems thinker who documents as they go and hates fixing the same problem twice
  • Takes initiative — spots what is broken or missing and raises it before the owner does

Experience & Skills

Required

  • GHL expertise: 2+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience building workflows, pipelines, funnels, and campaigns for live businesses
  • Customer support: 1+ year providing customer or technical support (tickets, live chat, calls, or client success)
  • Integrations: Working knowledge of Zapier, Make, n8n, or webhooks to connect GHL with other tools
  • AI fluency: Actively uses AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to build, write, and troubleshoot faster — specific tools and use cases confirmed at screening
  • Time zone compatibility: Able to work US Eastern Time (EST) business hours from the Philippines
  • Strong communication: Exceptional written and spoken English — clear, friendly, and concise with owners, staff, and members; assessed at screening
  • Deliverability: Understanding of email and SMS deliverability, including A2P 10DLC registration
  • Remote setup: Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated workspace

Preferred

  • Experience with gyms, fitness studios, or other membership-based businesses
  • Experience with gym management software (Mindbody, ABC Glofox, PushPress, Zen Planner, or similar)
  • GHL Admin certification
  • Familiarity with GHL Conversation AI / AI Employee features
  • Experience running Facebook/Instagram lead-gen campaigns into GHL

jobs.title: Security Operations Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Revizto enables the people behind the world’s most important structures to do their best work.
jobs.description:
Revizto enables the people behind the world’s most important structures to do their best work. We connect architects, engineers, contractors, and owners in one shared 2D/3D environment to help deliver complex projects on time and on budget. From airports and hospitals to data centers and large-scale infrastructure, Revizto supports industry leaders in reducing risk, improving collaboration, and delivering better project outcomes.

Built on a gaming engine, Revizto is designed to handle the scale and complexity of modern construction projects while remaining fast, reliable, and accessible across devices and environments — whether teams are in the office or on site.

Key Responsibilities & Requirements

  • Security Monitoring & Investigation: Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts and incidents across cloud, endpoint, and SaaS environments, ensuring timely identification and assessment of potential threats.
  • Incident Response Management: Lead and coordinate security incident response activities, including containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and preparation of comprehensive post-incident reports.
  • Threat Detection Engineering: Develop, test, and continuously refine security detection rules to improve accuracy, reduce false positives, and maintain detection coverage aligned with the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Proactive Threat Hunting: Conduct proactive threat-hunting activities across cloud, endpoint, and identity telemetry to identify suspicious behavior, emerging threats, and potential security compromises.
  • Security Log Analysis: Analyze and correlate security logs and telemetry from AWS, Microsoft Azure/Entra ID, Kubernetes, endpoints, and SaaS applications to detect and investigate potential security incidents.
  • Cloud Security & Vulnerability Management: Investigate cloud security findings and vulnerability alerts, collaborate with relevant system owners, and support timely remediation of identified security risks.
  • Security Logging & Visibility: Maintain the health, completeness, and reliability of existing security log sources while identifying and onboarding additional sources to improve monitoring and detection coverage.
  • Incident Response Documentation: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve incident response runbooks and escalation procedures to ensure consistent and effective handling of security events.
Requirements
  • Professional Experience: At least 3 years of hands-on experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, or security detection role.
  • SIEM & EDR Technologies: Practical experience working with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solutions, preferably Microsoft Sentinel, and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) platforms, preferably CrowdStrike Falcon.
  • Detection Engineering & Query Languages: Ability to write, analyze, optimize, and tune security detection queries using Kusto Query Language (KQL) or similar query languages.
  • Cybersecurity Fundamentals: Solid understanding of common cyberattack techniques, threat behaviors, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework, combined with a strong foundation in AWS and Azure cloud security principles.
  • End-to-End Incident Response: Proven experience managing security incidents throughout their entire lifecycle, from initial alert investigation and triage through containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and post-incident reporting.
  • Security Frameworks & Standards: Knowledge of established information security frameworks and standards, including ISO 27001, NIST, CIS, and SOC 2.
  • English Proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or higher proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Hands-on experience conducting proactive threat-hunting activities to identify and investigate potential security threats.
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes and container security principles, including common risks and security considerations in containerized environments.
  • Basic scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to support security investigations, analysis, and operational tasks.
  • One or more relevant professional certifications, such as GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GCTI, Microsoft SC-200, or CrowdStrike CCFA/CCFH.
Personal & Professional Competencies
  • Composure Under Pressure: Ability to remain calm, structured, and focused when managing security incidents and working under time-sensitive conditions.
  • Communication & Reporting: Strong written communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain security incidents, technical findings, and their impact to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Collaboration & Ownership: A proactive team player who can work effectively both independently and collaboratively, take ownership of responsibilities, and continuously identify opportunities to improve security processes.
  • Relationship Building: Ability to establish and maintain strong, productive working relationships with colleagues across teams and at all organizational levels.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Security Operations Engineer to join our Information Security team and play a key role in protecting Revizto's cloud infrastructure, endpoints, and SaaS environments.

In this role, you will be at the forefront of identifying, investigating, and responding to security threats, ensuring that potential risks are detected and addressed effectively. You will take ownership of security incidents throughout their lifecycle, continuously improve threat detection capabilities, and proactively identify vulnerabilities and emerging threats.

Working closely with Engineering, DevOps, and IT teams, you will contribute to strengthening our overall security posture, enhancing detection coverage, and reducing incident detection and response times. This is an opportunity to take ownership of meaningful security challenges and directly contribute to the protection and resilience of Revizto's technology environment.

Why Join Us

  • Recognised as one of Switzerland’s Best Managed Companies by Deloitte for three consecutive years from 2024 through
  • Company-wide trips, including Armenia in 2023 and Switzerland in 2025, with more to come
  • A flexible, employee-focused culture
  • An innovative and collaborative team environment
  • Great working conditions designed to support your best work

We can only accept applications from candidates based in Germany, Armenia, France or the UK.

** EventMobi is a remote-first company and this is a fully remote position. You may reside anywhere in Canada provided you are able to accommodate Eastern time working hours.

ABOUT YOU

Your events experience goes beyond internal company gatherings. You’ve worked in a professional events environment — a conference, association, agency, or corporate events team — and you think in run-of-shows, registration flows, and attendee journeys. You understand the full event lifecycle, from planning and logistics through on-site execution and post-event wrap-up. Extra credit if you’ve worked directly with clients or attendees and know what it takes to deliver a seamless event experience.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN US?

We are an award-winning event tech startup with teams in Toronto, Berlin, and Manila, proudly serving thousands of customers worldwide. Our commitment to innovation drives us to continuously enhance our products, keeping us at the forefront of the latest event technology trends.

As an Event Success Manager at EventMobi, you’ll play a key role in empowering our customers’ success. Acting as their strategic advisor, you’ll spend your days proactively educating, onboarding, strategizing, problem-solving, and implementing cutting-edge technology and production solutions for our top-tier clients. Collaboration is at the heart of your role—you’ll work closely with our Account Management, Product, and Customer Support teams to ensure our customers not only love using EventMobi but return year after year.

WHAT YOUR WORK WILL FOCUS ON:

  • Serve as a trusted partner and strategic advisor to professional event planners and marketers at large corporations and associations, helping them implement event technology and execute successful events.
  • Lead customer onboarding, strategy sessions, and relationship-building to drive adoption and value generation from EventMobi products.
  • Guide customers through technical product training with an events-first mindset — delivering hands-on enablement that prepares teams to execute high-impact events on our platform.
  • Manage full-service event contracts end-to-end, overseeing multiple concurrent events with varying scopes, timelines, and complexity.
  • Lead proactive project management across the entire event lifecycle — from planning and build through live execution and post-event follow-up.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Customer Support, Product, AV, and Sales) to coordinate requirements, resolve issues, and deliver seamless event experiences.
  • Monitor customer health and success metrics, identify risks early, and take action to drive adoption, retention, and long-term success.
  • Conduct regular customer touchpoints including strategy sessions and quarterly reviews to align on outcomes and optimize future events.
  • Maintain accurate account, project, and communication records in HubSpot and internal tools.
  • Support live events as needed, including occasional evenings, weekends, or travel for on-site or hybrid event support.
  • Share customer feedback and improvement ideas with internal teams to continuously enhance processes, products, and the overall customer experience.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS:

  • At least 5 years of hands-on experience planning or coordinating professional B2B events: conferences, trade shows, corporate meetings, or association events.
    *Experience with internal company events alone does not meet this requirement.
  • Demonstrated experience using event technology — registration platforms, event apps, or virtual event platforms. Familiarity with tools such as Cvent, Eventbrite, Bizzabo, Hopin, or similar is required.
  • A genuine interest in technology and its impact on the events industry.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical event organizers.
  • Top-notch organizational skills: you manage multiple projects simultaneously, document thoroughly, and follow through consistently.
  • An empathetic, problem-solving mindset — you care about delivering great outcomes for your clients.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • 2-year college diploma or 4-year degree in hospitality or events management.
  • Experience working with HubSpot, Salesforce, or other CRMs.
  • Previous experience supporting customer onboarding for technical products or SaaS platforms

WHAT WILL YOU GET FROM EVENTMOBI?

  • Compensation: Pay range between $65K and $80K CAD, according to experience. + Stock Options + Benefits
  • Time-Off: 3-weeks vacation + 1-week Sick Days + 3-summer days + your birthday is a holiday (seriously! log-off and hang out with the fam or go do something fun) + opportunities to meet your co-workers in person throughout the year
  • Benefits: Dental, Health, Life, Mental Health Consultations (Green Shield Health Inc)
  • Tools: Top of the line hardware and the best collaboration software for remote work so you can be as productive as possible while working from home
  • The Best Coworkers Ever: If you ask anyone that has worked at EventMobi, they will tell you that their fellow Mobiers are the best part of their experience! Don't underestimate the positive impact of caring co-workers have on your everyday happiness.

REMOTE WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS:

  • You have a safe, comfortable, and ergonomic workspace and working environment - a private and quiet workspace is a vital requirement for doing your best work!
  • You have a reliable internet connection capable of participating in video calls, with at least 30Mbps download speed

ABOUT EVENTMOBI

We're focused on building the most comprehensive event management platform to help conference organizers create engaging event experiences. We believe live events bring people together and enable positive change. Over 30,000+ events in 70+ countries from major brands such as Shoppers Drug Mart, to amazing non-profits such as American Psychiatric Nurses Association and Canadian Real Estate Association have trusted EventMobi’s suite of software technology to manage their events and engage their attendees.

If you are interested in seeing EventMobi in action, check out some of the videos below:

  • The Experience Manager Platform
  • The EventMobi Mobile Event App
  • The Product Tour
  • Top brands and organizations from around the world have used EventMobi’s event app technology to create incredible event experiences - hear directly from our customers.

APPLICATION NOTE

As part of your application, you will be asked to describe a professional event you planned or coordinated — including the type of event, number of attendees, and the tools you used. This is a required field and helps us understand your events background.

EventMobi is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Salary: Pay range between $65K and $80K CAD, according to experience.
