jobs.excerpt: About Autoscribe Autoscribe Corporation is a trusted leader in payment processing and consumer finance solutions, serving businesses nationwide since 1989.
jobs.description:
About Autoscribe
Autoscribe Corporation is a trusted leader in payment processing and consumer finance solutions, serving businesses nationwide since 1989. We specialize in high-volume consumer-to-business payment processing and fraud-identification services, helping organizations streamline transactions, reduce risk, and improve cash flow.

Our culture blends financial discipline with innovation—we’re a company that values precision, accountability, and forward-thinking problem solving. As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a Controller who is not only technically strong, but also excited to build, optimize, and lead within a dynamic fintech environment.

The Opportunity
Autoscribe is seeking an experienced, analytical, and hands-on Controller to lead our accounting function. This role is central to the financial integrity of our business—overseeing high-volume transaction accounting, ensuring accuracy in earnings and cost of goods sold, and strengthening the systems that support our growth.

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Controller will play a key role in financial strategy, operational execution, and decision support. This is a high-impact leadership position ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, detail-driven environment and wants to help shape the financial future of a growing organization.

What You’ll Do

Accounting Operations & Oversight

  • Lead all day-to-day accounting operations including AP, AR, general ledger, and payroll
  • Ensure accuracy, efficiency, and scalability of accounting processes

Payment Reconciliation & Transaction Integrity

  • Oversee reconciliation of high-volume payment flows and trust account disbursements
  • Ensure precise matching of incoming funds, processor settlements, and merchant payouts
  • Serve as a critical control point for transaction accuracy and financial integrity

Financial Reporting

  • Prepare timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with GAAP
  • Deliver clear, actionable financial insights to leadership

Internal Controls & Compliance

  • Partner with the Chief Compliance Officer to strengthen internal controls and fraud prevention measures
  • Ensure compliance with PCI-DSS, SOC 2 standards, and applicable regulations

Treasury & Cash Management

  • Manage cash concentration and movement from trust accounts
  • Oversee forecasting and liquidity planning to support operational needs

Tax & External Coordination

  • Act as liaison with external tax partners to ensure timely and accurate filings

Strategic Finance & Business Support

  • Analyze program and campaign performance, including yield and profitability
  • Support annual budgeting, variance analysis, and financial planning
  • Provide insights that guide growth and operational decision-making

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the accounting team
  • Build a culture of accountability, precision, and continuous improvement

What You Bring

Education & Credentials

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance (required)
  • CPA, CMA, or CCM strongly preferred

Experience

  • 8+ years of progressive accounting experience
  • 4+ years in a leadership or supervisory role
  • Experience in fintech, payment processing, or high-volume transaction environments strongly preferred

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel skills and experience with accounting systems
  • SQL or data querying experience is a plus

Knowledge

  • Strong command of GAAP
  • Familiarity with tax considerations including Section 179

PT 16 to 32 hours a week

Who we are

At Televero Health, we’re building something extraordinary driven by innovation, compassion, and a relentless commitment to delivering measurable and exceptional behavioral health care. Our unique virtual model supports diverse populations across the lifespan through a team-based approach that includes therapists, nurse practitioners, psychiatrists, psychologists, crisis support, and operational professionals. We deliver rapid access to care with appointments available within seven days and same-day support for urgent needs. At the heart of our mission is our team, and we invest deeply in each member—offering robust education, top-tier support, and evolving systems that empower you to do your best work. As the #54 fastest-growing private company in the U.S. on the 2025 Inc. 5000 list, we’re proud of the excellence our teams bring to every patient interaction.

If you're passionate about making a meaningful impact, we invite you to join us in transforming behavioral health care together.

Your role

Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP)

Your day-to-day expectations

  • Provide services via the Televero Telehealth platform, both live and offline
  • Maintain a high quality of care consistent with the practice’s goals
  • When not treating patients, assisting with, but not limited to, developing our behavioral health practice to include protocol development, training, and engaging in clinical behavioral health discussions with prospective clients
  • Prescribe medications and close out medication tickets in a timely manner
  • Take notes and assign billing codes within the EMR, including no-shows
  • Closeout documentation within twenty-four hours of the patient encounter
  • Review and interpret any patient assessments that we use in the practice
  • Attend monthly peer, supervisory, and educational meetings

Your workday

This position is 100% virtual.

We are open from 6:00 am to 6:00 pm PST, Monday through Sunday.

This position is part-time from 16 to 32 hours of patient time per week.

We will work with you to ensure a flexible schedule.

This role reports to Televero's Director of Nursing and a Pod Leader (Supervisory MD).

Experience to thrive

  • Bachelor's degree in psychology, social work or related field.
  • Completion of CCNE-accredited Master's of Science in Nursing (MSN) with a Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP) specialization.
  • Active PMHNP License in Washington.
  • Minimum 2 years' experience.
  • Two or more years of Telehealth experience.
  • Two or more years of Outpatient experience.
  • Two or more years of Prescribing experience.
  • Experience diagnosing and treating Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD).

Foundations for success

  • Responsive, strong communication both written and verbally.
  • A culturally aware and inclusive mindset in every interaction.
  • Strong collaboration skills and a team-oriented approach
  • Effective time management and organization in a virtual environment.
  • Reliable internet connection and confident navigating technology – including Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel, and Teams).
  • EMR experience and ability to navigate evolving systems.
  • Resourcefulness and independent, on the spot problem-solving capabilities.
  • A passion for learning, growing, and making a meaningful impact in a dynamic organization.

Benefits that grow with you

  • Federal holidays are company-observed
  • Liability insurance coverage is included
  • Full support for billing and credentialing
  • Dedicated clinical and operational resources including supervising physicians
  • Compensation for late cancellations and no-shows
  • Educational opportunities including in-house CEU/CME credits
  • A steady stream of patients with intakes scheduled for you
  • And more benefits on the way – we are always improving for our clinicians!

All questions included in our application must be answered to move forward in the interview process.

jobs.description:
VIP After-Hours Emergency Corporate Travel Consultant

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced VIP Corporate Travel Consultant to join our Emergency Customer Care (ECC) team, delivering white-glove, personalized service to C-Suite executives and high-profile clients during after-hours, overnight, weekend, and holiday periods. This role is uniquely designed for a seasoned travel professional who thrives in high-pressure situations and understands that for our VIP clientele, exceptional service never sleeps.

As a VIP Emergency Customer Care Consultant, you will manage urgent and complex domestic and international travel requests, including air, hotel, car, and ground transportation, via Sabre GDS, while maintaining the highest standard of professionalism, discretion, and client satisfaction. You will serve as a trusted advisor and first point of contact when our most valued clients need assistance the most.

Before you begin your role, you will complete a four-week paid training program designed to boost your industry knowledge, train you on contract airfares, and sharpen your Sabre skills, ensuring you are fully equipped to deliver the VIP experience our clients expect around the clock.

**Please note that this is a remote after-hours position that requires working overnights, weekends, and holidays**

This position requires flexible hours and shift availability as determined by business need and client call volume.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional, white-glove service to C-Suite travelers and their administrative staff during after-hours and emergency situations, ensuring all interactions are handled with the utmost professionalism and discretion.
  • Provide consultative support throughout the booking process, crafting bespoke travel itineraries tailored to the specific needs and elevated expectations of VIP and executive-level clients.
  • Coordinate urgent air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for complex domestic and international travel, often within time-sensitive and high-pressure timelines.
  • Expertly manage rerouting, exchanges, and itinerary changes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans and a seamless experience for the client from start to finish.
  • Proactively gather, retain, and apply client travel preferences and profiles to deliver a consistently personalized and anticipatory level of service.
  • Keep VIP clients informed of all necessary travel documents, visa requirements, and health requirements for international destinations, providing guidance with confidence and accuracy.
  • Proficiently handle ticketing, Phase IVs, and complex exchanges and changes involving both domestic and international fares.
  • Execute all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, PNR documentation and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and quality control, maintaining the highest degree of accuracy throughout.
  • Stay fully informed of airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements, applying this knowledge accurately and efficiently to all travel arrangements.
  • Demonstrate creative thinking and decisive problem-solving skills to provide optimal travel solutions in fast-paced, high-stakes situations.
  • Maintain ongoing communication with team members, Travel Managers, and Team Leaders through provided channels to ensure a united, consistent, and professional approach to VIP account management.
  • Complete all reservations accurately and in a timely manner, including post-trip follow-up and support where applicable.
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of recent experience as a VIP or Executive Travel Agent, with a demonstrated ability to serve C-level executives and high-profile clients with discretion and professionalism.
  • 4+ years of recent experience in corporate travel management, with a thorough understanding of the unique needs and challenges of business travelers, particularly in emergency and after-hours scenarios.
  • Expert in managing complex, urgent, and time-sensitive travel requests with precision, including the ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to ensure seamless VIP travel experiences.
  • In-depth familiarity with Sabre GDS for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance, along with proficiency in ticketing procedures, scripting, and handling complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both domestic and international travel.
  • Comfortable and proficient using Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Teams), travel booking tools (Concur, Deem), and various communication tools, with a strong technical aptitude and the ability to adapt to new technologies quickly.
  • Skilled in building long-term relationships with elite clientele by proactively gathering and retaining travel preferences, handling bespoke requests with discretion, and maintaining a comprehensive understanding of global geography and international destinations.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings, with strong attention to detail even in fast-paced, high-pressure situations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a polished, professional, and empathetic demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • A natural inclination to respond promptly to emergency travel requests, with the ability to handle high-stress situations, make quick and effective decisions, and provide expert guidance while consistently upholding the VIP standard of service.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

Corporate Travel Consultant - Warwick Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.

  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.

Benefits Include:

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

Put simply, we’re a bunch of travel lovers looking for more travel lovers to join our family.

About the role

WhereTo is looking for a Product Enablement Specialist to help run the function that becomes the go-to point of contact for product questions across our business. WhereTo is a nimble, startup-minded team within Flight Centre Travel Group focused on building the next-generation business travel platform that serves two of Flight Centre's main business travel brands, Corporate Traveller and FCM.

As Product Enablement Specialist, you'll own the day-to-day execution of the function: triaging incoming questions and stakeholder feedback, consolidating roadmap information, supporting go-to-market communication for new releases, drafting release notes and product-win comms, and documenting what's shipped, working closely with and reporting to the Product Enablement Lead, who sets the standards and handles anything complex or sensitive. You'll be a key point of contact for Sales, Account Management, Customer Support, and Brand stakeholders when they need clear, accurate answers about what we're building.

If you're a sharp, clear communicator who enjoys being the person who always has the answer, or knows exactly who does, we'd love to hear from you.

About you

Experience:

  • 2+ years in a role centered on internal communications, product operations, technical/solutions support, or a similar cross-functional capacity.
  • Experience translating technical or product detail for non-technical audiences.

Skills:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, this is the core of the role.
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort maintaining a single source of truth across multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to synthesize complex product information into clear, concise updates for varied audiences.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Product Marketing, Sales, and Account Management.
  • Proficient with roadmap and release management tooling (Product Board and JIRA being our current tools of choice) and internal comms platforms (e.g., Workvivo).

Industry Knowledge:

  • General understanding of the business travel industry and WhereTo's product portfolio across both brands.
  • Comfort learning quickly across a broad product surface, since this role touches the full breadth of what WhereTo builds rather than one specific product line.

Adaptability:

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, particularly while helping stand up a brand-new function.

What's in it for you

  • Exclusive Travel Discounts: As part of Flight Centre Travel Group, you gain access to exclusive industry rates and discounts through our in-house travel team.
  • Career Development: With Flight Centre Travel Group’s global presence, spanning 30+ brands in over 20 countries, you’ll have clear career pathways and the resources you need to achieve your professional goals, including training and support.
  • Vibrant Culture & industry-renowned social events: Experience our fun, industry-renowned culture with exciting social events such as monthly awards nights, global conferences, end-of-financial-year balls, and more.
  • Active Hour: Prioritise your well-being with an hour dedicated each week to focus on your fitness or personal wellness.
  • Comprehensive Health Cash Plan: Get reimbursed for a variety of medical services, including dental, optical, and chiropractic care, with our bronze-level health cash plan.
  • Health & Wellbeing Challenges: Stay engaged with monthly health and wellbeing challenges designed to keep you motivated and healthy.
  • Financial Wellbeing Support: Access expert financial services, including mortgage advice, regulated financial guidance, and money coaching to help you manage your finances.

  • Own the strategic roadmap for Acclaro’s proprietary platforms, aligning product direction with business goals and customer needs
  • Translate high‑level objectives into actionable feature sets, clear technical requirements, and measurable outcomes
  • Shape platform scalability and ecosystem growth through API‑first strategies and third‑party integrations
  • Lead research and technical discovery across LLMs, RAG, and emerging technologies to keep Acclaro on the cutting edge of AI‑driven localization
  • Use data and AI‑driven analytics to track KPIs, validate product performance, and drive continuous optimization
  • Partner cross‑functionally with Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Customer Success, and Linguistic Services to ensure a cohesive, high‑quality product experience

THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF YOU

  • Have 8+ years of SaaS product management experience, moving products from idea to launch with autonomy
  • Hold a bachelor's Degree in a related field or equivalent professional or military experience
  • Bring an AI‑first approach to Product Management and actively use AI to accelerate your workflow and decision-making
  • Are fluent in engineering and able to engage deeply on topics like architecture, APIs, security, and compliance
  • Treat your own productivity as a product—constantly optimizing processes, systems, and workflows
  • Excel in distributed, fast‑moving environments where ownership and clarity matter
  • Balance user empathy with business strategy to craft intuitive, high‑impact experiences for global users

  • Are an AI power user who has built personal agents or automated workflows to improve your own productivity
  • Think in platform ecosystems, with experience designing API‑first products and third‑party integration strategies

  • Global Team, Local Impact: Collaborate with colleagues around the world while making meaningful contributions locally.

  • Flexible Work Style: Enjoy remote work, flexible PTO, and a healthy work-life balance.

  • Impactful Work: Help top-tier brands succeed globally while promoting cultural understanding and connection.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: Market-leading pay, bonuses, and comprehensive medical and retirement plans.
  • Recognition & Support: Be seen and celebrated through regular recognition programs and supportive leadership.

VALUES WE LIVE BY

  • Passion with a Purpose – We’re energized by our work and why it matters.
  • Go the Extra Mile – We strive for excellence and proactive value.
  • Honesty in Action – We act with integrity, openness, and respect.
  • Own It, Do It – We follow through, take accountability, and take pride in our outcomes.

jobs.excerpt: RESPONSABLE DE L’IMPLÉMENTATION CLIENTFCM adopte une approche globale des voyages d’affaires et se spécialise dans la gestion de programmes de voyages nationaux et internationaux pour les entreprises de moyenne et grande envergure.
jobs.description:
RESPONSABLE DE L’IMPLÉMENTATION CLIENT

FCM adopte une approche globale des voyages d’affaires et se spécialise dans la gestion de programmes de voyages nationaux et internationaux pour les entreprises de moyenne et grande envergure.
Classée parmi les cinq plus grandes sociétés de gestion de voyages au monde, FCM dispose d’un réseau d’affaires présent dans plus de 97 pays, avec des sièges sociaux mondiaux à Londres, Brisbane, Singapour et New York. Appuyée par la force mondiale de Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combine une expertise locale et une portée internationale afin d’offrir à ses clients une expérience véritablement personnalisée.
Fondée en juin 2004, FCM a été nommée Meilleure société de gestion de voyages au monde pendant huit années consécutives aux World Travel Awards.

Pour en savoir plus sur FCM, veuillez cliquer ICI


À propos du poste

Joignez-vous à FCM à titre de Responsable de l’implémentation client et jouez un rôle clé dans la prestation d’une expérience d’intégration fluide auprès de clients nationaux et multinationaux. Ce poste est au cœur de la réussite client, veillant à ce que les nouveaux clients soient implantés avec succès, soutenus efficacement et positionnés en vue d’un partenariat à long terme. Vous collaborerez avec les parties prenantes internes et les équipes clientes, gérerez plusieurs projets d’implémentation simultanément et contribuerez à l’atteinte de résultats exceptionnels pour la clientèle. Si vous aimez évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, coordonner des projets et offrir une expérience client remarquable, cette occasion vous permettra d’avoir un impact concret.

Responsabilités principales

  • Gérer l’implémentation et l’intégration de clients nationaux et multinationaux conformément aux processus d’implémentation établis.
  • Offrir une expérience client d'une qualité supérieure tout au long du cycle de vie de chaque projet.
  • Coordonner et animer les réunions d’implémentation avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.
  • Assurer le suivi des échéanciers et veiller au respect des jalons convenus pour chaque implémentation.
  • Identifier, communiquer et escalader les risques liés aux projets en appliquant les méthodologies de gestion des risques en place.
  • Maintenir à jour et avec exactitude la documentation d’implémentation, les énoncés de travaux (SOW) et les dossiers de projet.
  • Recueillir et valider de manière proactive les informations nécessaires à la bonne réalisation du projet.
  • Soutenir les projets d’implémentation régionaux pour les clients multinationaux ainsi que l’adoption continue des outils en ligne.
  • Assurer le suivi de l’avancement des projets et des échéanciers au moyen des outils internes de gestion de projet.
  • Veiller au respect des normes, systèmes, processus et meilleures pratiques liés à l’implémentation.
  • Collaborer efficacement avec les collègues, les gestionnaires et les parties prenantes afin d’atteindre les objectifs d’implémentation.
  • Appuyer les activités de tests d’acceptation par les utilisateurs (UAT) et veiller à l’exactitude des implémentations.
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue grâce aux revues de projet et aux commentaires des clients.
  • Favoriser un environnement de travail sécuritaire, inclusif et accessible où tous les Flighties se sentent accueillis, respectés et soutenus dans leur réussite.
  • Effectuer toute autre tâche ou responsabilité connexe assignée.
  • Autres tâches et responsabilités assignées
  • Contribuer à un environnement de travail sécuritaire, inclusif et accessible où tous les Flighties se sentent accueillis, respectés et soutenus afin de s’épanouir

Expérience et compétences

  • Au moins 2 ans d’expérience au sein de Flight Centre ou 2 ans d’expérience à titre de Gestionnaire de l’implémentation ou dans un poste similaire.
  • Excellente compréhension des processus d’implémentation.
  • Feuille de route démontrée en matière de réussite dans des fonctions antérieures.
  • Solides compétences en coordination de projets et en gestion du temps.
  • Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets simultanément.
  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication, tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit.
  • Fort sens des affaires et excellentes capacités de résolution de problèmes.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec des clients et des parties prenantes à divers niveaux organisationnels.
  • Connaissance des outils de réservation en ligne, un atout.
  • Approche souple et grande capacité d’adaptation dans un environnement d’affaires en constante évolution.
  • Disponibilité pour effectuer des déplacements occasionnels, au besoin.
  • Bilinguisme (français et anglais) requis
  • Une connexion Internet fiable et à haut débit est requise pour assurer les responsabilités essentielles du poste, y compris, sans s’y limiter, la vidéoconférence, l’accès aux systèmes de l’entreprise et le traitement sécurisé des données de l’entreprise.
  • Le bilinguisme français/anglais est requis, en raison de la nature du poste qui consiste à traiter avec des clients et des fournisseurs français et anglais.

Des conditions de travail qui ont de quoi séduire!

FCTG est reconnu dans le monde entier pour ses magnifiques conditions de travail et sa culture entrepreneuriale encore plus exceptionnelle. Nous savons que notre personnel est notre atout le plus précieux. C’est la passion et le dévouement de nos équipes qui maintiennent notre entreprise au sommet de son industrie. C’est également la raison pour laquelle nous offrons des avantages sociaux et des primes hors du commun à notre personnel.

  • Amusez-vous: l’importance d’avoir du plaisir au travail imprègne chacun de nos gestes.
  • Obtenez des récompenses et une reconnaissance: voyez vos succès et ceux des autres être applaudis lors des fameuses soirées Buzz que nous organisons régulièrement, ainsi qu’au rassemblement mondial annuel. Il faut le vivre pour le croire !
  • Puisez dans votre génie : nos collaborateurs se servent de leur vivacité d’esprit, de leur savoir-faire et de leur persévérance pour trouver en tout temps une solution.
  • L’amour du voyage : notre société a été fondée par des personnes qui voulaient voyager et qui souhaitaient que d’autres en fassent autant. Cette passion marque immanquablement tout notre personnel et l’ensemble de nos services.
  • Des liens personnels : le fondement de notre grande entreprise repose sur les relations personnelles.
  • Diversité, équité et inclusion : engagement envers la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion à travers des initiatives telles que la Journée de la diversité (congé payé pour observer un jour férié ou une célébration culturelle de votre choix) Groupes de ressources pour les employés (équité raciale, équité des genres, LGBTQ2IA+, accessibilité, justice environnementale ), les initiatives éducatives du DEI et les pratiques équitables, y compris des évaluations régulières de l'équité et des protocoles de recrutement inclusifs.
  • Une carrière, et non un boulot: nous offrons à tous de véritables possibilités de croissance et d’évolution personnelle.
  • Nous offrons notre soutien tout temps à nos employés : nous nous engageons fermement à soutenir chaque employé dans son développement professionnel et personnel.
  • Redonner en retour : nous nous engageons à faire une différence grâce à notre programme de responsabilité sociale d'entreprise, qui soutient les organismes de bienfaisance désignés via le bénévolat et la collecte de fonds, notre programme environnemental de bureau, des espaces de bureau certifiés LEED® Gold et une journée de bénévolat rémunérée par année civile.

Voici un aperçu des avantages offerts :
Avantages

  • Politique généreuse de congés payés
  • Avantages et rabais liés aux voyages
  • Programmes de santé et de bien-être et services de bien-être financier pour les employés
  • Soirées de reconnaissance et conférences nationales et internationals
  • Avantages sociaux collectifs, incluant l’assurance maladie complémentaire, les soins dentaires et de la vue, les soins d’affirmation de genre et les soins de fertilité
  • Assurances, incluant l’assurance vie, l’assurance décès et mutilation accidentels, l’assurance maladies graves et l’assurance invalidité de longue durée
  • Programme d’aide aux employés
  • REER/RPA avec contribution de l’employeur
  • Programme de remboursement des frais de scolarité
  • Régime d’actionnariat des employés – possibilité d’acheter des actions de la société à la Bourse australienne, avec une contribution partielle de l’employeur, sous réserve des modalités et conditions applicables
  • Possibilités de carrière à l’échelle mondiale au sein d’un réseau de marques et d’entreprises

Emplacement – TÉLÉTRAVAIL, Canada

Si vous pensez que c’est là le poste que vous cherchiez et que vous souhaitez adhérer à notre culture entrepreneuriale primée, POSTULEZ SANS TARDER.

Cette offre d'emploi correspond à un poste vacant que nous cherchons actuellement à pourvoir.

Dans le cadre de notre processus de recrutement, nous pouvons utiliser des outils d’intelligence artificielle (IA) pour soutenir différentes étapes, notamment la présélection et l’évaluation des candidatures. Ces outils nous aident à évaluer les candidats en fonction des qualifications, des compétences et de l’expérience pertinentes pour le poste. Toutes les décisions d’embauche sont prises par notre équipe de recrutement et les parties prenantes concernées.

Nous accueillons les candidatures de candidats ayant des expériences variées.

Avant de postuler à un poste interne, vous devez être dans l'entreprise ou dans votre poste actuel depuis au moins 6 à 12 mois et en informer votre responsable avant de postuler.

Vous avez des questions sur cette opportunité? Communiquez avec notre équipe de recrutement à l'adresse

Pour ce poste, nous prévoyons offrir un salaire annuel compris entre 88 000 $ et 90 000 $. Le salaire de base sera établi en fonction de divers facteurs pertinents, notamment l’expérience, l’emplacement géographique et les exigences du poste.

Notre philosophie numéro un? Nos employés. La promesse de Flight Centre Travel Group est de fournir un environnement où prônent le respect, la dignité et des opportunités pour tous nos employés. Nous valorisons un lieu de travail inclusif et solidaire qui reflète véritablement la diversité de notre société.

Nous nous engageons à procurer un environnement où règne l’égalité en matière de respect, de dignité et de possibilités pour tous les membres de notre personnel. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Artificial Intelligence
jobs.excerpt: At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change.
jobs.description:
At Arctic Wolf, you won’t just watch the cybersecurity industry evolve – you'll help lead the change. Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re proud to be recognized by Forbes, CNBC, Fortune, CRN, Bartner Peer Insights and IDC MarketScape – but what matters most is the work behind it: delivering real outcomes for customers through award winning innovation like our Aurora Platform.

If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!

 

Our mission is simple: End Cyber Risk. We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Artificial Intelligence to be part of making that happen.  

 

About The Role

In this role, you advance that mission by planning and directing the AI development that turns massive volumes of security signal into faster detection and response. This work spans the full range of machine learning and AI solutions, from classical models to fine-tuned language models and agentic systems. You ensure AI initiatives, processes, and deliverables conform to the organization’s established policies, quality standards, and objectives. You also work closely with R&D Leadership, Product Management, and the Security Services (S2) organization to build scalable, production-grade AI that customers and analysts need, delivered on time.

Senior Managers carry a large scope of leadership and may have multiple managers and/or technical leads reporting to them. The right leader brings specialized subject-matter expertise in the AI domain along with a can-do attitude. They are comfortable working across functional boundaries, partnering with data scientists, platform engineers, threat researchers, and security operations analysts to push complex, ambiguous initiatives over the line.

Responsibilities

Generates and manages the day-to-day work for their team and is accountable for its outcomes. Partners with the Product team to define and deliver the 6-month AI roadmap and contributes to longer-term planning and strategy with R&D Leadership. Provides direction and clarity, removes obstacles, and leads teams that deliver high-quality, innovative AI solutions alongside architects, developers, data scientists, product managers, CSEs, and support people.

  • Set the direction for applying the right approach to each problem, from classical ML (e.g., clustering, random forests) to deep learning, fine-tuned language models, and agentic systems, in partnership with your technical peers and team members, translating complex security use cases into production-ready initiatives.

  • Partner with Architects and other leadership on the company’s technical roadmap, championing secure, observable, and scalable AI systems in cloud-native environments.

  • Oversee the design, training, deployment, and ongoing quality measurement of models and agentic experiences.

  • Drive continuous improvement in engineering and MLOps processes. Uphold secure coding and acceptable-use standards across the full development life cycle.

  • Drive cross-functional initiatives with platform, product, and security operations teams to integrate AI into production, and see that work through to completion.

  • Mentor each team member and help them grow their technical and leadership skills, establishing career development plans and achievable goals. Build collaborative relationships across teams and stakeholders.

  • Lead recruitment for their team and be a key contributor to hiring and recruitment strategy for both full-time and co-op roles.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Four years of experience in software, AI/ML, or data science roles (or a Master’s degree plus two years), including experience leading technical teams or projects.

  • Demonstrated experience leading technical teams and delivering AI/ML or Generative AI systems to production at scale.

  • Strong expertise in the production delivery of Generative AI or machine learning systems, including training, tuning, and ongoing quality measurement and evaluation (e.g., LLM-as-judge).

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., AgentCore, LangChain, LangGraph) and LLM integration.

  • Experience architecting MLOps processes and tooling for moving models from training to production, including drift monitoring and continuous learning in high-volume pipelines.

  • Familiarity with cloud-native data services (AWS preferred) and data engineering tools (e.g., Spark, Flink, Kafka, Databricks), and with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, and DevSecOps principles.

  • Exposure to cybersecurity concepts such as threat detection, MITRE ATT&CK, telemetry, and adversarial behavior modeling.

  • A can-do attitude, tenacity, and proven ability to work across cross-functional boundaries to drive ambiguous, high-impact initiatives to completion.

On-Camera Policy
To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.

About Arctic Wolf

At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021-2024), Best Places to Work – USA (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021-2024), Great Place to Work – UK (2024), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 7,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.

Our Values 

Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good. 

We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.  

We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities. 

All wolves receive compelling compensation and benefits packages, including: 

  • Equity for all employees

  • Flexible time off and paid volunteer days

  • RRSP and 401k match

  • Training and career development programs

  • Comprehensive private benefits plan including medical, mental health, dental, disability, life and AD&D, and value-added services

  • Robust Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with mental health services

  • Fertility support and paid parental leave

Arctic Wolf is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics, or any other basis forbidden under federal, provincial, or local law. Arctic Wolf is committed to fostering a welcoming, accessible, respectful, and inclusive environment ensuring equal access and participation for people with disabilities. As such, we strive to make our entire employee experience as accessible as possible and provide accommodations as required for candidates and employees with disabilities and/or other specific needs where possible. Please let us know if you require any accommodations by emailing . 

Security Requirements 

  • Conducts duties and responsibilities in accordance with AWN’s Information Security policies, standards, processes, and controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AWN business information (in accordance with our employee handbook and corporate policies). 

  • Background checks are required for this position.  

  • This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws and regulations, including the Export Administration Regulations (“EAR”).  Please note that, if applicable, an offer for employment will be conditioned on authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export control laws and regulations. 

The base salary range for this job family is 118,700 to 280,000 USD annually. This range reflects the base pay the company reasonably expects to offer for this position, aligned to the broader job family base pay structure. Actual base pay may vary based on skills, experience, and location, including job family level. In addition to base pay, Arctic Wolf offers variable incentive compensation, new hire equity grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.excerpt: About UsLet’s go on an adventure together!  Hey there, we’re G Adventures.
jobs.description:
About Us

Let’s go on an adventure together!

Hey there, we’re G Adventures. We’re one of the world’s leading small group travel companies, and we’ve always believed that travel isn’t just about where you go — it’s about how it changes you.

For the last 35 years, we’ve set out to do things differently. No cookie-cutter tours. No giant buses or cruise ships. And not to mention, as few selfie sticks as possible. Just real humans, travelling your heart out across the world with open minds and a non-stop desire to make our planet better, simply by exploring it.

At G Adventures, our DNA (or GNA, if you will) is built on belonging — where bringing your authentic self to work every day isn’t just accepted, it’s downright celebrated. For our office crew — you wanna rock a t-shirt with your dog’s face on it? We say go for it. For our Chief Experience Officers — you wanna hit the road and call some of the most epic places on Earth your home office? We love that — and we’ve got you. Wanna spend your days with people you genuinely like? Us too — and we’re pretty sure you’ll fit right in, wherever that is.

Now about that career of yours — this is the kind of place where you can spread your wings and truly grow into your role. The best part? You get to do it all alongside a passionate, freakishly talented, one-of-a-kind bunch excited to produce top-notch work and spread a ridiculous amount of goodness at the same time.

Feel like this could be the right fit? We think so too, and we’re already way too excited to meet you.

The Tour Staff Administrator provides administrative and operational support to the Tour Operations team, ensuring that systems, documentation, travel logistics, communications, and operational processes are maintained accurately and efficiently. The role is responsible for supporting Tour Staff (CEOs) and the wider Operations team through effective coordination, record management, routine reporting, and logistical administration, contributing to the smooth delivery of tours across the region.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

Administration & Document Management

  • Compile, verify, and organize all pre-trip documentation, ensuring accurate filing for Tour Staff (CEO) access.

  • Maintain compliance records, including passports, driver's licences, first aid certificates, background checks, and expiry tracking.

  • Update Tour Staff (CEO) Code of Conduct records, contact profiles, and operational databases as directed.

  • Maintain and audit physical and digital filing systems, transaction records, receipts, and payment documentation.

Systems Administration

  • Maintain and update the internal Tour Staff (CEO) website and resource portals with current itineraries, trip planners, and operational documentation.

  • Create, manage, and archive Tour Staff (CEO) Slack channels for tours, ensuring standard pre-trip information is available.

  • Upload approved Tour Staff schedules into internal systems (e.g. Polaris).

  • Support routine system administration and maintain accurate operational records.

Travel Logistics & Financial Administration

  • Coordinate routine travel arrangements for Tour Staff (CEO) relocations, including flights, accommodation, and ground transfers.

  • Coordinate the release and distribution of Tour Staff (CEO) swag in collaboration with the Workshop Manager.

  • Assist the Finance team with invoice sorting, data entry, and administrative processing as required.

Communication & Operational Support

  • Compile and format content for the regional monthly newsletter using information supplied by the Operations team.

  • Distribute standard customer feedback reports to suppliers on a monthly basis.

  • Publish Tour Staff (CEO) recognition and evaluation "Shout-Outs" on internal communication platforms.

  • Participate in the emergency phone rotation, providing after-hours support on a scheduled weekly basis.

Event & Inventory Coordination

  • Provide administrative support for internal meetings, staff training, engagement events, and operational activities.

  • Source venue quotations, coordinate bookings, monitor attendance, and assist with event logistics where required.

Skills & Experience:

  • Experience: 1+ years of experience within G Adventures or strong relevant experience in the tourism/travel industry. Past experience working as a tour leader or field guide is recommended. A diploma in Tourism is highly desirable.

  • Regional Passion: Some travel experience and a genuine passion for the people, culture, and geography of Africa.

  • Communication Skills: Highly developed written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting data to management and communicating sensitively across cultures.Good command in English and able to use systems well (Office, Google Sheets)

  • Crisis Management: Proven ability to remain calm under pressure, navigate stressful situations, manage crises, and prioritize the safety of others.

  • Systems Savvy: Confident using and troubleshooting complex internal computer systems, database software, and communication tools with speed and efficiency.

  • Organization & Agility: Strong administrative, organizational, and budgeting skills. Ability to juggle strict day-to-day operational deadlines while focusing on process improvement.

  • Flexibility: Willingness to work a flexible schedule, including rotational weekend shifts and evening emergency phone coverage (compensated).

What Do We Offer You?

  • Competitive Total Rewards Package, including exclusive travel perks!

  • Additional days off, including on your birthday!

  • Vacation time for you to recharge

  • Enhanced Parental Leave

  • Meaningful Employee Recognition Program

  • Learning and Growth Opportunities

  • Employee Resource Groups

*Applicable based on location*

Please note that Artificial Intelligence (AI) is used in the selection or interview process.

G Adventures is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We consider all qualified applicants.

jobs.description:
Join our team as an Product Owner and lead the charge in delivering innovative solutions that drive real customer value in our Workplace Solutions division. In this pivotal role, you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams, prioritize workflows, and bring strategic visions to life through agile methodologies. If you're passionate about shaping impactful products and making a difference, we want to hear from you!

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary: Product Owner: $100,000 - $118,000 plus annual bonus opportunity
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
  • Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Drive Product Solutions: Lead cross-functional teams and Agile Release Train resources to deliver high-value product solutions aligned with strategic visions, ensuring consistent customer value delivery.

  • Backlog Prioritization: Manage and refine product backlogs by balancing business value, stakeholder input, and strategic priorities to achieve impactful outcomes.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with ART leadership, business owners, subject matter experts, and other Product Owners to define and refine features, ensuring clear acceptance criteria and seamless communication across teams.

  • Agile Leadership: Act as a Product Owner for an Agile Release Train car, participating in planning, demos, retrospectives, and ceremonies to enhance product quality and team velocity.

  • Outcome Monitoring: Oversee business outcomes by tracking progress, adjusting priorities, and resolving delivery challenges while ensuring seamless transitions to operations, including training and communication.

  • Risk Mitigation: Identify and address risks in partnership with system delivery teams, escalating and resolving issues to keep projects on track while aligning with business goals.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Professional Experience: 3+ years in a business role or as a Product Owner/Product Manager, with a track record of leading product development, prioritizing work, and delivering outcomes aligned to business strategy;4+ years as an expert contributor on a systems team with deep knowledge of internal/external-facing UI technology and related backend systems that support insurance activities (e.g., enrollment, premium payment, and enrollee/member data management).

  • Agile Product Ownership Expertise: Ability to serve as a Product Owner for one or more Agile Release Train cars, with a conceptual understanding of the SAFe framework and its roles, processes, and collaboration methods.

  • Industry and Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with the insurance industry, operational business processes, and a broad understanding of technology domains, including cloud, client-server, SaaS, and Enterprise Architecture.

  • Leadership and Communication Skills: Strong leadership, collaboration, and negotiation abilities to build relationships with stakeholders, guide teams, and resolve conflicts effectively.

  • Analytical and Organizational Proficiency: Excellent time management, prioritization, and data-driven decision-making skills, coupled with the ability to independently manage complex, multi-year initiatives.

PREFERRED:

  • Proven ability to analyze and map complex data flows across systems, with a focus on external/internal facing User Interface (UI) and relationships to backend systems.

  • Strong understanding of Group Insurance concepts around member enrollment life cycles, member management, premium and billing.

We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

jobs.excerpt: Job Description Please note that this position requires working Pacific Time (PST) hours and being fully bilingual in Spanish and English.
jobs.description:
Job Description

Please note that this position requires working Pacific Time (PST) hours and being fully bilingual in Spanish and English.

A bit about this role:

This is an exciting opportunity for a compassionate and skilled Nurse Practitioner (APRN) Physician Assistant (PA) to provide virtual primary care through our innovative telehealth platform. As a Virtual Primary Care Nurse Practitioner, you will deliver comprehensive, high-quality care while fostering strong, lasting patient relationships.

You will provide ongoing management of chronic conditions, preventive screenings, acute care visits, and medication management, all through a virtual care model. You'll also work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team to coordinate in-person services such as lab work, imaging, and specialist referrals as needed.

We’re not just looking for a provider—we’re looking for a healthcare innovator who embraces change, values patient-centered care, and is excited about making healthcare better through technology.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Provide virtual primary care visits via telehealth, including comprehensive assessments, chronic disease management, preventive screenings, and acute care interventions.

  • Diagnose and manage chronic conditions (e.g., hypertension, diabetes, COPD, heart disease) and develop individualized care plans to optimize patient health.

  • Evaluate and treat acute concerns (e.g., infections, respiratory illnesses, minor injuries, skin conditions) within the scope of virtual care.

  • Order and interpret lab tests, imaging, and other diagnostics, coordinating follow-up care as necessary.

  • Manage medication prescriptions, titrations, and refills, ensuring patient adherence and safety.

  • Provide health coaching, lifestyle modification guidance, and patient education to empower patients in managing their health.

  • Identify patients needing referrals, or home-based services, and facilitate appropriate coordination with specialists or community resources.

  • Utilize and provide feedback on our electronic health platform, contributing to its continuous improvement to enhance patient and provider experience.

  • Participate in clinical case reviews, team huddles, and interdisciplinary collaborations to ensure high-quality, patient-centered care.

  • Engage in continuous learning and improvement, staying up-to-date with best practices in virtual care and primary care management.

Required skills and experience:

  • Active Nurse Practitioner (APRN) or Active Physician Assistant (PA) license in good standing in and the ability to obtain licensure in multiple states within 90 days of hire.

  • Board certification in Family Medicine, Adult-Gerontology, or Internal Medicine.

  • Minimum 2 years of primary care, urgent care, or internal medicine experience, preferably with experience in telehealth or virtual care settings.

  • Active BLS certification at time of hire.

  • Shift times may vary in order to align with standard business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM) in the Pacific time zone. Flexibility is required. Additionally, weekend shifts may be required in the future based on evolving patient care needs.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience managing chronic conditions, preventive care, and acute illnesses via telehealth.

  • Familiarity with value-based care models, population health management, and quality metrics (HEDIS, STAR ratings, etc.) is a plus.

  • Comfortable with digital documentation and telemedicine platforms (experience with EHRs and virtual care workflows preferred).

Salary range: $125,000 annually

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

    • Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting or Business
    • Qualified accountant (CIMA/ACA/ACCA) or a Part Qualified Accountant with strong industry experience

jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

Devoted Health is redefining healthcare. We are seeking a Primary Care Physician (PCP) to lead an innovative clinical model that treats members like family. In this role, you will be a clinician-leader and a builder of the highest-quality virtual primary care model in the nation. Your role will involve deep clinical work managing a shared panel of primary patients, supervising a team of Advanced Practice Providers, developing a suite of industry leading embedded AI-technology, and building out our core clinical model.

You will practice as part of a collaborative interprofessional team while supervising an Advanced Practice Provider pod caring for a panel of patients. You will be supported by industry-leading AI-enabled technology and will be able to refer your patients to a robust suite of internal Devoted Medical specialty clinics.

This position offers the opportunity to impact patient outcomes at scale in a modern, tech-supported care environment and to deeply influence the build of our primary care operation.

Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Clinical Care: Deliver primary care within an interdisciplinary team, ensuring effective, patient-centered care. You will be a clinician leader on the Active Care team, responsible for managing diagnostic dilemmas, complex workups, and patients with multiple ongoing chronic disease management needs.

  • Team Management: Provide supervision, teaching and quality oversight to a team of Advanced Practice Providers. You will foster a collaborative and supportive clinical environment that will help your team thrive.Lead weekly interdisciplinary rounds and readmission conferences to review high-risk patients.

  • Innovation: Drive innovation and process improvement to enhance the delivery of primary care services. You will be given the tools to rapidly solve problems and develop new ways of delivering primary care with AI and digital engagement as a foundation. The builder work you do will have a lasting and demonstrable impact on our delivery system.

  • Quality Measurement and Oversight: Our objective is to deliver the highest quality primary care in the nation. You will have the opportunity to build new quality measures, manage quality oversight for your pod, and help us iterate on our balanced scorecard for primary care. Additionally, you will hold collaborative practice agreements with APPs across multiple states.

Attributes to success:

  • Clinical Excellence: A passion for delivering high-quality patient care and demonstrated commitment to primary care. New graduates are encouraged to apply.

  • Servant Leadership: Recognize that everyone's success is your success. Enable your team to be empowered to do their best work possible and trust your guidance and assistance.

  • Passion for Improvement: Passionate about making healthcare better, solving complex problems, and supporting the delivery of healthcare that we would want for our own family members.

  • Adaptability & Agility: Wired for learning and change, comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-energy environment.

Required skills and experience:

  • A board-certified Internal Medicine or Family Medicine physician with demonstrated commitment to primary care

  • Experience serving diverse patient populations, with a focus on delivering care that aligns with our mission to treat every member like family.

  • You believe deeply in measuring and improving the quality of primary care delivery across a population.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience supervising Advanced Practice Providers or other healthcare professionals is highly desired, though recent graduates are welcome to apply.

  • Proven ability to manage change and drive innovation in a dynamic healthcare environment and/or run a clinical program is desired.

  • Experience with virtual primary care is a plus but not required.

Salary Range: $265,000 - $320,000/ year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

Position Title: Snr. Grid Compliance Manager (UK)

Department: Project Engineering Team (EMEA)

Reports to: Director of Project Engineering (EMEA)

Location: Remote with 20% travel to project sites, client offices etc

Description:

The primary responsibilities of the Snr. Grid Compliance Manager is to ensure that the grid connection/ compliance deliverables and test documentation required to be submitted to the DNOs and NESO by e-Storage and its’s partners or subcontractors, are provided in a timely, and high-quality manner to guarantee on time energization and smooth commissioning.

Responsibilities:

  • Track all project deliverables related to grid compliance and report monthly on status and issues.
  • Proactively identify and manage changes in the grid code compliance scope, identify potential risks, and prepare contingency plans.
  • Support the Commissioning Manager to provide realistic grid code compliance commissioning schedules and test management plans.
  • Attend all relevant meetings with DNOs and NESO.
  • Review and provide comments on grid code compliance studies / modelling.
  • Engage and manage power systems engineering consultants when required.
  • Prepare technical documentation and Scope of Work for powersystem consultants when necessary.
  • Review and comment on Client technical documentation / scope of works during tender bid preparation, support the Applications Team on grid code compliance.
  • Assist the Project Execution Team with the preparation of contractual notices related to scope changes and other grid connection matters.
  • Engage with sub-contractor grid compliance / interface managers to ensure contractual requirements are met.
  • Manage OEM models (PCS, PPC etc) and coordinate necessary support between Powersystem engineers and OEM model providers.
  • Assist commissioning team in the organisation of NESO/DNO’s grid compliance testing.
  • Responding to or coordinating responses to NESO/DNOs grid compliance testing and data requests

Qualifications and Experience requirements:

  • Engineering Degree in Electrical or Powersystem engineering.
  • Chartered engineer status and member of the IET
  • 5-10 years of relevant work experience in Renewables generation connection to Transmission or Distribution networks.
  • Familiar with grid connection process and G99/Full grid code requirements, including understanding of BELLA/BEGA arrangements.
  • Experience with grid code compliance studies, grid model testing in the generation, transmission and/or distribution systems.
  • Experience with voltage fluctuation/imbalance modeling and assessment (P28/P29).
  • Experience with harmonics modeling and assessment (G5/5).
  • Knowledge of all legal and technical documentation related to UK grid connection.
  • Static and Dynamic Modeling Tools/Software experience (e.g., DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD)
  • Strong written and oral communication skills.
  • Ability to work with internal and external customer team members.

Delivery

  • Build and maintain constructive and collaborative relationships with the client, other suppliers and third-party stakeholders.  

Business Development & Account Management

  • Proactively assist with recruitment activities to enable stable organisational growth.

  • Holds a current and recognised Project or Programme Management certification.

  • Experience of project delivery aimed at digital transformation. Evidence of innovating or leading initiatives to improve management and leadership practices within a team or an organisation.

deine aufgaben

Die Schicht bauen, die unsere Systeme mit einer Datenbank verbindet — in beide Richtungen — und uns dabei helfen, das Datenmodell richtig hinzubekommen.

Die Form der Daten steht weitgehend, und jedes neue System stellt sie auf die Probe. Quellen sind sich nicht einig, was als eine Person zählt, wann etwas passiert ist, und ob sie es zweimal melden. Das zu klären — und zu erkennen, wann das Modell angepasst werden muss, statt es um eine Quelle herumzubiegen — ist der Kern der Arbeit.

Wir suchen jemanden, der das mit uns durchdenkt und für einen bestimmten Entwurf argumentiert, nicht nur umsetzt, was spezifiziert ist.

dein profil

Umfang

InboundJedes System in die Datenbank. Mehrere Pipelines pro System — Quellen melden sehr unterschiedliche Dinge. Identitätsauflösung über Systeme hinweg.OutboundManche Zustände entstehen bei uns, nicht im Tool. Die Datenbank entscheidet und schiebt an die Plattform, die es ausführt.Beide Richtungen sauber haltenPlattformen melden zurück und widersprechen uns manchmal. Wer sich abgemeldet hat, darf nicht wieder hinzugefügt werden.ReportingKPI-Daten müssen in einem BI-Tool ankommen. Sie dorthin zu bringen gehört dazu, Dashboards bauen nicht.SucheDen Datenbestand in natürlicher Sprache durchsuchbar machen.DokumentationEntscheidungen schriftlich, Pipelines in GitHub.

Nicht Teil der Rolle

  • Frontend. Es gibt keins und es ist keins geplant.

Voraussetzungen

  • Integration gegen Third-Party-APIs und Webhooks, in der Tiefe: Pagination, Retries, Signaturprüfung, Rate Limits, undokumentierte Payload-Strukturen, verspätete und vertauschte Events, Quellen, die bei jeder Änderung feuern und nicht sagen, was sich geändert hat.
  • Bidirektionale Synchronisation zwischen Systemen, die beide dasselbe Feld für ihres halten — Loop-Vermeidung, Echo-Unterdrückung, eine klare Antwort darauf, wer bei Konflikten gewinnt.
  • Postgres als Anwendungsdatenbank, nicht nur als Ziel. plpgsql-Funktionen, Trigger, Constraints und RLS, um Regeln beim Schreiben durchzusetzen. Wenn sich deine SQL-Erfahrung auf Transformationen nach dem Load beschränkt, passt die Rolle nicht.
  • Idempotenz als Gewohnheit, nicht als Nachgedanke. Eine Pipeline, die erneut läuft und nichts verändert, ist der Abnahmetest.
  • Sauberes Arbeiten mit Git — Migrationen, PRs, Review.
  • Arbeit mit personenbezogenen Daten unter der DSGVO, und ein Verständnis dafür, warum das einschränkt, was überhaupt eingelesen wird.
  • Englisch in Schrift. Die Arbeit läuft überwiegend asynchron, und was du baust, muss für jemanden lesbar sein, der nicht dabei war.

Hilfreich, nicht erforderlich

n8n oder ein anderer Orchestrator · Supabase · Relevanzarbeit an einem Suchindex — Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Meilisearch oder vergleichbar; Cluster-Betrieb ist nicht der Teil, den wir brauchen · Erfahrung als einzige Person auf einem System · Deutsch.

wir bieten

Zusammenarbeit

Remote und überwiegend asynchron, aber nicht wortlos — gerade am Anfang sind echte Gespräche eingeplant, während du dich in die Systeme und ihre Zusammenhänge einarbeitest.

Rahmen

Freiberuflich, Start so bald wie möglich. Zunächst drei Monate; danach sehen wir, was gebraucht wird.

Berlin oder Remote innerhalb der EU.

As part of Zillow Group’s FinTech division, you’ll help reshape how consumers buy, sell, and finance homes while working in a collaborative, high-energy environment.
