Mortgage Loan Officers at Zillow Home Loans, drive their success through one of two specialized lending teams.

One team leverages a high volume, lead driven, phone-based environment for Loan Officers who excel at high-frequency conversion and scaling customer relationships quickly.

The other team focuses on a consultative, market-based model for those who thrive on building long-term strategic partnerships with Zillow Preferred Agents.

Both teams are core to our purchase-focused mission and are equally backed by Zillow’s industry-leading technology, brand, centralized operations, and leadership support. Whether you find your edge in data-driven, lead-responsive execution or in nurturing a local professional network, both paths offer a high-impact career within the Zillow ecosystem.

About the role

This is an opportunity to grow your career as a purchase-focused Mortgage Loan Officeroriginating home loans for customers introduced through Zillow’s ecosystem. You’ll guide borrowers from first contact through funding while delivering a best-in-class customer experience. Based on your background and strengths, you may operate in either a high-volume, digitally driven environment or a relationship-based, market-focused model. Success in this role comes from responsiveness, execution, and performance in a structured, metrics-driven organization—supported by Zillow’s brand, platform, and operational scale.

This role is “remote” with restrictions. Your designated remote location is defined as your principal place of residence, which must be physically located within the state listed above Utah. Position Title: Senior Developer, APIs

Department: Technology - Engineering - Digital Experience (DEx)

Reports to (Title): Head of Engineering

Level/Sub-Level:Operations Level / Professional​

☒Exempt ☐ Non-Exempt

POSITION PURPOSE

The Sr. Developer, APIs is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the API platform that supports YPO's member ecosystem, chapter operations, and agentic AI platform.

This role owns the technical implementation of APIs that sit at the core of the digital experience and works closely with Product, Data Architecture, IT, and Security to deliver scalable, secure, and well-governed API solutions.

The role requires strong backend engineering expertise, a high standard for API quality, and the ability to translate complex integration requirements into maintainable, production-grade systems within an event-driven, domain-aligned, serverless-first architecture.

Your API Portfolio: You will own the engineering implementation of three core API domains:

Members API

Stable, semantic endpoints exposing member profile, identity, peer discovery, and graph relationships. The foundation of member experience.

Chapters API

APIs powering chapter management, forum operations, event discovery, and role-based data access across YPO's global regional structure.

Agentic Ecosystem APIs

Governed API contracts for AI agents (Peer Discovery, Event Discovery) built on OpenAI + RAG and Google Gemini. Agents consume only approved APIs. Agent reasoning must always be surfaceable.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. API Design & Implementation

  • Design and implement production-grade RESTful and GraphQL APIs deployed via AWS API Gateway that are stable, semantic, and decoupled from vendor-specific backend schemas.

  • Ensure all APIs conform to YPO's canonical ontology and global member graph. No endpoint may directly expose Salesforce object structures. APIs must map to govern entity definitions maintained in the enterprise data dictionary.

  • Design APIs to operate within an event-driven architecture leveraging CDC, pub/sub messaging (Kafka and AWS EventBridge), and idempotent patterns.

  • Apply Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles bounded contexts, ubiquitous language, and domain events to ensure API boundaries reflect business domains, not implementation details.

  • Adopt a serverless-first approach using AWS Lambda, Step Functions, and EventBridge where appropriate, selecting stateful services only when serverless patterns are genuinely insufficient.

  • Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code across the Members, Chapters, and Agentic Ecosystem API domains.

  • Define and enforce data models, versioning standards, authentication flows (Auth0 / Okta / OAuth 2.0), and integration patterns from first principles.

  • Apply performance-aware design intentional pagination, caching strategies, query constraints, and rate-limiting so APIs scale safely under real-world load.

  • Every API decision must reinforce member trust through privacy-first architecture, consent enforcement, and transparent data usage.

  • Ensure every API response includes provenance and explanation metadata, so agent reasoning is always surfaceable to the member.

2. Agentic Ecosystem Engineering

  • Implement the API governance layer that controls how YPO's AI agents (Peer Discovery, Event Discovery) interact with member data on OpenAI + custom RAG and Google Gemini.

  • All agent-facing APIs must support structured retrieval, citation-ready provenance fields, consent-aware filtering, and deterministic fallback.

  • Build and maintain kill-switch-capable API boundaries that prevent agents from ever consuming raw member data outside approved contracts.

  • Instrument agent API integrations with feedback loop mechanisms hallucination rates, task success rates, and cost-per-outcome metrics must be observable and attributable to specific API behaviors.

  • Collaborate with data science and ML teams to translate agentic data flow requirements into governed, tested API contracts.

3. API Lifecycle, Versioning & Governance

  • Own the full API lifecycle: development, testing, documentation, versioning, deprecation, and migration planning. Every phase requires an explicit decision, no implied continuation.

  • Establish and maintain engineering standards for API versioning, backward compatibility, and breaking-change policy.

  • Build and maintain sandbox environments, integration test suites, and automated contract tests for every endpoint in the portfolio.

  • Working with Engineering leads to ensuring reliable CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, observability via Datadog, alerting, and uptime SLAs. All infrastructure changes must be deployed via Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CDK) manual console changes in production are not permitted.

4. Cloud Architecture, IAM & Security

  • Design and enforce IAM boundary design using least-privilege principles, permission boundaries, and Service Control Policies (SCPs) ensuring API-layer identities and Lambda execution roles cannot exceed governed data access boundaries.

  • Operate within and contribute to YPO's multi-account AWS strategy (AWS Organizations, Control Tower) understanding how workload isolation, environment separation, and cross-account roles affect API deployment patterns and security boundaries.

  • All cloud infrastructure must be defined and maintained as code using Terraform or AWS CDK this is a hard requirement, not optional practice.

5. Developer Experience & Enablement

  • Produce and maintain clear API documentation, for example queries, and troubleshooting guides so internal teams can self serve without escalation.

  • Support technical onboarding for new product teams and integration partners, ensuring APIs are discoverable, stable, and easy to consume.

  • Identify and address developer friction proactively issues must never surface only via member complaints or downstream team escalations.

  • Act as a technical resource for Engineering peers consuming the Members, Chapters, and Agentic APIs.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Data Architecture to ensure APIs maintain stable semantic meaning over evolving backend schemas frontend experience must be decoupled from vendor-specific fields.

  • Partner with IT and Security to enforce role-based access, chapter-scoped data boundaries, and member consent policy (Auth0 / Okta, OneTrust, GDPR, CCPA).

  • Collaborate with Product teams and the Sr. Product Manager, Technical to translate requirements and API specifications into production implementations.

  • Evaluate and integrate third-party technologies (Elasticsearch, Kafka / AWS EventBridge, Search Orchestration Service) that enhance YPO's member ecosystem.

How We Measure Success

  • API Reliability APIs meet defined uptime SLAs; issues detected proactively via Datadog not reported by members.

  • Code Quality New endpoints ship with full test coverage; zero undocumented breaking changes; lifecycle plans in place for every endpoint.

  • Developer Experience Internal teams can serve from documentation; integration timelines reduced; escalations minimized.

  • Delivery Roadmap milestones delivered on time, with acceptance test coverage and passing CI/CD pipelines.

  • Agent Safety Zero agentic API calls bypass the governance layer; kill-switch tested and functional for all agent endpoints.

  • Explainability Every API response includes provenance and explanation metadata; no result feels like a black box.

  • Observability All agent integrations emit hallucination rates, task success, and cost-per-outcome metrics traceable to specific API behaviors.

  • IaC Compliance All infrastructure changes are deployed via Terraform or CDK; no manual console changes in production.

SKILLS

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a multi-cultural organization with international members, helping them achieve excellence in voluntary roles for YPO initiatives. 

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, including strong diplomacy skills with the ability to build meaningful relationships with all levels of associates, members and vendors. Adaptable, insightful, empathetic and reliable. Great sense of humor and humility. 

  • Resourceful and able to work independently with initiative and common sense. Effective time management, organization and prioritization skills with the ability to focus on varied projects simultaneously. 

  • Possesses a distinct global mindset, sensitive to local and international customs and protocols.  

  • Demonstrate empathy through active listening and asking the right questions to find the source of an issue. 

  • Able to identify problems, research alternatives, provide solutions and/or resolve issues in a timely manner. Anticipates member/internal client needs and delivers with clarity. 

  • Analytical thinker with ability influence and guide processes with appropriate approach and execution. Natural curiosity and desire to learn more; proficiency and interest in applying new technologies and tools. 

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including proof reading, with a meticulous attention to detail. Adjust communication style appropriately to the audience.  

  • Professional presence, appearance, and stature to interact easily with YPO members, C-level executives and peers at all levels within the organization.  

  • Strong ability to translate complex security risks into clear business decisions.

  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across product, engineering, and global teams.

  • Analytical thinker with strong architectural judgment and risk-based decision making.

  • High degree of discretion and integrity in handling confidential information.

  • Ability to operate independently in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, with at least 3 years focused on cloud infrastructure security (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP).

  • Experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.).

  • Experience securing AI/ML infrastructure, including model APIs, data pipelines, vector databases, and inference endpoints.

  • Experience with AI technologies, ability to monitor LLM usage, audit model access controls, etc.

  • API abuse detection across the entire SDLC.

  • Strong experience with IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM).

  • Familiarity with container security and Kubernetes environments.

  • Experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, and dependency scanning tools.

  • Proficiency in Python or equivalent scripting language.

  • Strong knowledge of IAM, encryption, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC, and secure cloud architecture principles.

  • Understanding of compliance & security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST).

  • Exposure to mobile application security on native iOS and/or Android platforms, including API security, token management, and mobile threat defense.

EDUCATION/TRAINING/CERTIFICATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Security certifications are highly desirable (AWS, Azure, GCP, CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, etc.).

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Ability to work flexible and/or extended hours as needed to accommodate members and team members in multiple time zones.

  • Willingness and ability to travel, domestically and internationally, without restrictions, approximately 5-10% per year.

Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

Zayo is a managed network service provider focused on the emerging SDN market. As a pioneer in the SD-WAN segment, ZAYO has the platform and the expertise to help enterprises quickly transition from inefficient legacy networks to SDN-based operations resulting in the lower total cost of ownership while improving reliability, application performance, and network security.

The Network Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing the network infrastructure of our customers to ensure maximum uptime for their users. The role can include design, configuration, documentation and troubleshooting network related items ranging from basic to complex. The Network Engineer is the primary escalation point for the ZAYO NOC for all related support issues. This position will be primarily focused on our Prisma SD-WAN solution but may include additional SD-WAN & LAN solutions.

Work Authorization Requirement: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. This position is not eligible for employer-sponsored work authorization, such as OPT, TN, H1B or any other type of work visa, now or in the future.

Responsibilities:

  • Designing and implementing Prisma SD-WAN network solutions and/or improving the efficiency of current networks
  • Installing, configuring, and supporting of Prisma SD-WAN network equipment.
  • Maintain best practice documentation and other reference materials as needed to document procedures, and methods for the engineering team.
  • Report network status to key stakeholders and leadership teams
  • Provide assistance as needed to team members and operations teams for implementations, troubleshooting and repair of network installation and deployments.
  • Providing courteous and professional communication with internal departments, customers, and vendors
  • Ensuring ZAYO Networks’ standards are followed from beginning-to-end for each client and internal department interaction
  • Troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving hardware, software, and other network and system problems.
  • Work escalations from the ZAYO NOC Support teams to troubleshoot issues and outages
  • Work in the On Call engineering rotation
  • Work after-hours installations and maintenance
  • Customer facing position, responsible for working with other network engineering teams,
  • Minimal travel – Company Wide meetings and customer visits (travel <5%).
  • Other related tasks as assigned.

Qualifications:

    • Required, strong knowledge of Prisma SD-WAN (Palo Alto) edge Networking & Security.
      • Minimum of one (1) year experience designing and installing Prisma SD-WAN
    • Desired Prisma SD-WAN certification
    • Desired (not required) SD-WAN experience VMware, Versa and/or Fortinet
    • Knowledge of Network Diagnostics, protocols, and disciplines, BGP, OSPF, QoS, SNMP, VLANS, STP and VRF-LITE.
    • Strong IPv4 subnetting knowledge and knowledge of IPv6 addressing.
    • Knowledge of edge network security, encryption technologies & best practices.
    • Ability to explain network related issues to both technical and non-technical internal and external teams
    • Ability to troubleshoot networks at an expert level.
  • Must be able to meet applicable U.S. government security and access requirements, including obtaining and maintaining a security clearance or other authorization if required for assigned FedRAMP or federal government work and contracts.

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or a related field, or an equivalent combination of professional or military experience.

Experience:

  • Two (2) or more years of experience as a Network Engineer (or in a more senior networking role) supporting enterprise customers of varying sizes.

About the Work

The founder has spent several years building a marketing framework that is becoming a book, a community office hours series, and a full curriculum. It also powers our software. Everything we teach and sell rests on evidence, so we are hiring a researcher to build and protect that foundation.

The Role

You will work directly with the founder to turn the framework into an education program that holds up to scrutiny, and to supply the research our software is built on. You find the strongest evidence, tell us what it does and does not support, and help shape what we teach.
The role starts with research and grows into curriculum and test building, and into using AI to create marketing assets. How fast it grows depends on how quickly you establish the foundation for the framework. The founder is preparing much of the material for you to take over.

What You Will Own

  • The evidence library for the book, starting with the relationship marketing claims
  • A research pass on every office hours outline: each claim checked section by section, newest research first, with a claims and sources list the founder reviews before anything is cited
  • The curriculum structure: one core question and one takeaway for each chapter, learning objectives for each, and a path through the office hours topics
  • Tests and assessments for the curriculum, including questions that check what learners understood
  • Prompts and workflows that use AI to create marketing assets, built with the founder and checked against the evidence
  • Behavioral science input on how buyers think and decide, which feeds the buyer psychology behind each session and each persona in our software
  • Market research for new products, including target markets, buyer segments, and inputs to competitor discovery
  • Short summaries of new academic and industry research that affect the framework

What You Bring

  • A background in behavioral science, such as psychology, behavioral economics, or consumer decision-making
  • Hands-on experience with research methods, both quantitative and qualitative
  • Marketing experience, ideally in both B2B and B2C settings
  • Strong judgment about which sources deserve trust, and the habit of checking the original study instead of a summary of it
  • The ability to write findings in plain language that a business owner can use
  • AI fluency: you write clear prompts, build repeatable workflows, and check what AI returns against the original sources

Nice to Have

  • Experience building curriculum, training programs, assessments, or educational content
  • Familiarity with positioning, brand strategy, or innovation research

How We Will Measure Success

  • Cut lists & orders:Build supplier-ready cut lists and order data in Excel or via Autodesk export, following the templates and examples provided.

  • Shop drawings:Produce shop drawings, roof plans, panel layouts, elevations and details in AutoCAD; mark up in Bluebeam.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

The salary range for this role is $75,000 – $85,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Include on-site search functionality as part of daily monitoring of key pages and functions, and support quarterly content certification reviews to ensure content stays accurate, relevant, and discoverable.

  • Perform page speed optimization, address Core Web Vitals gaps, and recommend enhancements to reduce load time and improve mobile responsiveness.

  • Maintain and optimize XML sitemaps, robots.txt configurations, and crawlability settings.

  • Implement schema markup (JSON-LD), structured metadata, and microdata patterns to improve search visibility and content classification.

  • Enhance internal linking strategies and ensure taxonomy alignment for improved information architecture.

  • Support voice-search readiness through structured content improvements and search-friendly page architecture.

  • Validate search behavior, indexing patterns, and crawl logs to improve visibility and user discoverability.

  • Collaborate with developers, content teams, and UX staff to ensure technical SEO requirements are incorporated into releases.

  • Create and deliver SEO training materials, workshops, documentation, and best-practice guides to support workforce adoption.

  • Track key technical SEO KPIs and produce actionable insights for leadership.

  • Monitor algorithm updates and assess impacts to the client's digital properties.

  • Ensure technical SEO improvements align with federal, DoD, and accessibility requirements.

  • Establish and monitor goals, objectives, performance requirements, standards, and accountability with metrics to meet project requirements as well as Bixal standards.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • At least 5 years of experience performing technical SEO for enterprise websites, or equivalent combinationof education and/or experience.

  • This position must hold an active Secret clearance or higher, in support of a federal government contract.

  • Experience conducting technical audits using tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, SEMrush, or equivalent.

  • Experience optimizing page speed, improving site structure, and applying schema markup.

  • Experience optimizing email/newsletter platforms (e.g., GovDelivery or similar) and subscription-based content for search visibility and discoverability.

  • Working knowledge of generative/AI search behavior (e.g., how Google AI Overviews, Bing Copilot, ChatGPT search, and Perplexity source and cite web content) and how to optimize content for LLM-based retrieval, in addition to traditional SEO tools.

  • Experience authoring structured content and FAQs for conversational and voice interfaces.

  • Understanding of search engine marketing (SEM) and paid media concepts

  • Experience collaborating with content, UX, and development teams on cross-functional SEO initiatives.

  • Experience developing documentation, training materials, or workshops for internal stakeholders.

  • Strong understanding of SEO diagnostics, indexing signals, structured data, canonical rules, and website performance tuning.

  • Proficiency with SEO tools including Google Search Console, Lighthouse, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, and PageSpeed Insights.

  • Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript behavior, and CMS-driven platforms.

  • Knowledge of accessibility and mobile optimization best practices.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data.

  • Excellent oral and written communication and training abilities with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Attention to detail and commitment to precision in site diagnostics and documentation.

  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent SEO initiatives and deadlines.

  • Collaborative mindset for working across content, UX, engineering, and PMO teams.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience supporting federal, DoD, or large enterprise content ecosystems.

  • Familiarity with API-driven search services, metadata governance, and taxonomy standards.

  • Understanding of headless CMS or component-based content architectures.

jobs.excerpt: Help us shape the future of health technology! At Top Doctors Group, we work to improve the way people access healthcare.
jobs.description:
Help us shape the future of health technology!

At Top Doctors Group, we work to improve the way people access healthcare. Through technology, we connect patients, healthcare professionals, and clinics to provide a more accessible, efficient, and human experience.

Today, we operate in 10 countries and develop digital solutions that help thousands of healthcare professionals grow their activity and millions of people find the care they need.

We believe technology creates its greatest impact when it serves people. That is why we continue to grow and look for talented professionals who want to help us build the future of digital health in an international, innovative, and constantly evolving environment.

💡 Why is this role exciting?

Because you will have a direct impact on the development of a complex, cloud-native platform supporting digital health and social care.

iWantGreatCare, part of Top Doctors Group, is a platform that combines Node.js and TypeScript microservices, specialized background workers, event-driven workflows, and applications built with Vue.js and Nuxt.js. It runs on Google Cloud Platform, using technologies such as Pub/Sub, Docker, Kubernetes, MongoDB, BigQuery, ETLs, and modern CI/CD practices.

As a Fullstack Developer, you will design, build, and evolve scalable backend services, distributed workflows, and user-facing applications. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Design, Operations, Integrations, and DevOps to deliver reliable solutions with a meaningful real-world impact.

⚙️ About the platform

Our platform has a distributed, cloud-native architecture composed of:

  • Microservices and workers: Node.js and TypeScript services, with specialized background workers communicating through GCP Pub/Sub queues and REST APIs.

  • Cloud infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Docker, Kubernetes, and managed services supporting scalability and resilience.

  • Data: MongoDB, BigQuery, ETL processes, and integrations with other products and systems.

  • Frontend applications: Administrative and user-facing applications developed with Vue.js and Nuxt.js.

  • DevOps and observability: CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring, logging, and alerting.

🚀 What you will do

  • Design, build, and evolve Node.js and TypeScript microservices and background workers.

  • Develop queue-based integrations and event-driven workflows using GCP Pub/Sub.

  • Build and improve administrative and user-facing applications with Vue.js and Nuxt.js.

  • Implement robust error handling and strengthen monitoring and alerting across services.

  • Maintain and improve ETL processes and data integrations.

  • Participate in technical planning, estimation, and the delivery of complex features.

  • Work with DevOps to improve CI/CD practices and the platform’s scalability, reliability, and performance.

  • Collaborate with the Integrations team to ensure interoperability across company products.

  • Conduct detailed code reviews and help maintain high standards of code quality.

  • Share knowledge and contribute to the continuous improvement of the team’s engineering practices.

👀 We would love to meet you if…

✔ Proven experience designing or working with distributed systems.

✔ Strong expertise in Node.js and TypeScript, as well as experience with typed programming languages.

✔ Solid knowledge of microservices, background workers, asynchronous processing, and event-driven architectures.

✔ Experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, Kubernetes, and IAM.

✔ A good understanding of Docker, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and modern DevOps practices.

✔ Experience working with MongoDB, data integrations, and ETL processes.

✔ The ability to use AI coding tools, such as Cursor or Claude Code, to improve productivity while applying strong technical judgment to review, refine, and validate AI-generated code.

Important Notice for Applicants:

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Principal Full Stack Engineer to lead technical delivery on a federal platform that supports governmentwide regulatory planning and review. Federal agencies, oversight offices, and the public rely on these systems, which must stay available 24/7/365 while a modern replacement is built alongside them.

This role spans both sides of that work. You will keep the existing Java, Spring, and Oracle applications stable, performant, and secure, leading defect resolution and delivering approved enhancements. You will also design and build the replacement platform on cloud, container, and DevOps foundations, shaping its target architecture, its integrations with related federal systems, and the path for moving users and data off the legacy stack. Priorities shift between the two, so we're looking for a hands-on technical leader who is equally comfortable sustaining a production system and building a new one.

You will set technical direction, mentor engineers, and partner with our Project Manager, designers, and security lead. You will also work directly with the client's technical leads and product owner, translating complex trade-offs into clear recommendations.

This is a full-time position on an awarded contract with a 12-month base period and two 12-month option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $145,000 – $155,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as technical lead for the program, setting engineering standards, reviewing code and architecture, and guiding technical decisions across existing and new systems.

  • Lead the Target Solution Architecture and Analysis of Alternatives for the replacement platform, weighing integration, containerized deployment, DevOps efficiency, case and workflow management, and security.

  • Design, prototype, build, and deploy applications on cloud, container, and DevOps foundations, while maintaining and tuning existing Java, Spring, Tomcat, and Oracle applications on Red Hat Enterprise Linux.

  • Design reusable platform capabilities such as user access, workflow routing, document management, audit history, reporting, notifications, and public-facing APIs.

  • Lead triage, analysis, and resolution of priority defects affecting functionality, availability, security, or data integrity.

  • Design and deliver approved enhancements driven by new laws, executive orders, policy changes, and agency needs.

  • Build integrations with related federal systems, such as eRulemaking, FDMS, , the Federal Register, and .

  • Plan and support data migration, cutover, and decommissioning of legacy capabilities.

  • Support 99.5% uptime through patches, upgrades, performance monitoring, alerting, and rapid response to production issues.

  • Identify, prioritize, and pay down technical debt, including outdated code and unsupported libraries.

  • Own CI/CD pipelines that build with a single command, deploy automatically from version control, deploy without downtime, and roll back immediately when needed.

  • Hold the team to the contract's quality bar: at least 90% test coverage, zero linting errors, zero accessibility errors, and no unresolved medium or high security findings.

  • Build in Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility and secure coding practices from the start.

  • Lead functional, integration, regression, performance, accessibility, and security testing, and support user acceptance testing.

  • Keep dependencies, licenses, inline documentation, and system diagrams current.

  • Mentor engineers and review their work, helping the team grow its skills and consistency.

  • Work in an agile process with sprint cycles, contributing to planning, estimation, and roadmaps.

  • Brief client technical leads and the product owner on technical options, risks, and recommendations.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  • At least 10 years of professional software engineering experience, including technical leadership of development teams.

  • Deep hands-on experience with Java and the Spring Framework, including building and maintaining production web applications.

  • Strong experience with relational databases (Oracle preferred), including data modeling, SQL, and performance tuning.

  • Experience designing and deploying cloud-native, containerized applications (such as Docker and Kubernetes) on a major cloud platform.

  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines and automated testing with tools such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins.

  • Experience designing RESTful APIs and integrating multiple systems.

  • Experience modernizing or replacing legacy systems while keeping production stable.

  • Working knowledge of secure coding (OWASP), accessibility (Section 508, WCAG 2.1 AA), and Linux server environments.

  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

  • Polished communication skills, with experience presenting technical options and trade-offs to clients and non-technical stakeholders.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience delivering for federal government clients, especially GSA or other civilian agencies.

  • Experience integrating with or other federated identity and single sign-on services.

  • Experience with , AWS, or Azure, and related certifications.

  • Experience building workflow, case management, or document management systems.

  • Familiarity with federal regulatory processes, such as rulemaking or Paperwork Reduction Act information collections.

  • Experience with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Loki.

  • Experience supporting systems through FISMA Moderate ATO processes.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Commuter benefits

What you'll be doing

What We Need


Corpay is currently looking to hire an Account Manager within our Stored Value Solutions (SVS) division.

SVS serves more than 25% of the top 250 Global Retailers.


In this role, the Account Manager is responsible for building strong client relationships, driving revenue growth, and delivering strategic value to clients. You will serve as the main point of contact, providing consultative support through analysis, regular performance reviews, and by identifying opportunities to upsell solutions that align with client goals.


This is a home-office based position in the UK, and the individual must be able to travel for client presentations and team meetings with occasional international travel to the US and wider Europe.

jobs.description:
Pak jij de kans om samen met twee collega's te ondernemen in een groeiende technische detachering? Bij SD Worx Technics ga je vakspecialisten verbinden aan een opdracht waarin zij echt het verschil maken. Je krijgt hierin volop de vrijheid, het vertrouwen en de verantwoordelijkheid om impact te maken: op klanten, op technici én op je eigen carrière.

Jij zorgt voor de perfecte match en begeleiding gedurende het gehele proces. Jij bent dé specialist die precies weet wat er speelt in de technische sector. Jij weet op de juiste manier technici te benaderen en te overtuigen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Recruiter Techniek ben je de spil tussen onze technici en opdrachtgevers. Jij weet hoe je de beste technici binnenhaalt en samen met je collega plaatst bij je klanten. Vanzelfsprekend bouw je aan je relaties met je kandidaten. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

· Recruitment: je bouwt aan je kandidatenpool met de beste technici. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan elektromonteurs, maintenance engineers, servicetechnici en werktuigbouwkundige.

· Technici en opdrachtgevers matchen: Ook na het matchen blijf je de eerste contactpersoon van zowel de klant, als de begeleider van je kandidaat gedurende de opdracht.

· Targets behalen: Je werkt toe naar het behalen van jouw persoonlijke doelstellingen. Dit omvat zowel kwantitatieve als kwalitatieve targets.

· Netwerk verder uitbouwen: Je gaat zelfstandig actief opzoek naar nieuwe opdrachtgevers.

Wat bieden wij?

SD Worx Technics heeft een informele werksfeer waarin gestuurd wordt op output. Er is veel ruimte voor eigen inbreng en initiatieven. We bieden jou de vrijheid en flexibiliteit om de regie over je werk in handen te nemen. Zo krijg je de ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een salaris tussen de €2900,- en €4500,- bruto op basis van 40 uur afhankelijk van ervaring

  • Een netto onkostenvergoeding van €75,- en een netto internetvergoeding van €25,- op basis van 40 uur

  • Leaseauto die je ook privé mag gebruiken

  • Een kwartaalbonusregeling

  • 8,5% vakantiegeld

  • 25 vakantiedagen, 6,5 adv dagen (of 2,5% extra salaris) & een vrije dag op je verjaardag

  • Een pensioenregeling waarbij SD Worx 60% van de premie betaald

  • Korting op je sportschool abonnement en op een nieuwe fiets

Wat neem jij mee?

Als Recruiter Techniek is het van belang dat je een commerciële drive hebt. Het gaat om een zelfstandige functie die vraagt om proactiviteit. We zoeken daarbij iemand met:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau

  • Ervaring in de technische sector en/of detachering

  • Resultaatgerichtheid en ervaring met het behalen van individuele en teamtargets

  • Klantgerichtheid en sterke communicatieve vaardigheden

  • Oog voor de marktontwikkelingen en deze weet te vertalen naar kansen voor kandidaten

Technics

SD Worx Technics is een specialist in het matchen van technische vakmensen met uitdagende projecten. Wij bieden een persoonlijke benadering en leveren maatwerkoplossingen voor zowel onze klanten als onze medewerkers. Onze cultuur is open en informeel, met veel ruimte voor ondernemerschap en innovatie. Bij ons staan kwaliteit, betrokkenheid en integriteit centraal.

Bij SD Worx werken we als één team en groeien we samen, van beter tot best. Diversiteit staat centraal in ons bedrijf, omdat het ons inspireert en innovatie stimuleert. We verwelkomen sollicitaties van gekwalificeerd talent, ongeacht afkomst, nationaliteit, geslacht, huidskleur, etnische en sociale achtergrond, religie, leeftijd, handicap, seksuele geaardheid en levensfase.

Hier kun je volop groeien, leren en innoveren. Join the team en ervaar het zelf!

At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Project Manager to lead day-to-day communication and project coordination for a high-impact Head Start initiative, ensuring the team stays aligned around shared goals and clear, actionable tasks. Serving as a primary point of contact for the OHS Communications Team, this role works closely with team members to ensure collaboration across a multidisciplinary project team. The Project Manager applies agile methodologies and strong project management practices to keep complex workstreams on track, support continuous improvement, and deliver high-quality outcomes. This role is central to maintaining effective client relationships and driving efficient, transparent operations.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with four one-year option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This is a remote role. Candidates must be willing to travel to the Washington, D.C. area to conduct in-person meetings at government offices approximately once per quarter. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $105,000 – $125,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead daily project management activities to ensure smooth communication, task alignment, and timely delivery of project work.

  • Serve as a direct point of contact with the OHS Communications Team, fostering transparent, proactive, and professional communication.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to set priorities, track progress, and align workstreams.

  • Facilitate agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, retrospectives, stand-ups) and support the implementation of agile practices across the team.

  • Develop and maintain project schedules, work plans, and timelines using project management tools and methodologies.

  • Monitor project risks, dependencies, and progress, escalating issues when necessary and driving solutions to keep work on track.

  • Coordinate with external partners and stakeholders, building strong relationships grounded in respect, clarity, and diplomacy.

  • Contribute to process improvements that enhance team efficiency, communication flow, and delivery quality.

  • Produce clear project documentation—including reports, updates, and deliverable tracking—to support client visibility and decision-making.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree and at least 7 years of relevant Project Management experience.

  • Experience managing contracts for the Office of Head start.

  • Demonstrated experience with Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or similar role).

  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-faceted projects and deliver high-quality results on time.

  • Experience managing federal government contracts.

  • Demonstrated ability to use project management software and tools to plan, track, and report work.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, diplomatically, and effectively with internal teams and external partners.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and diverse stakeholders.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Experience supporting mission-critical systems with 24/7 availability needs.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust clearance in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Certified Scrum Master Certification (CSM)

  • PMP Certification.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We’re a group of go-getters who decided they didn’t want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.

What We Offer

  • An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

  • The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 1,800 team members worldwide, and our Global Talent Exchange Program means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

  • Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You’ll Do

As Director of GTM Operations, you’ll own the planning, analytics, and operating rhythm that connect our go-to-market strategy to execution across Sales and Marketing. What You Can Expect

This is a hands-on technical leadership role at the center of how Zoom gets found, understood, and surfaced across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. You will own the technical SEO foundation across a complex, multi-platform web ecosystem spanning Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, and modern frontend frameworks, translating search strategy into scalable production solutions. Your work connects directly to organic visibility, pipeline, and revenue, and your fingerprints will be on the architecture decisions that shape how Zoom shows up across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and the next generation of agentic web experiences.

About the Team


You will be part of Zoom's Website Engineering team within the Online Business organization, a cross-functional group of web engineers, CMS specialists, SEO and AEO experts, and performance engineers who build and scale the technical foundation powering Zoom's global web presence. The team collaborates closely with Marketing, Product, Design, Content, and Localization to deliver fast, accessible, and AI-ready digital experiences. Technical excellence, a bias toward automation, and engineering-by-design are at the core of how we operate.

Responsibilities


  • Lead the technical SEO roadmap and execution across Zoom's global web ecosystem, owning high-priority initiatives driven by SEO analysis, audits, crawl data, search performance data, server logs, technical root-cause analysis, and business priorities.
  • Translate SEO and AEO requirements into technical designs, development specifications, production implementations, and ongoing maintenance across Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, APIs, and modern frontend frameworks, ensuring requirements are incorporated throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Own technical solutions for crawlability, indexability, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, metadata, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, JavaScript rendering, client-side rendering, server-side rendering, static generation, incremental rendering, and search-friendly application architecture.
  • Build and scale reusable SEO capabilities including centralized metadata services, automated sitemap generation, structured-data components, redirect services, internal-linking systems, and standardized SEO configurations that platforms can inherit without repeated manual intervention.
  • Drive Core Web Vitals and web performance improvements, including LCP, INP, CLS, JavaScript execution, rendering performance, image optimization, font loading, third-party scripts, caching, CDN configuration, API performance, and server response times.
  • Develop automated testing, monitoring, dashboards, CI/CD quality gates, proactive alerting, and validation scripts that detect technical SEO issues and prevent regressions from reaching production across broken links, metadata, canonicalization, structured data, redirects, sitemaps, indexability, robots directives, duplicate URLs, internal linking, accessibility, performance, and rendering.
  • Establish the technical foundation for AEO and AI search by implementing structured data, semantic HTML, machine-readable metadata, entity and product schemas, and machine-readable endpoints; evaluate emerging AI-search and agentic-web standards and translate them into practical engineering requirements.
  • Define and maintain technical SEO standards and governance across Optimizely, WordPress, and custom applications, serving as the technical authority for SEO implementation within Web Engineering through reference architectures, launch-readiness criteria, design reviews, and code reviews.
  • Partner with SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Web Engineering, Product, and senior stakeholders to translate search strategy and business priorities into scalable technical solutions, improve Zoom's discoverability and representation across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms, and connect technical SEO initiatives to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.

What We're Looking For


  • 8+ years of experience in technical SEO, web engineering, or a related discipline, with a demonstrated track record leading technical SEO initiatives across large-scale websites and web applications in a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environment; ability to connect technical SEO work directly to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in technical SEO fundamentals: crawlability, indexation, rendering, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, XML sitemaps, robots directives, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, and JavaScript-based web applications; hands-on proficiency with JavaScript, PHP, HTML, and CSS to diagnose and implement technical SEO fixes directly in the codebase and CMS, not only through engineering handoffs.
  • Proven experience improving web performance and Core Web Vitals, including diagnosing issues related to JavaScript execution, rendering, caching, CDN configuration, images, third-party scripts, APIs, and server performance.
  • Experience building scalable SEO capabilities, automation, monitoring, and CI/CD quality gates across enterprise CMS platforms such as Optimizely and WordPress; comfortable going directly into the CMS or codebase to implement configurations, standardize templates, and deploy SEO capabilities across multiple sites and applications without requiring a dedicated engineering sprint for every change.
  • Strong understanding of structured data, Schema.org, JSON-LD, semantic HTML, and the technical foundations required for AEO and AI-powered search, with familiarity with emerging AI search platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.
  • Strong analytical skills using tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Semrush, Ahrefs, Sitebulb, analytics platforms, and application observability tools; experienced in analyzing server logs and crawl logs to identify crawl blocks, indexation gaps, rendering failures, and visibility issues across Google, AI search platforms, and LLM crawlers, and translating those findings into prioritized, actionable fixes.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineering architecture, establish technical standards, and partner effectively with SEO, Web Engineering, Product, Marketing, Content, and senior stakeholders.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Content Strategist / Information Architect for a project that supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them — with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

The Content Strategist / Information Architect shapes how content is planned, structured, and organized across the program's public-facing websites and applications so that users can find, understand, and act on information efficiently. This role guides content strategy across its full lifecycle, from audience research and planning through development, ongoing management, governance, and publishing, while contributing information-architecture expertise to usability testing, content governance, and search discoverability.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Responsibilities:

  • Administer content strategy and information architecture across the full content lifecycle, from planning and development through management, governance, and publishing.

jobs.description:
Job Posting Closing Date: Open until Filled

Where do you belong?

Your career is more than just a job, it's part of your life. Whether you’re a clinician, or non-clinical professional, at USACS you'll feel a sense of connection working with clinicians and office staff who share your interests and values. We want you to love coming to work each day because you believe in what you do and the people with whom you work. We care about your success.

USACS also understands that location is important. We offer career opportunities for clinicians and non-clinical support staff from New York to Hawaii and numerous points in between. Our supportive culture, outstanding benefits and competitive compensation package is best in class.

Job Description

The Clinician Scheduler develops and manages schedules for clinicians at hospital locations to ensure that all shifts are fully staffed for the expected patient volume. This role will work with Clinicians, Leadership, and Site Directors to ensure appropriate clinician coverage is in place to treat expected patient volumes. The clinician scheduler contributes to the corporation’s financial performance by managing schedules based on tiered prioritization of clinician utilization, optimizing clinician availability, assisting in requesting and planning future over/under staffing needs, and adjusting as needed on a continual basis.

Location: Remote


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

  • Creates and maintains schedules for multiple hospital locations 45 days before the start of the month.
  • Works independently utilizing scheduling software (Shift Admin) to auto-generate schedules based on customizations, rules, and weightings.
  • Establish relationships with all providers to learn their scheduling preferences and hard stops. Use discretion to determine reasonable asks and when medical director approval/denial is necessary.
  • Analyze requests, identify potential conflict areas, and determine the best solution. If unsuccessful in resolving independently, implement an escalation process.
  • Compile standard reports based on historical data to determine future staffing needs.
  • Collaborate with credentialing, RDO, Directors, or others to ensure available staffing.
  • Work with other clinician schedulers to ensure coordination of the utilization of cross-credentialed providers and days of availability.
  • Work with Scheduling Optimization to schedule traveling physicians and to optimize the site allocation process.
  • Ensure distributed days of availability allow for complete staffing of all shifts. Optimize trades and shift blocking to minimize costs of traveling physician expenses.
  • Responsible for ensuring continuity of care, shift equity, and distribution in accordance with site-specific scheduling policies.
  • Schedule providers based on budgeting tiers. Maximize the use of local FT clinicians based on contractual obligations, followed by PT, STAT, and locums in descending priority.
  • Responsible for coordinating and securing the use of outside clinician resources through locum companies within budgeted goals as necessary to complete the schedule.
  • Modification of shift maps as directed by site leadership
  • Work with the President/VP/Site Directors/RDOs to adjust the schedule for service/budget under immediate deadlines.
  • Work directly with site Physician/APP leaders to ensure optimal schedules before publication.
  • Responsible for ensuring anticipated and last-minute open shifts are filled. Responsible for communicating changes to schedule and providing all necessary parties are aware and in agreement.
  • Responsible for maintaining provider satisfaction regarding the monthly schedule. Ensures expectations are clear of clinician scheduling requirements and expectations from scheduling.
  • Ability to investigate the source of any complaints, analyze the underlying reasons, and resolve them as appropriate.
  • Responsible for setting up Shift Admin and properly applying shifts with pay codes to automate payroll through Workday integration.
  • Utilize strong judgment when deviations from established policies and procedures are necessary to complete schedules based on established deadlines.
  • Communicates terms and premium rates with providers to ensure all shifts are covered after the provider is scheduled to contract max by site leadership.
  • On Call responsibilities may be required.
  • Discretion in the escalation process when clinician leadership support is necessary to create a schedule effectively.
  • Responsible for ensuring all parties agree with scheduling policies and decisions surrounding specific issues, including local and support clinician leadership.
  • Analyze metrics and reporting, able to communicate results

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:

  • Ability to navigate and function under a dual and remote reporting structure
  • Strong organization and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to prioritize competing needs
  • Uses critical thinking skills to make decisions
  • Professional presentation/phone savvy
  • High-level analytics skills
  • Ability to effectively perform in a multi-task work environment
  • Ability to maintain patience and composure in difficult situations
  • Ability to identify and communicate emerging issues to management
  • Knowledge and skills in using personal computers (Windows) with a strong emphasis on Microsoft Office
  • Programs- Outlook, Word, Excel and Adobe Acrobat
  • Technical ability with scheduling software

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • Experience creating/managing complex fluid schedules
  • Shift admin scheduling experience preferred
  • Previous experience working with clinicians preferred

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

  • This position requires long periods of sitting and reviewing data on computer monitors
  • Required to have close visual acuity to perform the job

Hourly Rate: $21.59-$39.94

Hourly rate may be determined on several factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills, experience, education, geographical location and requirements stated in job description.

This role is focused specifically on integration engineering and middleware platform operations — the technical discipline of connecting enterprise systems, automating data flows, managing APIs, and ensuring reliable, secure, and performant integration services across CLIENT's on-premises and cloud application portfolio. The Integration / Middleware Engineer works at the platform and architecture level, designing and building integration solutions that enable CLIENT's enterprise applications to communicate and operate effectively as a cohesive enterprise environment.

This individual must demonstrate deep hands-on expertise in enterprise integration platforms, middleware technologies, API management, and data pipeline engineering, with the ability to independently design, build, and troubleshoot complex integrations in a federal enterprise environment that spans on-premises infrastructure, AWS, and Microsoft Azure Government.

  • Engineer and maintain integration interfaces, data pipelines, message queues, and event-driven integration workflows across CLIENT's enterprise application portfolio
  • Develop and maintain integration platform configurations, connection management settings, and interface administration procedures
  • Monitor integration platform health, performance, and error rates using Government-provided monitoring tools and dashboards

API Management Engineering:

  • Engineer API gateway configurations, including rate limiting, authentication, authorization, and traffic management policies
  • Develop and maintain API documentation, including endpoint specifications, data schemas, and integration guides

Middleware Configuration & Administration:

  • Engineer middleware configurations, including topic management, queue administration, consumer group management, and message routing rules
  • Monitor middleware platform health and performance, taking proactive action to address capacity, performance, and availability issues

  • Develop and maintain middleware administration runbooks, configuration standards, and operational procedures

Integration Testing & Quality Assurance:

We are looking for a VMware Infrastructure Engineer to design, deploy, and operate VMware-based virtualization, software-defined networking, and software-defined storage platforms across on-premises and hybrid cloud environments. The role covers vSphere, vSAN, NSX, Aria, and Tanzu, with a focus on automation, capacity management, and the practical realities of operating a large VMware estate alongside modern cloud-native workloads. jobs.description:
Strategic Alliance Lead (Associate Director or Director)

Location(s) – Europe (UK, France or Belgium) or United States (East Coast)

Do you get more energy from building something than from maintaining it? Can you sit across the table from a global pharma executive one day and roll your sleeves up with a project team the next? Ready to own a strategically relationship in our business, and write the playbook as you go, rather than inherit someone else's?

At Cerba Research, we are committed to finding the best talent to join our team. We have partnered with Vector Talent to manage the recruitment process for this role. If you're interested in applying, please direct all applications and questions to Vector Talent.

Cerba Research is looking for a Strategic Alliance Lead to take ownership of our most strategic partnerships, preferred-provider relationships, and sole-source alliances across Central and Specialty Laboratory Services. This is a build role: you'll be the executive and operational bridge between Cerba Research and our most important partners; designing the governance, framework, and cross-functional alignment that doesn't fully exist yet, while elevating the team around you into a more strategic way of working.

About Cerba Research

With over 40 years of clinical research expertise, Cerba Research has built a unique offering of services, which includes clinical trial management, specialty lab & biomarkers services and medical devices & diagnostics offerings.

Cerba Research supports clients from research and development all the way through clinical studies and commercialization of therapies. We combine the deep therapeutic understanding and agility of a specialist with the capacity, breadth and global reach of a central lab.

Our extensive experience in central & specialty laboratory services is key to our success, allowing us to provide clients with early scientific insights that optimize protocol development.

We provide key laboratory services to biopharma, government and not-for-profit organizations, supporting clinical trials. Our global accredited laboratory network and connected logistical infrastructure covers the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

Our aim is to transform clinical research to deliver the promise of precision and predictive medicine to help people live healthier lives. It's our passion, expertise, and commitment to quality that drive Cerba Research. We want to change the shape of clinical development, and help patients around the world get access to new treatments faster.

Why Join Us?

  • Real Ownership, From Day One – You'll be the named executive lead for a landmark strategic partnership generating multi-million-dollar bookings today, with a clear path to significantly more as the relationship expands.
  • A True Blank Slate – This isn't a role you're inheriting, you're building the governance framework, the relationship model, and the playbook that Cerba Research will use for its most important partnerships going forward.
  • Executive Access – You'll operate at the level of global pharma procurement, vendor management, and clinical leadership.
  • Global Reach, Real Impact – Join a business with 40+ years of clinical research heritage and a global accredited laboratory network spanning the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Australia and Africa.

How You Will Add Value

As Strategic Alliance Lead, you will contribute to:

  • Owning strategic alliance leadership across Cerba Research's highest-value partnerships, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Building and running the governance model - QBRs, executive steering committees, escalation pathways; from the ground up
  • Acting as the voice of the customer internally and the voice of Cerba Research externally, translating what each side actually needs into action
  • Driving strategic account growth - new services, new therapeutic areas, and expanded scope, in partnership with Commercial leadership
  • Coaching and elevating the existing portfolio oversight team into a more strategic, alliance-first way of working

Your Responsibilities

  • Serve as the designated executive and operational lead for assigned strategic partners, sole-source relationships, and preferred-provider agreements
  • Lead the implementation and onboarding of newly signed strategic partnerships, coordinating cross-functional readiness and governance structures
  • Monitor and ensure compliance with MSA commitments, service levels, and contractual obligations - proactively identifying and closing gaps
  • Define, track, and report KPIs including study award rates, turnaround time, quality indicators, and customer satisfaction, translating them into executive-ready insight
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Procurement, Vendor Management, Clinical Operations, and Executive Leadership
  • Lead resolution of complex operational, quality, or commercial issues affecting strategic partners, coordinating cross-functional teams to close them out
  • Develop and maintain Strategic Alliance Plans covering stakeholder mapping, growth targets, competitive positioning, and expansion opportunities

Travel:

Significant in the early phase of this role, as you build relationships and governance structures in person across our labs and our partners' sites. This typically settles to around 30% once a quarterly governance cadence is established.

Requirements

About You

You've owned a strategic alliance relationship in CRO or central/specialty lab services from the point it was awarded. You're as comfortable in the detail with a project team as you are across the table from a senior procurement or clinical leader. You'd rather build the framework than be handed one.

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Business Administration, Clinical Research, or a related field (advanced degree preferred)
  • Minimum 5 years in strategic account management, alliance management, or business operations within CRO, central laboratory, or a related life sciences environment, lab alliance experience preferred, CRO alliance experience essential
  • Demonstrated experience owning a strategic partnership, preferred-provider agreement, or sole-source relationship end to end
  • Comfortable operating in a heavily matrixed organization. You’re able to influence delivery teams and senior leadership in both directions without formal authority over either
  • Executive-level stakeholder engagement experience, ideally including pharma procurement or vendor management
  • A genuine interest in mentorship and team development, this role includes elevating the capability of the wider team
  • Fluent in English

At Cerba HealthCare, we believe that the diversity of people, backgrounds, and perspectives is an essential asset in fulfilling our mission: to improve the health of everyone, everywhere.

We are committed to providing an inclusive work environment that guarantees equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of age, background, sexual orientation, disability, or any other personal characteristic. All talented individuals are encouraged to apply.
