jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer - Malware Detection (remote work)
jobs.excerpt: CloudLinux is a global remote-first company.  We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations.
jobs.description:
CloudLinux is a global remote-first company. We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations. Every person on our team supports each other and does what we can to ensure we all are successful.

Check out our website for more information:

Imunify360 is CloudLinux's security suite for Linux web servers: real-time and background malware scanning, automated cleanup, a WAF, runtime PHP protection (Proactive Defense), a database malware scanner, and IP reputation. It runs on hosting providers' shared, VPS, and dedicated servers, so new web-malware campaigns land on our fleet early.

We sit on one of the largest labeled corpora of live web-server malware in the industry: files, verdicts, cleanup outcomes, and analyst decisions collected from production hosting servers every day. It already drives our signatures, heuristics, and ML models, and there is far more to get out of it. We are looking for a Senior ML Engineer who will turn that data into detection that ships — classifiers, LLM-assisted triage and generated signatures — and keep exploring new ML/LLM methods against it, measured by the product's false-negative and false-positive rates, not by notebook accuracy.

Our dataset focuses on web malware — PHP, JavaScript, HTML phishing kits, infected WordPress and Joomla plugins and themes, database injections — with the context around each file.

What you'll work with:

  • Malware samples from production servers, with verdicts and analyst decisions
  • Years of signatures and detection rules
  • Customer-reported false negatives and false positives
  • Runtime behavior of code on live sites
  • Web-attack traffic
  • File metadata and how files spread across servers
  • Cleanup outcomes, including what came back

What you will do:

The goal is 10x more malware detected at the same or lower false-positive rate. Hand-written rules and faster pipelines will not get there; models trained on our data might.

  • Decide which files on a server deserve a closer look, within tight CPU and memory budgets
  • Tell malicious code from benign at fleet scale and a sensible cost per file
  • Generate detection signatures automatically from new campaigns
  • Catch malware that only looks malicious in context, such as phishing pages and script injections
  • Route each file to the right detection engine
  • Make cleanup precise so sites stay clean afterwards
  • Prove each model improves detection before it ships

How we work:

You get an experimentation track, GPUs, and a direct line to leadership; in return, you bring numbers, not opinions.

  • Remote-first, async across UTC−5 to UTC+8. Decisions are written down (ADR-Lite) and public by default.
  • Hardware follows evidence: Each training direction starts with dedicated GPUs on our own bare metal; leadership has committed to fund more when the case is made with data.
  • Agentic engineering: Claude and Codex are the default tools, wired to GitLab, Jenkins, Redash, Jira, and Slite through MCP servers. We look at how engineers work with agents — context, specificity, review quality — not only at output.
  • Close to ground truth: You work daily with malware analysts, detection and infrastructure engineers, and the rest of our ML team.
  • Ship gates: No model or build goes out if it raises false positives or false negatives on our past-error sets. Blameless post-mortems within 24 hours.

What you'll deliver:

You own the path from raw samples to a model in production, and the numbers that prove it helped.

  • First month: A first model trained on production data and measured against today's engines — suspicious-file triage or a metadata model. The evaluation harness in place: splits by time and campaign so families don't leak, and a regression set from past FPs and FNs.
  • By month 3: Several models in production: some in shadow mode building evidence, some live and producing real detections, all gated on the past-error regression set. A training setup that keeps its GPUs busy. A written proposal (ADR) for the detection cascade, with cost per file and hardware needs.
  • By month 12: Models are a main source of new detections, reported as share of new detections and FN-rate trend. Retraining on fresh analyst and FN labels on a fixed cadence. Generated signatures inside the analyst workflow. Two or three parallel training directions that other engineers can run with your tooling.

Requirements

What you bring:

  • 5+ years building ML systems that ran in production, including 2+ in an adversarial domain: security, abuse, fraud, or spam.
  • You have trained and fine-tuned transformer models yourself — data preparation, tokenizing code, LoRA/QLoRA or full fine-tunes, distillation, quantization — not only called hosted APIs.
  • Classic ML depth: gradient boosting, linear models on sparse features, calibration, class imbalance, and judgement on when these beat an LLM.
  • Evaluation discipline: leakage-free splits by time and family, precision at a fixed false-positive budget, regression sets, and an honest account of why production will differ from offline.
  • Inference cost engineering: you have measured throughput and latency and made a model fit a CPU or memory budget (ONNX, llama.cpp, vLLM, int8/int4).
  • Strong Python, PyTorch and the Hugging Face stack; SQL on large analytical tables (ClickHouse or similar).
  • Familiarity with PHP or JavaScript, or willingness to pick it up working with our malware analysts.
  • You use AI coding agents daily and can show how.
  • English at upper-Intermediate (B2) level or higher, with particularly strong written communication for async work.

It is a strong plus if you have:

  • Web malware, webshells, phishing kits or WordPress security experience.
  • Models over code: AST or token features, code LLMs, graph models on program structure.
  • Malware clustering and similarity analysis.
  • Multi-GPU training on your own bare metal; MLflow or Weights & Biases; dataset versioning.
  • Go or Rust, for on-server inference.
  • Published work or talks on ML for security.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

  • A focus on professional development.
  • Interesting and challenging projects.
  • Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.

jobs.description:
Senior Backend Engineer

About us

We're creating the foundational backend systems that power private market access, from secure authentication and transaction processing to portfolio management and regulatory compliance.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to own the systems where money moves and balances have to be correct — the ledger, transaction processing, and the settlement and reconciliation workflows behind our platform. This is the correctness core of what we build. If a balance is wrong, a transaction double-processes, or a reconciliation silently drifts, nothing else we build matters.

You'll design the double-entry ledger, the money-movement engine, and the long-running state machines that carry complex financial workflows to completion reliably over hours, days, or weeks. You'll reason about idempotency, concurrency, partial failure, and replay as a matter of habit, not as an afterthought.

You'll own core infrastructure decisions and set the standard for how we build financial systems.

Requirements

What You'll Do

  • Design and build the double-entry ledger and money-movement engine that all transactions reconcile against
  • Model complex financial workflows as robust, observable state machines that run reliably over long periods
  • Guarantee financial correctness under concurrency: idempotent operations, transactional integrity, and reconciliation that ties out to the cent
  • Handle partial-failure and replay cases so no event is lost, duplicated, or applied twice
  • Build secure, well-versioned APIs
  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and data models
  • Debug production issues and own the reliability of mission-critical financial workflows

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of backend development on production systems
  • Demonstrated money-movement correctness experience: you've built a ledger, settlement system, payments core, or transaction-processing system and can talk in detail about how you kept it correct
  • Concurrency and idempotency depth: you can explain, from experience, how you handled double-processing, race conditions on balances, and replay
  • Reconciliation experience: you've built or owned systems that had to tie out exactly, and you know what happens when they don't
  • Strong TDD practices: you write tests first and maintain comprehensive coverage
  • Domain-Driven Design expertise: you model complex financial domains accurately
  • Deep PostgreSQL knowledge: schema design, transactions, isolation levels, optimization
  • Strong in a modern backend stack: we work in TypeScript/Node.js, Go and on the JVM ecosystem; we value real depth in either and the range to pick up the other

• Cloud deployment experience

  • Startup mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, high autonomy, driving solutions without detailed specs

Nice to Have

  • Payments, banking, brokerage, or investment-platform systems experience
  • Securities, custody, or portfolio/NAV domain knowledge
  • Event-driven architectures and message queues
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
  • Understanding of KYC/AML or compliance frameworks
  • Accounting principles or financial modeling

jobs.description:
The Senior Asset Manager, Commercial Servicing will provide proactive monitoring and surveillance of assigned assets securing Commercial Real Estate (“CRE”) loans, as well as being a source of information and training for Asset Managers. This is an individual contributor role that reports to a manager and will work hand-in-hand with various internal business units. The Senior Asset Manager will serve as the point of contact for the borrower and the assigned investor(s), provide oversight of an assigned portfolio, facilitate borrower requests, monitor and enforce loan covenants, resolve insurance non-compliance, complete financial analyses, delinquency resolution, be an escalation point for questions and inquiries from external clients and internal staff, and other responsibilities as need arises. This position requires the ability to provide best-in-industry customer service, interpret loan documents, compliance, quality control, provide mentorship to team members, and resolve a wide spectrum of borrower-related inquiries related to commercial loan servicing. This is a customer-facing position, and all interactions must be handled with a high degree of professionalism, courteous customer service, and promptness. Individuals in this role are required to adhere to investor servicing guidelines, internal policies and procedures.

Job Responsibilities and Requirements:

Customer Service:

  • Act as the primary contact for the borrower, investor, related third parties, and various internal business units in order to resolve all inquiries and servicing functions for the loan.
  • Maintain professionalism during all interactions.
  • Demonstrated ability to initiate difficult conversations while maintaining best-in-class customer service.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle escalated items during difficult conversations.

Portfolio and Asset Oversight and Servicing:

  • Quality Control check of loan boarding against the loan documents to ensure accuracy.
  • Coach team members on CRE loan document interpretation.
  • Identify & monitor loan covenants for borrower compliance to include letter of credit monitoring, cash management provisions, waterfall allocation, DSCR testing, occupancy triggers, etc.
  • Monitor Letters of Credit for expiration.
  • Interpret and work effectively with large data sets.
  • Expert monitoring of escrow and reserve functions within the CRE environment.
  • Work within a CRE loan servicing system and maintain data integrity.
  • Read, understand, and proactively monitor rent rolls, financial statements, property inspections, and other documents in order to address potential performance issues before they arise.
  • Strong knowledge of CRE loan participations.
  • Strong knowledge of CRE insurance coverage requirements.
  • Spread and analyze property level financial statements and provide training to Asset Managers for complex assets.
  • Create a pro forma based upon historical property performance and provide training to Asset Managers for complex assets.
  • Work closely with borrowers and investors to resolve delinquent payment issues as they arise.
  • Generate an amortization table and calculate various loan accounting items including, but not limited to, interest, default interest, prepayment premiums, yield maintenance, and escrow constants with no assistance.
  • Create, maintain, and monitor investor level watchlist.
  • Lead client calls and/or meetings reviewing loan performance issues.
  • Review loan draws submitted by the Borrower for accuracy and overall construction / renovation schedules and provide training to Asset Managers for complex draws.
  • Administer construction / rehab loan covenants, including periodic review of construction/rehab work schedule, progress reports and inspections, property stabilization performance schedules, budgets, and borrower equity earnout provisions
  • Proactive engagement with borrower regarding exit strategy and current market conditions as projects progress towards maturity.
  • Escalate items appropriately to Manager.
  • Prepare, Collaborate with Investor Reporting, and Review CREF-C Reporting Packages
  • Act as the first point of contact for all escalations from the team.

Complete Borrowers Requests:

  • Read and interpret CRE loan documents to determine Borrower Request eligibility.
  • Discuss and engage in conversations with borrowers and investors regarding borrower request submissions, requirements, and resolution with no assistance.

  • Complete presentation-level write-ups and recommendations for various types of borrower requests.
  • Review and Approve write-ups completed by Asset Managers prior to presentation.
  • Exceptional familiarity with the following requests, documentation requirements, and processes:
  • Assumption
  • Collateral Substitution
  • Insurance Loss Processing
  • Insurance Non-Compliance Resolution and Waivers
  • Lender Placed Insurance
  • Loan Maturity Extension
  • Loan Modification
  • Partial Release of Collateral
  • Property Management Change

Other Responsibilities and Requirements:

  • Adapt quickly to various requests from multiple sources.
  • Prioritize multiple, simultaneous incoming requests.
  • Generate reports for investors as required.
  • Coordinate with internal departments for servicing functions as required.
  • Review and update internal policies and procedures as required.
  • Assist with audits as requested.
  • Lead team trainings.
  • Prepare presentation for investors, management, and internal business units.
  • Other duties as assigned.
  • Qualifications
  • Demonstrates positive attitude, adds to a positive team morale, and is eager to take on and learn new things
  • Four-year degree from an accredited University preferred or equivalent work experience
  • Minimum of 8 years of CRE loan servicing experience required, 1 – 2 years in a leadership position preferred.
  • Familiarity with the full CRE loan life cycle from onboarding through Mortgage Satisfaction.
  • High attention to detail
  • Strong proficiency in Word, Excel, Outlook, CoPilot, and other information processing programs
  • Bilingual (English and Spanish) is considered a plus
  • Self-motivated and work independently
  • Ability to perform complex calculations using calculators and systems is required
  • Ability to reason and exercise sound judgment
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately
  • Outstanding communications skills (including verbal, written and listening skills), with an emphasis on strong customer service, professional relationship building skills, conflict resolution, and having difficult conversations
  • Previous experience with REALSynergy servicing system is considered a plus

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to lead delivery of data.CMS.gov, the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services' (CMS) open data platform, which hosts more than 170 data products used by researchers, policymakers, providers, and the public. As the primary strategic and delivery lead, you will own the product roadmap, run a cross-functional agile team of 15 to 25 people, and serve as the main partner to the CMS Office of Enterprise Data and Analytics (OEDA) and data owners across eight CMS components. You will guide the platform's next phase positioning as the single destination for CMS public data. This role suits a leader with deep CMS and open data experience who can turn stakeholder priorities into measurable results.

This is afull-time position contingent on contract awardwith a defined performance period of a nine month base period and four option years .

You’ll have the opportunity to join a project that directly supports Bixal’s mission of improving how government serves people. While the project has a defined timeline, we believe in open communication and proactive career support. You’ll be kept informed of contract status — and we’ll be here to help you grow into what’s next, whether within this project or beyond it.

Location:

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA with occasional travel to CMS headquarters in Baltimore, MD. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $120,000 – $130,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage a cross-functional delivery team, and scale staffing as optional tasks and surge support are authorized.

  • Own the product strategy and rolling roadmap, prioritize the backlog by desirability, feasibility, and viability, and update the roadmap at the start of each Program Increment (PI).

  • Lead the agile cadence: two-week sprints, three-sprint PIs, planning, demos, retrospectives, and the Scrum of Scrums.

  • Oversee all task order management, including project and sprint planning, financial tracking, and estimate at completion.

  • Produce the Monthly Status Report covering accomplishments, risks, QASP performance, financials, velocity and staffing. Produce the Project Status Dashboard to provide visibility into progress, defects and risks at all times, drawing on live Jira and Confluence data.

  • Develop and maintain the QASP, and report performance against its metrics and the SOO key results.

  • Identify risks, blockers, and dependencies early and bring them to CMS with a proposed path forward.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for CMS, including the COR and CO and Product Owners.

  • Coordinate with the Office of Communications and over eight CMS data-owning components, and onboard new data owners as needed.

  • Plan and deliver at least 10 new data product releases per contract year.

  • Oversee help desk operations, user communications, outreach, and presentations for CMS leadership.

  • Apply open data standards and strengthen data and content governance through standard guides and editorial workflows.

  • Coordinate with other CMS contractors in cross-contractor forums as directed by the COR.

  • Lead transition-in activities to ensure a continuity of services, reaching full operational capability within six months, and deliver the Transition-Out Plan 90 days before the end of performance.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in management, public administration, IT, or a related field.

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant program or project management experience.

  • Minimum 4 years on open data projects, with demonstrated expertise in DCAT-US 3.0 [RF1] ￼.

  • Minimum 4 years working directly with CMS programs or data.

  • Experience managing cross-functional teams, with the ability to lead 15–25 people.

  • Deep knowledge of Agile product management principles, including sprint planning, backlog management and release planning.

  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub.

  • Ability to oversee all aspects of task order management, including reporting, sprint planning, and project planning.

  • Experience facilitating stakeholder engagement across multiple CMS components and data owners.

  • Strong written and verbal communicationskills, including briefing government leadership.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to have:

  • PMP, SAFe, Certified ScrumMaster, or equivalent agile certification.

  • Experience with Drupal-based public websites or large public data platforms.

  • Familiarity with CMS security and ATO processes, Section 508, and WCAG 2.1 AA.

  • Experience with hosting migrations or website consolidation projects.

To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:

  • You’ll join Dexcom’s growing Commercial Excellence organization, where business partnership, data, systems, and insights come together to power commercial planning, engagement, execution, enablement, and measurement across EMEA. The team is transforming how Dexcom leverages commercial data—building a connected ecosystem, turning data into foresight & action, enabling field teams to deliver one coherent high-value experience, and elevating strategic decision‑making. We’re collaborative, fast‑moving, and committed to making data a competitive advantage.

  • The Commercial Data & CRM Operations Analyst is a hands‑on partner to Commercial teams responsible for executing and scaling CRM capabilities while ensuring high‑quality, reliable commercial master data. This role combines CRM platform execution with Master Data Management (MDM) operations to improve field effectiveness, data quality, and commercial decision‑making across EMEA.

Where you come in:

  • Build, configure, and maintain Veeva CRM / Vault features (objects, layouts, rules, workflows, reports, dashboards) aligned to commercial priorities, enabling efficient and insight‑driven field execution.

  • Translate business requirements into scalable CRM solutions, balancing user experience, compliance, and operational efficiency.

  • Operate day‑to‑day Master Data Management (MDM) processes, including evaluating and maintaining customer (HCP / HCO / account) data using established business rules and data quality criteria.

  • Execute data quality improvements across MDM and CRM, including data clean‑up initiatives, validation, and maintenance of customer hierarchies, affiliations, and attributes.

  • Support MDM and CRM integration activities, including onboarding, data migration, and alignment of legacy data with current business and system requirements.

  • Partner with Commercial Data Enablement, Analytics, Sales Operations, and IT teams to prioritize enhancements, resolve data issues, and ensure systems and data enable business processes.

  • Act as a frontline support resource for field teams, managing user requests, performing functional testing and validation, and ensuring solutions are production‑ready and adoption‑focused.

  • Maintain documentation of business rules, configurations, and data decisions, and track operational KPIs related to data quality, system usage, and process efficiency.

What makes you successful:

  • Experience working in MedTech or Pharmaceutical European commercial organizations and strong understanding of commercial data and processes.

  • Hands‑on experience with Veeva CRM / Veeva Vault configuration and feature deployment in a Commercial Excellence or Sales Operations environment.

  • Strong understanding of master data concepts, including customer hierarchies, matching, merging, survivorship, and data validation.

  • Experience executing data quality, data stewardship, or CRM data management activities with high attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage both system configuration tasks and operational data workloads, prioritizing effectively in a fast‑paced environment.

  • Experience performing functional testing, validation, and supporting user acceptance to ensure high‑quality system deployments.

  • Clear communicator, who can collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, field teams, analysts, and IT partners.

  • Proactive, execution‑oriented mindset with a focus on improving data quality, system capabilities, and user experience.

What you’ll get:

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.

  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.

  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.

  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.

  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

We are seeking a senior Lead Developer who will lead engineering on a Drupal and React platform hosted on Acquia, direct development of new datasets, interactive tools, and dashboards, and keep the platform secure, accessible, FISMA-compliant, and highly available. Beyond day-to-day delivery, this role will lead the platform's modernization, including evaluating and executing a hosting and CDN migration and consolidating other data websites onto the platform.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the United States, excluding its territories. You must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $135,000 – $145,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as technical authority for the Drupal and React platform, including JSON:API integration, custom Drupal modules, and the SQLite and MySQL data layers.

  • Maintain Acquia hosting, the Akamai CDN, and current integrations, and recommend how to apply platform vendor updates.

  • Lead technical design and development of new data products, interactive tools, dashboards, and features.

  • Build Drupal role-based access controls and self-service tools so data owners can publish and edit their own content.

  • Provide secure APIs and data exchange mechanisms for external systems and third-party use.

  • Manage release management, including emergency out-of-cycle releases to production.

  • Oversee functional, performance, security, accessibility, and user acceptance testing.

  • Ensure Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, with zero unresolved critical accessibility defects in production.

  • Maintain a secure, FISMA-compliant codebase, running static and dynamic security scans and fixing all critical and high vulnerabilities before release.

  • Maintain the ATO and its security documentation in CFACTS, coordinating with the CMS ISSO.

  • Own monitoring, incident response, and disaster recovery.

  • Lead the technical analysis and execution of the hosting and CDN migration.

  • Lead data migration and system integration for the website consolidation.

  • Lead technical knowledge transfer with the incumbent and ensure every release ships with complete technical documentation.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bacehlor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field or equivalent combination of educationa and experience.

  • At least 10 years of Drupal development, including a minimum of 3 years integrating React front-ends with Drupal backends via JSON:API, Acquia-hosted environments, and SQLite/MySQL

  • Subject matter expertise in open data standards, Drupal engineering, React engineering, and Agile SDLC

  • Familiarity with CDN technologies, including Akamai and alternative CDN platforms

  • Experience with cloud hosting and the ability to assess, plan, and execute hosting migrations

  • Experience overseeing development, testing, and validation (functional, performance, security, accessibility)

  • Experience with Section 508-compliant web development

  • Demonstrated experience maintaining a secure, FISMA-compliant codebase

  • Familiarity with CMS Authority to Operate (ATO) processes

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust clearance in support of a federal government contract.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Bixal is seeking a Design Lead to serve as the primary UX research and design authority on our team supporting the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS). In this role, you will lead human-centered design across the full lifecycle of — CMS's authoritative public open data platform serving more than 100 million Americans. You will oversee user research, interaction design, visual design, and design system governance, translating complex data discovery and access challenges into intuitive, accessible experiences for audiences ranging from first-time users to seasoned policy analysts and data scientists.

A portfolio of relevant design work is required as part of the application. (Please provide a password if the portfolio has controlled access.)

The successful candidate will participate in the oral presentation phase of the proposal process. They will be expected to represent the team's design vision and methodology directly to CMS stakeholders during the presentation.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of up to 5 years. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the United States, excluding its territories. You must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $120,000 – $135,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead all human-centered design activities across the program, ensuring design decisions are grounded in evidence and continuously refined through testing and feedback.

  • Plan and facilitate user research activities — including interviews, usability tests, contextual inquiries, card sorts, and surveys — at a cadence of at least one per Program Increment, in coordination with the client.

  • Coordinate with CMS on Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA) clearance timelines for research activities involving members of the public and manage scheduling accordingly.

  • Translate research findings into actionable design artifacts including personas, journey maps, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity Figma designs — and synthesize findings for both technical team members and CMS leadership.

  • Own and evolve the design system, ensuring component reuse, visual consistency, and accessibility compliance across all product teams and new feature releases.

  • Lead visual QA processes to maintain design-to-development parity, reduce UI defects, and ensure WCAG 2.1 AA conformance across all public-facing flows and data product pages.

  • Partner closely with engineering to ensure Figma designs translate accurately into implementation, and participate in sprint reviews, demos, and definition of done reviews.

  • Develop and present design rationale and research findings to CMS stakeholders, product owners, and leadership in a clear, accessible format — including oral presentations as part of the proposal or program review process.

  • Support content strategy and information architecture decisions that improve data discoverability and usability.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human-centered design (HCD) or related field.

  • At least 5 years of experience in HCD and user research for public-facing data websites.

  • Demonstrated experience leading design on a public-facing federal government digital platform, with a portfolio showing end-to-end work from research through shipped product.

  • Experience leading and synthesizing user research using a range of qualitative and quantitative methods (interviews, usability testing, surveys, analytics review, card sorting).

  • Expertise in Figma for interaction design, prototyping, design system management, and design-to-development collaboration.

  • Strong working knowledge of Section 508 compliance requirements and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards, including the ability to interpret accessibility audits.

  • Experience designing for audiences with varying levels of technical expertise, including both novice users and highly technical data consumers such as analysts, researchers, and developers.

  • Proven ability to design and improve content management interfaces and backend editorial workflows, not just public-facing user experiences.

  • Experience participating in Agile delivery, including sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement, PI planning, and iterative release cycles.

  • Experience working in or coordinating with cross-functional teams that include engineers, product managers, content strategists, and government product owners.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including demonstrated ability to present design rationale and user research to varied audiences — up to and including formal client presentations.

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Direct experience supporting or another CMS open data platform.

  • Experience with data visualization design for large, complex datasets — including interactive tools, dashboards, and downloadable data products.

  • Experience navigating the Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA) process for federally sponsored user research.

You will keep the existing Oracle database secure, performant, and reliable, and you will lead the move of decades of regulatory data to the new platform. That means mapping legacy data to new models, validating and reconciling every migration, and preserving the historical records, identifiers, and public references that agencies and the public depend on. Priorities shift as the work evolves, so we're looking for someone equally comfortable administering a production database and planning a careful, well-tested migration.

You will work closely with engineers, a security lead, and client technical stakeholders, and you will help shape decisions about how data is structured, protected, and retained on the new platform.

This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities.   • Administer, monitor, and tune the production Oracle Enterprise database, ensuring availability, performance, and integrity across all environments.

  • Manage backups, recovery, patching, upgrades, and capacity planning, and support continuity of operations and disaster recovery testing.

  • Implement and maintain database security controls, including access management, auditing, and encryption, and remediate database vulnerabilities within contractual timelines.

  • Support defect resolution, performance troubleshooting, and data requests that involve the database.

  • Develop and maintain the Data Migration Plan for moving legacy data to the new platform.

  • Map legacy data structures to new target data models, documenting transformations, assumptions, and data quality issues.

  • Build, test, and run repeatable migration and ETL processes, including validation and reconciliation against source systems.

  • Plan migration timing, rollback procedures, and acceptance criteria for each release.

  • Preserve historical records, legacy identifiers, and public references, and support archive or read-only access to historical data where needed.

  • Contribute to data model design, indexing, and query optimization for the new platform.

  • Support integration, decommissioning, and records retention planning as legacy capabilities are retired.

  • Maintain database documentation, data dictionaries, and runbooks.

  • Participate in agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, estimation, reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • At least 5 years of experience as a database administrator or database engineer supporting production systems.

  • Hands-on Oracle Enterprise database administration experience, including backup and recovery, patching, performance tuning, and security configuration.

  • Strong SQL and PL/SQL skills.

  • Experience leading or executing large-scale data migrations from a legacy database to a new platform, including data mapping, validation, and reconciliation.

  • Experience with data modeling and designing schemas for new applications.

  • Experience with ETL or data migration tooling and scripting (such as Python, shell, or similar).

  • Experience working in Linux server environments (Red Hat Enterprise Linux preferred).

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical decisions and explain data issues to non-technical stakeholders.

A Moving Experience.

Senior Business Developer – Manufacturing & Industrial Automation

Agentic voice AI is reshaping how work gets done on the industrial frontline, and we are responding to a deep unmet need: giving frontline workers — and the machines and systems they run — a voice that holds up in the tough, noisy, connectivity-poor conditions of the factory floor, warehouse, and field. This is about opening new markets from the ground up. To do it, we are bringing together a team that combines the top commercial and technical talent, with the domain expertise these markets demand. The pace is fast, the technology is new and exciting, and your work moves the business.

Your Impact

• Engage senior decision-makers across the manufacturing and industrial automation ecosystem — rugged device and wearable makers, connected-worker and MES/MOM platforms, voice-picking and WMS vendors, and SCADA/HMI and EAM/CMMS software leaders — from fast-moving startups to established global names.

• Qualify, size, and close opportunities, leveraging the company’s technical, commercial, and partnership resources to increase win rates and accelerate deal closure.

• Bring the experience and judgment to prioritize opportunities with the greatest commercial potential.

• Drive co-sell partnerships and customer deals from first contact through to close, owning the full cycle — across device and platform OEMs, systems integrators, and ISVs.

• Operate as a standalone commercial engine inside a small, entrepreneurial team, with enough technical fluency to hold your own on how manufacturing operations, industrial automation, and edge voice AI for frontline work.

Why Join the Team

• You get in early on a market about to scale and help define how agentic voice AI for the industrial frontline is won.

• This is a new business, so you shape the commercial playbook rather than inherit one. How we sell and partner is still being written, in large part by you.

• You bring the autonomy of a start-up and the credibility of an established company to every conversation, with the capital, customer relationships, technology, and brand behind you.

• Decisions come fast, obstacles get cleared, and you hold real authority over your part of the business.

What You Bring

• A track record in sales, business development, or venture capital — ideally selling into or alongside manufacturing, industrial automation, or enterprise/OT software. You know how to find, qualify, and win.

• Fluency in manufacturing and industrial automation — Industry 4.0 / smart manufacturing, MES/MOM, SCADA/HMI, IIoT, connected-worker platforms, or the OT/IT stack — ideally

on the software or software-integration side; experience with voice, conversational, or edge AI is a strong plus.

• Structured, professional, and immediately credible in front of founders and senior leaders.

• An entrepreneurial instinct, comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and full ownership of outcomes.

• Willingness to travel to customer sites, plants, and industry events).

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8+ years of quota-carrying sales, business development, or partnership experience selling technology into or alongside manufacturing, industrial automation, or enterprise/OT software markets.

• Demonstrated track record of sourcing, qualifying, and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals and partnerships.

• Working fluency in the manufacturing and industrial automation landscape (Industry 4.0, MES/MOM, SCADA/HMI, IIoT, connected-worker, or OT/IT).

• Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites, plants, and industry events (approximately 30%).

• Authorized to work in the country of hire without current or future employer sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

• MBA or equivalent advanced degree.

• Experience selling embedded, edge, or voice/conversational AI, or building SaaS/platform partnerships through an ISV or co-sell motion.

• An existing network across rugged-device, wearable, connected-worker, WMS, MES/SCADA/HMI, or EAM/CMMS vendors and systems integrators.

• Experience standing up a new market, product line, or territory from the ground up in a start-up or intrapreneurial environment.

• Proficiency with CRM and pipeline tools and a structured sales methodology

• Additional language capability for global, multilingual markets.

• Familiarity with Microsoft and NVIDIA partner ecosystem and motions.

Location & Travel

• Location: Remote — United States, Canada.

• Travel: approximately 30% to customer sites, plants, and industry events.

What we offer

  • We offer a generous compensation and benefits package (in addition to the base salary), including:

  • Salary range $129,400.00 USD- $207,100.00 USD It is not typical for offers to be made at or near the top of the range. The actual salary will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors.

  • Annual bonus opportunity

  • Insurance coverage (medical, dental, vision, life, and disability)

  • Paid time off

  • Paid holidays

  • Company contribution to the RRSP (Registered Retirement Savings Plan)

  • Equity awards for certain positions and levels

Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Director, Global Diagnostics Strategy Lead

What you will do

In this vital role, the Director, Global Diagnostic Strategy Lead (DxSL) will lead the creation, alignment, and execution of comprehensive global diagnostic strategies for assigned molecules and programs within a disease area or therapeutic area. The DxSL serves as the primary diagnostic strategy point of contact for program teams and governance forums, helping ensure that diagnostic development plans enable clinical development, regulatory approval, launch, commercialization, and lifecycle management of precision therapeutics.

The Diagnostics (Dx) Group is responsible for the successful transition of biomarker assays into marketed diagnostics that support therapeutic development strategy, regulatory approval, access, and commercialization.

You will:

  • Develop and lead integrated, end-to-end diagnostic strategies from early diagnostic need assessment through launch and lifecycle management.
  • Partner with Product Teams, program leadership and other decision-making forums, to align therapeutic and diagnostic development objectives.
  • Evaluate and propose diagnostic strategic options, including assay and platform approaches, partner strategy, regulatory and commercial pathways, trade-offs, opportunities, costs, timelines, and risks.
  • Lead and oversee Dx Development Teams (DxDTs) to ensure tactical execution of the diagnostic development plan and alignment between Rx and Dx development programs.
  • Influence decision-making in a matrixed environment by communicating balanced, unbiased assessments of diagnostic opportunities and risks.
  • Represent the Dx function with internal stakeholders and external diagnostic development partners.
  • Manage, coach, and develop a small team of Dx technical leads, as applicable, while delivering through cross-functional leadership and influence.

Key Responsibilities

Diagnostic strategy and portfolio leadership

  • Assess the need for diagnostic development for each assigned molecule or program within the disease area or therapeutic area portfolio.
  • Work with cross-functional Dx subject matter experts and program functional leads to build comprehensive, global, long-term diagnostic strategies that support program objectives.
  • Document and communicate diagnostic strategy through appropriate templates, decision materials, and executive-ready slide decks.
  • Provide strategic input to program teams and governance forums to enable informed decisions on diagnostic development options.

Execution through Dx Development Teams

  • Oversee DxDTs to ensure delivery of diagnostic development plans, milestones, timelines, risks, mitigations, and interdependencies.
  • Partner with Project Management to track risks, mitigations, milestones, timelines, resources, and financials across diagnostic development activities.
  • Ensure diagnostic strategies and plans are integrated with therapeutic development plans and clinical trial execution needs.
  • Operate within Amgen governance, policy, and decision-making frameworks, including DAI where applicable.

External partner strategy and business planning

  • Work across Amgen functions to identify, evaluate, and select diagnostic development partners as needed.
  • Oversee partner-selection activities related to diagnostic development, including workplan development and alignment on scope, roles, and deliverables.
  • Lead collaboration with external diagnostic partners to integrate diagnostic development, approval, and launch strategies.

Global launch, commercialization, and lifecycle management

  • Ensure diagnostic strategies incorporate global clinical, regulatory, commercial, access, and regional execution requirements.
  • Partner with global and regional commercial teams to align on commercial diagnostic strategy, including regional or country gap assessments.
  • Lead lifecycle management planning for diagnostic platforms or assays to support program objectives after initial approval and launch.
  • Support diagnostic market landscape assessments and business case development for key strategic choices.

Matrix leadership and stakeholder engagement

  • Communicate effectively with Amgen leadership, therapeutic product teams, cross-functional collaborators, and external partners.
  • Lead with courage and influence without direct authority across a complex matrix environment.
  • Proactively provide balanced and thoughtful input to product teams and other work package teams.
  • Actively seek and incorporate input from Dx Regulatory, Drug Regulatory, Clinical, Medical, Commercial, Value and Access, Business Development, Alliance Management, and other stakeholders.

Core Deliverables

  • Comprehensive diagnostic development strategies for assigned drug development programs and portfolio priorities.
  • Documented Dx strategy materials, including strategy templates, decision documents, and slide decks for cross-functional alignment and governance discussions.
  • Aligned Rx/Dx development plans with clear milestones, risks, mitigations, timelines, and accountabilities.
  • Diagnostic partner selection recommendations and workplans, where partner support is needed.
  • Global and regional diagnostic launch, commercialization, and lifecycle management plans.
  • Dx representation and strategic input at Product Team, EGT, CBDT, DxLT and other relevant forums.

Basic Qualifications

  • Doctorate degree and 4 years of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics, clinical development, or related experience; OR
  • Master's degree and 8 years of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics, clinical development, or related experience; OR
  • Bachelor's degree and 10 years of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics, clinical development, or related experience; AND

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience developing and implementing diagnostic, companion diagnostic, or precision medicine strategies within a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or diagnostics setting.
  • Advanced degree in biomedical sciences, medicine, diagnostics, molecular biology, pathology, genomics, oncology, or related discipline (Ph.D., M.D., Pharm.D., or equivalent).
  • Strong scientific acumen paired with a strategic mindset and the ability to translate biomarker and diagnostic insights into development and commercialization strategies.
  • Knowledge of the clinical, regulatory, commercial, and access considerations that shape global diagnostic development and launch plans.
  • Documented experience with oncology precision medicine, in vitro diagnostics (IVD), companion diagnostics (CDx), biomarker assay development, or diagnostic platform lifecycle management.
  • Experience evaluating diagnostic technologies, development options, market landscapes, and business cases, including trade-offs related to cost, time, risk, opportunity, and global execution.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence without authority, and gain alignment across senior stakeholders in a matrix environment.
  • Experience working with external diagnostic partners, business development, alliance management, and/or partner governance structures.
  • Familiarity with global regulatory submission requirements and diagnostic evidence expectations across major markets.
  • Experience with clinical trial design, biomarker-driven enrollment or testing strategies, and integration of diagnostic requirements into therapeutic development plans.
  • Excellent executive-level communication, presentation, facilitation, and decision-framing skills.
  • Strong project leadership skills, including resource planning, timeline management, risk identification, risk mitigation, and financial awareness.
  • Learning agility, organizational savvy, self-awareness, adaptability in changing environments, and an organized work style.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans

jobs.title: GTM Engineer (Go-to-market) | Regulated DTC Consumer Brand
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview:Our client is a small, founder-led consumer brand based in Austin, TX, that makes a regulated nicotine product (tobacco-free pouches) and sells it direct-to-consumer in the UK.
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Our client is a small, founder-led consumer brand based in Austin, TX, that makes a regulated nicotine product (tobacco-free pouches) and sells it direct-to-consumer in the UK. Because Meta, Google, and TikTok all prohibit nicotine advertising, there is no ad budget this company can spend to buy growth — every channel that's left (search, owned email and SMS, subscription retention, referral, retail and trade, athlete and podcast partnerships, field sampling) has to be built and wired together by hand. That constraint is the whole shape of this job.

Your Role:

This role exists because the easy version of growth marketing isn't available here — someone has to build the campaign machinery, not just brief it. You'll spend real time each week directing Claude Code to connect APIs, enrich lists, and automate recurring work, and the rest of your time running campaigns alongside the people actually knocking on doors: sales, field, and partnerships. You report directly to the two founders, at manager level, fully hands-on, with no reports of your own (headcount comes later, if at all). Success looks like a trade and partnership outbound engine that runs itself, a field team that's armed and getting better each cycle, owned channels (search, lifecycle, retention, referral) doing the growth work that paid acquisition can't, and numbers everyone can actually trust.

A note on the category: this is a regulated product, and the rules aren't style guidance — they're hard constraints on the job itself. No health, cessation, or performance claims anywhere, ever. Age and territory gating (18+, UK only) stays intact, full stop. No paid social or paid search for the product, no workarounds. Nothing overstated in writing. If that reads as a limitation on the work rather than the actual shape of it, this isn't the right seat.

You'll:

  • Build and run the trade and partnership outbound engine — define the segment, pull and enrich the list, verify and score contacts, write and track the sequence, and know when not to use a sequencer (some outreach has to go out by hand)

  • Arm the field team (sampling, shop visits, trade shows) with target lists, routes, one-pagers, and post-visit follow-up sequences, then work alongside them so the next version is better

  • Own the channels that are actually open here: search and content, lifecycle email and SMS, subscription retention (win-back, dunning recovery, pause-instead-of-cancel), and referral programs, including the reconciliation behind them

  • Produce creative in-house with AI tools against the brand's existing visual system — knowing when to generate, when to composite a real product shot instead, and when to send a piece to a human

  • Automate anything manual and recurring — enrichment scripts, list hygiene, report pulls, campaign QA, content pipelines — instead of adding it to someone's checklist

  • Own first-party measurement (order and subscription data, cohort retention, referral attribution, search visibility), since no ad platform is feeding this business conversion data, and flag a bad number before anyone else finds it

You Bring:

  • Real, hands-on experience directing Claude Code (or an equivalent coding agent) on live work — connected to an API or MCP server, shipping something still in use today. This is the one non-negotiable requirement on this list, and it's tested directly in the interview process; nearly everything else here is trainable

  • 3+ years hands-on in marketing — the profile that fits typically started in a coordinator-type role, got tired of waiting on others to pull data or wire up tools, and taught themselves to do it

  • Cold outbound you've run yourself, start to finish: built the list, wrote the sequence, watched the reply rate, fixed deliverability when it broke, using Apollo or an equivalent plus at least one sequencer

  • Comfortable with data — you read a CSV without flinching, write SQL or get there with help, and know why a bad join can quietly double your numbers

  • Working scripting ability in Python or JavaScript (or a track record of directing AI to write and debug it while keeping it honest), and you use git

  • APIs are ordinary to you: auth, keys, rate limits, webhooks, and reading docs to find the endpoint you need

  • A genuine eye for marketing — you can tell a good offer from a weak one, spot a broken page, and write an email a retail buyer will actually answer — and you write plainly, in specific, filler-free sentences

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with this kind of stack: list/enrichment tools (e.g. Apollo), sequencers, a commerce/subscription backend, Postgres/SQL, transactional email, SEO tooling, workflow automation (e.g. n8n), and AI image tools

  • Background marketing in a regulated or high-constraint category (alcohol, supplements, pharma, gambling, or similar), where claims review and compliance shape every campaign

  • DTC subscription or ecommerce experience, especially retention/win-back programs and referral mechanics

What’s Offered:

  • Based in Austin, TX, or remote with 9–5 CT overlap

  • Direct reporting line to the two founders — high visibility, real ownership, minimal layers

  • A hands-on, builder-first seat: you ship the work yourself rather than briefing someone else to

  • Real autonomy over a growth stack built on search, lifecycle, retention, referral, trade, and field — not ad spend

  • The chance to help build out the company's own agent and automation stack from the ground up

  • Compensation based on experience and location — to confirm with the client before this goes to candidates

Interview Process:

  • 1️⃣ Apply with a short note naming one thing you've built with Claude Code and what it does today (link it if you can)

  • 2️⃣ Screening call (30 minutes) — walking through that build in detail

  • 3️⃣ Paid exercise (about 3 hours) — given a target segment and API access, produce a scored, enriched contact list, a three-touch sequence, and the script or flow that generated it; one touch has to survive a claims review

  • 4️⃣ Working session with a founder — pick the exercise apart together and build one more thing live in Claude Code

jobs.description:
Onboarding Specialist - Paid Search

Full-time: $90,000 - $100,000

Location: Fully remote (must live in CA, NJ, IL, MO)

Why Revvim?

  • 100% employer paid platinum medical & dental insurance
  • 100% employer paid vision insurance
  • 100% employer paid pet insurance (for 2 pets)
  • 100% paid accident/hospital/critical illness insurance through Principal
  • Employer sponsored life insurance
  • 401(k) with matching
  • FSA with company matching
  • Annual weeklong winter holiday break
  • Wellness Benefit through Holisticly
  • Paid time off for new parents

About Revvim:

At Revvim, we pride ourselves on providing simple, effective solutions to the most persistent problems in the paid search and SEO world. We believe that the foundation for all the best professional relationships is trust – to that end, we value honesty and transparency and always strive to provide just that to our customers and agency partners.

About AdAi:

AdAi, our flagship product, is transforming paid search for brands by significantly increasing incrementality on Google Ads. We help businesses maintain or improve their advertising performance while reducing costs. More than 400 enterprise customers already rely on AdAi, and our customer base continues to grow rapidly. AdAi is gaining widespread recognition within the paid search community for consistently delivering substantial savings, which it tracks as "Reclaimed Savings." These savings enable brands to reinvest and drive further growth.

Your Role:

We are looking for a Paid Search expert to review Google Ads accounts and onboard them onto Revvim’s tech. You will also dedicate a portion of your time to monitoring and managing existing implementations. We are looking for you to use your deep paid search expertise to ensure customers implement our technology smoothly. Success will be measured by onboarding efficiency, customers' adoption speed, successful trial launches, and overall customer satisfaction.

Your Typical Week Will Look Like:

  • Onboarding customer Google Ads accounts, leveraging your expertise in campaign setup, settings, and general account hygiene
  • Dedicating a large portion of your time to monitoring and managing existing account implementations.
  • Crafting clear, insightful, and engaging presentations from paid search data to showcase the real-world impact of Revvim’s technology.
  • Collaborating closely with internal teams (Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success) to continuously refine our onboarding processes.
  • Applying meticulous attention to detail and structured thinking to ensure consistently high-quality outcomes.
  • Helping evolve and document onboarding workflows and SEM best practices.

You Must Have:

  • Experience: 3-5 years of hands-on experience managing mid-size and enterprise-level Google Ads accounts.
  • Deep Expertise in Google Ads & Analytical Problem-Solving: Must possess a strong understanding of cause-and-effect within account performance, knowing precisely where to look, what levers to inspect, and how to isolate anomalies when performance deviates or trial data looks off.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong organizational skills, meticulous attention to detail, and structured, methodical thinking.
  • Effective Communication: Excellent written and verbal skills for delivering clear guidance to internal peers and external stakeholders.

This Role is Great For You If…

  • You enjoy being a performance detective: You love digging into complex Google Ads accounts, dissecting cause-and-effect relationships, and figuring out the why behind performance shifts. When numbers look off, your instinct isn't to guess; it’s to dive into conversion tracking, exclusion lists, search terms, campaign structures, etc., methodically hunting down root causes until everything makes sense.
  • You enjoy being a technical storyteller: You excel at turning raw paid search metrics and trial data into clear, compelling narratives. Instead of dumping overwhelming spreadsheets on stakeholders, you distill complex trends into punchy, actionable performance summaries that highlight product value, giving our Sales team and prospects the confidence to buy.
  • You thrive on clean processes, clarity, detail, structured thinking, and enjoy behind-the-scenes orchestration.
  • You prefer excellence behind the scenes to constant customer-facing roles (though occasional customer interaction is an option).
  • You've experienced the campaign management grind and now want a more strategic, structured role.
  • You flourish in remote environments with clearly defined responsibilities.
  • You're excited about technology intersecting with SEM and want to shape that future with us.

We’d Also Love (But Don’t Require):

  • Agency experience providing exposure to diverse accounts and industries.
  • Familiarity with SA360, Google Search Console, Google Analytics, general analytics best practices, and Google Scripts experience.
Salary: $90k-$100k

Our Newest Opportunity:

The Payroll Specialist assists in the processing of payroll for our Biweekly and Monthly pay groups in Workday.   • Follows up on withholding orders, and other non-tax correspondence received from government authorities.

  • Audits payroll data to ensure accuracy.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.

  • Strong organizational skills.

  • Positive attitude.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Education, Training and Experience:

  • Associate degree in business administration or other related business major required.

  • Minimum of 2 years of payroll experience preferred.

  • Experience in PEO, HCM, or related industry is required for remote consideration.

jobs.description:
Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.


WHO WE ARE

We are Accenture's Supply Chain and Engineering reinvention partner for Life Sciences. We embed innovation, intelligence, and AI-native operations into the way the world designs, engineers, manufactures, and distributes products. We serve Life Sciences clients across the value chain to help bring lifesaving medicines and products to patients through harnessing the power of advanced technologies.


The Work:

Accenture is seeking a Consultant to drive hands-on execution across Life Sciences Warehouse and Transportation Management transformation programs within our Supply Chain & Engineering practice. We work with pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, and specialty distributor clients to modernize warehousing and logistics operations — combining regulated-industry delivery expertise with AI-powered automation and intelligent transportation management. The role provides the execution depth needed across multi-workstream fulfillment programs, supporting the implementation of warehouse management and transportation solutions across both pharma and medical device client engagements. This role requires hands-on delivery depth across both warehouse and transportation management systems — candidates must bring meaningful experience in each.


Key Responsibilities:

At a Consultant level, key responsibilities could include:

  • Support the delivery of warehouse management and transportation management system implementations across life sciences clients — managing project workstreams, coordinating with system integrators and client teams, and driving execution across platforms including SAP EWM/TM, Manhattan WMS/TM, Blue Yonder WMS/TM, and others in GxP-regulated environments.
  • Support validation activities and audit trail documentation requirements consistent with life sciences quality standards — working across pharma and medical device regulatory frameworks to ensure system implementations meet applicable GxP, GDP, and quality management obligations.
  • Lead design and implementation of TMS solutions for cold chain carrier management, lane optimization, and temperature excursion alerting across pharma and device distribution networks.
  • Support the integration of warehouse and transportation management platforms within a broader enterprise architecture — connecting WMS/TMS solutions with ERP, quality management, and supply chain visibility systems to enable end-to-end operational execution.
  • Apply AI and automation capabilities to warehouse and transportation operations — including intelligent slotting, AI-driven exception management, robotics integration readiness, and predictive quality alerts.
  • Design order fulfillment processes for life sciences commercial, hospital, and IDN channels — including pick/pack/ship workflows, returns management, recall execution, and consignment or loaner inventory flows.
  • Contribute to the development of reusable delivery assets, validated configuration templates, and warehouse design accelerators for the Life Sciences Fulfillment practice.
  • Engage deeply in project delivery with hands-on work, leading work products and supporting senior team members across active engagements.

Travel Requirements:

Travel is required for this role and could vary up to 75%

Here’s what you need:

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience delivering both warehouse management and transportation management system implementations in pharmaceutical, medical device, or broader life sciences environments — candidates with experience in only one discipline will not be considered.
  • Demonstrated platform fluency across both WMS and TMS — including hands-on project delivery with SAP EWM/TM, Manhattan WMS/TM, or Blue Yonder WMS/TM. Familiarity with one side of the stack alone is not sufficient.
  • Minimum 3 years of TMS delivery experience specific to life sciences distribution — including cold chain carrier management, regulated product routing, lane optimization, and temperature excursion alerting across pharma or device networks.
  • Experience integrating WMS and TMS platforms within a broader enterprise architecture — connecting to ERP, quality management, and supply chain visibility systems to enable end-to-end operational execution.

Bonus Points If:

  • Working knowledge of life sciences validation concepts and quality documentation requirements — including GxP, GDP, and applicable pharma or medical device quality management standards as they apply to system implementations.
  • Working knowledge of order fulfillment process design — pick/pack/ship, returns, and recall workflows in regulated life sciences environments.
  • Curiosity and growing fluency in AI, automation, and digital capabilities as applied to warehouse operations and logistics management.
  • Strong delivery orientation — ability to execute independently, manage work products, and communicate clearly with client and project teams.
  • Experience across both pharma and medical device distribution environments, or familiarity with the distinct fulfillment and quality requirements of each.
  • Exposure to robotics, AMRs, or warehouse automation technologies in life sciences distribution.
  • Familiarity with product traceability workflows — serialization, lot genealogy, or device traceability — integrated within WMS or TMS environments.
