jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101381

Position Overview

Autodesk’s worldwide sales organization depends on its forecast, pipeline, targets and reporting. This role builds the data models behind them. As an Analytics Engineer on the Forecasting & Revenue Intelligence team, you turn sales, subscription and hierarchy data into tested, documented models that analysts and sales leaders can trust, covering what customers bought, who owns which accounts and how the sales organization looked on any given date. You will work in SQL and dbt on Snowflake, and you will work closely with the people who use your models. This is a hands-on role on a new team, and you will own what you ship.

Location: United States (remote). Central or Eastern time zone preferred.

Organization: Revenue Operations

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain dbt models on Snowflake that bring Salesforce, subscription, billing, hierarchy and forecast data into a clean, documented form
  • Model data for analysis: a clear grain, stable keys, and definitions consistent with the shared metric dictionary
  • Keep history so any published number can be reproduced as it stood on the day it went out
  • Maintain the mapping between accounts, territories, sellers and the sales hierarchy as the organization changes
  • Reconcile the data to Salesforce and to Finance, and find the cause when they disagree
  • Build the datasets behind the weekly forecast pack, business reviews and leadership dashboards
  • Add tests and monitoring for freshness, completeness and accuracy, and fix what breaks
  • Explain data issues and trade-offs to sales and finance partners in plain terms, and agree on a fix with them
  • Work in version control with code review and continuous integration

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical or quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 3+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering or BI development, building models other people depended on
  • Dbt in production, with tests and documentation as part of how you work
  • Strong SQL, including window functions and incremental models, in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce data model: accounts, opportunities, line items and ownership
  • Ability to explain a data problem to a non-technical stakeholder and reach a decision together

Preferred Qualifications

  • Dbt snapshots or slowly changing dimensions for point-in-time reporting
  • Python for transformation or orchestration, with Airflow or similar
  • Enterprise software or SaaS commercial data: subscriptions, renewals, territories, and direct and partner routes to market
  • Revenue intelligence platforms such as Clari, Gong or Aviso, and BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau or Sigma

Become a part of our caring community

The Manager, Product Ownership is responsible for conveying product vision and roadmap to an Agile delivery team by defining user stories and prioritizing product backlog. The Manager, Product Ownership works within specific guidelines and procedures; applies advanced technical knowledge to solve moderately complex problems; receives assignments in the form of objectives and determines approach, resources, schedules and goals.

The Manager, Product Ownership maximizes the value delivered by Agile teams by leading a group of Product Owners responsible for defining user stories, prioritizing backlogs, and making sure business needs are met. This role reports to the Associate Director, Product Management, and is part of a product team modernizing associate- and provider-facing capabilities and platforms through a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives.


The Manager will lead up to eight Product Owners. On the people side, that means coaching, development, performance, and team health. On the practice side, it means consistent product ownership standards, backlog quality, and Agile ways of working. The Manager is a key partner to business stakeholders, technology teams, and operations leaders, and helps make sure the right work is built, in the right order, within budget and on schedule.

The ideal candidate is an experienced Agile practitioner and people leader. They're comfortable with ambiguity, enjoy developing others, and can move easily between shaping strategy and driving execution.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of up to eight Product Owners, including goal setting, performance management, and career growth.
  • Establish and reinforce product ownership best practices, including backlog management, story writing, acceptance criteria, prioritization, and value-based decision making.
  • Act as the escalation point for prioritization, scope, and tactical decisions within the team's area.
  • Take part in Agile and SAFe events such as PI Planning and help make sure Product Owners are prepared and effective.

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Visual fidelity, narrative flow, and brand elevation are your playground. This is a dual-threat role for the visual perfectionist. You aren't just cutting footage; you are the final polisher. You will take raw assets and transform them into broadcast-quality commercials and social ads that pop off the screen.

In the world of fashion and beauty e-commerce, product color accuracy and skin tones are non-negotiable. Your ability to balance technical color science with creative storytelling will directly impact our clients' brand trust and sales. If you love the edit bay as much as the grading suite, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Execute Hybrid Post-Production

    • Handle projects from rough cut to final grade. Edit compelling direct-response ads in Premiere Pro, then apply high-end color finishing within the same workflow.

    • Seamlessly switch between storytelling (pacing, music, hooks) and technical finishing (exposure, white balance, look development).

  2. Advanced Color Grading

    • Ensure perfect color accuracy for products (clothing, makeup) and natural, flattering skin tones for talent.

    • Expertly match footage from diverse sources—blending high-end cinema cameras (ARRI/RED) with iPhone UGC content in the same timeline.

    • Create and manage custom LUTs to streamline workflows for specific client brand identities.

  3. Visual Quality Control

    • Fix exposure issues, remove digital noise, and correct white balance errors to salvage imperfect footage.

    • Ensure all deliverables meet strict broadcast and web standards (Rec.709, sRGB) and maintain visual consistency across 9:16 and 16:9 formats.

  4. Workflow Optimization

    • Manage the round-trip workflow between Adobe Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve (if required) or master advanced Lumetri workflows for speed.

    • Organize project files and color assets so that looks can be easily applied to future campaign iterations.

Who You Are

  1. A Post-Production Generalist

    • 3–5 years of experience in both video editing and color correction (Agency, Commercial, or High-End Freelance).

    • A portfolio/reel showing "Before & After" color examples is required.

  2. Software Expert

    • Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro.

    • Advanced skills in DaVinci Resolve or deep mastery of Lumetri Color.

    • Ability to read scopes (waveform, vectorscope, parade) to objectively verify color accuracy.

  3. Detail-Obsessed

    • You can spot a slight green tint on a wall or a blown-out highlight instantly.

    • You understand that "Red" needs to be the exact Pantone shade of the client's product.

  4. Performance-Minded

    • You understand that a beautiful video is useless if it doesn't sell. You edit for retention and grade for clarity and appeal.

  5. Excellent Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency is required. You can explain why a shot needs to be darker or warmer to a non-technical producer.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the visual standard of major global brands and lead post-production quality initiatives.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryThe Laboratory and Diagnostics Advisor provides technical guidance and support for United States Government (USG)-funded STRIDES’ outbreak response and preparedness laboratory and diagnostic systems portfolio, leading efforts to expand, validate, and strengthen diagnostic capacity while reinforcing national laboratory systems for long‑term preparedness.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Laboratory and Diagnostics Advisor provides technical guidance and support for United States Government (USG)-funded STRIDES’ outbreak response and preparedness laboratory and diagnostic systems portfolio, leading efforts to expand, validate, and strengthen diagnostic capacity while reinforcing national laboratory systems for long‑term preparedness. As a core member of the STRIDES technical team, the Advisor supports outbreak response countries, including for the current Ebola outbreak, and regional preparedness contexts by guiding diagnostic network strengthening, laboratory readiness, biosafety and biosecurity, quality systems, and workforce development.

The role ensures that diagnostic assays, platforms, algorithms, and procurement align with national policies, outbreak response plans, and international standards; oversees laboratory and diagnostics activities and subcontractor implemented activities; and works closely with ministries of health, national public health institutes, reference laboratories, and other technical team members to ensure a coordinated, technically coherent approach across the STRIDES outbreak response and preparedness portfolio. Reporting to the STRIDES Senior Laboratory and Diagnostics Advisor, the Advisor ensures that emergency laboratory investments translate into sustainable, government‑owned diagnostic systems capable of supporting routine public health functions and future outbreak response.

Accountabilities

Technical Requirements:

  • Provides technical leadership for STRIDES’ outbreak laboratory and diagnostic systems portfolio, guiding the design and implementation of diagnostic capacity, laboratory network strengthening, biosafety and biosecurity, quality systems, and workforce development.

  • Works on moderate to complex laboratory systems challenges requiring evaluation of multiple technical, operational, and contextual factors—including diagnostic algorithm optimization, specimen referral systems, decentralized testing models, and national laboratory governance.

  • Demonstrates strong judgment in selecting diagnostic methods, technologies, and evaluation criteria; advises on assay validation, platform selection, and alignment of procurement with nationally approved workflows.

  • Networks and collaborates with key internal and external personnel, including ministries of health, national public health institutes, reference laboratories, STRIDES technical team members, implementing partners, and regional preparedness stakeholders.

  • Interprets laboratory readiness findings, quality system gaps, biosafety risks, and diagnostic performance data; recommends evidence‑based improvements across specimen handling, testing workflows, reporting systems, and laboratory surge operations.

  • Provides input to senior technical leadership on national laboratory policies, essential diagnostics lists, specimen referral strategies, laboratory governance mechanisms, and outbreak diagnostic guidelines.

  • Performs other duties as assigned to advance STRIDES’ outbreak response and Global Health Security objectives.

Project Design Implementation:

  • With technical oversight, provides leadership in the design, development, planning, and implementation of laboratory and diagnostic components of STRIDES projects, ensuring alignment with national priorities, outbreak response needs, and international standards.

  • Leads the creation of the laboratory and diagnostics technical portion of project plans, incorporating diagnostic network strengthening, biosafety and biosecurity, quality management systems, workforce development, and reference laboratory capacity building.

  • Oversees day‑to‑day laboratory and diagnostic activities in assigned response and preparedness countries, including readiness assessments, deployment of diagnostic platforms, optimization of testing algorithms, and strengthening of specimen referral and transport systems.

  • Tracks delivery of laboratory‑related project outputs, ensuring activities are implemented on time, within budget, and consistent with STRIDES’ technical approach and donor requirements.

  • Monitors staff members’ LOE to ensure adequate technical coverage across laboratory readiness, diagnostic operations, biosafety mentorship, quality systems strengthening, and reference laboratory support.

  • Coordinates requests from country offices for laboratory technical assistance, ensuring coherent and timely support across response and preparedness contexts.

  • Leads the design and implementation of global‑level innovative technical strategies for outbreak diagnostics, decentralized testing, laboratory governance, biosafety and biosecurity, and diagnostic network optimization.

  • Maintains constructive dialogue and technical exchange with field counterparts, national laboratory authorities, reference laboratories, and implementing partners to ensure coordinated, high‑quality laboratory system strengthening.

  • Develops tools, guidance, and job aids that support the design and implementation of laboratory and diagnostic components, including readiness assessment tools, diagnostic algorithm job aids, and quality systems strengthening instruments.

  • Ensures laboratory and diagnostic implementation is consistent with international best practices, national policies, and STRIDES’ technical standards; verifies that diagnostic workflows, biosafety measures, and quality systems meet client and funder contractual obligations across one or more major functional areas.

  • May supervise junior technical staff, Laboratory/Diagnostics Officers, subcontractors, and consultants implementing laboratory activities; provides oversight to ensure coherent, high‑quality execution of diagnostic network strengthening, biosafety mentorship, and quality systems support.

  • Functions in an advisor capacity with oversight of technical project administration, finance compliance, technical deliverables, and team management across laboratory and diagnostic components, including subcontractor implemented work.

  • Leads daily laboratory and diagnostic activities for assigned projects, including diagnostic platform deployment, specimen referral system strengthening, biosafety and biosecurity support, and quality management system improvements.

  • Tracks delivery of laboratory‑related project outputs, ensuring timely, high‑quality completion of diagnostic readiness assessments, algorithm optimization, biosafety improvements, and quality system strengthening activities.

Partner/Sub-Award Management:

  • May serve as a daily POC (Point of Contact) with clients for some projects on technical matters.

Capacity Building, Training and Supervision:

  • Develops and implements technical training and capacity building interventions.

  • Identifies strategies to address training gaps.

  • May supervise or provide technical guidance to staff members.

Operations Management (Finance, HR, etc.):

  • Manages the processes, services, planning, organizing, coordinating, and controlling of all technical resources for a project.

Project/Program Reporting:

  • Drafts sponsor financial and technical reports.

  • Collates and uploads output and deliverables data to sponsor data systems. Prepares and delivers presentations to sponsors on progress.

  • Helps in the development and review of work plans.

  • Creates technical content, owning the content, true experts at an advanced level (may be the most senior technical person).

  • Serves as the primary author for technical deliverables (e.g., reports, presentations, manuscripts).

  • Gathers and aggregates data to provide a summary / high level overview.

Quality Assurance:

  • Ensures technical deliverables are consistent with best practices in the industry / subject and meet client/funder contractual obligations.

  • Identifies areas for improved efficiency or effectiveness within prescribed parameters, and institutes enhancements to procedures.

Applied Knowledge & Skills

  • Ensures appropriate and timely technical support for field projects.

  • Ensures the quality of implemented technical activities and systems at all levels. Conducts routine coordination with employees and consultants, on-site and in the field.

  • Strong knowledge and skills in a specific technical area/function and general understanding of concepts and principles of related technical areas/functions.

  • Solid knowledge of standards for the technical area/field, operational processes and procedures, work, and task flow.

  • Has the ability to manage projects, set realistic priorities, and plan for the successful implementation of activities.

  • Proficient writing and verbal communication skills.

  • Relevant computer software skills (including, at a minimum, the standard applications in MS Office).

  • Ability to manage their own work to job and performance standards.

  • Must be able to read, write and speak fluent English fluent in host country language.

Problem Solving & Impact

  • Demonstrates the ability to assess needs within agreed upon duties and considers course of action best to meet those needs.

  • Effectively applies knowledge of technical area to solve a range of problems. Demonstrates the ability to develop solutions to problems that cannot be solved using existing methods or approaches.

  • Faulty decisions/recommendations/failures to complete assignments will normally resultiserious delays to assigned projects resulting in considerable expenditure of additional time, resources, and funds.

  • Decisions and actions impact primarily workflow, project processes and timeframes. Problems encountered are valid, requiring review of practices and precedents to resolve. Problem solving involves evaluating and resolving discrepancies with data, analyses, processes within prescribed guidelines.

  • Policies or guidelines exist for most problems; others must be referred to by a supervisor or more senior professional.

Supervision Given/Received

  • May supervise junior staff members.

  • Coordinates own workflow and sets individual priorities.

  • Works under general guidelines for completion and accuracy as determined by the supervisor.

  • May manage a centralized functional area of activity. Serves as mentor to technical staff.

Education

  • Master’s Degree or an International Equivalent in Laboratory Science, Microbiology, Clinical Diagnostics, Public Health or a related clinical/medical field.

  • Project Management (PM) Certification preferred.

Experience

  • Typically requires 8+ years of relevant experience in implementing large-scale laboratory systems, networks, and diagnostics programs.

  • Emergency outbreak response experience/knowledge preferred.

  • Mentoring junior laboratory staff and guides technical activities.

  • Documented success providing systems-level laboratory guidance.

  • Proven track record training laboratory personnel, validating assays, and establishing quality management systems (QMS).

  • Experience designing laboratory strengthening portfolios, securing research or development grants, or driving public health program growth.

  • Prior work experience in a non-governmental organization (NGO), government agency, or private organization.

  • International or Domestic (US) Program Development or Program management preferred.

Typical Physical Demands

  • Typical office environment.

  • Ability to spend long hours looking at a computer screen and doing repetitive work on a keyboard.

  • Ability to sit and stand for extended periods of time. Ability to lift 5lb.

Technology to be Used

Travel Requirements

jobs.excerpt: If you love getting hands-on with web security, cloud infrastructure and the emerging risks of AI and LLM integrations, you’ll feel right at home with us.
jobs.description:
If you love getting hands-on with web security, cloud infrastructure and the emerging risks of AI and LLM integrations, you’ll feel right at home with us. At Metricool you will be able to do so with real ownership over how security and compliance get built into the product, not just audited after the fact.

You will have the possibility to work 100% remotely, working in a high-growth international B2B SaaS, in which all members love to create, work in teams, analyze and help Community Managers make their work easier.

Your mission is to become the dedicated owner of application, cloud and AI security at Metricool, relieving our Senior Developers and Leads from manual security reviews and building specialized security management across our core monolith (JavaEE, Spring Security, Vue), AWS infrastructure, AI-powered features and internal compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2).

In this position, you will be able to make a wonderful contribution and impact in different areas:

As Senior Security Engineer,

  • Application & Platform Security:Harden Spring Security, JavaEE filters, CORS, anti-CSRF protections, SameSite/HttpOnly cookie flags, and strict CSP headers.

  • AI Security & Testing: Run threat modeling and vulnerability testing on our AI/LLM features, protecting against the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs: prompt injection, data poisoning, data leakage, insecure output handling, and API abuse.

  • Compliance & Auditing (ISO 27001 / SOC 2): Define, audit and collect technical evidence for compliance controls (access management, encryption at rest and in transit, incident logs), lead ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits, and evaluate third-party vendor risk.

  • Infrastructure & Cloud Security:Configure AWS load balancers, Nginx, Tomcat, container security (Docker), and HTTPS enforcement.

  • Code Reviews & Audits:Run regular code reviews, secret-detection audits, and third-party dependency reviews (Maven, Node.js).

  • Build automated security checks (SAST/DAST/ZAP) into our CI/CD pipelines.

As a Team Member:

  • Cross-functional Alignment:Work closely with Senior Developers and Leads to bring security into the development process from the start, rather than bolting it on afterward.

  • Continuous Improvement:Document controls, evidence and runbooks so compliance stays audit-ready year-round, not just ahead of a renewal.

  • Culture of Excellence:Drive a security-first culture that embraces secure AI adoption without slowing down developer velocity.

Long story short: How will your first days in Metricool look like?

  • First month: Gain full context of the monolith architecture, the AWS stack and our current compliance posture.

  • First Quarter: CompleteAI feature threat modeling, execute security header hardening, and set up the ISO 27001/SOC 2 evidence collection matrix.

  • To the moon: Own platform security end to end, keep compliance continuous and seamless, and lead the secure adoption of new AI technologies.

Job requirements. You’ll be successful on your mission if you have:

  • The candidate must be located in Spain.

  • A senior profile, confident owning security end-to-end across application code, cloud infrastructure and compliance, not just reviewing it on paper.

  • Languages: Professional fluency in Spanish (mandatory) and English. A language proficiency check is part of the hiring process.

Hard skills:

  • JavaEE, Spring Security, Vue.js, Node.js, Docker, OWASP ZAP, AWS, Linux, MySQL, Maven, Git/Bitbucket.

  • AI & Security: Understanding of the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, AI data privacy, and secure API/prompt engineering.

  • Compliance Frameworks: Knowledge of ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS controls, SOC 2 Type II Trust Services Criteria (security, availability, confidentiality), and vendor risk assessments.

Soft skills:

  • Hands-on mindset: comfortable writing and reviewing code, not a “paper compliance” auditor.

  • Pragmatic approach to security: applies controls without imposing heavy bureaucratic overhead on development speed.

  • Genuine curiosity about emerging risks, especially around GenAI/LLM adoption in software platforms.

  • Clear communicator, able to turn audit requirements into practical, developer-friendly processes.

Why will you fall in love with Metricool?

  • Truly Remote: Work from wherever you’re most productive. We provide the tools; you provide the talent.

  • 100% Flexible Schedule: We care about the work getting done, not the hours you’re sitting at the desk. You organize your own time so you can live your life, as long as you’re there to collaborate when the team needs you.

  • Health Insurance:We’ve got you covered so you can work with peace of mind.

  • Language Lessons: We’re an international team speaking English, Spanish, French, and German. We’ll help you learn a new language to help break down barriers and connect better with your colleagues.

  • The Epic Weekend: Once a year, we all get together in person to hang out, touch grass, and remind ourselves we’re not just avatars on Slack.

  • Salary:We are actively working to align our budgets with market standards, offering highly competitive salary packages. For this position we estimate between 55,000€ and 65,000€ (annually).

  • Growth: We’re a fast-growing company. If you’re curious and take ownership, there’s no ceiling here.

What are the steps of the hiring process?

  • First interview (30 minutes)with Horten People & Culture: culture fit, compensation alignment, and language check.

  • Second interview (60 minutes) with Marcos Cacabelos:a deep dive on SAST/DAST/ZAP tools, AI testing scenarios, and ISO 27001/SOC 2 practical cases.

If you are excited about the things that you just read, don’t hesitate to apply for the job position!

jobs.title: Sr Clinical Research Associate II
jobs.excerpt: The Senior Clinical Research Associate II is responsible for the site management, site monitoring and close-out of assigned clinical trials investigator sites to ensure patient safety and quality study execution in accordance with applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards.
jobs.description:
The Senior Clinical Research Associate II is responsible for the site management, site monitoring and close-out of assigned clinical trials investigator sites to ensure patient safety and quality study execution in accordance with applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards.

The Senior Clinical Research Associate II role is accountable for site management and monitoring, managing investigator site relationships to ensure effective delivery of clinical trials (e.g. enrollment, database release), to safeguard the quality of investigator sites (e.g. patient safety, site quality and compliance with GCP), to maintain investigator and site staff engagement and satisfaction, and to enhance the company’s image with its external stakeholders.

The Senior Clinical Research Associate IIis responsible for the resolution of all protocol-related issues for assigned investigator sites and will work closely with the Site Care Partner, and other members of the study team, as required, in activities associated with the set-up, running and close out of sites in a clinical trial. Responsible for investigator site management and monitoring for assigned sites.

Clinical Trial Monitoring

  • Ensure proper conduct of clinical trials in accordance with the Study Monitoring Plan and applicable prevailing laws, Good Clinical Practices, and Pfizer standards to achieve project goals, timelines and quality
  • Manage assigned operational aspects for implementation of clinical trial activities at assigned investigator sites from site initiation through database lock, ensuring relevant timelines and quality deliverables are met
  • During study conduct, serve as the primary point of contact for assigned investigator sites. Work in partnership with and/or escalate to the SCP to ensure quality of site delivery
  • Interface with the study team as needed, facilitate information flow between members of the study team, vendors and assigned investigator sites.

Partner with SCP to perform investigator site development, coaching and training of site personnel to ensure ongoing compliance with protocol and the safeguarding of patients; provide protocol training to, and address protocol related questions from the investigator site staff when required, including discussions on known/anticipated operational and clinical trial risks:

  • Attend investigator meetings when required (virtual or F2F).
  • Provide enrollment support and ensure progress by responding to site activation and recruitment issues from investigators. Partner with SCP and the study team to define and support recruitment initiatives at site level
  • Conduct onsite, remote/electronic monitoring as needed for study site initiation, routine monitoring and study site closure activities and ensure these are conducted accordance to the Study Monitoring Plan, SOPs and commensurate with emerging issues and technologies.
  • Monitor site level AEs and SAEs and collaborate with the Drug Safety Unit and follow-up with investigators sites, as needed, to bring SAE reports required information to resolution
  • Submit all required reports, documentation, updates and tracking within required timeframes, including but not limited to Trial Master File documentation, site reports, site follow up letters, protocol deviations, patient recruitment, clinical supply management, study progress and metrics.
  • Identify and resolve investigator site issues within required timeframes: agree and develop corrective and preventative actions with investigator and site personnel to close open issues and to prevent recurrence/persistence of issues.
  • Resolve data queries within required timelines, prepare investigator site close-out plan and conduct close-out activities within required timelines.
  • Ensures adequate oversight of the investigational product at the investigator site, including receipt, handling, accounting, storage conditions, and destruction activities.

• Support database release as needed

  • May undertake the responsibilities of an unblinded monitor where required

Clinical/Scientific and Site Monitoring Risk:

  • Maintain thorough understanding of the product, protocol and therapy area in sufficient details to have appropriate discussions with the investigator and site team
  • Interact with investigator site heath care professionals in a manner which enhances Pfizer’s credibility, scientific leadership and in order to facilitate Pfizer’s clinical development goals
  • Support the study clinician in ensuring patient safety, eligibility and providing clinical guidance to investigators
  • Drive Quality Event remediation, when applicable
  • Serve as a point of contact for audit conduct, and drive Audit Observation CAPA development and checks, when applicable.

Other

  • Mentor/train Clinical Research Associates and Senior Clinical Research Associates I, as assigned
  • Serve as an SME for CRA-related processes
  • Participate in or lead global, regional or local working groups/process improvement initiatives
  • Perform the duties of a Site Care Partner for small projects or under guidance of a Site Care Partner in larger projects e.g. feasibility and site selection, PTA, coordination of site activation checklist items, ICD finalization, SIV (as applicable), including management of issues that may compromise time to site activation

• Conduct co-monitoring activities.

Work Location Assignment: Remote

Pay Transparency Note:

Minimum annual gross base salary: 217500 PLN

Annual bonus: 15%

Corporate benefits as per Pfizer Pay Policy, including Medicover, Multisport, life insurance, private pension plan and other.

Purpose

Breakthroughs that change patients' lives... At Pfizer we are a patient centric company, guided by our four values: courage, joy, equity and excellence. Our breakthrough culture lends itself to our dedication to transforming millions of lives.

Digital Transformation Strategy

One bold way we are achieving our purpose is through our company wide digital transformation strategy. We are leading the way in adopting new data, modelling and automated solutions to further digitize and accelerate drug discovery and development with the aim of enhancing health outcomes and the patient experience.

Flexibility

We aim to create a trusting, flexible workplace culture which encourages employees to achieve work life harmony, attracts talent and enables everyone to be their best working self. Let’s start the conversation!

Equal Employment Opportunity

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workforce is crucial to building a successful business. As an employer, Pfizer is committed to celebrating this, in all its forms – allowing for us to be as diverse as the patients and communities we serve. Together, we continue to build a culture that encourages, supports and empowers our employees.

Disability Inclusion
Our mission is unleashing the power of all our people and we are proud to be a disability inclusive employer, ensuring equal employment opportunities for all candidates. We encourage you to put your best self forward with the knowledge and trust that we will make any reasonable adjustments to support your application and future career. jobs.excerpt: About the RoleA US-based commercial paving and hardscape construction company operating across multiple regions is seeking an offshore Bid Coordinator and Takeoff Specialist to support its Sales Estimating teams.
jobs.description:
About the Role

A US-based commercial paving and hardscape construction company operating across multiple regions is seeking an offshore Bid Coordinator and Takeoff Specialist to support its Sales Estimating teams. This is a front-end bid process role: you will manage bid inboxes, qualify incoming invitations, set up projects in STACK, and perform quantity takeoffs so that estimators can focus their time on pricing and sales activity.

This role carries significant organizational visibility and sits at the core of the company's growth and business development process. Accuracy, consistency, and diligence are essential — a missed bid date or an imprecise takeoff has a direct impact on the company's ability to compete and win work. The ideal candidate combines construction takeoff experience with strong written communication, self-management, and a high level of professionalism working across time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Bid Coordination

  • Monitor and work the regional bid inboxes daily, ensuring every invitation to bid is reviewed and dispositioned without delay
  • Review incoming bid requests and determine whether the scope aligns with the company's product and service offering
  • Assign qualified bids to the appropriate region and estimator, flagging time-sensitive or high-value opportunities immediately
  • Track and record bid and no-bid decisions, including the reason for each no-bid
  • Monitor for and distribute addenda, bid date changes, and other general contractor correspondence to the assigned estimator
  • Download and file plan sets, specifications, and addenda in the correct project folder following company file and folder naming standards
  • Set up projects in STACK so takeoff and estimating can proceed; create or update the corresponding bid record in the company's bid tracking system
  • Manage and maintain the bidding schedule in STACK across all regions, keeping bid dates and statuses current
  • Review plan sets to identify the appropriate sheets and detail pages to be added to STACK for takeoff

Takeoffs

  • Analyze project drawings, specifications, proposals, and related documents to perform accurate quantity takeoffs
  • Perform takeoffs in STACK for paver, retaining wall, and related hardscape scope using company standards and naming conventions
  • Complete each takeoff by the agreed internal due date so the estimator has sufficient time to price and submit the bid
  • Identify and document discrepancies or gaps between plans, specifications, and details; raise questions to the Sales Estimating team well ahead of the bid deadline
  • Communicate with the Sales Estimating team to clarify scope of work, materials, and schedule requirements, and document all clarifications
  • Assist with final assembly of the estimate for presentation to the general contractor or owner
  • Collect and organize all bid documents and takeoff files for future reference and reuse
  • Actively participate in the internal estimate review process

Reporting and Process Improvement

  • Generate weekly and monthly bid activity and takeoff productivity reports
  • Develop and maintain strong working relationships with regional Sales Estimating teams and the Corporate team to enhance bid accuracy and improve win rates
  • Identify and recommend areas for increased efficiency in the bid intake and takeoff process
  • Remain current with the latest estimating and takeoff technology and best practices

Systems

The company's primary takeoff and estimating platform is STACK. Additional tools in use include Microsoft Office 365 (Outlook, Excel, Word, Teams, SharePoint), PDF markup tools, and Airtable for project tracking. Prior experience with STACK is strongly preferred; full onboarding on internal workflows will be provided.

Qualifications

Required

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant work experience; experience in construction takeoffs and estimating strongly preferred
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and blueprints accurately
  • Working knowledge of takeoff and estimating techniques, construction terminology, and cost estimation principles
  • Proficient in takeoff and estimating software (STACK preferred) and Microsoft Office 365
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to collaborate clearly across time zones and in a fully remote environment
  • Excellent attention to detail and analytical problem-solving skills
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills; ability to manage multiple bids simultaneously and meet consistent deadlines
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while remaining responsive and collaborative with the US-based team
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection, a backup power and connectivity plan, and a dual-monitor workstation capable of running plan review and takeoff software
  • Quiet, secure work environment appropriate for handling confidential project and pricing information
    •

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in the hardscape, landscape, masonry, paver, retaining wall, or flooring industry
  • Hands-on experience with STACK takeoff software
  • Prior experience supporting a US-based construction team, general contractor, or subcontractor bid process
  • Experience with Airtable or similar CRM and project tracking tools
    •

Requirements

This is a full time role

Up to $8/hr

100% Remote

jobs.excerpt: INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands.
jobs.description:
INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands. In our Automotive vertical, that means turning complex vehicle data into images and animations that can represent a car across configurators, launch campaigns, print, exhibitions, and promotional videos.

We are looking for a Senior 3D Artist who can turn complex automotive data into polished visual output. You will work from high-poly vehicle assets, build materials, render stills and animations, composite final images, and keep quality consistent across large content sets.

Your impact is visible. You will create content that represents premium automotive brands in configurators, campaigns, launch campaigns, retail tools, and large-format experiences. The work must look beautiful, but it also has to survive scale.

What You Will Do

  • Create automotive CGI that holds up at close range
    Build still images and animations from high-poly vehicle models. Texture, shade, light, render, and composite final content for automotive brands with strict visual standards. You will work on exteriors, interiors, detail crops, accessories, colorways, wheels, trims, and motion sequences.

  • Own the render, not just the task
    Evaluate image quality from a senior production perspective. You can see when a render issue comes from lighting, material response, geometry, camera setup, render settings, or compositing. You will refine clearcoat, metallic flakes, glass, rubber, leather, stitching, displays, brushed metal, chrome, and shadow behavior until the image feels physically and visually right.

  • Work inside scalable production pipelines
    Create scenes and outputs that can survive large content sets. You will follow naming, versioning, render-layer, compositing, and scene-organization standards. You will help keep assets clean, reusable, and ready for configurators, campaign derivatives, market adaptations, and automated content workflows.

  • Improve quality while delivering content
    Implement feedback from art directors, leads, clients, and production teams without losing control of the setup. You will spot recurring issues, improve material libraries, refine lighting templates, document useful fixes, and help reduce manual rework across automotive production.

Requirements

You Have

  • Strong experience in automotive CGI and high-end 3D production. You are comfortable working with complex high-poly models, physically based materials, lighting setups, render passes, compositing workflows, and final image polish.

  • You know 3ds Max, V-Ray, Photoshop, and Nuke or After Effects at a professional level. Your portfolio or showreel demonstrates seniority through visual judgment, technical control, and finished output, not just clean modeling or isolated shots.

  • You can communicate clearly in English with artists, leads, producers, and technical teams. You can explain what is wrong in an image, what needs to change, and what tradeoff is being made.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content.

Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.

  • XDR and File Integrity Monitoring:Operate XDR and approved file integrity monitoring configurations. Verify agent coverage, health, and updates; apply approved routine adjustments; and coordinate remediation with system owners.

  • Authentication Monitoring:Monitor Cognito authentication failures, suspicious logins, and account takeover indicators. Investigate findings and coordinate login availability issues with application owners.

  • Cloud and SIEM Monitoring:Verify GuardDuty coverage across AWS accounts and regions and monitor findings. Check Sumo Logic log delivery, alerts, and dashboards, and escalate collection or monitoring failures.

  • Identity and Access Management:Provision, modify, and promptly revoke access based on approved requests. Apply least privilege and MFA requirements, document approvals and changes, and coordinate periodic access certifications with system owners.

  • Incident Response:Lead the triage and investigation of security incidents, perform authorized containment, and coordinate resolution with internal teams and vendors. Maintain incident timelines, post-incident reports, and root cause analyses.

  • Firewall Management:Review firewall anomalies, maintain rule justifications and approval records, and coordinate monthly rule reviews and approved routine changes with network engineers.

  • Documentation and Reporting:Maintain Confluence procedures and incident runbooks, reviewing them quarterly and after relevant changes or incidents. Provide monthly metrics on control completion, coverage, incidents, access changes, and overdue actions.

  • Continuous Improvement:Identify gaps in detection coverage, controls, and processes and recommend improvements. Share knowledge with and help guide less experienced team members.

Success in this role will be measured through a combination of control execution, detection coverage, access hygiene, and incident handling, including:

  • Daily log reviews completed on schedule, with documented evidence for every review.

  • PCI DSS and SOC 2 control tasks completed by their due dates, with overdue actions tracked to closure.

  • Clean quarterly ASV scans, with remediation and rescans completed within required windows.

  • XDR, FIM, and GuardDuty coverage maintained across all in-scope systems, accounts, and regions, with gaps escalated promptly.

  • Access revocations completed within defined SLAs, and periodic access certifications completed on time.

  • Incidents triaged within defined response times, with timelines, post-incident reports, and root cause analyses completed for all qualifying events.

  • Monthly firewall rule reviews completed with current justifications and approval records.

  • Audit evidence delivered without findings attributable to missed or undocumented controls.

  • Procedures and runbooks reviewed quarterly and kept current.

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of hands-on security operations or related IT security experience, including independent alert investigation, incident triage, and identity administration.

  • Practical experience with AWS (including GuardDuty and Cognito), SIEM queries, XDR, Windows/Linux logs, and network security; comparable product experience accepted.

  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS and SOC 2 control execution and evidence, least privilege, change control, and incident response.

  • Proven ability to work independently, manage recurring compliance deadlines, and prioritize competing demands.

  • Strong ticket documentation skills and excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to take part in after-hours incident response coverage, including a weekend and holiday backup rotation.

jobs.title: Lead/Staff Full Stack Engineer, AI Platform & Agents
jobs.excerpt: As Lead/Staff Full Stack Engineer, AI Platform & Agents, you will Build the GenAI platform that powers critical decisions in healthcare, legal, tax, and compliance industries.
jobs.description:
As Lead/Staff Full Stack Engineer, AI Platform & Agents, you will Build the GenAI platform that powers critical decisions in healthcare, legal, tax,
and compliance industries. Your work will directly shape the future of these
fields, enabling faster, safer, and more impactful decision-making at a global

scale.

About this role
Our team is building a central GenAI Platform to empower hundreds of product
teams across the organization with scalable capabilities for rapid development,
validation, and deployment of AI agents. We also drive the development of the
most impactful AI agents, ensuring faster delivery and greater impact across
multiple domains. With over 20 agents already launched and many more in
progress, our work accelerates innovation and improves outcomes in critical
industries.
You'll join a 100-engineer remote-first team within a larger organization that
combines the stability of an established company with the agility of a startup. In
this high-autonomy, high-impact role, you'll take problems from concept to
production, mentor less experienced engineers, and lead by example. You'll
design and ship full-stack systems, shape platform capabilities to empower
hundreds of product teams, and directly contribute to the development of the

most impactful AI agents.

Flagship Agent: UpToDate Expert AI
In Health, we’re launching UpToDate Expert AI—a medical research and clinical
reasoning agent that transforms the world’s most widely used point-of-care
knowledge resource into a real-time medical assistant. Millions of physicians will rely on it to accelerate differential diagnosis, refine treatment decisions, and
reduce cognitive load—while maintaining rigorous safety, privacy, and guideline
fidelity. Improvements you ship (latency, reliability, hallucination reduction) will
translate directly into faster, higher-quality patient care at global scale.

Tech stack
You don’t need to know all of these on day one, but you should be ready to learn

quickly.

  • TypeScript, Node.js, React, Python, LangChain/LangGraph, MCP/A2A, Rust

  • AWS (primary), Azure, GCP; Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions

  • DocumentDB, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search

  • Azure OpenAI, AWS Anthropic, Google Gemini

  • GitHub, Confluence, Slack

What you’ll do

  • Design and implement full-stack applications, AI agents, and platform components that enable rapid GenAI agent development, validation, and deployment.

  • Build developer tooling, CI/CD, and observability for safe, fast iteration (evals, canaries, rollout/rollback, cost and quality telemetry).

  • Apply secure SDLC and privacy-by-design practices (threat modeling, least privilege).

  • Collaborate with product, UX, and domain experts to deliver customer-focused solutions with measurable outcomes.

  • Apply current LLM patterns (RAG, retrieval, routing, tool-use, evals) to deliver measurable customer value—faster, more reliable AI systems; reduced time-to-decision; improved trust/safety metrics; and lower cost per query.

  • Lead by example and be heavily hands-on: drive architecture, mentor engineers, and take ownership of larger projects.

Team context

Org and Sub-teams: Central GenAI Platform within Wolters Kluwer, driving
innovation across businesses by creating re-usable platform services and
components. Sub-teams are fewer than 10 engineers, focused on platform

services or customer-facing agents.

Culture and Reporting: We value a "manager of one" mindset, where
outcomes matter more than optics. Authority is earned through
demonstrated impact, not tenure or title. You’ll report directly to the

Director of Engineering, AI Platform.

Team Size and Impact: Our globally distributed team of ~100 engineers
combines the stability of an established company with the agility of a
startup. We are moving fast, and there are many areas where you can have

a big impact.

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Strong full-stack development skills and cloud experience

  • (AWS/Azure/GCP).

  • Expert in at least one, and proficient across the others:

  • AI Agent development and evaluation

  • Backend development

  • Frontend development

  • Cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP)

  • CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code

  • Site Reliability Engineering (SRE)

  • Quality engineering / testing strategy

  • Secure SDLC and privacy by design

  • Proven track record delivering secure, reliable, cloud-native systems to

  • production.

  • Excellent problem-solving, ownership, and cross-functional

  • communication.

Nice to have

  • Proven ability to deliver software products independently or as part of a

  • small, fast-paced team.

  • Experience of taking AI agents from concept to production, including safety

  • evaluations, iterative testing (e.g., A/B testing), and continuous

  • improvement.

  • Experience with LangChain/LangGraph and MCP; vector/RAG systems;

  • OpenSearch.

  • Worked on traditional ML tasks like training, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Understand how LLMs work, their failure modes, and techniques like fine-

  • tuning and model adaptation.

  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as SOC2, HIPAA, etc.

Stages

  • 15‑minute intro screen

  • 2× live coding in your preferred language

  • 1× systems design

  • 1× presentation of past work

​Timeline: Typically 2–4 weeks

Your first months

  • Month 1: Deep-dive into one platform component most aligned with your

  • expertise; ship small improvements while ramping up.

  • After onboarding: We’ll align on a high-impact area that fits your strengths

  • and ambitions.

To apply:

Please submit your resume along with a brief cover letter that includes a “Statement of Exceptional Work.” In your cover letter, highlight one of your most impactful projects by addressing the following:

  • Your role and the problem space you were working in

  • The technical and product challenges you faced, and how you addressed them

  • The measurable impact of your work (e.g., metrics, outcomes, improvements)

This will help us better understand your approach to solving complex problems and the value you bring to the team.

Please do not include any proprietary or confidential information in your submission

#BETHEDIFFERENCE

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. ​About the CompanyHeroship builds the Agentic Healthcare Operating System that lets telehealth companies and clinics scale their impact — combining medications, biologics, and AI-driven infrastructure into one platform.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

​

About the Company

Heroship builds the Agentic Healthcare Operating System that lets telehealth companies and clinics scale their impact — combining medications, biologics, and AI-driven infrastructure into one platform. We exist to change millions of lives by removing the operational, clinical, and growth barriers that keep care from reaching the people who need it. We partner with providers to help them deliver better care to more patients, faster. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career inside one of the most dynamic categories in healthcare, let’s talk.

Position Overview

Heroship is seeking a multi-talented, growth-driven Marketing Manager to lead provider education, lifecycle marketing, and content for our clinic and telehealth partners across medications, biologics, and our Agentic Healthcare Operating System. Reporting directly to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO), this individual will play a pivotal role in building deep, durable relationships with providers — educating them clinically, commercially, and operationally so they grow with us and stay with us.

This is a hybrid creative, analytical, and relationship-driven role for someone who understands how to teach, nurture, and retain a sophisticated provider audience. You will be building education funnels, owning the partner lifecycle, producing meaningful content, and measuring everything — all with the goal of helping our clinics and telehealth partners scale their impact

.


Requirements

Duties & Responsibilities
Provider Education Funnels

  • Design and own provider education funnels across three tracks: clinical (protocols, formulations, biologics, safety), business (clinic operations, margin, scaling), and marketing (patient acquisition and retention for our partners).

  • Build the journey from first touch to certified, activated provider — mapping content, sequencing, and milestones at each stage.

  • Develop onboarding curricula, enablement kits, and reference materials that get clinics and telehealth partners productive on the Heroship platform quickly.

  • Translate complex clinical and platform capabilities (medications, biologics, agentic AI workflows) into clear, credible, provider-facing education.

  • Partner with Clinical, Product, and Pharmacy teams to keep education accurate, compliant, and current.

  • Track funnel performance: enrollment, completion, time-to-activation, and downstream retention impact.

Lifecycle Management & Relationship Building

  • Own the full provider and partner lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, expansion, retention, reactivation, and win-back.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. Tars is an AI agent platform for customer experience.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Tars is an AI agent platform for customer experience. We sell to two personas: Marketing and Customer Support leaders in mid-market and enterprise companies. Netflix, American Express, and Vodafone are among the brands that use us.
This is a 6-month SDR internship for someone at the start of their career who wants to learn enterprise tech sales by actually doing it - not by watching. You'll build the pipeline that our founders close.
What you'll actually do
  • Pick up the phone. Cold calling US decision-makers is the core of this job, not a side activity. Daily call blocks, in US hours, to CX, Support, and Marketing leaders who didn't ask to hear from you. Most of the craft you'll build here is on the phone.
  • Work LinkedIn as your second channel. Personalized connection notes, DMs, and smart commenting to the same buyers - manual, thoughtful, yours.
  • Let the machines do the email. We've built AI-powered research and sequencing systems that run the email layer largely on autopilot. You direct them; you don't hand-type sequences all day.
  • Own opportunity creation end to end. Research target accounts, find the right buyer, work them across call + LinkedIn + email, book the meeting. The founders run the meetings and close - you build the pipeline that makes those meetings happen.
  • Sit in on real discovery calls and demos. You'll watch the meetings you booked get run by the people who close them, and learn the full cycle from inside.
  • Keep the pipeline honest in HubSpot. Notes, next steps, stage updates. Boring but non-negotiable.
How the process starts
The moment you apply, you'll get an email from us with a short assignment - completing it is the first stage of this process. We only interview candidates who complete the assignment, so check your inbox (and spam) right after applying.

Requirements

Who you are
  • Willing to dial. Here's the honest filter: most people want outbound to be an automation job. It isn't. If calling a VP in Texas who doesn't know you makes you a bit nervous and a bit excited, keep reading. If it only makes you nervous, this role will make you miserable - and that's fine, it's not for everyone.
  • Disciplined. Call blocks happen every day whether yesterday went well or not. We'd rather see evidence of a boring routine you've kept for months than a burst of brilliance.
  • At the start of your career - a fresh graduate or up to ~2 years in. No sales experience required. Hunger and coachability matter more than your resume.
  • Genuinely curious about AI. You've played with AI tools on your own, or you badly want to. You'll be working with AI agents from week one.
  • You write well. Clear, specific, human - your LinkedIn touches and email direction still live or die on it.
  • Fine with US-overlap hours. The buyers are awake when India is having dinner. That's the job.
  • You want a career in tech sales. Top performers in this cohort earn a shot at a closing (AE) track with us.

Benefits

  • 6-month internship, India-remote, with the possibility of converting full-time
  • Stipend: INR 30,000/month + meetings-booked incentive
  • Working hours substantially overlap US time zones - this is a live-dialing role, so expect India evening/night shifts
  • Top performers of the cohort earn a shot at a junior AE (closing) track
  • You'll work with AI-powered research and sequencing systems from week one, directly with the founders

jobs.excerpt: Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail.
jobs.description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first.We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Senior AI & Automation Engineer is a senior individual contributor and technical leader on the Data & Technology Solutions team, responsible for architecting, building, and scaling intelligent AI systems and enterprise automation solutions that directly improve care quality and operational performance across our Medicare Advantage business. You will serve as a go-to technical expert for AI Scientists, Data Engineers, Product Managers, Clinical Operations, and Application Engineering teams — driving end-to-end delivery of production AI systems that span claims processing, risk adjustment, prior authorization, revenue integrity, and member engagement. This role carries a higher degree of independent ownership and technical authority than the mid-level equivalent, with expectations to lead complex, ambiguous initiatives from concept through production and to actively elevate the engineering practices of the broader team.
  • Lead the build of distributed, cloud-native systems for enterprise workloads. Own the design and build of services, APIs, and microservices that run reliably at scale in a regulated environment. Set the standard for distributed systems practice on the team: fault tolerance, retries and idempotency, queuing and eventing, caching, and horizontal scaling.
  • Lead hybrid infrastructure work bridging cloud and non-cloud systems. Own the build of integrations with non-API data sources, including flat files, legacy databases, EDI feeds, mainframes, and streaming data, as well as multimodal data such as documents, images, and audio. Set integration patterns the rest of the team builds against.
  • Own CI/CD, containerization, and deployment standards. Drive adoption of Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD best practices across the team. Own infrastructure-as-code standards for the systems the team builds.
  • Own data and automation pipeline reliability. Build and govern ETL and orchestration pipelines at scale. Own automation strategy using RPA platforms and orchestration tools, including ROI governance and engineering standards for fault-tolerant workflow design.
  • Apply AI/ML to production systems and own inferencing performance (applied, not research). Own the build of inferencing pipelines (batch, real-time, streaming) that serve models handed off from AI Sciences, for workloads such as claims processing, risk adjustment, and member communication. Partner directly with AI Scientists to take models from research into low-latency, high-throughput production systems, owning the benchmarking and tuning that gets them there. This is applied integration, serving, and performance ownership, not model research or training. Own the technical approach for integrating LLMs into workflows, including prompt engineering, RAG, and multi-agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen).
  • Lead the Databricks build-out supporting AI Sciences. Own productionizing models and pipelines built on Databricks, including Delta Lake, MLflow, and Unity Catalog. Own the CI/CD, orchestration, access controls, and cost tuning that let Databricks-based work move reliably into production, and set standards for how the team uses the platform.
  • Define alerting, testing, and monitoring frameworks that surface degradation before it affects member outcomes, and lead post-incident reviews.
  • Mentor engineers and shape engineering culture. Provide senior technical mentorship through code reviews, design critiques, and paired problem-solving. Contribute to hiring, technical interviews, and team-wide engineering standards, including responsible AI practices such as bias detection, explainability, and governance.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Senior individual contributor role with no formal direct reports. Expected to function as an informal technical lead: mentoring, conducting code reviews, participating in hiring panels, and guiding the technical direction of junior and mid-level engineers on project teams.


Job Requirements


Required

  • 5-8 years of professional software engineering experience with a demonstrated focus on distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or data platforms
  • Proven track record independently owning and delivering complex, production-grade distributed systems from concept through deployment and operations
  • Experience building and scaling hybrid infrastructure connecting cloud-native and non-API/legacy systems
  • Demonstrated experience serving and integrating AI/ML models or LLMs in production, including performance tuning (not model training/research)
  • Experience in a regulated industry (healthcare, insurance, or financial services) with deep working knowledge of compliance and security requirements
  • Experience building and scaling automation solutions using RPA platforms and workflow orchestration tools, including ROI governance

Preferred:

  • Experience with the Databricks platform (Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog) at a senior or platform-owner level
  • Experience applying AI/ML to complex healthcare data (claims, revenue cycle, prior authorization, medical coding, clinical text)
  • Familiarity with HL7 FHIR, ICD-10/CPT, or DICOM
  • Experience in a Medicare Advantage, managed care, or payer environment at a senior engineering level
  • Prior experience as an informal technical lead, principal engineer, or engineering lead

Education:

  • Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or related quantitative field, or equivalent progressive senior-level experience
  • Preferred: Master's degree in Computer Science or related quantitative discipline

License

  • Required: None at this time
  • Preferred: Advanced or specialty cloud certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP); RPA platform certification

Repligen is seeking a Regulatory Compliance Engineer to support product compliance activities across our Hardware, Automation, Chromatography, and Protein business units. In this highly collaborative role, you will help ensure our products meet global regulatory, environmental, and customer compliance requirements while partnering with engineering, quality, sourcing, and R&D teams to address complex compliance challenges. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to innovative technologies, support a growing global organization, and play a key role in bringing compliant products to market.

This role is expected to model our Leadership Behaviors—Integrity & Compliance, Customer Focus, Collaboration, Courage, Team Empowerment, and Accountability & Results—in all aspects of work.

Responsibilities

  • Understand legal requirements related to Repligen's products and services and ensure compliance with applicable industry regulations while serving as a trusted resource for regulatory and product compliance matters.
  • Maintain the latest versions and subscriptions of standards applicable to products, services (USP, EP, EDQM, JP, among others), and systems implemented within the company, ensuring the organization remains aligned with evolving industry requirements.
  • Continuously build and maintain expertise in EMC, Low Voltage Directive, Machine Directive, Pressure Equipment Directive, and other emerging regulatory requirements that may impact Repligen's products, services, customers, and business operations.

  • Support customer compliance requests by gathering technical information, providing documentation, and delivering timely, high-quality responses that strengthen customer confidence and trust.
  • Coordinate external testing, certification, and compliance activities with third-party organizations and laboratories, ensuring effective project execution, communication, and follow-through.
  • Monitor and support compliance efforts related to EMC, REACH, RoHS, PFAS, Pressure Equipment Directive (PED), and other applicable global regulations, proactively identifying risks and helping drive resolution.
  • Review, modify, and approve Quality Agreements and User Requirement Specifications (URS), ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and company standards.
  • Work closely with Organizational Knowledge and other stakeholders to provide guidance aligned with corporate policies regarding trademarks, registered marks, and related compliance considerations.
  • Participate in product design and development activities, providing compliance guidance early in the product lifecycle and partnering with technical teams to support informed decision-making.

Education & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Physics, or a related technical discipline required.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in regulatory compliance, product compliance, quality systems, or a related field.
  • Experience within life sciences, biopharmaceutical, medical device, diagnostics, analytical instrumentation, or other highly regulated industries preferred.
  • Working knowledge of global product compliance and regulatory requirements such as EMC, PED, RoHS, REACH, PFAS, Cal Prop 65, Low Voltage Directive, Machine Directive, or similar standards.
  • Experience interpreting technical regulations, customer requirements, and industry standards and translating them into business processes and compliance actions.
  • Familiarity with 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, USP, EP, EDQM, JP, or comparable pharmaceutical and life sciences standards preferred.
  • Experience coordinating external testing, certification, validation, or regulatory assessment activities is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP and document management platforms, including SharePoint.
  • Proven ability to build strong partnerships and effectively influence cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to changing requirements, and drive results in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment.

The Vice President, FP&A is a key strategic leader responsible for partnering with the Chief Financial Officer to support Travere Therapeutics' continued growth and long-term value creation. Reporting to the CFO, this individual will help guide the Company's financial strategy through disciplined financial planning and forecasting, thoughtful capital allocation and rigorous business decision support, ensuring financial resources are deployed to maximize impact for patients and shareholders.

Building upon a strong finance foundation, the Vice President will lead the evolution of the Company's financial planning, forecasting and budgeting capabilities to meet the needs of an increasingly complex and growing organization. The role and Finance team will provide strategic financial insight across the business, helping evaluate investment opportunities, optimize resource allocation and support the financial assessment and integration of business development initiatives.

This leader will work closely with the CFO, Executive Leadership Team and business leaders across the organization to ensure financial considerations are embedded in strategic decision-making. Equally important, the Vice President will invest in the continued development of an already talented Finance team, serving as a mentor and coach while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous learning.

The successful candidate will combine exceptional analytical rigor with strong business judgment, an enterprise mindset and the ability to influence decisions through thoughtful partnership. This individual will thrive in a collaborative environment, balancing strategic perspective with operational excellence while helping position Travere for its next phase of growth.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the Company's financial planning and analysis function, including annual budgeting, quarterly forecasting, long-range planning, scenario analysis, financial modeling, and performance reporting to support strategic decision-making.

Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is building a pipeline of qualified subject matter experts (SMEs) to support anti-human trafficking training and technical assistance (T/TA). Selected experts may be engaged on a short-term, part-time basis to design training content, advise on and peer review training materials, and deliver training in-person or virtually.

Please read carefully before applying:

This is a call for experts to join a talent pipeline. By applying, you are asking to have your resume reviewed and, if appropriate, added to a consultant database for future consideration.

  • If you apply, you will receive a confirmation email acknowledging that your application was received.

  • Your resume will then be reviewed and may be added to our consultant pipeline.

  • Applicant contact depends on alignment with the role. You will be contacted only if a specific project arises in 2027 for which your experience is a strong fit.

  • Joining our talent pipeline doesn't guarantee a project or assignment, and there's no obligation for either you or Bixal. If an opportunity aligns with your background, we'll be in touch.

  • Any potential work would be short-term and part-time (for example, designing the content for a single training, advising on one curriculum, or delivering one training session). Assignments are discrete and time-limited; they are not ongoing or full-time roles.

  • Availability, timing, and volume of work in 2027 depend entirely on project needs.

Compensation:

The compensation rate is expected to be $100 – $200/hour, depending on scope of work.

What Selected Consultants May Be Asked to Do:

Depending on the specific project need, engaged consultants may be asked to do one or more of the following on a short-term basis:

  • Design and develop training content and materials — for example, curricula, Training-of-Trainers (ToT) manuals, toolkits, micro-learnings, fact sheets, workbooks, desk guides, and screening tools — aligned with adult-learning principles and suited to in-person, virtual, and self-directed formats.

  • Advise on and review training content, including serving as a peer reviewer to assess the accuracy, relevance, and quality of materials.

  • Deliver training in person or virtually, including interactive sessions with case-based problem-solving and Q&A.

  • Update or adapt existing training content to reflect current best practices, terminology, and field needs.

Minimum Qualifications to apply:

  • Bachelor's degree.

  • At least 8 years of professional experience working in the anti-human trafficking space.

  • Recognized subject matter expertise in one or more areas of anti-human trafficking — for example, victim identification and response, prevention, case management, trauma-informed care, labor or sex trafficking, tech-facilitated exploitation, or clinical/healthcare response.

  • Experience developing and/or delivering training or educational content in the anti-human trafficking space, or comparable experience translating subject matter expertise into materials, presentations, or capacity-building for professional audiences.

  • Working knowledge of trauma-informed, person-centered approaches to human trafficking.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with the SOAR (Stop, Observe, Ask, Respond) framework or comparable public-health approaches to human trafficking.

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.
