About Forterra

At Forterra, we are unleashing autonomy at scale to transform the battlefield. Our mission is to build the foundational platforms that enable an intelligent ecosystem to coordinate, adapt, and execute with speed and precision even in the uncertainty and disruption of modern conflict. In an era marked by rapid technological change and evolving threats, we design for flexibility, survivability, and operational dominance.

Forterra delivers weapons, sensors, and battlefield effects through integrated autonomous networks reaching operational areas faster, safer, and without placing human lives at risk. Our systems operate with distributed control, dynamic routing, and real-time responsiveness, enabling sustained advantage across complex mission environments.

About the role

Forterra is looking for a Software Systems Engineer to define and integrate the requirements, architecture, interfaces, and verification approach for safety critical embedded software supporting autonomous ground vehicles. This is an individual contributor role that works across software, systems, test, and safety engineering. You will turn operational and safety needs into implementable requirements and interfaces, maintain the technical thread through verification, and help the team understand how the software will behave, integrate, and perform across multiple platforms

Someone who can connect system intent to implementation. You should be comfortable moving between functions, requirements, interfaces, architecture, software behavior, and verification evidence. The role requires enough technical depth to work directly with embedded software teams and enough systems perspective to see how decisions affect the larger vehicle and safety case.

What you'll do

  • Derive, refine, and maintain system and software requirements for safety critical embedded functions.
  • Break system functions into implementable software responsibilities and support functional allocation across system elements.
  • Define interfaces, data flows, operating modes, fault behavior, and assumptions for embedded software components.
  • Maintain the relationship between hazards, safety goals, mitigations, requirements, architecture, and verification evidence through requirements traceability.
  • Review software and system designs for completeness, consistency, testability, diagnosability, and safe behavior under faults and abnormal conditions.
  • Work with software and test engineers to establish verification methods, resolve requirement issues, and assess coverage and evidence.
  • Support architecture reviews, requirements reviews, technical baseline reviews, integration reviews, and customer reviews with clear technical analysis and documentation.
  • Work across development, test, safety, and program teams to resolve cross component issues and maintain a reusable platform baseline.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Five or more years of systems engineering experience with complex embedded, autonomous, automotive, aerospace, defense, or industrial systems.
  • Hands on experience developing and managing system or software requirements, including requirements traceability and clear verification criteria.
  • Experience with functional decomposition, allocation, interface definition, and architecture development for embedded systems.
  • Working technical knowledge of embedded software, including C or C++, RTOS concepts, communications, and hardware and software interfaces.
  • Experience using requirements or architecture tools such as Jama, DOORS, SysML, UML, or comparable tools.
  • Familiarity with verification planning, integration, anomaly resolution, and technical evidence for customer or program reviews.
  • Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical relationships clearly

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience applying safety critical development and assurance standards such as MIL-STD-882E, JSSSEH,JS-SSA-IG, ISO 26262, IEC 61508, or DO-178C.
  • Experience with hazard analysis and safety engineering activities such as FHA, STPA, functional allocation, mitigation analysis, or safety case development.
  • Experience defining interfaces and behavior for vehicle networks, diagnostics, fault management, orsafety monitoring functions.
  • Understanding of robotics domains such as motion control, planning, perception, localization, vehicle dynamics, and platform integration.
  • Experience working across multiple vehicle variants or programs while maintaining a reusable technical baseline.
  • Experience providing technical leadership through architecture reviews, requirements workshops, mentoring, or cross functional integration

$150,000.00—$175,000.00 USD

The salary offered to candidates will vary based on a variety of factors including (but not limited to) relevant work experience, education, specialized training, critical expertise, training, and more. Senior Operations Specialist, Contracts & Vendor Management

Location: Anywhere in the continental US, with the ability to travel up to monthly (quarterly for company summits plus periodic in-person sessions and school visits)

Join our mission to transform elementary math! We’re looking for a Senior Operations Specialist who is passionate about the details that keep a growing organization running smoothly. You’ll own our contract lifecycle - tracking every agreement from draft to signature to renewal, and digging into redlines with a sharp eye - while also managing the vendor relationships behind our printing and physical material operations. Both sides of this role draw on the same core strengths: attention to detail and the ability to represent Inflection Point Learning well to the schools, districts, and vendors we work with. We need someone who reads the fine print for fun, who finds satisfaction in a well-organized system, who uses AI to increase efficiency and transparency, and who builds the kind of trusted relationships with vendors and internal partners that make hard problems easier to solve.

Our vision

Welcome to Beast Classroom, where students delight in mathematical challenge - playing games, solving puzzles, and exploring rigorous content that demands flexible, creative thinking; where teachers are energized and empowered to teach math; where principals stop by and smile at the signs of a budding math culture; and where there is no ceiling for math excellence.

Our mission

At Beast, we’re on a mission to bring this experience to teachers in elementary schools everywhere. We’re building Beast Classroom, a K-5 math curriculum based on the beloved Beast Academy comic universe and the rigorous Art of Problem Solving pedagogy that has trained the world’s top math students for a generation.

Why we need you

We have the foundational pieces in place: a pedagogy rooted in deep problem-solving, a growing community of early-adopter educators, and mission-aligned backers. We’ve built a talented team on a foundation of transparency, trust, and deep care.

As we grow, our contract and physical material operations are growing more complex right alongside us: more agreements to track and negotiate, more print runs and shipments to coordinate, more vendors to manage. And as schools rethink how much screen time belongs in the classroom, our physical materials have never been more important. We need a Senior Operations Specialist who can bring order and rigor to both areas: someone who can read a contract closely enough to catch what matters, keep every agreement moving without anything slipping through the cracks, and partner closely with our printing and fulfillment vendors so all of our materials reliably show up where they need to be, on time and at quality. About the Role

Reporting to the Senior Director of Operational Excellence, this role helps ensure that the processes supporting healthcare claim identification, case development, and recovery are followed consistently and working as intended.

You will use established KPIs and operational reviews to identify breakdowns in performance or process adherence, diagnose the root cause, and coordinate process and technology issues through resolution. You will also perform UAT for system defects, bug fixes, and workflow changes affecting Intellivo’s recovery operations.

Monitor Operational Adherence

  • Evaluate whether established case workflows, processes, and operating standards are followed consistently.

  • Partner and provide Recovery Operations leadership with clear, evidence-based findings when issues involve employee adherence, knowledge, training, or performance.
  • Drive employee adoption of new processes and procedures and monitor adherence following implementation.

Diagnose Root Cause

  • Investigate operational and performance issues to determine the underlying cause.
  • Determine whether issues stem from process adherence, process design, workflow, technology, automation, data, capacity, or another operational factor.
  • Analyze case activity, operational data, and workflow behavior to validate findings.
  • Distinguish between issues requiring process or technology remediation and those requiring intervention by Recovery Operations leadership.
  • Translate findings into clear recommendations and required outcomes.

Manage Process & Technology Resolution

  • Coordinate process, workflow, system, or automation changes needed to resolve identified issues.
  • Define business requirements, ownership, expected outcomes, and measures of successful resolution.
  • Work across Recovery Operations, Technology, Product, Finance, Legal, and Client Services to move issues through resolution.
  • Track issues, dependencies, and solutions through completion.
  • Validate results after implementation to confirm the underlying issue has been resolved.

Perform UAT & Validate Fixes

  • Coordinate and perform UAT for bug fixes, system changes, automation, and operational workflow improvements.
  • Develop test scenarios based on healthcare claims, case management, and recovery workflows.
  • Validate that system changes address the original operational issue without creating unintended downstream impacts.
  • Document testing results, defects, and unresolved issues.
  • Maintain follow-through from issue identification through testing, deployment, and post-implementation validation.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of direct professional experience in healthcare billing or health insurance operations is required. Candidates without this experience will not be considered.
  • 3+ years people management
  • Experience working with healthcare claims, billing, reimbursement, revenue cycle, payment integrity, subrogation, coordination of benefits, recovery, or related insurance workflows.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate healthcare operational issues and identify root causes across people adherence, process, workflow, technology, and data.
  • Experience performing UAT for system defects, bug fixes, workflow changes, and technology implementations.
  • Experience translating operational issues into clear business requirements and test scenarios.
  • Strong analytical skills and working knowledge of AI prompting, Power BI and Excel.

Who is Intellivo?

As an industry market leader in subrogation, Intellivo empowers health plans and insurers to maximize financial outcomes by identifying and pursuing more reimbursement opportunities from alternative third-party liability (TPL) payers. Through innovative technology, Intellivo accelerates the identification of reimbursement opportunities while eliminating burdensome outreach to plan members. jobs.title: Business Enablement Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About the Role As a Business Enablement Specialist, you will design, document and operationalise repeatable processes and the systems that support them.
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Business Enablement Specialist, you will design, document and operationalise repeatable processes and the systems that support them. Working across Product, Engineering, Operations and Commercial teams, you will simplify complex workflows, reduce manual work, and ensure teams have reliable tools, clear procedures and the data they need to operate at scale. This is a hands-on role that combines process design, systems configuration, integration work and cross-functional change management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Map, document and optimise end-to-end operational workflows across multiple products and platforms, identifying automation opportunities and failure modes.

  • Configure and maintain internal systems and tooling (CRM, ticketing, workflow orchestration, admin panels and integrations) to support streamlined operations.

  • Design and implement integrations and automations using APIs, webhooks, ETL/ELT patterns and third-party platforms to reduce manual handoffs and data reconciliation.

  • Create clear, scalable process documentation, runbooks and SOPs so teams can operate independently and consistently.

  • Author tracking and instrumentation requirements to ensure operational observability: logs, metrics, alerts and dashboards for key process health indicators.

  • Partner with Engineering and Product to prioritise system improvements, scope development work and validate that releases meet operational needs and reliability standards.

  • Lead change management and training for new processes and systems, including stakeholder communication, onboarding materials and hands-on support during rollouts.

  • Own incident playbooks and contribute to incident response readiness: triage steps, escalation paths and post-incident reviews with actionable remediation plans.

  • Maintain data quality and access controls across operational systems, ensuring privacy-sensitive information is handled according to policy.

  • Continuously measure process performance and iterate: reduce cycle times, error rates and manual interventions through disciplined experimentation and monitoring.

How You’ll Do It

  • Develop clear process maps, decision trees and acceptance criteria that translate business workflows into system requirements.

  • Implement and maintain integrations using standard patterns (webhooks, message queues, scheduled jobs) and document failure/retry behaviours.

  • Build and maintain dashboards and alerts for operational KPIs, and perform routine QA to detect regressions or instrumentation gaps.

  • Create and maintain runbooks and training materials; run workshops and drop-in clinics to increase adoption and reduce support load.

  • Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to scope deliverables, set success metrics and verify post-deployment outcomes.

Requirements

  • 3+ years’ experience in operations, business systems, process improvement or a related role supporting cross-functional teams.

  • Practical experience with business systems such as CRMs, ticketing/workflow tools, analytics platforms and common SaaS integrations.

  • Working knowledge of integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, ETL/ELT, event-driven architectures) and a pragmatic approach to automation.

  • Strong documentation skills — able to produce unambiguous process specs, runbooks and training guides that scale across teams.

  • Solid analytical skills with experience instrumenting and monitoring processes using metrics, dashboards and alerts.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills with the ability to translate between technical and business audiences.

  • Comfortable working in fast-paced environments and taking ownership of cross-functional initiatives from discovery through to operational handover.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with workflow orchestration platforms, low-code automation tools, or integration platforms (Zapier, Make, Workato, n8n, or similar).

  • Familiarity with SQL or basic scripting (Python, Google Apps Script) to build small automations and perform data validation.

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring stacks (Datadog, Grafana, Looker/Looker Studio or similar) for operational metrics and alerting.

  • Experience designing processes in privacy-conscious environments and implementing appropriate access controls.

  • Previous experience leading cross-functional change programmes or training initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

  • Operational workflows are well-documented, measurable and reliably executed with minimal manual intervention.

  • Systems and integrations reduce cycle times and error rates, and internal teams trust the tools and runbooks provided.

  • Incidents are resolved according to playbooks, root causes are addressed, and recurrence is demonstrably reduced.

  • Process and system improvements are delivered iteratively with clear metrics demonstrating impact on scalability and efficiency.

Why Join Us?

You’ll join a collaborative team where your work directly improves how the business operates at scale. This role offers exposure to multiple product lines, the chance to shape tooling and process standards, and the opportunity to make measurable impact by reducing operational complexity and enabling teams to move faster.

jobs.excerpt: Important Notice for Applicants: At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates.
jobs.description:
Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Security Engineer to serve as security lead for a FIPS 199 Moderate federal platform that supports governmentwide regulatory planning and review. Federal agencies, oversight offices, and the public rely on these systems, which must stay available 24/7/365 while a modern replacement is built alongside them.

You will protect both. On the legacy side, you will keep a Java, Oracle, and Red Hat environment hardened, patched, and compliant. On the modernization side, you will build security into a new cloud-based platform from day one so it is ready for an Authority to Operate (ATO) when it reaches production. Because work can shift between the two, we're looking for someone comfortable moving between sustaining an existing system and securing a new one.

This is a client-facing role. You will be the program's named security lead, working with the client's technical leads, our Project Manager, and the engineering team, and translating security requirements into practical decisions that keep delivery moving.

This is a full-time position on an awarded contract with a 12-month base period and two 12-month option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $130,000 – $140,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

Vulnerability Management & Security Operations

  • Run automated vulnerability scans of operating systems, databases, and web applications, and lead remediation and patching across Red Hat Enterprise Linux, Oracle, Apache/Tomcat, and Java application components.

  • Meet contractual remediation timelines for scan and penetration test findings (15 days for critical, 30 for high, 60 for medium, 120 for low), and document Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms) when a timeline cannot be met.

  • Harden systems against GSA security benchmarks and CIS Level 1 guidelines.

  • Track end-of-life software, unsupported libraries, and known vulnerabilities, and raise risks early with a recommended path forward.

  • Support continuous monitoring, log review, and incident response in line with NIST SP 800-61.

  • Support continuity of operations (COOP) and disaster recovery planning and testing.

Compliance, Assessment & Authorization

  • Maintain the system's assessment and authorization (A&A) package under NIST SP 800-37 and SP 800-53 Rev. 5, including the System Security and Privacy Plan, contingency plan, business impact analysis, incident response plan, and contingency plan test report.

  • Maintain POA&Ms and support Government-led security assessments, control reviews, and penetration testing.

  • Support privacy compliance artifacts such as Privacy Threshold Assessments and Privacy Impact Assessments.

  • Keep security documentation current as legacy capabilities are replaced and retired.

Secure Development & Modernization

  • Perform threat modeling for new features, integrations, and architecture decisions.

  • Embed static and dynamic security testing (such as Snyk and OWASP ZAP) in CI/CD pipelines so every release meets OWASP ASVS with no unresolved medium or high findings.

  • Review releases for security impact before production, protecting availability.

  • Advise on secure architecture for the modernized platform, including federated identity, FIPS 140-validated encryption, Zero Trust principles, and software supply chain security.

  • Prepare security packages for prototype testing and position the new platform to receive an ATO at production deployment.

Advisory & Client Partnership

  • Provide guidance on public key infrastructure, firewall and network security, internet protocols, and configuration management.

  • Serve as the client's security point of contact, briefing technical leads and the Project Manager on risks, findings, and remediation progress.

  • Coordinate with client IT teams on infrastructure changes and validate system security after those changes.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • At least 5 years of hands-on information security experience, including securing federal information systems under FISMA.

  • Hands-on experience with the NIST Risk Management Framework, including implementing and assessing NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 controls at the Moderate baseline.

  • Experience writing and maintaining A&A documentation, including System Security Plans, contingency plans, incident response plans, and POA&Ms, and supporting a system through ATO.

  • Experience running vulnerability scanning tools (such as Tenable/Nessus or Qualys) and driving remediation across operating system, database, and web application layers.

  • Experience hardening Linux (preferably Red Hat Enterprise Linux) servers and relational databases (preferably Oracle) against CIS or agency benchmarks.

  • Working knowledge of application security, including the OWASP Top 10 and ASVS, static and dynamic testing tools, and securing CI/CD pipelines.

  • Familiarity with public key infrastructure, TLS certificate management, firewall configuration, and network protocols.

  • Clear, confident communication skills, with the ability to explain risk and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including client leadership.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent.

  • Experience with GSA IT security policies, procedural guides, or the GSA ATO process.

  • Experience securing cloud-hosted or containerized platforms (AWS, , Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust architecture (OMB M-22-09) and secure software development practices (NIST SSDF, OMB M-22-18).

  • Experience with identity federation and single sign-on, including .

  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, or Splunk.

  • Experience supporting systems through a legacy-to-modern platform migration.

How We Support Our Team:

  • Flex hours

  • 401K with matching incentive

  • Parental Leave

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

  • Flex Spending Account

  • Company provided short-term disability and life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • 11 Paid holidays

Our company is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all individuals and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Why Join the Team

  • This is a new business, so you help shape the solution itself. How it works in the real world, on real customer hardware and plant-floor systems, is still being defined, in large part by you.

  • Your impact is rewarded directly, with real financial upside tied to the deals you support.

What You Bring

  • Genuinely curious about how things work — you enjoy going deep with engineering teams and translating the hard parts into something a customer can act on.
  • A natural collaborator who works closely with sales, product, and professional services, with the ambition to take on more ownership and get closer to the customer.
  • A builder’s mindset — comfortable with ambiguity and a fast-moving, new-business environment where the solution is still being shaped, in large part by you.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software, Industrial/Automation/Controls Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years in solutions or sales engineering, technical pre-sales, systems integration, or hands-on development, including customer-facing technical ownership of evaluations and PoCs.
  • Hands-on understanding of the manufacturing and industrial automation stack — the OT/controls layer (PLC, SCADA/HMI, historians, OPC UA, MQTT), the operations layer (MES/MOM, ERP, PLM, EAM/CMMS, WMS), and the reference models and standards that govern it (ISA-95/ISA-88, Industry 4.0, Unified Namespace) — and of hybrid edge/cloud architectures, on-device and embedded systems, and offline-first deployment.
  • Working knowledge of the underlying frontline hardware and where voice runs on it — rugged handhelds and wearables, industrial headsets and AR/assisted-reality glasses, and edge/on-device compute and AI-ready silicon (SoCs/NPUs).
  • Proven ability to lead technical evaluations, PoCs, and proof-of-value engagements from discovery through onboarding and post-sales hand-off.
  • Excellent customer-facing communication, able to engage both shop-floor engineers and senior or executive stakeholders.
  • Authorized to work in the country of hire without current or future employer sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (MS/PhD) in a relevant engineering or computer science discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with one or more leading MES/MOM or EAM platforms (e.g., Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell FactoryTalk/Plex, AVEVA, PTC, IBM Maximo, Tulip) and industrial protocols (OPC UA, MQTT, Unified Namespace).
  • Experience with voice, conversational, or speech AI; on-device/edge SLMs; and audio front-end or microphone-array integration.
  • Familiarity with OT/industrial cybersecurity and functional-safety standards (IEC 62443, zero-trust/defense-in-depth).
  • Experience delivering solutions in regulated or high-noise environments (e.g., pharma/GxP, process industries, warehousing and logistics).
  • Multilingual capability for global customer engagements.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft and NVIDIA partner ecosystem and motions.

Location & Travel

  • Location: Remote — United States, Canada.
  • Travel: approximately 30% to customer sites.

What we offer

  • We offer a generous compensation and benefits package (in addition to the base salary), including:

  • Salary range $138,500.00 USD- $221,600.00 USD It is not typical for offers to be made at or near the top of the range. The actual salary will be determined based on experience and other job-related factors.

jobs.description:
Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Help Desk Specialist to be the first point of contact for users of a federal platform that supports governmentwide regulatory planning and review. Federal agencies, oversight offices, and the public rely on these systems, which must stay available 24/7/365 while a modern replacement is built alongside them.

You will provide both Tier 1 and Tier 2 support, diagnosing and resolving issues directly, from access and account problems to errors inside complex, role-based regulatory workflows, and escalating to engineering only when a fix requires a code or infrastructure change. You will also be the team's early-warning system: spotting patterns in tickets that point to defects, escalating outages immediately, and feeding what users experience back to the engineering team. As new capabilities are released on the modernized platform, you will support users through each change, so we're looking for an experienced support professional who can work independently across both a legacy system and a new one.

This role is technical and service-oriented. You will work closely with our engineers, trainers, and change enablement lead, and with client stakeholders who depend on fast, accurate support.

This is a full-time position on an awarded contract with a 12-month base period and two 12-month option periods. This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a project that aligns with Bixal’s mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. While the role has a fixed duration, we are committed to transparency and collaboration, keeping you informed about contract updates and new opportunities. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location

This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US.  Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $90,000 – $110,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

User Support & Issue Resolution

  • Serve as the first point of contact for agency and oversight office users by web, phone, and email, providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 support and resolving technical, access, account, and process issues directly whenever possible.

  • Triage, categorize, and log every incident and service request in Zendesk, including requestor, description, time logged, and time to resolve.

  • Meet contractual service levels: an initial tailored response to 95% of tickets within 3 business hours, and resolution or escalation of 98% within 1 business day.

  • Handle user access and authorization requests, login issues, and questions about workflows, roles, and system status.

  • Investigate complex issues using application logs, database queries, and system monitoring tools, and escalate those that need engineering support with clear reproduction steps, root-cause findings, and user impact.

Monitoring, Escalation & Reporting

  • Monitor incoming tickets for patterns that suggest widespread issues or defects, and flag systemic problems to the engineering team.

  • Report outages and serious issues immediately to the technical team by phone and email, especially those affecting public availability, system performance, or data integrity.

  • Produce weekly and ad hoc help desk reports covering ticket volume, response and resolution times by priority, and trends.

  • Feed recurring user pain points into the product backlog as inputs for future fixes and enhancements.

User Enablement & Release Support

  • Create and update targeted help content, including online tips, FAQs, and user guide updates.

  • Support training materials and workshops in partnership with the training and change enablement leads.

  • Support users through each new release on the modernized platform, answering questions and capturing early feedback.

  • Help maintain help desk procedures, ticket categories, and knowledge base content as systems change.

  • Other relevant duties as assigned and qualified/trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • At least 4 years of experience providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 technical support for enterprise-level web applications, including complex, workflow-driven or role-based systems.

  • Demonstrated experience resolving issues independently through Tier 2 troubleshooting, and knowing when and how to escalate to engineering teams.

  • Hands-on experience with Zendesk or a comparable ticketing system (such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management), including ticket categorization, workflow configuration, and reporting.

  • Experience consistently meeting defined service-level agreements for response and resolution times.

  • Working knowledge of SQL and application log analysis to investigate and diagnose user-reported issues.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across user access and permissions, browser, application, and integration issues, with the ability to document root causes and reproduction steps for engineers.

  • Experience analyzing support data to identify trends and systemic defects, and turning findings into clear reports and recommendations.

  • Experience writing user-facing help content, FAQs, or knowledge base articles.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a patient, professional approach to supporting users of varied technical backgrounds, including senior government stakeholders.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • ITIL Foundation or CompTIA A+ certification.

  • Experience supporting federal agency users or a federal help desk.

  • Familiarity with federal regulatory processes, such as rulemaking, the Unified Agenda, or Paperwork Reduction Act information collections.

  • Experience supporting applications built on Java and Oracle, or similar enterprise technology stacks.

  • Experience supporting users through a system migration or the rollout of a new platform.

  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG) for user-facing content.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewAs our Safer Gambling Team continues to grow, we are seeking an experienced Safer Gambling Team Lead to lead our team and provide additional expertise in the management of complex customer accounts and safer gambling cases.
jobs.description:
Overview

As our Safer Gambling Team continues to grow, we are seeking an experienced Safer Gambling Team Lead to lead our team and provide additional expertise in the management of complex customer accounts and safer gambling cases.

This is a team leadership position for an individual with proven experience in Safer Gambling/Responsible Gambling within the online gambling industry. Reporting to the Safer Gambling Manager, the role will combine leading the Safer Gambling Team with customer account management, risk assessment, complex safer gambling cases and customer interactions.

The successful candidate will have strong practical knowledge of safer gambling principles, customer risk management, affordability and financial risk, behavioural indicators, customer interventions and relevant regulatory requirements.

The role will involve working independently on complex and potentially higher-risk customer accounts, ensuring appropriate and proportionate interventions are applied and that all decisions are well considered, clearly documented and compliant with regulatory expectations.

The Safer Gambling Team Lead will be responsible for the day-to-day management of the team, including rotas, workload, performance and the training and development of agents, and will act as the first point of escalation for colleagues on complex cases and customer interactions.

This is a remote position which requires employees to work shifts between 6:00am and 11:00pm. Employees work a continuous rotating shift pattern, including mornings, evenings, and weekend work.

Summary of the Position

The Safer Gambling Team Lead will lead the Safer Gambling Team, with responsibility for the day-to-day management of the team and the monitoring of customer accounts and safer gambling activity.

The successful candidate will manage standard customer cases independently, reviewing account activity, customer history, behavioural indicators, financial information and previous interactions to determine appropriate and proportionate action.

Where more complex cases or customer interactions arise, they will be expected to provide additional support, using their experience and judgement to assist with appropriate decision-making and resolution.

The Safer Gambling Team Lead will also act as the first point of escalation for colleagues seeking assistance with challenging cases or queries, providing guidance and sharing knowledge to support consistent and effective case management across the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, motivate and manage the Safer Gambling Team, setting clear expectations and acting as the first point of escalation for the team.
  • Manage the team rota and shift cover, ensuring adequate coverage across all shifts and compliance with working time requirements.
  • Allocate and monitor workload across the team.
  • Monitor individual and team performance against agreed KPIs and scorecards, providing regular feedback and coaching.
  • Conduct one-to-ones, probation reviews and performance reviews, and address performance, conduct and attendance matters in line with company policies.
  • Lead the onboarding and training of new agents.
  • Manage and review customer accounts, identifying behavioural, financial and affordability risk indicators.
  • Handle complex and higher-risk safer gambling cases, making proportionate and evidence-based decisions.
  • Complete affordability and financial risk assessments in line with regulatory requirements and internal procedures.
  • Apply appropriate interventions, including deposit limits, restrictions, cooling-off periods, enhanced monitoring, account closures and self-exclusion where appropriate.
  • Conduct proactive and reactive safer gambling interactions with customers.
  • Demonstrable track record of confidently managing welfare calls and high-risk customer interactions, applying sound judgement, empathy and appropriate interventions in line with safer gambling procedures and regulatory expectations.
  • Manage and de-escalate challenging or irate customer interactions, using effective communication and sound judgement to reach appropriate and professional resolutions.
  • Handle complex customer queries and sensitive conversations professionally and empathetically.
  • Review Safer Gambling calls to ensure quality and consistency, stepping in where appropriate to support difficult customer interactions or assist agents who require additional guidance or support.
  • Provide confident guidance and direction to colleagues seeking assistance, using experience and sound judgement to support decision-making and stepping in where required to manage complex situations or customer interactions.
  • Support colleagues with complex cases and provide guidance where additional experience or knowledge is required.
  • Maintain accurate, detailed and audit-ready case records, including clear rationale and outcomes.
  • Support the Safer Gambling Manager with operational matters and deputise when required.

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Quality Assurance Consultants to support food, dietary supplement, ingredient, packaging, and consumer product manufacturers in achieving and maintaining compliance with Food Safety and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) requirements. The ideal candidate has a strong background in food quality systems, regulatory compliance, supplier qualification, auditing, and food safety program development.

This role provides the opportunity to support clients across the food and consumer products industries, helping organizations strengthen quality systems, prepare for regulatory inspections, implement food safety programs, and maintain compliance with applicable FDA and industry requirements.

NOTE:This is an evergreen posting for future positions within our team.  If you would like to be considered during the next round of hirings and have the qualifications, please apply.

NOTE: This is a PRN role with expected hours to be between 15-20 hours per week

Compensation:$62.500 - 76.50 per hour

Responsibilities

  • Conduct assessments and audits of food manufacturing, packaging, warehousing, distribution, and ingredient supplier operations.
  • Evaluate compliance with FDA food regulations, food GMP requirements, and industry food safety standards.
  • Perform gap assessments against applicable regulations and standards, including:
    • 21 CFR Part 117 (Preventive Controls for Human Food)
    • 21 CFR Part 111 (Dietary Supplements), as applicable
    • FSMA requirements
    • HACCP principles
    • GFSI-recognized standards (SQF, BRCGS, FSSC 22000, IFS)
  • Develop and improve Quality Management Systems (QMS) and Food Safety Management Systems (FSMS).
  • Review and author SOPs, quality procedures, food safety plans, hazard analyses, and preventive control programs.
  • Support clients during FDA inspections, customer audits, certification audits, and regulatory responses.
  • Investigate quality events, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, and food safety incidents.
  • Review and assess CAPAs for adequacy, effectiveness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Support supplier qualification, vendor monitoring, and supplier auditing programs.
  • Provide training and coaching on GMPs, food safety requirements, HACCP, sanitation, documentation practices, and inspection readiness.
  • Prepare clear, concise reports, recommendations, and client deliverables.
  • Maintain current knowledge of evolving food safety regulations and industry best practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biology, Quality Assurance, or a related discipline.
  • 15+ years of Quality Assurance, Food Safety, or Regulatory Compliance experience within food, beverage, dietary supplement, ingredient, or consumer product manufacturing.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • FDA Food Regulations
    • FSMA
    • 21 CFR Part 117
    • HACCP Principles
    • GMP Requirements
    • Food Safety Management Systems
  • Experience conducting internal, supplier, contract manufacturer, and third-party audits.
  • Experience implementing and maintaining GFSI-recognized programs (SQF, BRCGS, FSSC 22000, or equivalent).
  • Strong understanding of risk assessment, root cause analysis, CAPA development, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Proven experience supporting regulatory inspections and certification audits.
  • Excellent technical writing, communication, and client-facing skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.
  • HACCP or PCQI certification preferred.
  • Lead Auditor certification (SQF, BRCGS, ISO 22000, or equivalent) preferred.
  • Willingness and ability to travel as required (domestic U.S. and occasional international travel).

Preferred Consulting Experience

  • Food Safety Plan development and implementation
  • FDA inspection readiness assessments
  • Food facility registration and compliance programs
  • Supplier qualification and auditing
  • Mock FDA inspections
  • Sanitation program evaluations
  • Environmental monitoring programs
  • Allergen control programs
  • Quality Management System implementation
  • Training and coaching of QA and production personnel

jobs.excerpt: About Cardlytics Founded in 2008, Cardlytics (NASDAQ: CDLX) is the industry-leading purchase intelligence and incentives platform.
jobs.description:
About Cardlytics
Founded in 2008, Cardlytics (NASDAQ: CDLX) is the industry-leading purchase intelligence and incentives platform. We make commerce smarter and more rewarding for everyone by helping businesses attract, understand, and incentivize consumers through our partners' digital reward programs. Join us on our mission to make commerce smarter and more rewarding for everyone!

About the Team

At Cardlytics, our goal is to streamline data consumption across the entire organization. We understand that accessible, reliable data underpins informed decision-making and innovative problem-solving. By partnering closely with product and engineering teams, we tailor our solutions to fit their specific workflow needs and make strategic investments in our platform to ensure swift access to data. Our approach is designed to simplify the way teams interact with data, to accelerate time-to-insight to enable Cardlytics teams to harness the full potential of their data for impactful outcomes, and to make deliberate technology choices that keep our data infrastructure cost-effective.

About the Position

Cardlytics is seeking a Principal Software Engineer, Tech Lead - Platform to join the team, reporting to the VP of Engineering, Cloud & Data Infrastructure.

We are looking for an experienced technical leader to own and evolve our data compute environment end-to-end on AWS, including defining the next-generation platform direction. In this role, you will make architectural, design, and operational decisions that shape how analysts, engineers, and business stakeholders interact with data at Cardlytics. As data consumption increasingly shifts toward AI and agentic applications, you will also shape the platform's evolution into an AI-ready foundation — spanning the semantic layer, feature store, and data ontology that these systems depend on. You will combine deep expertise in industry-leading data platforms with the ability to provide technical leadership, define platform standards, and act as the primary technical partner for diverse user groups across the organization.

You will:

  • Architecture and design: Design and evolve the Cardlytics next-generation architecture; establish reference architectures and standards for batch, streaming, ML, and AI/agentic workloads.

  • AI-ready data platform: Build out the semantic layer, feature store, and data ontology that make Cardlytics data consumable by AI/agentic applications; enable governed, self-service access for both human and machine (LLM/agent) consumers.

  • User enablement: Serve as the primary technical partner for analysts, engineers, and business users; develop self-service guides, onboarding materials, and best-practice documentation to reduce friction across all user groups.

  • Technical leadership: Set technical direction for the platform and mentor engineers across the data and platform teams; drive engineering excellence and best practices, and manage the vendor relationship.

  • Performance and reliability: Define monitoring standards and SLAs, lead performance tuning for Spark jobs, open table formats (e.g. Delta, Hudi), and SQL query engines; own incident response and root-cause analysis.

  • Governance and security: Drive adoption of a unified governance layer (e.g., Databricks Unity Catalog) for centralized RBAC, column-level security, data lineage, and metadata management; implement and maintain security best practices including encryption and audit logging.

  • Platform standards and governance: Define the operating model and guardrails for the managed lakehouse platforms (including Databricks on AWS) — compute policies, access model, catalog structure, and cost governance — with day-to-day administration executed by the platform and domain teams working within those standards.

  • Infrastructure as code: Own the CI/CD strategy for lakehouse and data platform deployments (Terraform, GitHub Actions, and platform-native packaging such as Asset Bundles); enforce DevOps practices across engineering teams.

You have:

  • 7+ years of experience in data engineering or data platform roles, with at least 2 years in a technical lead or architecture capacity.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with the leading industry platforms, frameworks, and tools: Databricks, AWS EMR or similar, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Spark (PySpark), and SQL; with a solid understanding of compute/cluster management on AWS.

  • Proven experience designing and delivering Lakehouse architectures and large-scale ELT/ETL pipelines in production environments.

  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code tools, such as Terraform.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting diverse stakeholder groups including analysts, engineers (including ML engineers), and non-technical business users.

  • Strong understanding of data governance, data modeling, and cloud security best practices.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

Nice to have:

  • Experience designing or operating a semantic layer, feature store, or data ontology / knowledge graph in a production environment.

  • Familiarity with managing data for ML systems and AI/agentic applications, such as training pipelines or inference for LLM-powered and agentic tools.

Technical Environment

We primarily use macOS and Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides). While our preferred platform is macOS, we support both macOS and Windows. Familiarity with or willingness to work within this environment is required.

Core Values

Our shared values are the driving force behind everything we do. Across all roles, we are looking for teammates who embody these values:

  • Customer and partner first

  • Act with urgency and focus

  • Integrity with our partners and data

  • Accountability even when challenged

  • Empowerment over hierarchy

  • Growth over comfort

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible paid time off plus company holidays

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance begins on your first day

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match, plan also includes a student loan debt repayment option

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Educational assistance for continuing education

  • Lifestyle Spending Account for physical, emotional, and financial wellness (like gym memberships, home down payments, art classes, park passes, and more!)

  • Complimentary Calm app subscriptions to support employee mental health and wellbeing

As an equal opportunity employer, Cardlytics is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our people bring our products and organization to life, and every unique perspective makes us better. If you can do the job and you’re excited about growing with us as we scale our best-in-class advertising platform, we’d love to hear from you. If you need accommodation in the recruiting process due to a disability, please email or inform your recruiter.

Role Details

Job Title: Crop Insurance Adjuster

Location: Remote-CA

Reports To: Joe Kemph

Role Overview:

ProAg has an exciting opportunity for a Crop Adjuster to join our team in the Sacramento Valley area. Imagine joining a team that’s part of an organization that shares your passion for American Agriculture. A team that understands the challenges ag producers face and the disproportionate financial risks they shoulder. How do you know this team has that passion and understanding? Because many of us at ProAg still farm and ranch ourselves or were raised on the farm or ranch. It’s in our blood.

As a ProAg Crop Adjuster, you will make first contact with our policy holder on the farm or ranch that has just experienced a loss. You will work with our customer to complete field inspections, read maps and aerial photos, measure fields and storage bins, collecting production records of farm commodities, all the while assessing damage or loss. You’ll stick with each claim for each grower until the work is done and the claim is settled.

Reporting to the Area Claims Supervisor, you will work regularly in the field on the farms, climbing grain bins, walking over rough terrain for long distances, etc. You will apply your good judgment, common sense and understanding of ProAg's adjusting guidelines and policy provisions for a variety of Multi-Peril Crop Insurance, Crop Hail, and Named Peril policies.

In this position, you will work from home and cover a territory of the Sacramento Valley. This position will require travel of up to 75%, occasionally even beyond your assigned territory.

In this Exciting Opportunity, You Will:

  • Perform fact-finding to determine cause(s) and percentage of loss, exercising your best independent judgment in the handling of claims. Escalate any issues or problems that you can’t resolve to the Area Claims Supervisor.
    • Convey regulations and interpretation of procedure to claimants, agents, and industry people on claim situations.
    • Effectively communicate our position on developing industry topics such as new specialty crops or expanding coverage programs.
    • Continuously expand your knowledge of RMA rules and regulations and ProAg procedures for applying all MPCI, Crop Hail, and Federal Crop Insurance regulations.

What You Bring:

• High school diploma

  • Crop insurance experience in claims or compliance or any ag-related experience and background
    • Analytical skills and attention to detail
    • Basic computer and internet applications
    • Communication, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills
    • Reliable means of transportation and the willingness to travel
    • Completion of your Claim Adjuster Proficiency Program (CAPP) certification and/or any applicable licenses required by State agencies preferred.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefit package
    • Strong learning culture with ongoing development opportunities
    • Opportunities for growth and career advancement
    • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, with eligibility beginning on your first day of employment

• Basic life and disability insurance

• 401(k) plan with 6% company match

  • 20 days of PTO, three floating holidays, approximately 10 paid holidays, and volunteer time off
    • Paid parental leave
    • Access to our award-winning wellness program, including mental health services, fitness network membership, and a complimentary Headspace subscription
    • Student loan matching program
    • Employee discount program
    • An opportunity to do meaningful work and love what you do

What We Represent:

A career with purpose. Our crop insurance professionals work each day to bring peace of mind and protection to American farmers and ranchers. Join a team who truly cares.
• Part of something bigger: We offer a career with purpose as you support the farmers and ranchers who create food, fuel, and fiber for the world.
• Personal connections: We are built on strong relationships and appreciation of your individuality.
• A team who cares: We look out for each other personally and professionally because we care about each other.
• Innovators by trade: We’re committed to a brighter tomorrow for our team members and agriculture.
• The best of both worlds: We combine personal connections with powerful resources, thanks to our culture and the backing of Tokio Marine HCC.

The Company:

ProAg, a member of the Tokio Marine HCC group of companies, is positioned as a financially strong and well-capitalized insurer with an AM Best rating of A++. With 100 years of service to our agents & insureds, we stand committed to continuing the principles that ProAg was founded on: Integrity, Loyalty, and Customer Service. Tokio Marine HCC is a leading specialty insurance group with offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and other exciting locations. With the strength and stability that comes from being a member of the Tokio Marine Group, and more than fifty years of growth, profitability, and stability, we offer important insurance products that most people don’t even know exist. Every policy we write is special, enabling our clients to do amazing

NOTE: This is a FULLY remote role, but the candidate must be within LOCATION to collaborate with their team, peers, and internal customers. You do not have to be in the specific country or city shown in this listing, but please only apply if you are physically based within LOCATION.

Trusted by 20,000+ property managers worldwide, Hostaway is an industry leading, AI-powered vacation rental management platform designed for professional short-term rental operators. Hostaway brings everything together for greater efficiency and faster growth.

Profitable, high-growth, and the first short-term rental PMS unicorn 🦄. Join us at our most exciting stage yet! Learn more about our recent valuation and story here.

About the role

Hostaway is looking for its first Product Analytics leader, someone to own how we choose what to build, and to prove what it delivered. This role is about setting the standards and building the tools that help teams move faster with confidence. You'll define what good looks like, set the standards for how we measure, and bring the whole product organization along with you.

You'll work alongside our product leaders, who decide which bets we make, helping make sure the evidence behind them is solid. In a company leaning hard into AI, you'll also work out what measurement even means when the AI, not the human, is doing the work. It's a rare chance to be first: to shape the processes, metrics and KPIs, in a fast-growing, profitable, AI-first company with low bureaucracy and little hierarchy. Your work will make the impact of everyone around you visible.

Reporting directly to the Chief Product Officer, this is a hands-on role where you will write SQL, build analyses, and mentor others rather than purely manage. While Data Engineering oversees the data pipelines, warehouse, and central architecture, you will own the product measurement layer on top, maintaining a dotted-line partnership with the CTO.

Your Mission

  • Set the product measurement standard: what counts as an active, adopting customer, and how every analysis gets segmented.

  • Bring measurement into planning early, so every product requirements document includes sizing, an expected metric impact and a measurement plan.

  • Design measurement where clean A/B tests aren't available, and redefine it for an AI-native product where activity metrics no longer tell the full story.

  • Bring numbers to investment decisions, and grow metrics fluency so product managers can bring their own numbers to reviews.

  • Set the technical standards and build the function: tracking plans, instrumentation specs, data quality, starting with an experienced product analyst.

  • Stay close to the work. You'll remain hands-on day to day, writing queries and building analyses yourself rather than only directing others.

Requirements

  • 8+ years in product analytics, ideally in B2B SaaS at a scaling stage. We're open to strong candidates from other product backgrounds too.

  • Strong data foundations. You know how to design clean, reliable data models together with Data Engineering, and how to set up event tracking that stays consistent across features and domains. Experience with SQLMesh is a plus. You use AI tools heavily in your own work and understand where they help and where they mislead.

  • Influence beyond your title. You've disagreed with a senior leader about a number, backed it up with evidence, and your definition was still in use six months later. You've helped a company move from gut feel to data-led decisions, and you work patiently with product managers to find what fits a company of our size.

  • You build the function, not just run it. You've set up analytics operating models rather than inherited them. You can build business models that hold up to a finance leader's scrutiny, and you can show what actually worked: designing fair comparisons in a complex B2B product and being honest about what a number does and does not prove.

Nice to have

  • Measuring AI features, automated workflows or API usage; product-led growth; churn modeling; platform businesses with more than one user type (ours are property managers and their guests); travel, hospitality or property technology.

This role probably isn't for you if...

  • You see analytics as a service desk, waiting for tickets to come in.

  • You're a dashboard specialist. Dashboards are an output; the real work is changing how decisions get made.

  • You've only worked in large, mature data organizations, where the frameworks and teams were already established.

  • You need a formal title to have influence.

What we offer

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive pay based on market rates in the country of the applicant.

  • 100% Remote: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere within your country of residence—be it a co-working space, your home office, or even your dining room table. The choice is yours. Just don’t ask to work in our office (we don’t have one).

  • Equity: Every role in our company comes with valuable stock options in a fast-growing and profitable company. This ensures we all share in the company’s success.

  • Values-Driven Leadership: Our Core Values are not just words we’ve written to make us feel good. We leverage them daily when making strategic and tactical decisions.

  • Professional Growth: Our rapid growth offers unparalleled learning and development opportunities, along with a multitude of career advancement opportunities.

  • Annual Paid Leave: The specific amounts vary by country and are aligned with country and/or contract-specific norms.

  • Geographic Specific Benefits: As an international employer, we offer different country-specific benefits such as Health Insurance and Pensions in countries where these perks are customary. The specifics depend on the country of the applicant.

  • Dynamic Team Culture: As a global company with team members in over 40 countries, our diverse and international culture fuels our innovation and creativity, providing a key pillar to our success (and making it a lot of fun to work here).

Thank you for your interest. If you apply for this role, you will receive an email from our Talent Acquisition team after your application has been reviewed alongside the qualifications for this role and the qualifications of others who have applied.

jobs.excerpt: Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities.
jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Our engineering team at Grow Progress is critical to our mission to build cutting-edge persuasion technology for social good. We’re pioneering a new approach to persuasion: giving our customers the power to persuade more people based on how they think — not just how they look.

Who We Are

  • Grow Progress gives our customers the power to persuade more people by tailoring their messages to match each audience member’s identity. WEG VERWALTER/IN (m/w/d) - Remote oder Berlin Office

Vollzeit/Teilzeit/Freelancer

Gestalte die Zukunft der Hausverwaltung mit Ralph!

Hast du Lust mit einem innovativen Start-Up eine ganz Branche zu revolutionieren? Ralph (www.ralph-hv.de) ist Tech-Start-Up und Berlins modernste Hausverwatung zugleich. Wir denken Hausverwaltung von Grund auf neu, denn einiges muss sich bei Hausverwaltungen ändern! Wir verbinden unsere eigene Software mit der Expertise von erfahrenen Verwalter/-innen und einem starken operativen Team, das dir als Verwalter:in den Rücken frei hält. Beschreibung der Rolle

Es handelt sich um eine hybride Vollzeitstelle als WEG Verwalter:in. Du hast aber ein ganzes Team um die herum: Ein operatives Team, das für dich Tickets beantwortet, Aufträge auslöst, Architekten, die Begehungen begleiten können und ein Buchhaltungsteam. Als WEG Verwalter kannst du dich auch für den Aufbau von Beziehungen zu neuen und bestehenden Kunden engagieren, bietest einen außergewöhnlichen Kundenservice und trägst somit direkt zum Wachstum und zur Entwicklung des Unternehmens bei. Somit arbeitest du bei uns strategischer und weniger operativ als du es ggf. von anderen Verwaltungen gewohnt bist.

Hast du Lust, die Zukunft der Hausverwaltung mitzuentwickeln?

Deine Aufgaben

Du möchtest unser Wachstum in Berlin vorantreiben und dabei Eigentümer/-innen mit unserem Produkt begeistern?

Dann nimm die Herausforderung an, als WEG Verwalter/in für Ralph Verantwortung zu übernehmen:

  • Du planst und moderierst unsere hybriden und digitalen Eigentümerversammlungen

  • Du koordinierst unser Team des Instandhaltungsmanagements, und hilfst bei der Handwerker-Koordination und der Auftragserteilung

  • Du beweist deinKommunikationsgeschick bei der Korrespondenz mit Beiräten, Eigentümern und Dienstleistern

Was wir dir bieten

  • Verschiedene Vertragsoptionen: Egal ob Teil- oder Vollzeit oder Arbeit auf Stundenbasis, wir suchen die besten Talente. Kontaktiere uns und frage uns nach flexiblen Möglichkeiten.

  • Flexibilität: Kein Bock auf 9 to 5? Wir auch nicht. Wir sind "Remote-first" und erwarten nicht, dass das Team ins Office kommt. Egal ob du aus Berlin oder z.B. aus Barcelona arbeitest, du kannst dir deine Arbeit um deine Termine in Berlin herum frei gestalten.

  • Sicherheit: Wir bieten dir auf Wunsch ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis, damit deine Zukunft planbar und gesichert ist.

  • Entwicklung: Du kannst über Ralph deine Zertifizierung zum/r Verwalter/in erhalten. Deiner Entwicklung sind keine Grenzen gesetzt – hier lernst du spannende neue Dinge und bleibst immer up-to-date. Darüber hinaus bieten wir interessierten Mitarbeitenden die Weiterbildung zum Klimaverwalter an.

  • Teamwork: Vor Ort erwartet dich ein dynamisches und aufgeschlossenes Team, welches eine gute Einarbeitung gewährleistet und dir bei allen Fragen zur Seite steht

  • Verkehrsanbindung: Ein zentral gelegener Standort mit direkter Anbindung an den ÖPNV – bei uns kannst du das Auto gerne stehen lassen.

  • Mitarbeitervorteile: Neben einer betrieblichen Altersversorgung, zusätzlicher Erfolgsbeteiligung und Unternehmensaktien bieten wir dir Fitnessangebote, Ferienwohnungen u.v.m.
