jobs.description:
Description

AtRankings.io, we help law firms grow through GEO, SEO, paid media, video, and other digital marketing services. We are looking for a Law Firm Digital Strategist to connect client objectives to clear priorities,measurable roadmaps, and coordinated work across channels. This role reports to the Chief Strategy Officer and contributes to improving our approach to client strategy.

The Account Manager owns the client relationship and ongoing communication. The Law Firm Digital Strategist owns strategic direction, the roadmap, and the analysis that informs recommendations. Channel teams own execution. This is an individual-contributor role focused on planning, analysis, and direction, without hands-on campaign management or production responsibilities. The Strategist leads strategic discussions within client meetings in partnership with the Account Manager, explains recommendations and results, and participates in occasional in-person meetings.

Responsibilities

Client Objective Translation and Roadmap Ownership

  • Assess each client’s market, competitive position, desired case mix, geographic priorities, and budget to identify opportunities and constraints.

  • Partner with the Account Manager and client to establish realistic growth objectives, accounting for intake performance, firm capacity, and the time required to produce results.

  • Translate objectives into measurable roadmaps covering at least three months, with priorities, milestones, KPIs, and a clear rationale for the recommended approach.

  • Maintain an active roadmap for every assigned client, preparing the next segment before the current one ends. Develop longer-term plans when client goals or complexity require them.

Cross-Channel Strategy and Prioritization

  • Evaluate opportunities across GEO, SEO, Local SEO, paid media, video, organic social, content, link building, CRO, creative, web, and analytics.

  • Establish priorities based on expected impact, dependencies, available resources, and approved client scope and budget. Identify when additional investment or approval is needed.

  • Partner with channel experts to ensure execution plans support the roadmap while allowing specialists to determine the best technical approach.

  • Identify blockers and sequencing issues, challenge work that does not support client objectives, and recommend a better use of resources.

Performance Analysis and Accountability

  • Interpret client performance using qualified lead volume, lead quality, acquisition costs, conversion rates,signed cases where available, and relevant channel metrics.

  • Diagnose underperformance, distinguish marketing issues from tracking gaps or intake challenges, and develop corrective recommendations with the appropriate teams.

  • Identify when to expand successful initiatives, shift budget or effort, pursue new growth opportunities, or change the approach.

  • Escalate material risks, execution blockers, data issues, and resource constraints promptly, and follow through on agreed actions.

Internal Collaboration and Client-Facing Support

  • Partner closely with Account Managers to align strategic recommendations with client priorities, expectations, and commitments.

  • Lead strategic discussions with clients, explaining performance findings, recommendations, trade offs, and expected outcomes.

  • Keep Account Managers, channel teams, and leadership aligned on priorities and decisions, resolving strategic disagreements constructively.

Roadmap Management and Strategic Documentation

  • Complete monthly strategy checkpoints to evaluate progress, performance trends, blockers, and necessary adjustments.

  • Document objectives, strategic diagnosis, priorities, timelines, KPIs, risks, and next decisions, maintaining clear records of changes and assumptions.

  • Adapt planning depth to each client’s needs, balancing ongoing improvements for successful accounts with deeper analysis for complex or underperforming accounts.

  • Contribute to improving planning processes, templates, and strategy standards as the function evolves.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of digital marketing experience, including responsibility for developing client strategies, evaluating performance, and recommending priorities across multiple channels.

  • Strong understanding across multiple disciplines: SEO and Local SEO, with the ability to evaluate how GEO, paid search, paid social, CRO, content, and video contribute to a shared objective. Deep expertise in every channel is not required.

  • Demonstrated ability to connect multiple channels into a practical plan, explain investment tradeoffs, and adjust priorities based on results.

  • Ability to assess a client’s market, competitive position, business goals, budget, and constraints before recommending an approach.

  • Strong analytical skills, including experience interpreting data from GA4, Google Search Console,

  • advertising platforms, call tracking, CRM systems, SEO tools, or comparable reporting environments.

  • Experience presenting strategies and performance recommendations directly to clients, including

  • navigating difficult conversations.

  • Ability to influence priorities and resolve disagreements constructively with Account Managers, channel specialists, and department leaders.

  • Strong written communication and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize strategic attention across a substantial client portfolio.

  • Agency experience managing multiple concurrent client strategies is preferred. Legal marketing experience is a plus but is not required.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Client outcomes: Progress toward agreed objectives, including qualified leads, acquisition efficiency, and signed cases where reliable data is available. Outcomes are evaluated in the context of approved budgets,execution, intake performance, and client decisions.

  • Strategic effectiveness:Clear diagnosis, justified priorities, realistic sequencing, and a measurable connection between recommended work and client objectives.

  • Planning and follow-through:Active roadmaps for all assigned clients, completed monthly checkpoints, timely identification of risks, and consistent follow-through on corrective actions.

  • Channel progress:Relevant indicators selected for each client’s objectives, such as organic lead growth, local visibility, paid-media efficiency, conversion rate, impression share, and AI visibility.

Benefits

  • Annual Salary of $100k

  • Fully Remote

  • Unlimited PTO

  • $100 Wellness Reimbursement Program

  • Quarterly training stipend for Professional Development

  • 401(k) with 3% Employer match (Safe Harbor)

  • 100% Employer-Paid Health Insurance (For Employee)

What to Expect in the Interview Process

  1. Resume Review: Applications and resumes are reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team.

  2. One Way Interview: Selected candidates will receive a link to answer a short set of questions by video. Please plan to record your responses in your typical work-from-home environment, ensuring it is well-lit and free of distractions.

  3. Live Zoom Interview:Candidates who move forward will meet with Talent Acquisition and the Hiring Manager for a live Zoom interview to discuss experience, role expectations, and team fit.

Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI. Aerospike powers millions of transactions per second with millisecond latency, at a fraction of the total cost of ownership compared to other databases.

Global leaders, including Adobe, Airtel, Barclays, Criteo, DBS Bank, Experian, Grab, HDFC Bank, PayPal, Sony Interactive Entertainment, The Trade Desk, and Wayfair, rely on Aerospike for customer 360, fraud detection, real-time bidding, profile stores, recommendation engines, and other use cases.

At Aerospike, we dream big and deliver even bigger. Our mission is to unleash the power of the world’s real-time data with a database built for infinite scale, speed, and sustainability.

If you're ready to shape the future of data, join us.

Aerospike is looking for a technically sharp, enterprise-focused Solutions Engineer to help drive adoption and shape the technical vision of our blazing-fast, real-time data platform across North America. In this high-impact pre-sales role, you’ll partner closely with account teams and executive stakeholders to lead architecture design, translate complex enterprise requirements into scalable blueprints, and prove clear, compelling value for our prospective customers.

Based in North America, you’ll serve as the principal technical advisor and enterprise architect throughout the sales lifecycle — from high-level discovery and architectural design to proof-of-concept (POC) governance and post-sale deployment strategy. Whether it’s designing fault-tolerant, high-throughput database topologies, addressing complex data modeling challenges, or leading strategic technical discussions, your expertise will be key to helping enterprise clients realize the power of Aerospike.

This is a pre-sales engineering & architecture position.

Responsibilities

  • Engineer for advantage: Lead technical discovery and design creative, multi-region architectures that solve demanding data, scale, latency, and resilience requirements.
  • Master the data plane: Bring deep expertise in databases, distributed systems, data platforms, and high-throughput workloads—and make complex technology decisions clear to every audience.
  • Sell the architecture and the outcome: Connect technical choices to business value, competitive differentiation, ROI, and the customer’s broader data strategy.
  • Create conviction through proof: Design and lead rigorous POCs, benchmarks, whiteboarding sessions, demos, and architecture reviews that validate performance, scalability, and business impact.
  • Be the technical deal strategist: Partner tightly with Account Executives to shape deal strategy, multi-thread stakeholders, neutralize architectural risk, and advance complex opportunities.
  • Unblock with ingenuity: Diagnose hard customer problems, develop practical solutions, and turn technical objections into reasons to buy.
  • Turn field insight into leverage: Capture recurring requirements, architectural patterns, and competitive intelligence to influence Product, Engineering, Customer Success, partners, and enablement.
  • Close as the trusted technical authority: Lead executive and engineering conversations across North America and help convert technical credibility into regional revenue.

Qualifications

  • Command the room: Bring exceptional executive presence, communication, and presentation skills to earn credibility with C-level leaders, principal architects, and developers.
  • Architect across the data stack: Demonstrate deep expertise in NoSQL, relational databases, distributed systems, MPP data warehouses, and specialized platforms such as graph, time-series, and AI/ML feature stores.
  • Build for real-world scale: Bring hands-on Linux experience and a strong understanding of high-concurrency, high-throughput, mission-critical, and zero-downtime systems.
  • Think in distributed systems: Apply practical knowledge of Spark, Hadoop, HBase, HDFS, Hive, Impala, and adjacent data-processing ecosystems to solve complex customer problems.
  • Win technical evaluations: Guide enterprise prospects through demanding architecture reviews, competitive bake-offs, POCs, and time-sensitive decisions with structure, urgency, and sound judgment.
  • Solve what others cannot: Use exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, and architectural problem-solving skills to isolate root causes and design elegant, executable solutions.
  • Operate as a strategic self-starter: Manage complex evaluations, competing stakeholders, and shifting priorities with minimal oversight while keeping the commercial objective in view.
  • Translate the field into product leverage: Capture customer requirements and convert them into precise, actionable feedback for Product Management, Engineering, and R&D.
  • Advocate where developers learn: Represent Aerospike through architecture workshops, developer meetups, hackathons, technical content, and industry events.
  • Code with credibility: Bring software engineering experience and strong coding ability in at least one core language, including Java, C/C++, Python, or Go.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Know distributed databases in production: Bring deep operational or architectural expertise with Aerospike or comparable platforms such as CockroachDB, Yugabyte, MongoDB, Cassandra, or Couchbase.
  • Architect across the cloud frontier: Hold advanced AWS, Azure, or GCP certifications—or demonstrate equivalent hands-on expertise designing secure, scalable, production-grade cloud environments.
  • Build cloud-native systems: Show strong command of microservices, containers, Docker, Kubernetes, and the operational patterns required to run distributed applications at scale.
  • Understand performance below the application layer: Diagnose the impact of networking protocols, CPU architecture, NVMe and SSD behavior, memory hierarchy, and other hardware dynamics on system performance.
  • Bring pre-sales pattern recognition: Have experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Principal Consultant in a high-growth technology company, with a track record of influencing complex enterprise decisions.
  • Be field-ready: Willing and able to travel up to 30% across North America to support customers, prospects, partners, and technical events.

Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Position Summary

The Senior Director, Technology Risk & Compliance Business Partners - GSC & OT will set direction for the Technology Risk & Compliance Business Partners - GSC & OT capability across GSK and lead the organisation that delivers it. This is a senior leadership role accountable for the capability across GSK. This role covers Global Supply Chain and Operational Technology, including manufacturing and laboratory systems.

About the team. The Technology Risk and Compliance Business Partners are the face of the Cyber Security Office to GSK's business and technology areas. Each partner owns the cyber risk and compliance relationship for an assigned area, translating central strategy into what that area actually needs to do, and bringing its risk back into the Cyber Security Office.


Key responsibilities:

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:


  • Set the multi-year strategy for Technology Risk & Compliance Business Partners - GSC & OT and secure the investment to deliver it.

  • Own the budget, vendor portfolio and headcount plan for the capability.
  • Represent the capability to the CISO, GSK Tech leadership, auditors and regulators, including supporting risk and compliance for Sarbanes Oxley, Privacy regulations and Anti-Bribery and Corruption.

  • Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.

  • Utilize enterprise ticketing platforms to manage support requests and operational tasks.

  • Strong experience administering Microsoft server and desktop environments, including Active Directory in complex multi-domain environments.
  • Proficiency in system administration tools and technologies such as Group Policy, PowerShell scripting, DNS, DHCP, and identity services.
  • Solid expertise in Windows desktop operating systems and enterprise productivity platforms.

Leadership and Experience

  • Demonstrated experience managing and supporting Azure Virtual Desktop environments in a production setting.
  • Proven leadership experience overseeing technical teams responsible for infrastructure operations.

The Company

NorthMark Compute & Cloud (NMC²) is backed by dedicated leadership and investment, with a clear mission as it operates at the bleeding edge of technology. Its goal is to scale and enhance the high-performance computing (HPC) and cloud infrastructure that supports its clients' research, production, and delivery, enabling breakthroughs that shape the industries of tomorrow. Its engineers build critical infrastructure to eliminate friction in scientific research, simulations, analysis, and decision-making, accelerating discovery and driving faster innovation.

The Position

We are seeking an experienced, technically credible Infrastructure Delivery Program Manager to own end-to-end delivery of one of NMC²'s flagship HPC Center sites — a multi-year, multi-phase program spanning several buildings and representing $500M+ in capital investment. NMC² operates multiple HPC sites; the SVP, HPC Infrastructure Programs holds portfolio-level oversight across all of them, while this role owns full delivery accountability for a single flagship site. This is a senior leadership role owning the program management discipline for the full lifecycle of the site — translating executive strategy into structured, well-governed delivery, and holding a team of HPC Project Managers accountable for cost, schedule, and quality outcomes across every phase and building.

You will report to the SVP, HPC Infrastructure Programs, acting as their operating partner for program execution and governance on this site, while building and leading a team of HPC Project Managers who each own a phase, building, or major workstream within the flagship program. This role sits at the intersection of technical delivery, vendor and construction coordination, and executive reporting — you should be equally comfortable in a schedule risk review and a board update. Given the scale and duration of the program, you will also be the primary point of continuity and institutional knowledge for the buildout across its multi-year lifecycle.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end delivery of NMC²'s flagship HPC Center buildout — from planning and design through commissioning and ramp — across all phases and buildings of the program.
  • Build, manage, and develop a team of HPC Project Managers, each owning a phase, building, or major workstream: assign scope, coach on technical delivery rigor, and hold the team accountable to cost, schedule, and quality commitments.
  • Establish and enforce program management standards, methodology, and tooling across the buildout (RAID logs, dependency tracking, change control, stage-gate reviews), ensuring consistency across phases delivered over multiple years.
  • Coordinate with utility, permitting, and municipal stakeholders as needed to keep site development on schedule at this scale.
  • Serve as the primary program governance partner to the SVP, HPC Infrastructure Programs, translating executive priorities into structured program plans, milestones, and reporting cadences.
  • Drive cross-functional coordination across engineering, data center operations, supply chain/procurement, construction and facilities, and finance to identify and de-risk delivery timelines.
  • Own program-level risk management: identify critical-path risks and technical/vendor dependencies across phases, escalate blockers early, and drive root-cause resolution.
  • Build and maintain executive dashboards and KPI reporting that give real-time visibility into capacity, schedule, cost, and quality across every phase and building of the program.
  • Manage day-to-day site-level vendor and subcontractor relationships (colocation, local trades, specialty installers), holding them accountable to delivery commitments; partner with the SVP and central procurement on major hardware/GPU supply and general contractor agreements negotiated at the portfolio level, ensuring this site's needs are represented in those negotiations.
  • Coordinate with peer site VPs and the SVP on shared portfolio constraints — hardware/GPU allocation, skilled labor and talent availability, and centrally-negotiated vendor capacity; escalate unresolved cross-site conflicts to the SVP for prioritization rather than resolving them peer-to-peer.
  • Partner with engineering and finance on capacity planning and forecasting to align infrastructure delivery timelines with commercial commitments and client SLAs.
  • Prepare program status materials for executive leadership, board meetings, and investor updates when infrastructure delivery is on the agenda.
  • Lead post-mortems and continuous improvement processes to raise program management maturity across the organization.
  • Support scaling of the program management function: hiring, onboarding, and career development for HPC Project Managers.
  • Partner with the Strategy & Operations function (or equivalent) to feed program-level data — cost, schedule, capacity, risk — into executive reporting, annual planning, and board materials, ensuring a clear handoff rather than duplicated ownership.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; PMP, PgMP, or equivalent program management certification a strong plus.
  • 12-15+ years of experience in technical program or project management, ideally within data center, HPC, cloud infrastructure, or large-scale capital infrastructure delivery.
  • Proven track record owning a large-scale, multi-year, multi-phase capital infrastructure program end-to-end ($250M+ capex), such as a data center campus buildout, hyperscale GPU cluster deployment, or comparable large facility development. Candidates with direct ownership at $100-250M scale and a clear trajectory toward this level will also be considered.
  • Experience managing and developing a team of project or program managers — able to hold a team accountable for workstream outcomes without owning execution directly.
  • Deep fluency in program management methodology: critical path analysis, risk and dependency management, resource and capacity planning, stage-gate governance.
  • Comfortable operating at both a strategic level (executive and board reporting) and a tactical level (schedule detail, vendor management, technical risk).
  • Experience managing vendor and contractor relationships tied to infrastructure delivery (construction, hardware suppliers, colocation providers) — either through direct negotiation or through administering and enforcing centrally-negotiated agreements.
  • Strong executive communication skills, with experience presenting program status directly to C-suite or board audiences.
  • Direct experience with hyperscale infrastructure, GPU/HPC compute buildouts, or comparable large-scale facility development — this is a required qualification given the scale of the program, not a bonus.
  • Bonus: experience coordinating with utilities, permitting authorities, or municipal stakeholders on large capital projects.
  • Bonus: experience in a PE-backed or high-growth scale-up environment.

We’re proud to be independent, founder-led and growing fast. Alongside our award-winning products, we’ve built a culture we’re equally proud of. We are ranked as one of the UK’s Top 25 Great Places to Work for mid-sized companies. Respect, collaboration and personal growth sit at the heart of how we work. You’ll find flexibility, support and opportunities to develop here, alongside regular team socials and funded CPD.

Role Description

IMP’s products are trusted by MATs nationwide to manage their finances more efficiently and effectively. Our portfolio covers three areas. Planner handles budgeting, forecasting and reporting. ICFP handles curriculum financial planning. Finance and Purchasing are the newest products, and they record and control a trust’s day-to-day spend. The portfolio is growing, each product serves a loyal and expanding customer base, and each evolves as our customers’ needs change and as IMP builds its platform ambition.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own IMP Finance and Purchasing, the two products that run a trust’s everyday finances. Purchasing helps trusts manage and control their spend. Finance is the transactional system behind it and handles day-to-day accounting, from payment runs to bank reconciliation.

This is a complex domain. Accounting rules, approval controls and audit requirements shape every decision, so this role needs someone who has already worked on a finance, accounting or purchasing product and understands how these systems work underneath. You won’t be learning the domain from scratch. You’ll bring that knowledge with you and apply it to the MAT sector.

Your job is to deepen and extend these two products as trusts adopt them. That means sharpening what has already shipped, validating and delivering the capabilities that will matter most next, and working closely with engineering and design to deliver with rigour and pace. You’ll need genuine curiosity about customer problems and the strategic discipline to decide what not to build.

Above all, you will stay close to the user. The trust finance teams and budget holders who use these products every day are your compass. A discovery-led understanding of their needs shapes what you build.

You will join a product team that is moving from reactive delivery to discovery-led development. You’ll play a leading role in embedding that change in your squad and modelling it for the wider team.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Strategy and Vision

  • Define and evolve the vision for the Finance and Purchasing products in response to customer insight, market signals and business goals.

  • Own your product roadmap. Balance improvements that deepen the value of what has shipped against new capabilities that extend the products’ position in MAT finance and purchasing.

  • Work with the Head of Product and leadership to align your products’ direction with IMP’s broader platform strategy and commercial objectives.

  • Keep a clear view of the competitive landscape in finance and purchasing software, and of how your products can continue to stand out in the MAT sector.

2. Customer Discovery and Insight

  • Own discovery for your products: identify problem areas, validate hypotheses and define success metrics before any build commitment.

  • Run regular customer interviews, observation sessions and contextual research with MAT finance teams, business managers and budget holders.

  • Bring together insight from customer interviews, support data, usage analytics and NPS, and turn it into clear problem statements and opportunity assessments.

  • Build and test prototypes and lightweight MVPs before committing to build, and refine solutions with design based on real user feedback.

  • Champion the voice of the customer across the business so that product decisions rest on evidence rather than assumption.

3. Roadmap Ownership and Prioritisation

  • Own and communicate your product roadmap. Make prioritisation decisions that balance customer impact, business value and technical feasibility.

  • Define and monitor the product metrics that show whether your products deliver the outcomes customers and the business need, distinguishing leading from lagging indicators.

  • Work with engineering and design to turn roadmap priorities into well-scoped delivery cycles with clear acceptance criteria and measurable outcomes.

  • Work with other PMs and POs across the IMP product team on cross-product dependencies and shared planning, including where Finance and Purchasing connect to Planner and the wider platform.

4. Delivery Partnership

  • Work closely with your engineering squad and designers through the whole delivery cycle, from refining the problem to reviewing shipped features against defined outcomes.

  • Make sure your squad understands why they are building something, not just what and how, including the accounting and control requirements behind it.

  • Use AI tooling to improve the quality and speed of specifications, synthesis and product analysis.

  • Monitor product performance after launch and drive iterative improvements based on data and customer feedback.

5. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Go-to-Market

  • Work with Support, Implementation and Sales to bring customer feedback together and make sure product developments are well communicated and adopted.

  • Work with Customer Success and Marketing to shape go-to-market activity for significant Finance and Purchasing releases.

  • Represent your products’ customer perspective in cross-functional conversations and keep the business aligned on priorities and trade-offs.

Skills, Experience and Attributes

Essential:

  • Product management or product ownership experience on a finance, accounting, purchasing, procurement or spend-management software product. This is a must-have.

  • A strong working understanding of core finance and accounting processes, such as nominal and cost centre coding, the requisition-to-invoice cycle, payment runs, bank reconciliation, and approval and control workflows.

  • A track record in B2B SaaS product management or product ownership, typically 4+ years, though we care more about demonstrated capability than an exact year count.

  • Experience owning an established product and evolving it meaningfully in response to customer need and commercial opportunity.

  • Strong customer discovery skills: you have run interviews, drawn out insights and shaped product direction from evidence rather than assumption.

  • Experience defining and tracking product metrics to validate impact, including leading indicators that predict retention and adoption.

  • Strong prioritisation judgement: you can make difficult trade-off decisions and defend them clearly.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management, including the ability to push back with data and offer alternatives rather than just saying no.

  • Comfortable working autonomously in a remote environment and driving work forward without close supervision.

  • Experience with product management tools such as , Jira or Azure DevOps.

  • An active user of AI tooling for product management work, and curious about how to apply it further.

  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Desirable:

  • Hands-on finance experience, for example in a finance team, alongside your product experience.

  • Knowledge of MAT budgeting, curriculum financial planning or school funding workflows.

  • An understanding of MAT structures, the UK education landscape or school finance governance.

  • Experience in EdTech, school MIS or education finance systems.

  • Experience in sectors where the buyer and the daily user are different people.

  • Formal product discovery training (Continuous Discovery Habits, Prod MBA, Product School or equivalent).

  • Experience using Claude for specifications, analysis and customer insight synthesis, or Lovable for rapid prototyping.

Benefits

  • 27 days’ holiday per year plus bank holidays, with the option to buy up to 5 additional days

  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave

  • AXA Health insurance, including dental, optical and mental health

  • Broadband allowance

  • Home office stipend

  • Life assurance (4 x basic salary)

  • Encouraged and funded CPD

The IT Analyst — Data Analytics & Data Science is responsible for analyzing complex business and technology data to provide actionable insights, support data-driven decision-making, and improve IT and business performance. This position works with business stakeholders, data scientists, data engineers, IT teams, and management to collect, prepare, analyze, visualize, and interpret data.

The role supports data analytics, predictive analysis, reporting, data quality, and technology initiatives while helping the organization identify trends, improve processes, manage risks, and make informed business decisions.

  • Collect, integrate, clean, and analyze data from multiple business and IT systems.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. The Senior Product Manager – Agents and Intelligence, will be responsible for shaping and leading the development of agent-driven workflows at Agiloft, capturing data insights across our platforms, and leveraging those insights to deliver business value to our customers. jobs.excerpt: Envitia is a UK-based software and services company that helps organisations unlock the full value of their data to make better, faster decisions.
jobs.description:
Envitia is a UK-based software and services company that helps organisations unlock the full value of their data to make better, faster decisions. With over 30 years of experience, we specialise in delivering innovative software products, solutions, and consultancy services that transform complex data challenges into actionable insights.

Our mission is to empower customers across defence, government, and national security sectors to harness the power of data — from geospatial intelligence to advanced analytics and AI integration. We are proud to be a trusted partner to UK defence and government organisations, delivering technology that drives smarter, data-driven outcomes.

We’re also delighted to have been named one of The Sunday Times Top 100 Medium-Sized Companies — a recognition of our commitment to innovation, collaboration, and creating an outstanding workplace where people can thrive.

The Role

At Envitia, we help Defence organisations unlock the value of their data to enable better decision-making, faster operational outcomes and greater mission success. We're looking for a Defence Solution Architect who can bridge the gap between operational need and technical delivery, translating complex mission challenges into secure, interoperable and scalable solutions.

This is a high-impact role within our Consulting division, where you'll work closely with Defence stakeholders, mission experts, engineering teams and delivery partners to design and integrate capabilities that enable effective data discovery, transformation and exchange across complex environments. You'll be responsible for creating solution architectures that not only define systems, but demonstrate how data moves, transforms and delivers operational value.

From shaping mission-led architectures and developing data models to defining integration patterns and ensuring alignment with Defence standards, security requirements and enterprise architecture principles, you'll play a key role throughout the solution lifecycle. You'll contribute to technical assurance, capability development and the successful delivery of innovative Defence solutions from concept through to implementation.

If you're passionate about solving complex Defence challenges, enabling data-driven operations and shaping the future of interoperable military capabilities, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Design and assure end-to-end solution architectures that support experimentation, integration, and Defence data interoperability.
  • Translate operational mission threads, user requirements and experimentation objectives into scalable, secure and deliverable technical solutions.
  • Produce and maintain architectural artefacts, including solution views, data flow diagrams, interface specifications, data models, integration views and decision records.
  • Define integration approaches that enable data discovery, transformation, exchange and exploitation across heterogeneous Defence systems.
  • Work collaboratively with mission engineering, software development, data engineering, experimentation and operational analysis teams to ensure architectural coherence from concept through implementation.
  • Support the definition and assurance of Information Exchange Requirements, interface contracts, non-functional requirements and security constraints.
  • Identify technical risks, interoperability challenges, architectural trade-offs and delivery dependencies, providing clear recommendations to Defence and delivery stakeholders.
  • Support experimentation planning, execution and technical reviews, ensuring lessons learned are captured and fed into future capability development.
  • Ensure solutions align with security, information assurance, Defence standards and enterprise architecture principles.
  • Provide technical leadership in solution reviews and Technical Design Authority forums.
  • Contribute reusable architecture patterns, methods and learning from customer work into Envitia’s wider architecture capability.
  • Ensure solution and data architectures are subject to robust cost and effort estimation, covering design, development, transition, operation, maintenance and exit costs.

Experience Required

  • Experience working within Defence, national security, mission engineering, operational analysis or experimentation environments.
  • Understanding of Defence interoperability, mission data and information exchange, including how data, systems and users connect across complex multi-domain operations.
  • Experience designing secure, scalable and interoperable solution architectures that enable data discovery, integration, transformation and exchange across heterogeneous environments.
  • Ability to develop and interpret mission threads, operational workflows, information exchange requirements and data models that support operational decision-making.
  • Knowledge of solution and enterprise architecture frameworks and modelling approaches such as TOGAF, ArchiMate or similar.
  • Experience translating business, operational, security and technical requirements into coherent end-to-end solution designs.
  • Familiarity with modern technology ecosystems, including cloud platforms (Azure and AWS), APIs, containerisation, Kubernetes, event-driven architectures and COTS integrations.
  • Experience producing architecture artefacts, integration views, data flow models and assurance documentation for complex programmes.
  • Understanding of MOD and Defence standards relating to interoperability, information sharing and secure architecture.
  • Ability to communicate architecture decisions and technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience presenting solution designs to Technical Design Authorities, Design Review Boards or equivalent governance forums.

Security Clearance Requirements

Due to the nature of our work, the successful candidate must be eligible to obtain and maintain SC security clearance.

Location

This role offers flexible and remote working, with travel to our Horsham office approximately two days per month and occasional travel to customer sites across the UK as required.

What it's like to work at Envitia

At Envitia, we believe that our greatest asset is our people. We’re committed to fostering a work environment where every employee feels valued, supported, and motivated to excel. Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to enhance both your professional and personal wellbeing, including:

  • Annual Leave: 25 days plus your birthday off, with the ability to buy or sell up to five additional days
  • Private Healthcare: Comprehensive coverage with additional options for family members
  • Training & Skills Development: Ongoing learning opportunities to help you advance your career
  • Fitness Reimbursement: Support for gym memberships or fitness-related expenses

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Picture Yourself at Parexel:


The Principal Database Programmer – eCOA (eCOA Study Designer) provides technical expertise for the design, configuration, testing, deployment and maintenance of electronic Clinical Outcome Assessment (eCOA) solutions used in clinical trials. The role translates protocol, assessment and operational requirements into compliant participant, caregiver and clinician facing questionnaires, schedules and workflows within approved eCOA technologies. The eCOA Study Designer works independently across multiple projects, collaborates with sponsors and cross-functional study teams, and supports integration of eCOA configurations with Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems.

Design, Set Up, Maintain, Revise and Close Out eCOA Studies:


  • Interpret protocols, schedules of assessments, eCOA specifications and licensed instrument requirements to design appropriate electronic data collection workflows.

  • Apply established naming conventions and build standards, including clear identification of eCOA-specific forms, fields and code lists.
  • Coordinate the initial eCOA configuration and controlled push to EDC; maintain alignment among the eCOA configuration, EDC draft and applicable CRF versions.
  • Assess and implement approved protocol amendments, production revisions, translations and study maintenance changes while protecting data integrity and traceability.

  • Prepare system demonstrations, test evidence, questionnaire screenshots and other materials required for internal review and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Support pre-UAT meetings, UAT execution, defect triage and resolution; ensure issues are documented in the approved study issue-tracking process.
  • Coordinate deployment readiness and communicate completion of technical quality control and UAT prerequisites to applicable stakeholders.
  • Support post-production troubleshooting and controlled implementation of approved corrections.

Project and Stakeholder Support:


  • Collaborate with Clinical Database Programming, Data Management, eCOA Clinical Data Analysis, COA Science, Clinical Operations, and other study functions to finalize eCOA requirements and resolve design issues.

  • Provide input to study timelines, monitor assigned work and communicate changes in scope, assumptions or resourcing needs.
  • Provide technical advice to internal project teams and support multiple projects simultaneously.

Documentation and Compliance:


  • Create and maintain eCOA specifications, configuration records, implementation checklists, test evidence, screenshots, issue records, version documentation, and other required study artifacts.
  • Maintain study documentation in accordance with SOPs, Work Instructions, and guidelines to support traceability, inspection readiness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Document deviations, decisions, risks, and configuration limitations and communicate them to the appropriate project stakeholders.
  • Follow system life cycle, access control, change control, validation and records-management requirements.

Support Technologies, Standards and Continuous Improvement:


  • Provide technical solutions to internal and external client inquiries relating to eCOA study design and its interaction with EDC and other clinical systems.
  • Participate in the development and maintenance of standards, reusable libraries, templates, checklists, tools and processes that improve eCOA delivery quality and efficiency.

jobs.excerpt: About High ScaleWe’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media.
jobs.description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need an Audiovisual Producer (Realizador Audiovisual) who is a master of the entire post-production spectrum, blending storytelling, rhythm, and sound into a cohesive masterpiece.

Why This Role Matters

Holistic storytelling, sensory impact, and creative autonomy are your playground. In this role, you aren't just an "editor"—you are a creator. You will take ownership of the entire audiovisual experience, from the narrative cut to the sound design, color grade, and motion graphics.

This role is designed for the "Preditor" (Producer/Editor)—the multifaceted talent common in the LATAM market who can take a folder of raw assets and turn it into a broadcast-ready commercial without needing to pass it to three other departments. If you thrive on owning the final product and crafting the full sensory experience, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Execute End-to-End Post-Production

    • Take ownership of video projects from ingest to final export. You will be responsible for the edit, the sound mix, the color balance, and the motion graphics.

    • Transform raw studio footage and UGC into dynamic, high-performance ads for Social Media (TikTok/Reels) and Connected TV.

  2. Master Audio & Sound Design

    • Go beyond simple music sync. Use sound effects (SFX), foley, and dynamic audio mixing to drive the pacing and emotion of the edit.

    • Select and edit music tracks to create the perfect "vibe" that aligns with the brand's identity.

  3. Implement Visual Polish (Motion & Color)

    • Apply polished motion graphics (kinetic text, logo builds) to reinforce the message.

    • Perform creative color grading to ensure the video looks premium and consistent with the brand's aesthetic.

  4. Creative Conceptualization

    • Work with the creative team to propose visual solutions. You don't just follow a script; you propose cuts, transitions, and effects that elevate the concept.

    • Adapt and iterate on successful concepts to create new "winning" variations.

Who You Are

  1. A True "Realizador Audiovisual"

    • 3–6 years of experience in a generalist post-production role (agency, production house, or freelance).

    • You are comfortable wearing multiple hats: Editor, Sound Designer, Colorist, and Motion Designer.

  2. Technical Generalist

    • Mastery of Adobe Premiere Pro is non-negotiable.

    • Strong proficiency in After Effects (for graphics), Audition (for sound), and DaVinci/Lumetri (for color).

    • You understand codecs, bitrates, and export settings for every platform.

  3. A Rhythm Master

    • Your edits have a heartbeat. You understand how to cut to music and how to use pacing to keep a viewer engaged for the full 30 seconds.

  4. Detail-Oriented & Organized

    • You manage your own projects and timelines effectively.

    • You are meticulous about Quality Control (QC)—no flash frames, no audio peaks, no typos.

  5. Bilingual Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency (C1/C2) is required. You will be collaborating with US-based producers and must be able to articulate creative choices clearly in English.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the creative direction of global brands and lead complex audiovisual projects.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one stunning frame at a time.

Teknisk kompetanse

  • Minimum 3–4 års erfaring med Java og/eller Kotlin, inkludert moderne rammeverk (f.eks. Spring Boot).

  • Erfaring med utvikling av robuste backend-løsninger og integrasjoner (REST-baserte API-er).

  • Frontend-erfaring med JavaScript/TypeScript og React.

  • Interesse for og erfaring med bruk av AI-assistenter og moderne AI-verktøy i det daglige utviklingsarbeidet.

Erfaring og arbeidsform

  • God forretningsforståelse og evne til å finne gode tekniske løsninger på kundens behov.

  • Erfaring fra konsulentrolle er en fordel.

  • Erfaring fra samarbeid i tverrfaglige team.

Personlige egenskaper

  • Jobber strukturert og har høy bevissthet rundt kvalitet i leveranser.

  • Bidrar aktivt til faglig utvikling gjennom deling, sparring eller fagfora.

  • Holder deg oppdatert på ny teknologi og tar initiativ til å ta den i bruk der det gir verdi.

Formelle krav

  • Relevant høyere utdanning på universitets- eller høyskolenivå.

  • Må kunne kommunisere flytende på norsk med kunden, både muntlig og skriftlig.

Hva tilbyr vi?

  • Attraktive betingelser, gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, samt gode utviklingsmuligheter.

  • Spennende og samfunnsnyttige prosjekter hos ledende kunder.

About Nutrisense

We are a HealthTech startup with a mission to help anyone discover and reach their health potential. The Nutrisense mobile app leverages continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) with access to virtual support from best-in-class dietitians so that everyone, not just individuals with diabetes, can learn about their unique food responses, understand their metabolism, and reach health goals that lead to an optimized life. Our customers range from the ultra-healthy trying to take their lives to new levels to individuals with diabetes and multiple health conditions. Our platform focuses on bringing individualized, real-time data about your metabolic health to the palm of your hand.

Role Description

As a Nutrisense dietitian, you will directly engage with our customers, addressing diverse needs like diabetes management, weight loss, PCOS, performance training, and digestive issues through personalized insurance-based video consultations. Your day includes 60-minute initial consults and 60 & 30-minute follow-up calls, offering comprehensive support to our customers. Our dietitians have flexibility in booking consults based on your preference and availability.

Our platform focuses on bringing customized solutions for health concerns in the palm of your hands. You will also use your creativity and expertise to help build and develop a rapidly growing start-up. Our dietitians do not follow the status quo and recommend outdated advice such as MyPlate, but instead, stay up-to-date on the latest research for health optimization.

Who you are:

  • Passionate educator: You are a natural teacher and educator, and excel in explaining complex concepts in a language thats appropriate to the member.
  • Truth-seeker: You think independently. You love battle-testing ideas and listening to feedback. You're honest with yourself and willingly update your beliefs when you encounter new information.
  • Excellent communicator: You communicate openly, directly, and efficiently. You first work to understand by taking the time to listen and ask questions. You speak your opinions and offer constructive feedback. You're not afraid of difficult conversations.
  • Creative problem-solver: You come up with innovative ideas to solve complex problems. When faced with obstacles, you are resourceful. You work quickly, learn, and iterate. You prefer progress to perfection and prioritize action over analysis.
  • Adaptive contributor: You are flexible and expect changes to happen quickly and often. You participate in and contribute to changes and effectively provide feedback for the collective good.
  • Compassionate supporter: You are empathetic and provide the support that your members need, from tough love to educator to cheerleader. You go above and beyond to ensure they have an excellent experience.

Required qualifications:

  • Registered Dietitian Nutritionist (RDN) or CNS with a minimum of 1 year of relevant work experience﻿
    • If CNS, must maintain at least one active state license
  • Required minimum of at least 10 hours/week of availability, with flexibility for unlimited hours based on individual preference
  • Ability to work on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays
  • Previous work experience with Telehealth is preferred
  • Previous work experience in functional nutrition is preferred

Total Compensation Package For This Role Includes:

  • How our compensation works:
    • You will be paid $40 per hour (billed in 15-minute increments for each video call session). This session rate compensation is a high hourly rate in order to compensate for any administrative time spent outside of a session as well. This flat rate per billable unit can look like this:
      • 55-minute sessions: compensation of $40
      • 30-minute sessions: compensation $20
    • You will also be paid $25/hour for any required meetings outside of patient video session work.
    • You will be paid an initial flat fee to compensate for onboarding and training time.
  • 100% Remote environment - No strings attached. We encourage our employees to travel and experience life as they see fit.
  • Flexible schedule
  • Nutrisense discounts

REQUIRED NEXT STEPS:

Please complete the mandatory questionnaire here and follow the instructions to complete the application.

Applications without completing the questionnaire will not be reviewed.

*If you are a Registered Dietitian Nutritionist with experience and are interested in joining a mission-driven startup that is disrupting the health industry and cares about creating a dynamic environment for its employees, apply today!

Nutrisense has an organization-wide commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a work environment where everyone has a sense of belonging. Individuals from historically underrepresented or underserved communities are strongly encouraged to apply.*

Hear from our team directly why you should join us!

SHIFT:

Day (United States of America)

Seeking Breakthrough Makers

Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.

At CHOP, your experience is valued; your voice is heard; and your contributions make a difference for patients and families. Join us as we build on our promise to advance pediatric care—and your career.



CHOP does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, or any other legally protected categories in any employment, training, or vendor decisions or programs. CHOP recognizes the critical importance of a workforce rich in varied backgrounds and experiences and engages in ongoing efforts to achieve that through equally varied and non-discriminatory means.


A Brief Overview

The Coding and Clinical Documentation Integrity Department at CHOP, which provides centralized coding support for all CHOP facilities, is seeking an experienced Medical Coder to join their team. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience in both inpatient and outpatient facility coding and must hold one of the following active certifications: RHIA, RHIT, or CCS.

This position is responsible for assigning ICD-10-CM/PCS and/or CPT codes to charts of all discharged patients. The Coding Technician is accountable for ensuring accurate, appropriate, and high-quality coded data across the organization.

Productivity expectations include:

Inpatient coding: 2.5 charts per hour

Outpatient/same-day surgeries: 6 charts per hour

A minimum accuracy rate of 95% must be maintained

This is a Monday through Friday, 8-hour day shift role, with flexibility to start as early as 5:00 AM EST after the introductory period.

The position is fully remote and available to candidates residing in eligible U.S. states. Unfortunately, we are unable to support workers located in: Washington, Wyoming, North Dakota, California (for hourly positions),U.S. Territories, Outside the United States

This is a great opportunity to contribute to a team dedicated to excellence in coding and clinical documentation integrity, all while working remotely.

What you will do

  • Reviews and analyzes medical records to determine the principal diagnosis, and procedure and all appropriate secondary diagnoses for inpatient and outpatient charts.
  • Correctly identifies all diagnoses and procedures 95% of the time.
  • Correctly assigns ICD-10-CM/PCS and/or CPT codes to all procedures and diagnoses 95% of the time.
  • Codes all charts within three days of availability with 98% of the time.
  • Maintain productivity standards accordingly.
  • Creates appropriate physician queries and participates actively in the physician query program.
  • 98% of the time the queries are identified and appropriate
  • Informs supervisor of trends and opportunities for improvement in clinical documentation.
  • Maintain thorough knowledge of coding, including and knowledge of CHOP’s internal coding guidelines.
  • Reviews the official AHA Coding Clinic and demonstrates the ability to accurately apply new coding guidelines.
  • Researches new diagnostic and procedure codes as required to perform the coding function. Participates in the education of staff, physicians and appropriate divisions, as warranted.
  • Maintains reference library.
  • Assures compliance with the national Correct Coding Initiatives.
  • Correctly identifies missing components of charts 95% of the time and sends workflow notice to colleagues for retrieval of missing documentation.
  • Abstract the pertinent clinical, coded, demographic and other required information into the EPIC electronic medical record abstracting system with 95% accuracy.
  • Identifies trends/opportunities for improvement in clinical documentation and communicates through the appropriate channels.
  • Utilize the Epic EHR and HDM/3M coding system to indicate accounts pending coding and the specific reasons.
  • Work collaboratively with other coders to resolve challenging cases/coding scenarios.

Education Qualifications

  • Associate's Degree Required
  • Bachelor's Degree Preferred

Experience Qualifications

  • At least two (2) years acute care inpatient and outpatient coding experience Required

Skills and Abilities

  • Epic, HDM/3M Encoder, Microsoft Applications

Licenses and Certifications

  • Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) - American Health Information Management Association - upon hire - Required or
  • Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) - American Health Information Management Association - upon hire - Required or
  • Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) - American Health Information Management Association - upon hire - Required

To carry out its mission, CHOP is committed to supporting the health of our patients, families, workforce, and global community. As a condition of employment, CHOP employees who work in patient care buildings or who have patient facing responsibilities must receive an annual influenza vaccine. Learn more.

$37.99 - $42.73 Hourly

jobs.excerpt: About Positron AIPositron AI is building next-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low-latency, high-throughput large language model inference.
jobs.description:
About Positron AI

Positron AI is building next-generation AI inference accelerators designed from the ground up for low-latency, high-throughput large language model inference. Chips built for the training era keep running into two walls at inference time: memory bandwidth and chip-to-chip networking. We designed our architecture to break through both. Our first-generation Atlas systems are deploying in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Asimov, our first custom ASIC, takes that architecture to silicon. In simulations, Asimov delivers several times more tokens per dollar and tokens per watt than leading GPUs, at a fraction of the power. Paired in our Titan system, Asimov is built to serve models beyond 16 trillion parameters. In September 2026, we raised $875 million at a $5 billion valuation. NEA led the round, joined by Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and others, to bring Asimov and Titan to market. Our team includes engineers from Groq, Lambda, NVIDIA, Meta, F5, and many other industry leaders.

Role Overview

We're looking for an exceptional Principal ASIC Architect to help define the future of AI inference hardware. You will collaborate across architecture, software, machine learning, systems, and silicon implementation to design next-generation AI accelerators capable of serving rapidly evolving frontier models. This role requires exceptional technical breadth, balancing mathematical understanding, ML trends, systems architecture, and practical silicon implementation. This may be the single most important technical hire after the Chief Architect.

Key Responsibilities

Architectural Exploration

  • Own architectural exploration across the evolving landscape of transformer models, MoE, sparse models, and long-context inference.
  • Evaluate emerging techniques including speculative decoding, continuous batching, KV-cache evolution, sub-quadratic and linear attention, and state-space models.
  • Assess memory architectures, communication architectures, and interconnects for next-generation accelerators.

Performance Modeling

  • Develop analytical models and build simulation frameworks to evaluate architectural tradeoffs.
  • Estimate latency, throughput, bandwidth, memory and compute utilization, scaling efficiency, power, area, and cost.

Hardware/Software Co-Design

  • Partner closely with compiler, runtime, system software, firmware, ASIC engineering, and ML research teams to align hardware direction with real workload needs.

ASIC Specification & Roadmap

  • Develop architecture documents and define subsystem interfaces.
  • Evaluate tradeoffs across competing architectural directions and guide the future product roadmap.

Industry Awareness

  • Track new LLMs, reasoning models, research papers, hardware competitors, academic research, and emerging algorithms to keep Positron's architecture ahead of the field.

AI-Enabled Engineering

  • Use AI to accelerate research, performance analysis, architecture exploration, simulation generation, and documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in ASIC architecture.
  • Deep expertise in AI accelerator design and high-performance SoCs.
  • Hands-on experience building performance models for memory systems and interconnects.
  • Strong hardware/software co-design ability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GPU architecture.
  • A solid grasp of ML systems, distributed inference, and large-scale serving.
  • Deep knowledge of transformer internals.
  • Compiler experience.
  • A track record of research publications.

Leveling & Scope

While this role is currently posted at a specific level, we are a growth-oriented organization and are open to hiring at a more senior level for the right candidate. Please note that this job description serves as a focused but generalized overview of the role; specific responsibilities and impact expectations will be tailored to the experience and seniority of the final hire.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role looks like helping define future Positron architectures and creating a scalable architectural direction that bridges software and hardware, influencing products that remain competitive for years despite rapidly evolving AI models.

Why Join Us?

  • Shape the core architecture of Positron's AI inference accelerators at a foundational level, with outsized influence over the company's technical direction for years to come.
  • Work at the intersection of frontier AI research and silicon implementation, tackling problems few architects in the industry get to own end to end.

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is $300,000 – $350,000.

Please note that the figures provided represent the base salary range only and do not include other elements of our total compensation package, equity, or comprehensive benefits.

At Positron AI, we value the unique expertise each candidate brings. While the range above reflects our typical expectation for the position, we reserve the flexibility to exceed this range for candidates whose specialized skills, significant experience, or unique qualifications fall outside the standard scope of the role. Final offers are determined based on a variety of factors, including internal equity, and individual impact.

Benefits & Perks

We want you to do your best work and feel confident that you and your family are taken care of. That means comprehensive coverage, real time to rest, and support for your future.

Health and wellness

  • Fully company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents
  • Company-paid life and disability coverage, with voluntary options to add more
  • Supplemental hospital, critical illness, and accident coverage available

Time off and flexibility

  • Unlimited paid time off, so you can truly unplug and recharge
  • 13 paid company holidays
  • Remote-first culture with a company-provided computer and home office setup

Compensation and future

  • Competitive salary and equity
  • 401(k) with company matching, eligible from day one

Visa Support

This position is open to candidates currently authorized to work in the U.S. We cannot provide new visa sponsorship for this role but are open to facilitating H-1B visa transfers for eligible candidates.

Equal Opportunity Employer. If you're excited about the role but don't meet every bullet, we'd still love to hear from you.

About Us
Our company is on a mission to reduce food waste and make high-quality, affordable food accessible to everyone. Through our innovative app-based marketplace, we connect shoppers with discounted perishable items while helping retailers turn would-be waste into revenue and meaningful environmental impact. We’re growing quickly across North America and partnering with retailers of all sizes to expand our reach.

If you’re passionate about creating real change for people and the planet, we’d love for you to join us. Your work here will directly contribute to a mission that helps families save money, reduces waste, and builds a more sustainable future.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a Director of Communications tohelp shape the brand of Flashfood in the world, by telling stories about our business, our technology, our environmental impact and the shoppers and retail partners who love us.

The goal of our Communications function is to raise awareness, drive adoption (for both shoppers and retailers), build trust and loyalty, and increase brand love and affinity.

This dynamic leader will be highly strategic in their approach, inherently collaborative with other internal teams, and deeply curious about all the aspects of the business, our industry and the key stakeholders who are most important to its success. This person is a proactive, forward-thinking professional who can see around corners, and knows how to position the brand in the right way, at the right time, with the right people.

This role is ideal for someone who:

  • Thrives in a constantly evolving environment (in a good way, we're growing fast!)
  • Thinks strategically across both sides of our marketplace, shopper and retailer, and builds cohesive stories that inform, attract, and create lasting affinity for each
  • Communicates brilliantly, whether in writing, in a room, or through visuals
  • Takes ownership and drives ideas all the way through execution
  • Builds strong relationships inside and outside the company, and knows how to activate them for mutual benefit
  • Balances speed with quality, and short-term wins with long-term thinking
  • Is driven by solving real business problems with measurable impact

What You'll Do

  • Drive the external narrative and overall perception of Flashfood, using outside storytellers (press, creators/influencers, podcasts, etc.) and partners (NGOs, etc.) as your canvas
  • Lead Media Relations, Creator Relations, Government Affairs/NGO Outreach, Industry Relations, Internal Comms, and Social Impact for Flashfood
  • Partner with Marketing to produce campaigns that showcase the brand's impact, and turn our announcements and activity into storytelling opportunities
  • Partner with teams across the company (e.g. Product) to mine for storytelling opportunities that drive the business forward
  • Create and execute an executive visibility strategy, platforming our key execs in press, industry events, and beyond
  • Develop an ongoing slate of consumer PR stories that keep Flashfood topical among our KOLs, and broaden the range of media that covers us
  • Build a cohesive Creator Relations strategy, partnering with third-party creators and influencers to tell brand stories that bring in new audiences and retain current ones
  • Build and nurture relationships with press — both traditional media (print, broadcast, .com) and "new media" (podcasts, Substacks, etc.) — to land stories that advance the brand
  • Lead our relationships with relevant government entities and NGOs, partnering with them to elevate the Flashfood brand and the impact we're having on food waste reduction
  • Partner with People on our internal comms strategy and approach
  • Lead the assembly and dissemination of the annual Impact Report
  • Partner with our PR agency, briefing and guiding them with efficiency and impact

What You'll Bring

  • A deep expertise shaping corporate narratives for high-growth companies, ideally within consumer, tech, or marketplace driven industries
  • At least 8 years experience in a cross section of the following categories: Media Relations, Executive Visibility, Creator Relations, Government Affairs, Internal Comms and Social Impact
  • Strong earned media experience, with an impressive track record of landing stories in a variety of media outlets
  • Extensive experience working across earned media, influencer, editorial, and event-driven communications
  • Strong judgment when it comes to decision making around high-stakes external activity
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguity
  • Proven ability to execute and deliver results in a fast-paced environment
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills
  • A high level of ownership and accountability
  • Comfort working cross-functionally and balancing competing priorities
  • Data-driven mindset, with the ability to define success, measure performance, and adjust based on impact

Nice to Have

  • Experience in product communications
  • Experience working across both the US and Canadian markets
  • Experience working with or for a two-sided marketplace
  • Experience leveraging AI tools and strategies to boost performance

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits
  • 100% remote work with flexibility and trust
  • Mission-driven work that reduces food waste and expands access to affordable food
  • A fast-growing, collaborative team with big ambitions
  • Real opportunities for career growth

Flashfood is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we’re dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels supported and empowered to do their best work.

Lantheus (NASDAQ: LNTH) is the leading radiopharmaceutical-focused company, delivering life-changing science to enable clinicians to Find, Fight and Follow disease to deliver better patient outcomes. Headquartered in Massachusetts with offices in New Jersey, Canada, Germany, Sweden, Switzerland and United Kingdom, Lantheus has been providing radiopharmaceutical solutions for nearly 70 years.

Today, we’re expanding our portfolio and pipeline across oncology, neurology and cardiology. Through recent acquisitions, along with strategic partnerships across the life sciences ecosystem, we are accelerating our efforts to advance precision medicine and improve patient outcomes around the world.

At Lantheus we are purpose-driven, and every employee plays a vital role in our success. We’re dedicated to cultivating a high-growth, forward-thinking culture where innovation thrives and diverse perspectives drive meaningful progress.

Join us and be part of a company where your contributions make a real impact, because we know someone’s health is in our hands.

Summary of role

Develop and execute a territory business plan which aligns with the overall DEFINITY® Marketing and Sales strategy to maximize effectiveness and produce sales results.

This is a remote position open to applicants authorized to work for any employer within the United States.

Requirements of the Role

  • Demonstrate the ability to uncover customer needs and apply appropriate marketing resources to satisfy those needs, overcome objections, gain agreement, and advance the sales process.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with all key stakeholders across multiple settings (e.g., sonographers, medical directors, technical directors, pharmacy directors, purchasing directors, etc.)
  • Maintain strong clinical, competitive and marketplace knowledge and apply relevant information in selling situations.
  • Communicate clearly the economic impact of LMI products to financial stakeholders within local and regional health systems, provide reimbursement support and, as appropriate, manage local contracting.
  • Provide echo contrast education to cardiology fellowship programs and cardiac ultrasound schools.
  • Collaborate with integrated teams (e.g., Marketing, Medical Affairs, Sales Management) and with external support resources to prioritize business challenges and propose solutions which ultimately benefit our customers and the patients they serve.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives for the purpose of developing innovative marketing resources, training materials, sales tactics and/or sales analytics applications.
  • Attend and actively participate in sales meetings, conference/video calls and training sessions.
  • Actively demonstrate the Lantheus values of accountability, quality, customer service, efficiency, collaboration, and safety
  • Ensure a compliant, principled culture to promote Lantheus Holdings products and adhere to the highest ethical standards.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum requirements include BA or BS in an accredited 4-year college or university.
  • Minimum of 5+ years of demonstrated successful sales experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, or equivalent industries.
  • Proficient in using computer software applications and video conferencing platforms, to include MS Office and CRM
  • Strong oral and written communications skills, with ability to present clinical information in a compelling and persuasive manner.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify problems, develop effective strategies, and quickly implement solutions.

Requirements:

Preferred

  • "Hospital sales"
  • Proven history of successful cardiovascular sales and/or clinical cardiology experience
  • Retains a current network of contacts in local healthcare organizations.

Other Qualifications:

Field based role requiring overnight travel based on business need (including in-person customer interactions, displays, industry meetings, and mandatory in-person training), recurrent weekend or evening work may be required.

  • The candidate is required to reside within assigned territory Sacramento or San Jose area
  • Must meet “call metrics” (which may cover both in-person and virtual client engagement) and other requirements established for territory from time to time.
  • Must have valid driver’s license, qualified vehicle, and appropriate motor vehicle insurance.
  • Must acquire and maintain facility credentialing for access to medical facilities within assigned territory (including annual flu shot and all other vaccines required by medical facilities within assigned territory).

Core Values

The ideal candidate will embody Lantheus core values:

  • Let people be their best
  • Respect one another and act as one
  • Learn, adapt, and win
  • Know someone’s health is in our hands
  • Own the solution and make it happen

The pay range for this position is between $112,000 and $169,000 annually.

Actual base pay offered may vary depending on a number of factors such as job-related knowledge, skills and experience. Employees in this position are eligible for a discretionary performance-based cash incentive. Benefits for this position include a comprehensive health benefits package that includes medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage. Other offerings include life and disability benefits, pre-tax accounts, a 401(k) with company contribution, and a variety of other benefits. In addition, employees are eligible for a generous time off package including paid vacation, holidays, sick days, and paid parental leave. Interested candidates can apply at Lantheus.com. Applications for this position will be accepted until October 23, 2026.
