jobs.title: Senior Director, R&D Venture Delivery
jobs.excerpt: When you’re the best, we’re the best.  We instill an environment where employees feel engaged, satisfied and able to contribute their unique skills and talents while living and working as their authentic selves.
jobs.description:
When you’re the best, we’re the best. We instill an environment where employees feel engaged, satisfied and able to contribute their unique skills and talents while living and working as their authentic selves. We provide extensive opportunities for personal and professional development, building both employee competence and organizational capability to fuel exceptional performance through an inclusive environment both now and in the future.

Vizient R&D is building new ventures that help healthcare organizations solve complex, high-impact problems. These ventures often begin with ambiguity: emerging client needs, early ideas, evolving business models, and cross-functional teams working quickly to determine what should exist and how to bring it to market responsibly.

We’re looking for a builder-minded product and execution leader to help turn that ambiguity into progress.

In this role, you’ll partner with venture leadership to move ideas from concept to validated product direction to early build execution. You’ll bring strong judgment, design awareness, client orientation, and operating discipline. You’ll also play a key role in structuring and driving client-facing workstreams, ensuring that client discovery, feedback, pilots, implementation planning, and executive touchpoints are tightly connected to venture strategy, product development, and our internal milestones.

This is a role for someone who can shape how early-stage ventures are discovered, designed, built, piloted, launched, and prepared to scale.

What you’ll do

  • Lead cross-functional execution across early-stage ventures, partnering with engineering, data science, commercial, legal, privacy, compliance, and operations teams.
  • Prepare and facilitate client working sessions, discovery conversations, pilot reviews, and executive touchpoints that build trust, alignment, and momentum.
  • Translate venture strategy, customer insight, and vision into clear priorities, roadmaps, operating plans, and measurable outcomes.
  • Clarify customer problems, pressure-test assumptions, define MVPs, shape discovery plans, and keep teams focused on user, customer, and business value.
  • Design and run lightweight venture operating systems, including planning rhythms, build reviews, milestone tracking, launch readiness, risk reviews, and executive reporting.
  • Create clarity in ambiguous environments by surfacing the right questions, structuring decisions, and helping teams move forward without unnecessary process.
  • Help teams adopt modern ways of working, including customer discovery, rapid learning loops, agile delivery, disciplined experimentation, prototyping, and continuous improvement.
  • Identify risks, dependencies, resourcing constraints, and unclear ownership early, then drive practical solutions.

You may be a good fit if you

  • Have 10 or more years of experience leading complex work in product-led, technology-enabled, consulting, innovation, or venture-building environments.
  • Have operated as a product operations leader, product strategy lead, chief of staff, strategic program leader, venture operator, business operations leader, or senior cross-functional execution lead.
  • Have led client-facing workstreams and can translate client input into product, pilot, and go-to-market decisions.
  • Bring strong fluency across discovery, strategy, design tradeoffs, prioritization, MVP definition, launch readiness, experimentation, and success metrics.
  • Can bring structure to ambiguity without creating bureaucracy, moving easily between strategy and detail.
  • Have executive presence, low ego, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without needing to own every decision.

Strong candidates may also have

  • Experience in healthcare, healthcare technology, data, analytics, AI, enterprise software, consulting, or other regulated environments.
  • Experience supporting zero-to-one or one-to-scale product development.
  • Experience introducing new tools, AI-enabled workflows, automation, prototyping methods, or knowledge management practices.
  • Experience partnering with commercial teams on market validation, customer feedback, launch planning, pricing, packaging, or go-to-market readiness.
  • A track record of improving how teams learn from customers, make product decisions, manage dependencies, communicate, and hold themselves accountable

Estimated Hiring Range:

At Vizient, we consider skills, experience, and organizational needs in our compensation approach. Geographic factors may adjust the range estimate and hires typically fall below the top range. Compensation decisions are tailored to individual circumstances. The current salary range for this role is $135,200.00 to $236,600.00.

This position is also incentive eligible.

Job Description:

GDIT has an opportunity for a DevOps Engineer to design, build, automate, and maintain cloud-native deployment and container orchestration capabilities on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). This role is responsible for expanding enterprise CI/CD automation using GitLab, enabling secure and scalable deployments, and supporting mission-focused application teams across the ICAM ecosystem.

This is a fully remote position.

Meaningful Work and Personal Impact:
The ideal candidate is a hands-on DevOps engineer with deep experience in AKS, GitLab pipeline automation, container orchestration, and cloud-native operational patterns. You will support engineering teams by providing secure, repeatable build-and-release automation while ensuring services are deployed reliably and monitored effectively. Your work directly improves deployment velocity, operational resilience, and modernization efforts in support of enterprise ICAM mission requirements.

  • Design, deploy, and manage Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) clusters, including node pools, workload identities, ingress controllers, and security configurations.

  • Develop, optimize, and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines for build automation, containerization, quality gates, security scanning, and production release workflows.

  • Build and maintain Helm charts, YAML manifests, templates, and reusable AKS deployment patterns.

  • Implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM) for provisioning and managing cluster and cloud resources.

  • Collaborate with application teams to containerize applications, troubleshoot deployments, and optimize runtime performance.

  • Implement and maintain observability tools (Azure Monitor, Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/EFK) for monitoring cluster health, logs, and metrics.

  • Ensure secure handling of secrets, certificates, and configuration values using Key Vault or equivalent tools.

  • Troubleshoot AKS workloads, GitLab CI/CD failures, pipeline performance, Kubernetes scaling issues, and service connectivity problems.

  • Document operational procedures, IaC patterns, deployment workflows, troubleshooting guides, and DevOps standards.

  • Support Zero Trust, compliance, and enterprise security requirements through hardened DevOps practices.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED (Required):

  • Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 5 years’ experience. An additional 4 years of experience may be substituted in lieu of degree.

  • Minimum of an active Secret security clearance.

  • Current DoW 8140 certification (Security+ CE or higher).

Technical Skills:

  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes operations, container lifecycle, networking, scaling, and security.

  • Expertise with GitLab (runners, pipeline configuration, security scanning, artifact management).

  • Proficient with Docker, Helm, YAML, and Kubernetes manifests.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Bicep.

  • Familiarity with monitoring and observability stacks (Azure Monitor, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK).

  • Ability to troubleshoot cluster issues, deployments, pods, services, and containerized workloads.

  • Excellent documentation and cross-team collaboration skills

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED (Desired):

  • Experience with Azure DevOps, ArgoCD, Flux, or other GitOps tools.

  • Experience integrating AKS with identity and access controls (AAD workload identities, managed identities).

  • Knowledge of service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd, Consul Connect).

  • Experience with container security scanning, SAST/DAST, and vulnerability management.

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust, enterprise cloud security, and compliance frameworks.

Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

How will you make an impact? 


Jabil is seeking a Software Test Development Engineer who will directly contribute to the validation test solutions in place for server hardware manufacturing facilities. You will play a vital role in ensuring the quality and reliability of hardware products in a large-scale production environment.


You will be responsible for contributing to the end-to-end architecture, definition, development and production deployment of production software applications and infrastructure spanning multiple customers and manufacturing regions.


You will also be responsible for interfacing with internal engineering, manufacturing and quality teams and our end customers to ensure your software deliverables meet the rigorous standards of Jabil’s world-class manufacturing environments.

with a schedule of 6:00 AM–6:00 PM or 8:00 AM–8:00 PM.

  • Experience working in a multi-site and multi-cultural environments

jobs.description:
CVEDIA · Remote, based in the US or Canada · Full-time

About CVEDIA

CVEDIA builds AI video analytics for physical security, smart cities and defense. We train our own models, and we make them run about ten times more efficiently than our competitors, which makes every deployment far more cost-effective. Our models already run in real products on server and edge hardware around the world, and we also ship them on our own appliances.

We have spent years earning the trust of this market by shipping technology that works, moving faster than the incumbents, and standing behind every deployment. That trust is what you will build on.

About the role

We need someone who already knows the North American security channel to turn that trust into growth in the US and Canada.

You will not start from zero. You will take over a healthy book of existing accounts in the region, grow it, and add new integrators, distributors and end users to it. You will report to our Chief Commercial Officer.

In your first months you will get to know our accounts, our partners and our products. Then you will build the pipeline and the channel that carry the region's revenue, and you will tell us what the market wants next.

If you have spent the last several years selling surveillance, access control or integration services, and the integrators, consultants and distributors you know pick up when you call, keep reading.

What you will do

  • Take over our existing accounts in the US and Canada, and grow the revenue each of them brings.
  • Build and close a pipeline of integrators, distributors and enterprise end users across security, retail, transportation and critical infrastructure.
  • Recruit channel partners and equip them to sell CVEDIA when you are not in the room.
  • Own the revenue target for the region, and hit it.
  • Tell our product and engineering teams what the market is saying, including the parts we do not want to hear.

You may be a good fit if

  • You live in the US or Canada.

Job Title: Prior Authorization & Billing Specialist

Position type: Full-Time

Working Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Pacific Daylight Time , Monday - Friday
Salary rate: $5-$6

Key Responsibilities:

  • Handle, process, track, and follow up on prior authorization requests to ensure timely approvals and continuity of patient care.
  • Answer and triage incoming patient calls, gather relevant patient information, address general inquiries, and route concerns to the appropriate healthcare personnel.
  • Process prescription refill requests, coordinate with healthcare providers for approval, and monitor pending requests to ensure timely follow-up.
  • Manage end-to-end medical billing processes, including claims preparation, submission, routing, payment posting, claim status monitoring, and follow-ups on outstanding or denied claims.
  • Verify patient insurance eligibility, benefits, and coverage manually when insurance information or package selections in Athena EHR require correction.
  • Assist with overflow patient calls during high-volume periods while maintaining professional and empathetic communication.
  • Maintain accurate patient records, insurance information, authorization statuses, and billing documentation in the practice's EHR system.
  • Coordinate with healthcare providers, insurance representatives, pharmacies, and internal team members to resolve patient and administrative concerns.
  • Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance with HIPAA regulations when handling patient information.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of experience in medical virtual assistance, healthcare administration, medical billing, prior authorization, or a similar healthcare-related role.
  • Strong understanding of medical administrative workflows, with willingness to undergo training for practice-specific processes.
  • Experience handling patient calls, triage, intake, and patient coordination.
  • Knowledge of prescription refill workflows, insurance eligibility verification, and medical claims processes.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple responsibilities efficiently.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote healthcare environment while maintaining patient confidentiality.

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

The Strategic Enterprise Account Executive role is part of our Enterprise Sales teams specialized in Financial Services. This team is comprised of elite, forward-thinking sales leaders, industry experts, and strategic visionaries who partner with our most valuable, top-tier clients. Operating in a highly focused model, you will be in charge of a dedicated, select handful of enterprise accounts (or a singular, massive global account) to shape their overarching digital transformation and drive their evolution into an Agentic Enterprise—where autonomous AI agents and humans work together to drive unparalleled success.

We are looking for Strategic Account Executives to lead and orchestrate our highest-value enterprise relationships. In this role, you don't just sell software; you act as a trusted advisor to C-level decision-makers, defining multi-year strategic roadmaps and translating complex business challenges into high-value AI and cloud solutions. You will lead a massive virtual matrix team to deliver a unified vision, balancing short-term commercial execution with long-term partnership value.


What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Success will be measured by your ability to drive annual recurring revenue (ARR), expand our strategic footprint within your assigned accounts, maintain high customer satisfaction, and successfully orchestrate internal matrixed teams to execute a unified account strategy.

  • Drive the Account Vision: Partner closely with co-account executives and stakeholders to define, own, and execute a comprehensive, multi-year strategic roadmap for complex, top-tier accounts.
  • Engage the C-Suite: Act as a trusted advisor to C-level executives. Evangelize AI-powered solutions, platform ecosystems, and digital transformation through strategic, value-based selling and compelling Points of View (POVs).
  • Orchestrate the Matrix: Function as the "Strategic Quarterback" leading a large virtual team. Align Specialist AEs, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, Professional Services, and Global System Integrators (GSIs) to ensure a seamless, unified customer experience.

  • Maintain Operational Excellence: Navigate high-pressure environments, manage complex annual quota planning, deliver accurate forecasting, and consistently achieve revenue goals.
  • Financial Services Industry: Deep understanding of banking, capital markets, wealth management, or insurance. Experience dealing with strict compliance frameworks, fintech disruptions, data privacy, and core legacy-to-cloud modernization strategies.

Core Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 15+ years of experience in complex, multi-national enterprise SaaS sales, top-tier management consulting, or driving large-scale internal digital transformations within the specified vertical.
  • Executive Presence: Proven ability to convey leadership, direction, and confidence in every interaction, effortlessly adapting your communication style for top-down C-level discussions.
  • Matrix Leadership: Demonstrated success navigating and leading large, cross-functional virtual teams and external partners in a fast-paced environment without formal disciplinary authority.
  • Resilience & Execution: A consistent track record of navigating high-pressure commercial environments, managing complex enterprise deal cycles, and meeting or exceeding high-value revenue quotas.
  • Language Skills: Professional fluency in English and German (both written and spoken) to support our regional and global client bases.

Even Better If...

  • You bring a unique hybrid background (e.g., a mix of top-tier strategy consulting and direct Enterprise SaaS sales execution).
  • You possess deep technical or strategic familiarity with next-generation autonomous AI agents, Customer 360 ecosystems, or advanced CRM platforms.

Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Social Media Manager who can build, engage, and grow our brand presence across all digital channels.

Why This Role Matters

Brand perception, community engagement, and cultural relevance are your playground. As the Social Media Manager, you are the voice and pulse of High Scale's brand. You’ll be the bridge between our agency's groundbreaking work and the wider industry, translating our internal innovation into a compelling public narrative. You’ll manage our social channels, build an engaged community, and ensure our brand feels like a VIP in every digital interaction.

Your work will directly impact our brand authority, inbound leads, and our reputation as industry leaders. If you thrive on building communities and telling powerful brand stories, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Own Our Social Channels

    • Develop and execute a comprehensive social media strategy for High Scale's brand (LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, etc.).

    • Create, curate, and post engaging content daily that showcases our work, culture, and expertise.

    • Manage the content calendar, ensuring a consistent and high-quality brand presence.

  2. Build & Engage Our Community

    • Serve as the primary voice of the brand, actively responding to comments, DMs, and mentions.

    • Proactively engage with industry leaders, potential clients, and creative partners to build relationships.

    • Develop and implement strategies to grow our follower base and increase engagement rates.

  3. Coordinate Content Creation

    • Work closely with our internal creative, production, and marketing teams to source and repackage campaign highlights, case studies, and behind-the-scenes content.

    • Translate complex agency wins and data into simple, shareable, and impactful social posts.

  4. Represent the Brand & Analyze Trends

    • Act as an ambassador for High Scale, embodying our innovative and data-obsessed culture.

    • Provide insights on industry trends, platform changes, and competitor activity.

    • Track and report on key social media KPIs, using data to refine and optimize your strategy.

Who You Are

  1. A B2B & Creative Storyteller

    • 3–6 years of experience in social media management, preferably for a creative agency, media company, or tech brand.

    • Proven track record of growing and managing professional social media accounts, especially on LinkedIn and Instagram.

  2. Organized & Strategic

    • You can juggle multiple platforms, content formats, and priorities without breaking a sweat.

    • Skilled at building content calendars, managing assets, and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

  3. Excellent Communicator

    • Clear, confident, and persuasive in both written and verbal communication (English fluency required; Spanish is a major plus).

    • You have a sharp, witty, and professional writing style adaptable to different platforms.

  4. Collaborative & Adaptable

    • Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

    • Able to work with creative, production, and leadership teams to execute ambitious brand goals.

  5. Data-Driven

    • Track KPIs (engagement, reach, follower growth, leads) to inform decisions and strategy.

    • Comfortable using social media management and analytics tools to report on performance efficiently.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the growth of High Scale's brand and collaborate on top-tier campaigns for global brands.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one breakthrough campaign at a time.

jobs.description:
Greater Good Charities is a 501(c)(3) global nonprofit organization that works to help people, pets, and the planet by mobilizing in response to need and amplifying the good. To date, we have provided over $1B in aid, expertise, and funding in 121 countries in support of this mission.

Position Overview

The Corporate Partnerships Coordinator is a dynamic, dual-focus role that blends new business development with operational support for the Corporate Partnerships team. This position drives pipeline growth through proactive outreach, prospect research, and account management, while also ensuring the team runs efficiently through marketing materials development, CRM data integrity, and cross-departmental coordination. The role is critical to achieving Greater Good Charities' ambitious goals of $200M in in-kind and $5M in cash donations annually.

Key Responsibilities:

Pipeline Development & Corporate Outreach

  • Conduct comprehensive research on potential corporate partners to identify and qualify prospects based on partnership fit and capacity
  • Secure meetings with corporate Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to host Lunch and Learns showcasing GGC's impact and partnership opportunities
  • Schedule and coordinate exploratory and expansion meetings for senior team members
  • Prepare briefing materials and talking points for all donor and prospect meetings
  • Support proposal development, presentation materials, and revenue diversification initiatives to drive team achievement of annual goals

CRM Data Management & Analytics

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date donor, prospect, and partner information in HubSpot
  • Build, manage and execute ZoomInfo and Hubspot sequences to support corporate outreach and engagement
  • Generate reports on prospect pipeline, conversion metrics, and fundraising performance to support strategy and decision-making
  • Track all interactions, proposals, and partnership communications across development staff
  • Support data cleanup, segmentation, and database maintenance to ensure data integrity
  • Assist with annual strategic reviews by preparing comprehensive account summaries

Account Management Support

  • Manage a portfolio of 5-10 smaller corporate partnership accounts spanning assigned accounts and new business development
  • Support stewardship activities, partner communications, and relationship cultivation
  • Coordinate partnership fulfillment and logistics in collaboration with Operations
  • Assist with annual strategic reviews, account planning, and partner reporting
  • Coordinate donor recognition and appreciation activities

Customizing

Materials, Stewardship and Communications

  • Using existing templates, produce compelling one-pagers, fact sheets, pitch decks, and partnership summaries for corporate prospects and partners
  • Produce impact reports and stewardship materials using PowerPoint
  • Ensure brand consistency across all development communications and partner-facing materials
  • Produce professional presentations and collateral for donor meetings and partnership negotiations

Cross-Department Liaison & Coordination

  • Coordinate with Program teams to gather impact stories and outcome data for partner reporting and materials
  • Collaborate with Marketing on donor communications and campaign materials
  • Work with Finance on gift processing and reporting requirements
  • Support Operations with partnership fulfillment and logistics coordination

Administrative Operations

  • Prepare meeting agendas, take notes, and distribute action items
  • Maintain organized filing systems for donor records, partnership agreements, and development documents
  • Support budget tracking and expense management for development activities
  • Handle confidential partner and donor information with discretion and professionalism
  • Support special events and fundraising campaigns as needed

Performance Metrics

  • Contribute to overall department goal of $200M in-kind and $5M in cash
  • Prospect research: 25+ qualified prospects per month
  • Lead conversion rate: 15%+
  • Account retention rate: 90%+

Minimum Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
  • 2-4 years of experience in business development, corporate partnerships, nonprofit development, or a related coordinator role
  • Proficiency in HubSpot CRM and ZoomInfo
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage corporate partners at all levels
  • Excellent organizational and project management abilities with experience managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong research and analytical skills
  • Knowledge of corporate partnerships, cause marketing, and major gift processes
  • Commitment to the mission of Greater Good Charities

Working Environment: This position is fully remote. The employee is expected to work 40 hours/week from 9 am – 5 pm in their time zone Monday – Friday. Occasional evening or weekend work for events and urgent deadlines. Some travel may be required for donor meetings and partnership events.

Benefits include 13 paid national holidays, sick leave, paid vacation, parental leave, 401K, medical, dental, and vision benefits.

Salary: $53,000-$58,000

jobs.description:
We're looking for an InternalSales Representative to drive new business at Hire Overseas, a fast-moving offshore staffing and HR platform placing vetted global talent into U.S. companies. You will own the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting and inbound lead handling through discovery, proposal, and close, and you will be a direct contributor to the revenue that fuels the company's growth.

This is a small business. This is a lean operation. You will build your own pipeline, run your own process, and manage your own systems without a supporting cast. You will have a high degree of ownership and autonomy over how you build pipeline, run your process, and close deals. If you are a self-directed seller who takes full ownership of outcomes, moves fast, and thrives without needing structure handed to them, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Work directly with founders at a growing offshore staffing company with real traction, strong case studies, and a differentiated offering
  • High-ownership sales role with full autonomy over pipeline, process, and how you close

What You'll Work On

Outbound Prospecting and Pipeline Generation

  • Identify and research target accounts across U.S. companies that are strong candidates for offshore hiring
  • Conduct outbound outreach via phone, email, and LinkedIn to generate pipeline without relying on inbound alone
  • Build and maintain a healthy, organized pipeline of active prospects and follow up consistently without dropping threads
  • Test and iterate on messaging, targeting, and outreach approaches to improve conversion at every stage

Inbound Lead Handling

  • Respond to inbound inquiries quickly and qualify them accurately against the ideal customer profile
  • Move qualified inbound leads through the funnel efficiently and with a high sense of urgency
  • Ensure no inbound lead waits or falls through the cracks

Discovery, Proposal, and Closing

  • Run structured discovery conversations to understand prospect needs, pain points, timeline, and fit
  • Prepare and present tailored proposals that speak to the specific value Hire Overseas delivers for each client
  • Handle objections confidently and move deals to close with a consultative approach
  • Own the deal from first touch through signed agreement and handoff to customer success

CRM and Pipeline Management

  • Maintain accurate, current records of all outreach, conversations, and deal status in the CRM
  • Keep pipeline data clean and trustworthy so leadership has a real view of what is coming and when
  • Track and report on key sales metrics including activity, pipeline, and revenue contribution

What You Bring

  • Proven B2B sales experience with a track record of closing deals and generating revenue in a full-cycle or high-contribution sales role
  • Self-directed and high-ownership with the ability to build and manage your own pipeline independently
  • Strong spoken and written English communication skills with the confidence and presence to run sales conversations at a senior level
  • Comfortable operating with autonomy in a small business where processes are still being built and the answers are not always handed to you
  • Organized and disciplined with clean CRM habits and consistent follow-through on every open opportunity
  • Motivated by results and comfortable being measured against revenue targets

Nice to Have

  • Experience in staffing, recruiting, HR services, or B2B professional services
  • Background selling at a startup or founder-led company where you had to build as well as sell
  • Familiarity with offshore or global hiring and the business case for remote contractor models
  • Experience with outbound sales tools such as Apollo, Outreach, Salesloft, or similar platforms

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your B2B sales experience, and walking through how you approach building pipeline from scratch when there is no inbound lead flow to rely on

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you want to own a full sales role at a fast-moving company where your results are directly visible and your decisions actually move the number, this role gives you the autonomy, the product, and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

Position Summary
The Sr. Product Enablement Manager owns how DataSpring users and customers learn to use our products successfully, and serves as a cross-functional liaison between Product and the teams that support our users. As a shared service for both provider and member data teams, this person identifies where users encounter friction, determines the most effective intervention, and personally creates the solution, including in-app guidance, guided walkthroughs, short-form videos and visual tutorials.

This is a hands-on role that combines content creation and product adoption with ownership of how product information and user feedback flow between teams. The successful candidate works closely with the product team by participating in user acceptance testing, reviewing product analytics, listening to the call center and customer-facing teams, and translating those insights into timely, effective user education, product recommendations and change-readiness communication.

They may also coordinate with external production or Pendo-services partners when additional capacity or specialized expertise is required. They remain accountable for priorities, instructional quality, product accuracy, consistency, and measurable results.

Success is measured by changes in user behavior: fewer avoidable support contacts, faster time to value, stronger feature adoption, successful task completion, and greater user confidence, not simply by volume of content produced.

The Sr. Manager also strengthens the broader team: absorbing overflow from the UX and user enablement teams, providing backup coverage during launches and releases, and reducing the coordination load on Product and Operations leaders.

The successful candidate will be an exceptional plain-language communicator with strong hands-on production skills. They must be comfortable making independent decisions about priorities and formats and producing useful, accurate content under tight deadlines, shifting priorities, and incomplete information.

The Sr. Product Enablement Manager is a full-time, exempt, remote position and reports to the Director, Product Operations.

Specific Responsibilities

Training Needs Assessment and Prioritization

  • Identify and synthesize user-friction signals from support contacts and call drivers, customer interactions, implementation and account teams, internal questions, CSAT and NPS feedback, usability research, and product-usage data.
  • Translate identified friction into clearly defined user-education and product-adoption needs.
  • Prioritize requests according to user impact, business importance, urgency, audience, and production effort.
  • Recommend which requests should not be pursued and clearly communicate the associated tradeoffs.
  • Establish and operate a lightweight intake and triage process so requests are consistently captured, evaluated, prioritized, and resolved.
  • Participate in UAT and product-release activities to identify education needs before new functionality reaches users.
  • Partner with Product Management to distinguish between issues that require training and those that should be addressed through product design.

Content Development and Production

  • Determine the most effective intervention for each need, including a Pendo tooltip, contextual message, guided walkthrough, product tour, short-form video, annotated screenshot, visual tutorial, etc.
  • Design content for distinct user roles, personas, workflows, and levels of product familiarity.
  • Script, record, edit, caption, and publish concise product-training videos using modern screen-capture and authoring tools.
  • Create brief, task-focused content that helps users accomplish a specific goal rather than simply describing product features.
  • Build, test, publish, and maintain Pendo guides, tooltips, walkthroughs, and other in-app experiences.
  • Create visual content that can be reused across in-product guidance, help centers, release communications, and customer-support channels.
  • Apply consistent brand, voice, terminology, and plain-language standards for a nontechnical healthcare audience.
  • Ensure content meets applicable accessibility requirements, including captions, transcripts, alternative text, keyboard considerations, readable contrast, and Section 508/WCAG standards.
  • Maintain editable source files, templates, naming conventions, version history, and a reusable content library.
  • Use AI-assisted and automated production tools appropriately to shorten production cycles while maintaining accuracy, security, and editorial quality.
  • Plan and run in-app engagement campaigns that drive awareness and adoption of new and underused features.

Measurement and Continuous Improvement

  • Evaluate training effectiveness using Pendo analytics, support data, task completion, feature adoption, depth of use, and time to first successful use.
  • Test and improve content based on behavioral data and user feedback.
  • Revise, replace, consolidate, or retire content that is outdated, redundant, or failing to change user behavior.
  • Identify fast-follow priorities based on observed user friction, feature-adoption patterns, customer feedback, and support-center questions and call drivers.

Content and Platform Governance

  • Establish training content standards, review processes, and clear ownership so training, help content, and product messaging stay aligned with each release.
  • Lead Pendo governance, including standards for page and feature tagging, guide creation, targeting, review, and publishing across teams.
  • Help define guidelines for the responsible use of AI tools in content creation, covering accuracy, security, privacy, and editorial review.

Cross-Functional Partnership and Product Liaison

  • Work closely with Product Management, UX, Customer Support, Implementations, Sales, Client Partnerships, Marketing & Communications, Compliance, and other subject-matter experts.
  • Serve as a shared resource for both provider and member data teams, coordinating product enablement and communication across both.
  • Help teams distinguish between a product problem, communication problem, support problem, and education problem.
  • Communicate priorities, tradeoffs, progress, risks, and results clearly to stakeholders.
  • Partner with the Solutions Center to review call drivers and user feedback on a regular cadence; compare support themes with Pendo behavior data.
  • Help keep Solutions Center training and knowledge resources current with each release.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.excerpt: WHAT WE DONitrogen equips financial advisors with a suite of AI-powered products that showcase the value of their advice so they can attract clients and keep them fearless.
jobs.description:
WHAT WE DO

Nitrogen equips financial advisors with a suite of AI-powered products that showcase the value of their advice so they can attract clients and keep them fearless. Since launching Riskalyze in 2011, we've been on a mission to create what we call Catalyst Moments — those powerful instances when an advisor leads a client from confused and fearful to confident and fearless.

Nitrogen is a connected suite of advisor products designed to showcase the value of advice in every client meeting. Combining agentic AI with Risk Alignment, Insurance Alignment, Investment Research, Income Planning, Tax Intelligence, and Legacy Planning, combining agentic AI with trusted, deterministic analytics to turn complex financial insights into persuasive visuals. The result: clearer conversations, stronger relationships, and advisors who can prove their value in every client meeting.

Trusted by tens of thousands of advisors, backed by an industry-leading Net Promoter Score of 71, and the first wealthtech company to earn ISO 42001 certification, Nitrogen is built on thirteen years of advisor data and half a trillion dollars in assets on platform. We invented the Risk Number®, built on a Nobel Prize-winning academic framework, and we champion the Fearless Investing Movement — because a world empowered to invest fearlessly starts with empowered advisors.

Nitrogen is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. We are committed to being fair and intentional in our hiring decisions by reviewing every application thoroughly.

WHY DESIGN MATTERS AT NITROGEN

The last mile of financial advice isn't more data; it's clarity. It's the moment someone goes from confused to fearless. At Nitrogen, we help financial advisors showcase the value of advice in every client interaction. A lot of that comes down to great design. An advisor can have powerful analytics, but if their client can't understand what it means for their future, it doesn't really help them. Our job is to make that part clear, so clients walk away feeling confident.

Three ideas guide how we design and build at Nitrogen:

  • AI does the work. Nucleus™, our AI engine, doesn't just summarize or make suggestions. It takes action for advisors. You'll help design how that works, so advisors understand what it's doing, when it needs their input, and how to stay in control.
  • Connected intelligence makes the work right. Our analytics are grounded in proven methodology, not AI-generated math, and our products are designed to work better together. You'll help create the shared patterns and connected experiences that make the whole suite feel cohesive.
  • Persuasive visuals make the client feel it. You'll turn complex financial data into visuals that help clients understand where they stand, see the value of advice, and feel confident about what's next.

THE ROLE

This is a chance to help shape what AI-native financial advice looks like. You'll have real influence over product decisions, room to experiment with new ways of working, and the opportunity to set a high bar for design in a complex product that advisors rely on every day. Our advisors love Nitrogen, and it shows in our Net Promoter Score of 71.

We're a small design team with a well-structured process that moves fast. Every designer owns real parts of the product from start to finish. You'll work closely with a PM and an engineering lead to figure out what problems to solve, shape solutions, and see them through until they ship.

You don't need an extensive background in wealth management to be a great fit. Most of us didn't either when we started. We have insurance experts, CFPs, and people who've built advisor tools for over a decade on the team, and they'll help get you up to speed fast. What matters more is your curiosity, your ability to make complex ideas clear, high standards for your own work, and your drive to make a real impact.

We're a fully remote team spanning Poland to California, and we welcome applicants across time zones in the US. Our core collaboration hours are Monday through Friday, 10am to 2pm ET, and you'll need to be reliably available during that time to collaborate with teammates, including our engineers in Poland. Some of our most valuable work happens during these overlapping hours, when we can work through problems, make decisions, and move ideas forward together quickly in real time. You won't be in meetings the entire time, but we do expect you to be available to collaborate during that window. Outside those hours, you have the flexibility to manage your own focused design time. We trust you to work with strong accountability, autonomy, and a commitment to delivering results.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Work with your PM and engineering lead to shape new features, from a rough idea to a plan we can commit to. We work in structured, six-week development cycles, so a big part of the job is asking good questions early, exploring tradeoffs, and figuring out what's worth building.
  • Design how Nucleus works when it takes action for advisors: how it communicates progress, handles uncertainty or mistakes, and knows when to bring a person back into the loop.
  • Take complicated topics like investment risk, portfolio analysis, and insurance coverage, and turn them into visuals that make the numbers click, from how much a portfolio could swing in a bad year to whether a family's coverage is actually on track.
  • Build and maintain reusable design components, patterns, and documentation that keep our products consistent and give engineers and AI tools a reliable foundation to build from.
  • Prototype early and often. AI-powered prototyping is a core part of how we work, especially early on. You'll turn ideas into working experiences quickly, explore multiple approaches, and learn before committing to a direction. We use Figma, v0, Claude, and Devin every day.
  • Work closely with engineering through implementation, reviewing what's built and refining the details so what ships meets our high quality bar.
  • Share what you learn, improve how we work, and create reusable AI workflows that help all of us move faster without sacrificing quality.

Requirements

  • Exceptional visual product design skills. You can take a complex, data-dense product and make it feel clear, intuitive, and polished. Your portfolio shows a strong eye for layout, typography, visual hierarchy, and the details that make an experience feel finished.
  • A track record of shipping. You've designed and shipped software people rely on, can explain the decisions behind them, and have results or lessons learned to show for it.
  • Demonstrated AI proficiency. AI tools are already part of how you work. You use them to explore ideas, accelerate your process, and build working prototypes, not just generate static mockups. You can show us what you've built and explain how AI has changed the way you design.
  • An understanding of agentic design. You think about what makes AI experiences understandable and trustworthy, including how to communicate what the AI is doing, handle uncertainty and errors, and keep people in control.
  • Experience working with design systems. You're comfortable designing within established patterns, contributing new components when needed, and thinking about how systems scale across products and the people and tools building them.
  • Strong sense of ownership. You've owned big pieces of a product, and you work well with PMs and engineers without needing much oversight.
  • Curiosity and a bias toward learning. You can get your head around an unfamiliar domain quickly, identify what you need to learn, and use research, experimentation, and real feedback to guide your next move.
  • Conviction and humility. You're willing to ask hard questions, experiment, and advocate for what you believe is right. You're just as willing to listen, take feedback, and change your mind when you learn something new.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience designing and shipping AI-powered products, particularly agentic workflows or other experiences where AI takes action on behalf of users.
  • Experience with investing, finance, or insurance products. Or you're the friend people ask about their 401(k), or the one who's always tinkering with the newest AI tool on the weekend.
  • Experience leading a design system initiative or major product redesign, including templates, modular components, or guidelines that help AI agents create more consistent work.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and React, and/or comfort using front-end AI tools to polish an experience before it ships.

The expected compensation range for this role is a $130k-$140k + annual bonus target.

Lesser experience may result in lower compensation and greater experience may result in greater compensation than the stated range.

Benefits

Financial Benefits & Perks

  • 4% 401(k) Match. Our employees invest so much in our company and we love getting to invest in them. The company will match your contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to 4% of your total annual compensation.
  • Free Financial Planning Services. By working at a financial technology company, you get the benefit of fantastic financial advice. This is offered to all employees wanting expert guidance on how to handle their money.

Health & Family

  • Medical, Dental & Vision insurance plans. We want to help keep you (and your family) healthy! Comprehensive health insurance options for you & your family.
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA) or Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) available depending on chosen medical plan. We know that investment risk isn’t a one-size-fits all and neither are your health savings options!
  • Generous maternity & paternity leave for either the birth or adoption of a child. Mom's & Dad's need time with their new family members!
  • Discounted pet insurance available. Pets are family too!!

Time Away & Culture

  • 3 weeks vacation & 1 week sick time per year.Take the time you need for fun or simply time to recover from not feeling well.
  • 11 paid company holidays per year. Enjoy your time off; you deserve it!
  • Remote & in-person team building activities help our employees stay connected and engaged. We absolutely love to hype our people up!
  • Company wide meetings held by our CEO benefit all employees by keeping everyone in the loop. We are one team, and we tackle projects together.
  • Employee development is our priority. From leadership training, to mentorship, to industry resources, we care about progressing you in your career.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

We are seeking a Hybrid Cloud Architect to design strategies, reference architectures, and platform capabilities that span multiple cloud providers — AWS, Azure, GCP, and selectively OCI — for enterprises operating on more than one cloud by deliberate choice. The role focuses on portability, abstraction layers, federated identity, cross-cloud networking, and platform offerings that hide cloud-specific complexity from product teams. The ideal candidate has architected meaningful multi-cloud capabilities, understands the trade-offs between portability and cloud-native depth, and brings strong opinions grounded in production experience.

jobs.excerpt: About High ScaleWe’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media.
jobs.description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Casting Talent specialist who can hunt down the fresh faces, authentic voices, and charismatic creators that define our brands.

Why This Role Matters

Authenticity, charisma, and connection are your playground. In the world of performance marketing, the "face" of the ad is often the biggest variable in its success. As a Casting Talent specialist, you are the detective and the connector. You aren't just filling roles; you are finding the specific personalities that make a viewer stop scrolling and start listening.

Your ability to distinguish between "cringe" acting and genuine influence will directly impact the ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) of our clients. If you have a natural eye for potential and love building relationships with creators, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Scout & Source Creators

    • Proactively hunt for new talent on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and casting platforms. You won't just wait for applications; you will go out and find the hidden gems.

    • Build a diverse roster of actors, models, UGC creators, and real-people testimonials suitable for beauty, fashion, and tech brands.

    • Identify talent that matches specific demographic and psychographic profiles provided by the Strategy team.

  2. Vet for Performance

    • Review self-tapes and past content to ensure talent has on-camera charisma, good lighting setups (for remote creators), and the ability to deliver lines naturally.

    • Conduct brief audition interviews to test communication skills and professionalism.

  3. Manage Talent Relationships

    • Serve as the primary point of contact for our talent roster, building strong, long-term relationships.

    • Brief talent clearly on project requirements, scripts, and visual direction to ensure they nail the shoot on the first try.

    • Negotiate rates and usage rights effectively, maximizing value for our clients.

  4. Database Management

    • Maintain an organized, tagged database of talent (e.g., "Mom aged 30-40," "Gen Z Skincare Enthusiast") for rapid deployment on new campaigns.

Who You Are

  1. A Social Media Native

    • 1–3 years of experience in casting, influencer marketing, or talent management.

    • You understand the "vibe" of different platforms. You know what a "TikTok face" looks like versus a "TV commercial face."

  2. A Good Judge of Character

    • You have high emotional intelligence. You can tell within seconds of a video if someone is authentic or "acting."

    • You are inclusive and adept at finding diverse talent that represents the real world.

  3. Excellent Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency is required. You are comfortable negotiating with agents and guiding creators through a brief.

    • You are responsive and professional, representing High Scale well in the creator community.

  4. Organized & Fast

    • Casting often happens on tight timelines. You can manage multiple casting calls simultaneously without getting flustered.

    • You are diligent with paperwork, agreements, and contact details.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the creative direction of global brands and grow into a Senior Casting Director or Producer role.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one perfectly cast role at a time.

About the Institute for Nonprofit Practice
The Institute for Nonproﬁt Practice (INP) works to ensure that the nation’s nonproﬁt, public sector, and social impact leaders have the skills, knowledge, networks, and conﬁdence to boldly advance their organizations and missions and build a more equitable future for all.

INP serves social impact leaders who are driving solutions to some of the most pressing issues of our time. Nonprofits constitute the third-largest sector of the U.S. workforce – nearly 1 in 10 workers – yet the sector continues to face a chronic deficit of investment in the people who power it. The types of peer-to-peer learning and exchanges that INP offers are needed more than ever as the sector wrestles with a set of challenges that have mounted over the past few years – including workforce shortages, high burnout and turnover rates, and a rising demand for services – that can significantly undermine organizational effectiveness. With an 19-year track record of delivering programs that measurably increase leaders’ key leadership skills, confidence, and networks, INP is committed to meeting this moment by continuing to empower social impact leaders to adapt and thrive amidst these obstacles.

About the Role - Senior Grant Writer
As the Senior Grant Writer, you serve as the primary author and strategist for all grant proposals, letters of intent, prospective funding scenarios, and donor reports. You hold end-to-end accountability for the narrative quality, accuracy, strategic positioning, and timeliness of every institutional submission. Deeply attuned to funder priorities and the nuances of institutional philanthropy, you translate INP’s mission, community impact, and strategic vision into compelling, persuasive narratives that resonate with foundation and corporate partners.

Reporting to the Director of Institutional Giving, you are an integral member of a collaborative seven-person development team. In this role, you steward an established institutional portfolio of roughly 30 local and national funders—representing gifts typically ranging from $100,000 to over $2 million and totaling more than $7 million in annual institutional support.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Grant Writing & Submission: Write and submit approximately 30 proposals/LOIs and 30 reports annually (averaging just over one submission per week), crafting compelling narratives that reflect INP’s voice, mission, and strategic priorities.
  • End-to-End Project Management: Own the grant lifecycle from initiation to final delivery, tracking deadlines, maintaining the master institutional giving calendar, and ensuring strict adherence to foundation guidelines.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with program, finance, and executive leadership to source financial data, program metrics, and impact narratives needed for robust proposals and donor reporting.
  • Prospect Research & Pipeline Development: Guide prospect research strategy and landscape analysis to identify and qualify up to $1M in new funding opportunities annually, partnering with Development Coordinators to execute detailed research and build out prospect profiles.

What You’ll Need
  • 7+ years of relevant professional experience, with a proven track record of writing successful institutional fundraising proposals.
  • Exceptional writing and self-editing skills, coupled with an appreciation for a collaborative, team-based editorial process.
  • Experience using Salesforce or a comparable CRM to log outreach, manage pipeline data, and track conversion milestones.
  • Comfort leveraging modern workplace tools and AI applications to streamline communications and day-to-day operations.
  • Ability to work gracefully under pressure, manage competing priorities, navigate ambiguity, and meet strict deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions while executing independently to achieve organizational fundraising goals.
  • An authentic commitment to INP’s mission and a dedication to advancing diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging.

Who You Are
  • An Effective Writer. You write well and take pride in your ability to do so, especially when given the opportunity to communicate an idea, topic, or vision that you are passionate about.
  • Resourceful and Adaptable. You’re nimble and flexible. You possess a positive attitude and identify creative solutions to obstacles. You can juggle many important responsibilities at once and you’re rigorous about prioritizing.
  • Self-motivated. You take the initiative, identifying problems and opportunities across your portfolio, developing recommendations, and taking action on those recommendations.
  • A Humble Teammate. Nothing is beneath or above you. You are quick to always lend a hand or two! You are able to earn influence without authority and naturally seek to support small projects or large strategic goals.
  • An Abundant Thinker. You operate from the belief that the right coalition of partners can unlock transformative possibilities. You approach relationship building with relentless curiosity and genuine enthusiasm.
  • Impact-Driven. You are motivated by social justice and energized by the opportunity to strengthen, connect, and elevate social sector leaders nationwide.

Compensation, Benefits, and Location
INP provides a competitive salary that is benchmarked annually against Boston-area nonprofits. The hiring range for this position is $80,000 to $90,000 annually. The ﬁnal salary within this range will be determined based on candidate's qualifications and relevant experience. New staff are rarely brought in at the top of the range to ensure internal equity and to leave room for salary growth during an employee’s tenure at the Institute for Nonprofit Practice.

Our comprehensive benefits package includes:
  • Employer-covered health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO) for all team members
  • Eleven paid holidays and winter and summer breaks for collective rest and restoration.
  • 401(k) with a 3% employer match of employee contributions.
This is a full-time, fully-remote position. Limited travel is expected; 2-4 times per year.


The Application Process
INP has engaged Equitable Hiring Group to support this hiring process. To apply, please complete the short form to the right.

Please submit your application by Wednesday, November 4th. Our simple process makes it easy to apply early!

To ensure an equitable review, we ask that you remove the names of the schools you attended (both undergraduate and graduate) from your resume. Please retain the degree itself. For example, instead of "Greendale Community College - B.A. Economics," simply list "B.A. Economics."

This evaluation process will follow practices shown to reduce bias in decision-making and may be different from other application processes you have experienced.

The overall evaluation process will look to follow this anticipated timeline:
  • Early November: Selected candidates will be asked to complete a short-answer questionnaire.

  • Mid-November: Selected candidates will be asked to complete a paid, timed trial project.
  • Late November: Selected candidates will participate in a video panel interview with multiple team members.
  • Early December: Finalist candidates will interview with leadership, either via Zoom or in-person.
  • Mid-December: Offer extended.

jobs.description:
We're looking for a Sr. Data Modeler to design and govern the data models that serve as the foundation for analytics, reporting, and business intelligence across the organization — with particular depth in semantic and metrics-layer modeling. Beyond traditional schema design, you'll build the semantic layer that sits between raw data and downstream consumers (dashboards, reverse-ETL syncs, AI-assisted querying), working closely with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to keep definitions consistent everywhere they're used.

What you'll get to do:

  • Contribute to the semantic layer strategy — defining metrics, dimensions, and business logic once so they're consistent across BI tools, reverse-ETL syncs, and AI-assisted querying
  • Design serving-layer models as the "source of truth" for business definitions, resolving ambiguity before it reaches dashboards
  • Build and govern semantic views/metrics layers (e.g., Snowflake semantic views, dbt metrics/semantic layer) that let analysts and AI tools query curated data without re-deriving business logic
  • Partner directly with analytics and BI consumers to understand how models get used downstream, and iterate on semantic definitions based on real query patterns
  • Reduce metric drift by auditing existing reports/dashboards for divergent definitions of the same business concept and consolidating them into governed semantic models

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of experience in data modeling or a related field, including experience operating at a senior or technical lead level
  • Experience designing or maintaining a semantic layer or metrics layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Snowflake semantic views, Cube) that serves multiple downstream consumers
  • Strong point of view on the difference between a data model and a semantic model, and how to design for both correctness and analyst usability
  • Advanced SQL skills and deep understanding of relational database design
  • Experience modeling data within modern cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
  • Experience working with transformation frameworks such as dbt
  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata management, and documentation practices
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical designs and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience preferred.
  • Foundational background in dimensional modeling (Kimball and/or Inmon) — helpful context, though this role emphasizes semantic/metrics layer design over traditional schema work
  • Experience with data catalog or governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Atlan)
  • Familiarity with data mesh or data product concepts
  • Background in a specific industry domain relevant to the business (e.g., finance, healthcare, retail)
