jobs.title: Director of Finance & People Operations
jobs.excerpt: About Green Ocean Property ManagementGreen Ocean Property Management is a growing property-management organization serving residential rental and condominium/HOA portfolios, supported by related service businesses.
jobs.description:
About Green Ocean Property Management

Green Ocean Property Management is a growing property-management organization serving residential rental and condominium/HOA portfolios, supported by related service businesses. Our operating model depends on accurate financial information, disciplined execution, strong managers, and people systems that can scale with the company.

Position Summary

The Director of Finance & People Operations is the senior functional leader responsible for the company’s financial discipline and HR operating system. Reporting to the COO, this person leads through the Controller and HR Manager and ensures both teams produce timely, accurate, decision-ready work without depending on the COO for day-to-day management.

This is not primarily a bookkeeping role or an HR-generalist role. It is a manager-of-managers position for someone who can connect financial performance, workforce decisions, internal controls, and manager accountability. The right person will make the business more predictable: leadership will know where the company stands financially, managers will understand the numbers and people outcomes they own, and finance and HR processes will run reliably.

Core Outcomes

The Director will be accountable for the following outcomes:

  1. Reliable financial close and reporting — Monthly financial statements are accurate, reconciled, completed on the approved close calendar, and translated into clear actions for leadership.
  2. Forward-looking financial control — Leadership has a current cash forecast, budget, operating forecast, and early warning on material risks or variances.
  3. Clear financial accountability — Each department manager understands and owns the revenue, cost, staffing, and operating metrics assigned to that function.
  4. Strong internal controls — Corporate books, client/property books, payroll, billing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and cash controls have clear ownership, documented review steps, and escalation rules.
  5. A dependable people system — Recruiting, onboarding, performance management, retention, compensation administration, employee relations, and offboarding operate consistently and legally.
  6. Independent, accountable teams — The Controller, HR Manager, and their teams have clear scorecards, decision rights, development plans, and the ability to deliver without the Director redoing their work.

Key Responsibilities

Finance Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and hold the Controller accountable for month-end close, account reconciliations, accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll accounting, financial reporting, and finance-team performance.
  • Oversee finance managers and accounting teams supporting the company’s operating entities and property-management segments.
  • Maintain clear boundaries between corporate financial reporting and client/property accounting, including disciplined use of QuickBooks Online for company books and Buildium for client/property books.
  • Own the annual budgeting and forecasting process, including department-owner budgets, operating assumptions, cash planning, scenario analysis, and monthly variance reviews.
  • Produce a concise monthly management package covering revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, labor, cash, receivables, payables, budget variances, and material risks.
  • Partner with operating leaders to improve profitability, pricing discipline, billing completeness, collections, labor efficiency, and cost control.
  • Establish and enforce internal controls, approval limits, reconciliation standards, segregation of duties, and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure leadership can distinguish source-system facts, estimates, forecasts, and proposed decisions.
  • Coordinate tax, insurance, banking, audit, and outside-accounting relationships as assigned.
  • Improve finance systems, dashboards, data quality, and automation while retaining appropriate human review over financial decisions and postings.

HR and People Operations Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and hold the HR Manager accountable for the performance of the HR team and the quality of company-wide people processes.
  • Translate the company plan into a workforce plan covering required roles, hiring priorities, capacity, compensation cost, and succession risk.
  • Ensure recruiting uses clear role scorecards, structured interviews, hiring-manager calibration, documented decisions, and measurable pipeline reporting.
  • Oversee onboarding, offboarding, employee records, payroll coordination, benefits administration, leave administration, and required compliance processes.
  • Maintain a practical performance-management system with clear role expectations, regular one-on-ones, documented feedback, performance improvement plans, and timely reviews.
  • Track and improve time-to-fill, offer acceptance, 90-day retention, voluntary turnover, performance-review completion, and required training completion.
  • Guide managers on employee relations, documentation, coaching, and escalation; engage employment counsel or a qualified HR partner when legal interpretation is required.
  • Develop compensation ranges, promotion criteria, and career paths that are internally consistent and tied to demonstrated capability—not title or tenure alone.
  • Build an HR team that can independently operate recruiting, retention, administration, and manager-support workflows.

Executive and Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the COO’s principal leader for finance and HR operations.
  • Convert financial and people data into a short, prioritized executive do-list with an owner, deadline, metric, and expected business effect.
  • Participate in leadership planning, operating reviews, annual planning, and major staffing or investment decisions.
  • Identify risks early and bring a recommendation—not only a problem—to the COO and CEO.
  • Set weekly operating cadences and scorecards for both functions, and ensure agreed actions are completed and verified.
  • Protect confidential employee, payroll, client, and financial information and maintain appropriate access controls.

Decision Authority and Boundaries

The Director is expected to independently improve routine finance and HR processes, enforce approved controls and deadlines, manage the two functions, and make day-to-day operating decisions within approved policies and budgets.

The Director prepares evidence-based recommendations for executive approval on major hires or terminations, executive compensation, material policy changes, unbudgeted commitments, financing, acquisitions, legal settlements, and other decisions reserved for the COO or CEO.

This role owns operational finance and people leadership. It is not automatically a CFO seat: capital strategy, investor relations, fundraising, and mergers and acquisitions are included only when expressly assigned.

Proposed Scorecard

Final targets should be confirmed during the first 30 days after reviewing the current baseline.

Finance

  • Month-end close completed on the approved calendar.
  • All material balance-sheet accounts reconciled, with no unexplained material exceptions.
  • Weekly 13-week cash forecast maintained and reviewed against actual results.
  • Monthly financial package delivered on time with actionable variance explanations.
  • Every department completes its scheduled budget-versus-actual review.
  • Accounts receivable, accounts payable, unbilled work, and collection exceptions remain within approved targets.
  • Payroll, tax, banking, and required financial filings are completed accurately and on time.

People Operations

  • Approved roles have current scorecards and active hiring plans.
  • Time-to-fill, offer acceptance, 90-day retention, and voluntary turnover are reported and improved against agreed targets.
  • Onboarding, performance reviews, compliance training, and offboarding documentation are completed on time.
  • Payroll and benefit changes are accurate and submitted by deadline.
  • The HR Manager and Controller consistently deliver their scorecards without the Director redoing their work.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant progressive experience in accounting or finance, including responsibility for close, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, cash management, and internal controls.
  • Experience leading managers and building teams that produce accurate work independently.
  • Working knowledge of HR operations, including recruiting, performance management, payroll/benefits coordination, employee relations, compensation administration, and employment compliance.
  • Experience in a multi-entity, service, property-management, real-estate, or similarly operationally complex business.
  • Strong ability to turn financial and people data into clear decisions for non-finance leaders.
  • Demonstrated judgment with confidential employee and financial information.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, follow-through, and comfort holding peers and managers accountable.
  • Advanced proficiency with spreadsheets and practical experience with accounting, property-management, payroll, HRIS, and reporting systems.
  • Ability to lead a distributed or remote team across functions and time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • CPA, CMA, MBA, SHRM-CP/SCP, or comparable professional qualification.
  • Experience with QuickBooks Online, Buildium, BambooHR, Google Workspace, and workflow or reporting automation.
  • Experience improving close speed, cash forecasting, billing completeness, collections, retention, or manager accountability with measurable results.

Benefits and Time Off

Benefits for this full-time role include:

  • Health insurance: Employer-sponsored health coverage. Eligibility, plan terms, and the employer contribution are governed by the applicable benefit plan and offer letter.
  • Paid time off (PTO): 15 paid days annually, subject to company policy.
  • Paid sick time: 5 paid days annually, subject to company policy and applicable law.
  • Paid Holidays

Leadership Profile

The strongest candidate will:

  • lead through clear outcomes rather than constant task supervision;
  • be rigorous without creating unnecessary bureaucracy;
  • challenge assumptions respectfully and use source data before drawing conclusions;
  • distinguish urgent work from high-value work;
  • solve recurring problems through process, ownership, and systems;
  • coach managers while still holding a firm performance standard; and
  • communicate bad news early, plainly, and with a recommended next step.

Equal Opportunity

Green Ocean Property Management is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without unlawful discrimination.

Internal Hiring Note

Because this position directly leads both the Controller and HR Manager, the hiring process should test four distinct capabilities:

  1. ownership of a finance function;
  2. judgment in hiring and workforce planning;
  3. successful management of managers and distributed teams; and
  4. the ability to run company-wide accountability processes without confusing process ownership with direct management of every manager.

A strong accounting candidate without proven people leadership is not sufficient. A strong HR leader without command of close, cash, budgeting, controls, and management reporting is also not sufficient.

Salary: up to $15

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need an Audiovisual Producer (Realizador Audiovisual) who is a master of the entire post-production spectrum, blending storytelling, rhythm, and sound into a cohesive masterpiece.

Why This Role Matters Holistic storytelling, sensory impact, and creative autonomy are your playground. In this role, you aren't just an "editor"—you are a creator. You will take ownership of the entire audiovisual experience, from the narrative cut to the sound design, color grade, and motion graphics.

This role is designed for the "Preditor" (Producer/Editor)—the multifaceted talent common in the LATAM market who can take a folder of raw assets and turn it into a broadcast-ready commercial without needing to pass it to three other departments. If you thrive on owning the final product and crafting the full sensory experience, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Execute End-to-End Post-Production

    • Take ownership of video projects from ingest to final export. You will be responsible for the edit, the sound mix, the color balance, and the motion graphics.

    • Transform raw studio footage and UGC into dynamic, high-performance ads for Social Media (TikTok/Reels) and Connected TV.

  2. Master Audio & Sound Design

    • Go beyond simple music sync. Use sound effects (SFX), foley, and dynamic audio mixing to drive the pacing and emotion of the edit.

    • Select and edit music tracks to create the perfect "vibe" that aligns with the brand's identity.

  3. Implement Visual Polish (Motion & Color)

    • Apply polished motion graphics (kinetic text, logo builds) to reinforce the message.

    • Perform creative color grading to ensure the video looks premium and consistent with the brand's aesthetic.

  4. Creative Conceptualization

    • Work with the creative team to propose visual solutions. You don't just follow a script; you propose cuts, transitions, and effects that elevate the concept.

    • Adapt and iterate on successful concepts to create new "winning" variations.

Who You Are

  1. A True "Realizador Audiovisual"

    • 3–6 years of experience in a generalist post-production role (agency, production house, or freelance).

    • You are comfortable wearing multiple hats: Editor, Sound Designer, Colorist, and Motion Designer.

  2. Technical Generalist

    • Mastery of Adobe Premiere Pro is non-negotiable.

    • Strong proficiency in After Effects (for graphics), Audition (for sound), and DaVinci/Lumetri (for color).

    • You understand codecs, bitrates, and export settings for every platform.

  3. A Rhythm Master

    • Your edits have a heartbeat. You understand how to cut to music and how to use pacing to keep a viewer engaged for the full 30 seconds.

  4. Detail-Oriented & Organized

    • You manage your own projects and timelines effectively.

    • You are meticulous about Quality Control (QC)—no flash frames, no audio peaks, no typos.

  5. Bilingual Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency (C1/C2) is required. You will be collaborating with US-based producers and must be able to articulate creative choices clearly in English.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the creative direction of global brands and lead complex audiovisual projects.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one stunning frame at a time.

jobs.description:
Error-bounded lossy compression has become an important technique for reducing the storage and I/O costs of large-scale scientific data while providing strict control over data distortion. Existing compressors typically exploit spatial or temporal correlations through predefined prediction models, which may not effectively capture the complex underlying dynamics of scientific datasets. In this work, we plan to investigate the use of Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamics (SINDy) to improve error-bounded lossy compression. We wukk evaluate the approach on representative scientific datasets and compare it with state-of-the-art error-bounded lossy compressors. Our results will demonstrate the potential of incorporating data-driven SINDy data predictor into scientific data compression and provide insights into when SINDy-based prediction can improve compression ratios and downstream data quality.

#TeamNextdoor

Nextdoor (NYSE: NXDR) is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at .

Meet Your Future Neighbors

As a Product Manager on the Search team, you'll take on one of the most consequential rebuilds at Nextdoor. Search is the most explicit statement of intent a neighbor makes on the platform, and most searches aren't commercial at all: a lost-pet post, a neighbor's name, a school thread from last week, and sometimes a plumber. Search has been under-resourced for years and it shows. That changes now, with executive sponsorship, dedicated investment, and a blank sheet. You'll own the rebuild end to end, organic and monetized search together, from the quality of every result to how sponsored content earns its place on the page.

We're looking for a search expert who has done this before: someone who has owned consumer search, made it measurably better for users, and defined the relevance and quality metrics to prove it. You'll need real commercial literacy too. You've worked shoulder to shoulder with the ads and monetization side, built genuine empathy for why the business needs to extract value from search, and you know firsthand how sponsored content, ad load, and paid-organic blending actually behave. You know that great search monetization makes results better, not worse, and you've seen engagement and revenue grow together when both sides pull in the same direction. This is a multi-year rebuild rather than a tuning exercise, and you won't do it alone: dedicated data science partners, ML engineers with search backgrounds, and design coverage are committed to the team. Ideally, you've also built beyond search and bring the range of a generalist athlete who can flex across consumer, marketplace, and business-facing problems. You'll partner closely with engineering, data science, research, design, and PMM to turn that thinking into shipped experiments with real, measurable impact.

At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. We aren't looking for prompt engineers; we’re looking for people who use tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean to challenge their own thinking and take full ownership of AI-assisted outputs.

TheImpact You’ll Make

  • Build the missing foundation first: define the metric that tells us whether a neighbor found what they came for, and make it the measure every experiment and ship call answers to. It does not exist today, and it's the most important thing you'll deliver in your first six months
  • Own the Search rebuild end to end, organic and monetized together, from query understanding and retrieval to ranking, result quality, and how the page comes together
  • Make the majority of searches work: most queries are a neighbor looking for a post, a person, a place, or an answer, with no commercial intent, and today we fail them too often
  • Partner with dedicated data science and ML engineering on query understanding, retrieval, and ranking, going deep on the mechanics when the details matter
  • Design how organic and sponsored content blend on the page, including placement, ad load, relevance thresholds, and monetization-eligibility routing, so paid results appear only where a business is the genuine answer
  • Grow revenue on the minority of queries with commercial intent, connecting neighbors to local businesses through organic and sponsored placements, with relevance as the guardrail revenue never overrides

What You’ll Bring To The Team

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including deep ownership of consumer search at scale and clear wins in making it better for users
  • Working knowledge of information retrieval fundamentals, including query understanding, retrieval, and ranking, plus experience defining search relevance and quality metrics from scratch and shipping ML- or LLM-powered search features
  • Experience working directly with the monetization side of search, whether you owned it or partnered closely with ads and revenue teams, and genuine empathy for how the business extracts value from search
  • A track record of growing engagement and revenue together, with the judgment to know when monetization improves the user experience and when it degrades it
  • Strong consumer product instincts built from shipping experiences used at scale, and genuine curiosity about how neighbors search for and find local information
  • A strong track record designing and analyzing A/B tests, including balancing revenue metrics against engagement guardrails, and translating ambiguous or conflicting signals into a clear ship decision
  • Range beyond search: you've shipped in adjacent areas like growth, marketplace, ads, or 0-to-1 products, and you flex quickly as the team's needs evolve
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, a bias toward action, and the appetite for a multi-year rebuild rather than a quick optimization win

Rewards

Compensation, benefits, perks, and recognition programs at Nextdoor come together to create our total rewards package. Compensation will vary depending on your relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

The starting salary for this role is expected to range from $170,000 - $250,000 on an annualized basis, or potentially greater in the event that your 'level' of proficiency exceeds the level expected for the role. The salary range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location.

We expect to award a meaningful equity grant for this role. With quarterly vesting, your first vest date will take place within 3 months of your start date.

When it comes to benefits, we have you covered! Nextdoor employees can choose between a variety of health plans, including a 100% covered employee only plan option, and we also provide a OneMedical membership for concierge care.

At Nextdoor, we empower our employees to build stronger local communities. To create a platform where all feel welcome, we want our workforce to reflect the diversity of the neighbors we serve. We encourage everyone interested in our mission to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, or any other trait that unfairly targets a group of people. In accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we always consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Position:Business Development Executive
Status:Full-time, exempt
Location:Remote
Reports to:VP of Business Development
Compensation: $85000 - $105000; commensurate with experience.

Who we are:
Intent Clinical offers a continuum of services to guide individuals, families, advisors, and employers through the behavioral health industry by providing concierge-level care, identifying suitable treatment and aftercare options, and assisting in creating and implementing sustainable recovery plans. We help address the needs of those struggling with behavioral health issues including substance use disorders, mental health issues, eating disorders, and mood and personality disorders. We also support individuals on the autism spectrum, aging adults with dementia, and young adults who are struggling with transitions to independence. Through a curated national network of more than 400 highly specialized professionals spanning the full continuum of care, we move with intention from first call to care plan faster than anyone else in this space.

Who you are:
You are a driven, relationship-focused sales professional who thrives in a dual-focus role: equal parts new business development and account management, requiring someone who can open doors and keep them open. You are a front-line ambassador for the Intent Clinical brand — earning trust with sophisticated, high-stakes professionals and positioning Intent Clinical as their go-to human-side partner for high-net-worth clients. You bring maturity, discretion, and a genuine understanding of the world our clients and partners operate in, and you approach every relationship with the consultative, relationship-driven mindset this role demands. You navigate the wealth advisor, family office, legal, top-tier employer, and clinician communities with ease and confidence, and you believe in Intent Clinical's mission and understand that the partnerships you build directly support some of the most sensitive and important work in the mental health space.

What you'll do:
New Business Development
  • Identify, prospect, and engage new referral partners across all target channels; wealth advisors, family offices, legal teams, top-tier employers, and clinicians.
  • Execute a disciplined outreach strategy that builds a consistent pipeline of qualified partner relationships.
  • Lead consultative discovery conversations that uncover partner needs and clearly articulate the Intent Clinical value proposition.
  • Own the full sales cycle from first contact through signed partnership agreement and successful first referral.
  • Represent Intent Clinical at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities relevant to target partner channels.
Account Management
  • Manage and grow an assigned portfolio of existing referral partner accounts.
  • Conduct regular touchpoints with partners to strengthen relationships, gather feedback, and identify opportunities to deepen engagement.
  • Monitor referral activity and partner health; proactively addressing any gaps in engagement or satisfaction.
  • Introduce partners to new Intent Clinical service lines as they become available, expanding the scope of each partnership over time.
  • Ensure every partner interaction reflects the concierge standard and brand promise of Intent Clinical.
Pipeline and Reporting
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all sales activity, pipeline status, and account health in the CRM.
  • Provide regular pipeline and forecast updates to the VP of Sales.
  • Track and report on key performance metrics including new partner acquisition, referral volume, and account growth.
Market Intelligence
  • Stay current on trends and developments across the wealth management, behavioral health, and employer benefits spaces.
  • Share market intelligence, partner feedback, and competitive insights with the broader sales and leadership team.
  • Identify emerging referral partner opportunities and bring them to the VP of Sales for strategic consideration.
  • Other duties as assigned.
What you'll bring:
  • 4-7 years of sales or business development experience, with a track record of success in a consultative, relationship-driven environment.
  • Minimum of a bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field.
  • Experience selling into or working alongside wealth management, financial services, behavioral health, healthcare, or employer benefits audiences strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with the high-net-worth community and an understanding of the professionals who serve them — you navigate this world with ease and confidence.
  • Proven ability to manage both new business development and existing account relationships simultaneously.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills — you build trust quickly, listen well, and represent a premium brand with professionalism and discretion.
  • Self-directed and organized — you manage your pipeline, your time, and your priorities without needing close supervision.
  • CRM proficiency and a data-driven approach to managing your book of business.
Nice to have (not required):
  • Experience in mental health, behavioral health, or concierge healthcare.
What we'll bring:
  • Flexible work environment, with primarily remote work.
  • Collaborative and supportive culture focused on your personal and professional growth.
  • Health, dental, vision, FSA plan, and 401K plan.
  • Wellness incentives of up to $500 annually.
  • Monthly phone stipend.
  • This position is eligible for an incentive plan.
  • Direct mentorship from senior sales leadership and a clear path for growth within a scaling organization.

Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We encourage applications from all interested individuals, including but not limited to people of color, women, those with disabilities, LGBTQIA+ individuals, immigrants, veterans and anyone else who has faced discrimination or oppression as a result of their identities. We are committed to promoting an environment that celebrates diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging in all areas of our organization. We strive to foster an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, respected, and valued. We embrace differences of all kinds, such as age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, physical ability, religion, veteran status, national origin, and socioeconomic background, among others.

We understand that diversity goes beyond visible differences and encompasses a vast array of characteristics, experiences and beliefs. We actively seek individuals with diverse backgrounds, whether from minority or majority groups, to join our team because we believe this enriches our company culture and enhances the services to our clients. Also, studies have shown that folks of historically marginalized groups will often only apply to a job if they meet or exceed the listed qualifications. So regardless of your background, if you believe that you could be a good fit for our company, but don’t quite hit every requirement, please do still apply, we would love to hear from you!

These statements are intended to confirm our commitment to creating an inclusive workplace—they are not intended to exclude any individual. We are an equal opportunity employer; we do not discriminate in hiring or any other employment decisions based on any protected category.

jobs.description:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Python Team Lead to join our dynamic team on a full-time basis.

About the Client

Our client is an international provider of intellectual property services and technology solutions, helping businesses protect and manage innovations through patent translation, international filing, patent research, and renewal services.

About the Project

The project focuses on replacing complex, labour-intensive backend business processes with Python-based automation and LLM-powered solutions.

You will join as the first engineer and Team Lead of a growing contractor team, establishing the technical foundations and helping shape how the team works and delivers. You will collaborate closely with an AI & Automation Product Manager with experience at Meta, turning business challenges into practical solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring strong Python expertise, excellent communication skills, and the confidence to take ownership of problems from discovery through production.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical delivery of automation initiatives, taking responsibility for solution quality and delivery outcomes.
  • Work closely with the Product Manager and business stakeholders to understand existing workflows, clarify requirements, and define priorities.
  • Translate complex business problems into actionable technical plans and clearly scoped tasks.
  • Design and develop Python services, automated workflows, and integrations with existing systems and APIs.
  • Apply LLM capabilities where they provide measurable value, with appropriate validation and human review.
  • Establish engineering standards, development practices, and a collaborative team culture.
  • Guide and mentor engineers, delegate responsibilities, and provide constructive feedback and code reviews as the team grows.
  • Proactively identify risks, resolve blockers, and communicate progress and trade-offs clearly.
  • Lead technical discussions, handle disagreements constructively, and help stakeholders reach informed decisions.
  • Ensure solutions include appropriate testing, monitoring, error handling, and production support.

Requirements

  • Strong commercial experience building and maintaining production systems with Python.
  • Proven experience leading an engineering team while remaining actively involved in technical design and development.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including active listening, constructive feedback, and effective conflict resolution.
  • Strong ownership: the ability to independently drive problems from initial investigation to a working production solution.
  • Experience collaborating directly with Product Managers and business stakeholders, translating business goals into technical delivery.
  • Ability to organise team workloads, delegate effectively, support engineers, and maintain accountability for commitments.
  • Experience delivering backend automation, system integrations, or solutions that replace manual business processes.
  • Practical experience integrating LLMs into applications or automated workflows.
  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals, including APIs, databases, data processing, and reliable error handling.
  • Experience with automated testing, Git, and production deployment practices.
  • Ability to work effectively with evolving requirements, make pragmatic decisions, and explain technical trade-offs.
  • Strong spoken and written English, sufficient to lead discussions, clarify complex requirements, and confidently challenge assumptions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building a new engineering team or establishing delivery processes from scratch.
  • Experience interviewing and onboarding engineers.
  • Experience with document processing, information extraction, or document-heavy workflows.
  • Experience evaluating LLM outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Experience with workflow orchestration, background jobs, and asynchronous processing.

Accenture Song’s Utilities team, a group of management consultants helping leading organizations reinvent service as a driver of customer trust, operational efficiency, and satisfaction. We help clients move beyond traditional cost-focused service models by defining future-ready customer service strategies, operating models, transformation roadmaps, and business cases that connect human-centered design, data-driven insights, AI, and scalable technology platforms.

Within Utilities, we work with electricity, gas & water providers to address rising customer expectations, affordability pressures, regulatory requirements, outage and emergency communications, energy transition programs, and the need for proactive, personalized, digital-first engagement. You are passionate about the Utilities industry and understand the critical moments that shape customer trust, including billing, payments, collections, outage management, move-in/move-out, field service coordination, energy efficiency, rate changes, distributed energy resources, and clean energy adoption. You have developed thought leadership, assets, and offerings that present innovative insights, guidance, and recommendations on market-relevant topics. You have built strong relationships with multiple senior clients, serving as a trusted advisor for executive leadership. You have a history of developing & mentoring peers and junior team members.

You have experience originating sales (as guided by Managing Directors) from ideation through development of proposals and RFP oral presentations.

You are energized by the opportunity to ideate & deploy automation, AI, Agentic AI and Agentic Commerce solutions to reinvent the end-to-end Utilities Customer processes, across channels and across the front- and back-office.

jobs.title: UX Analyst (Product Workflows) | Field Operations SaaS | Remote (LATAM) 🎨
jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewOur client is a software company that helps property managers inspect properties and turn what they find into clear, shareable reports.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Our client is a software company that helps property managers inspect properties and turn what they find into clear, shareable reports. Someone opens the app on their phone, walks a property capturing photos, video, and voice notes even with no signal, since it works offline and syncs later, then reviews everything and runs reporting on the web. It plugs into the property-management systems teams already use, so the data doesn't sit in a silo. They've been at this since 2014, profitable and self-funded the whole way, and today more than 20,000 people use it across the U.S. and 20-plus countries, together capturing over 100 million inspection photos. There's even a new AI feature that turns spoken notes into a finished report on its own, so an inspector can walk a property, say what they see, and skip the typing.

Your Role

You own how work moves through the product from the first step to the last: the steps, the logic, the states, and the handoffs between the phone in the field and the review screen back at the office. You'll map how property managers actually work, find where a flow gets confusing or breaks, and redesign it so the next person doesn't have to think about it. There's another designer on the team who leans visual and component-level, so you lean process and flow, and together you cover the whole surface. This is a design role about how work behaves, not visual polish. You report to the Head of Engineering, and what you design gets built instead of sitting in a backlog.

You'll

  • Map property management workflows end to end, from field capture to sync to review to report

  • Talk to the people who live in a workflow, then redesign it with fewer steps

  • Write the logic, branches, and edge cases behind each flow so engineering builds it right the first time

  • Design the offline and retry states so users always know what's happening when the signal drops

  • Prototype in Figma and check it with quick usability runs

  • Hand engineering annotated specs (states, rules, microcopy) they can build from with little back-and-forth

  • Review builds, log precise issues, and confirm the fixes before sign-off

You Bring

  • Experience designing complex, multi-step workflows (B2B, SaaS, operations, or field tools). We care more about how the flows in your portfolio hold up than about a year count, and we'll happily hire someone earlier in their career who clearly has the instinct for this

  • A portfolio that shows the whole path, problem to mapping to logic to final, not just polished screens

  • Systems thinking: you design for the states, branches, permissions, errors, and empty cases, not just the happy path

  • You write clear flow documentation and specs engineering can build straight from

  • Strong Figma for mapping, prototyping, and handoff

  • AI fluency: you use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Figma AI to move through options and specs faster without lowering quality

  • A working handle on accessibility (contrast, tap targets, text size, focus order)

Bonus Points

  • Service design or process mapping (journey maps, service blueprints, workflow diagrams)

  • Experience designing information-dense web UIs (tables, filtering, bulk actions, reporting dashboards)

  • Background in workflow-heavy B2B products: property management, field services, logistics, or operations tooling

  • Comfort using analytics to confirm a redesigned flow actually performs better

What's Offered

  • Fully remote across LATAM, around 40 hours a week, flexible for the right person, with a few hours of overlap during U.S. Pacific business hours

  • What we'd estimate for a role like this: around $2,000 to $4,000 USD a month, based on experience. Tell us the range that fits you and we'll go from there

  • Paid weekly in USD as a contractor

  • Up to 20 days of paid time off a year (10 vacation days plus 10 local public holidays)

  • A two-person design team where you own the flow side and a counterpart owns the visual side, plus a direct line to the Head of Engineering

  • A team that ships small, steady improvements over big rebuilds, so your work gets built instead of sitting in a backlog

Interview Process

1️⃣ Intro call: your background and how you approach workflow and product design
2️⃣ Practical exercise: map and simplify a real inspection workflow
3️⃣ Portfolio and collaboration deep dive: with the designer you'd partner with
4️⃣ Conversation with the Head of Engineering: handoff and how design fits release cycles
5️⃣ Final conversation with the CEO: context and next steps
Timeline: most people go from first call to decision in about 2 to 3 weeks.

About the role

Owns the technical performance, discoverability and optimization of digital content across search, AI-driven discovery and the website. Combines strong technical expertise in SEO, AEO/GEO, CMS, analytics and conversion optimization with good editorial judgement to improve how audiences find, experience and act on Syskit content.

Responsibilities

Own organic discoverability: develop and execute SEO, AEO and GEO approaches, including search intent, content architecture, internal linking, structured content, on-page optimization and technical SEO fundamentals.

Drive website performance: use HubSpot CMS confidently to build, manage and optimize pages and content experiences, identifying improvements to journeys, navigation, CTAs and conversion.

Use analysis to drive action: use Google Search Console, HubSpot, analytics and other search/AI visibility tools to understand performance, diagnose issues and identify opportunities. Turn data into an ongoing optimization roadmap.

Optimize content: audit existing content and determine what to improve, consolidate, restructure, repurpose or retire based on discoverability, audience need and commercial value.

Improve conversion: understand CRO principles and use data and experimentation to improve how visitors progress from content consumption to meaningful actions.

Strengthen digital authority: understand the role of review sites, third-party sources, backlinks, citations and external authority in traditional and AI-driven discovery, and work with Content, Comms and other teams to improve visibility.

Create and edit content: write, edit and restructure high-quality B2B content when required, working with existing writers as necessary.

Stay ahead: monitor developments in search, AI discovery and digital content technology, test new approaches and translate meaningful changes into action.

Skills and experience

  • Strong understanding of SEO and modern search/discovery practices, including AEO and GEO
  • Demonstrable experience working with a CMS; HubSpot CMS experience an advantage
  • Comfortable using Google Search Console, HubSpot reporting and web analytics tools
  • Understanding of website conversion optimization, user journeys and content UX
  • Able to interpret performance data and turn it into practical recommendations
  • Understanding of technical SEO fundamentals without needing to be a developer
  • Experience using AI and emerging content tools appropriately to improve research, production and optimization
  • Strong collaboration skills across Content, Design, Product Marketing, Growth and Marketing Operations
  • Strong B2B writing and editorial skills with good editorial judgment
  • Curious, experimental and comfortable working in a rapidly changing digital environment

About Syskit

Syskit Point is the governance layer for Microsoft 365, giving IT teams full visibility and control over their environment from a single platform. Organizations use it to govern permissions and workspaces, reduce oversharing and data exposure, optimize storage and licensing costs, and roll out AI tools with confidence.

Founded in 2009, Syskit is trusted by more than 3,800 organizations worldwide, including Lego, Volvo, IBM, and STADA, many of them in regulated industries. Learn more at syskit.com.

Salary: €2500-3600 gross per month

Your new role

Strategic Pursuits team. Building on strong research, writing, coordination and document management skills, the Pursuit Coordinator will help pursuit teams find, develop, organise and refine content needed for winning bids, tenders and proposals. The role will support all stages, from early client and competitor insight through submission, interviews and lessons learned.

Therapeutic Area Head, Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care

Syneos Health® is a leading fully integrated biopharmaceutical solutions organization built to accelerate customer success. We translate unique clinical, medical affairs and commercial insights into outcomes to address modern market realities.

Every day we perform better because of how we work together, as one team, each the best at what we do. We bring a wide range of talented experts together across a wide range of business-critical services that support our business. Every role within Corporate is vital to furthering our vision of Shortening the Distance from Lab to Life®.

Discover what our 29,000 employees, across 110 countries already know.

WORK HERE MATTERS EVERYWHERE

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

The Senior Vice President (SVP), Clinical Development – Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care provides strategic, scientific, and operational leadership across global clinical development programs within the Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care (CMIC) therapeutic areas. This executive role is responsible for ensuring the successful delivery of complex, high-value studies across all phases, driving operational excellence, financial performance, innovation, and client satisfaction.

As a senior member of the Global Project Management leadership team, this individual shapes the organization’s therapeutic delivery strategy, ensures scientific and operational rigor, and fosters high-impact partnerships with clients and internal stakeholders. The SVP, CMIC acts as a trusted advisor and scientific authority within Cardiology, Metabolic Disorders, Critical Care, and related domains—bringing both credibility and vision to drive Syneos Health’s position as a market leader in these therapeutic areas.

Key Responsibilities:

Impact to the Organization

  • Directly influences Syneos Health’s success in the Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care therapeutic areas by ensuring delivery excellence, strengthening client partnerships, and driving innovation across clinical operations.

  • Serves as both a scientific authority and operational leader, shaping the future of clinical delivery and reinforcing Syneos Health’s reputation for excellence and leadership in the global CRO landscape.

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the strategic vision for Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care delivery, aligning clinical execution with corporate goals and client expectations.

  • Anticipate emerging trends and therapeutic innovations to position Syneos Health as the preferred partner in these therapeutic areas.

  • Drive organizational strategy for operational excellence, scalability, and delivery modernization.

  • Collaborate closely with senior leaders to align project delivery with enterprise objectives and strategic growth priorities.

Scientific Authority & External Influence

  • Maintain fluency in current and emerging clinical standards across cardiovascular, metabolic, and intensive care indications.

  • Act as a recognized thought leader—engaging in high-level discussions with client C-suites, regulatory stakeholders, and industry influencers.

  • Contribute to scientific and clinical development discussions, leveraging evidence-based insights to shape client strategies and partnerships.

  • Represent the company in scientific and industry forums to enhance visibility and credibility.

Therapeutic Portfolio Oversight

  • Provide executive oversight of all Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care projects from early to late development phases.

  • Ensure operational excellence, delivery performance, and proactive risk mitigation across the portfolio.

  • Establish and monitor governance frameworks for performance tracking, escalation management, and continuous improvement.

  • Partner cross-functionally with operational, scientific, and quality leaders to drive consistency and innovation in project delivery.

Executive Client Management & Business Development

  • Serve as the senior executive liaison for key strategic clients within the CMIC portfolio.

  • Partner with BD and functional teams to expand client relationships and identify growth opportunities.

  • Support high-stakes client engagements, including bid defenses, RFIs, and strategic presentations; coach senior leaders to do the same.

  • Cultivate long-term partnerships by demonstrating deep therapeutic expertise, strategic insight, and delivery excellence.

Financial & Operational Leadership

  • Maintain accountability for the financial health and performance of the CMIC therapeutic area.

  • Drive forecasting accuracy, portfolio profitability, and efficient resource utilization.

  • Collaborate with finance and operations leaders to ensure sustainable cost management and growth.

  • Champion data-driven decision making using operational analytics and performance metrics.

Organizational Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of global leaders (VP and below) within the CMIC therapeutic area.

  • Build a culture of collaboration, inclusion, empowerment, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Partner with HR and organizational leadership to strengthen succession pipelines and develop next-generation leaders.

Quality, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure compliance with ICH/GCP, regulatory standards, and internal quality systems.

  • Collaborate with quality leadership to drive inspection readiness and consistency across global operations.

  • Lead process improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, scalability, and client satisfaction.

  • Model a culture of quality and operational integrity across all delivery teams.

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (MS, PharmD, MD, or equivalent) in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, or related scientific discipline required; Ph.D. preferred but not required.

  • Minimum of 15+ years of experience in clinical research, project management, or clinical operations within CRO, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology environments.

  • Extensive experience leading complex clinical development programs in cardiology, metabolic disorders, or intensive care indications.

  • Proven ability to manage large, global portfolios and lead multi-layered leadership teams.

  • Strong business acumen and financial management experience (budgeting, forecasting, P&L ownership).

  • Deep understanding of drug development processes, GCP/ICH guidelines, and global regulatory expectations.

  • Exceptional executive presence with demonstrated ability to influence and engage at C-suite and senior client levels.

  • Strategic thinker with a track record of driving innovation, transformation, and operational excellence.

  • Ability to travel as required (approximately 30–35%).

At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

The individual is responsible for budgets, forecasts, analytics, and developing KPIs, while providing insight and making recommendations to clients. The Senior Controller must be self-motivated and be able to provide superior and responsive professional services for clients and staff in a virtual environment to create an unparalleled experience for all.   • Execute team meetings
  • Utilize internal documentation system when updating/developing procedures and policies.
  • Enforces a system of internal controls to verify integrity of processes and procedures are followed by staff

  • Assist with interviewing and onboarding new team members, as needed
  • Partner and collaborate with other Senior Controllers on best practices to enhance company knowledge sharing culture

Essential Skills & Experience:


The ideal Senior Controller candidate will have extensive knowledge in accounting for businesses in the under $20M market. The ideal candidate should have 10 – 15 years of progressive accounting experience, with a combination 5+ years in public accounting and 5+ years in private industry.

In addition:

  • Adaptive leadership style with a passion for mentoring staff. Exceptional ability to work with all levels within the organization while fostering a team environment.

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment, with a sense of urgency to achieve timely, quality results

Job Description

This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S

Every day at Enlyte, our people focus on making the journey from incident to outcome smarter, simpler and brighter. We help those who help restore lives by making it easier to navigate the complex road to recovery through advanced technology, insight, and expertise. We mix wisdom with sparks of ingenuity to break through barriers, eliminate delays, and ease frustration. Our vision of meeting the unique needs of our clients with flexible thinking and responsive solutions means working together as one team fully dedicated to transforming today and navigating next.

Division Specific Information

The Core Services team is part of the Security team. Members of the team are charged with developing identity and access management solutions for the organization across the hybrid cloud landscape, which includes Directory Services in Active Directory, Identity services in Microsoft Azure Cloud, and AWS Identity support. The team also supports Microsoft O365, including Messaging services under Exchange and Teams, Intranet Services under SharePoint, and Personal cloud storage services under OneDrive, as well as federation and single sign-on services through Azure Entra ID. This position serves as the team's primary Privileged Access Management specialist, focused on privileged account governance, monitoring, and security controls.

How will you make an impact?

This position reports to the Manager of Core Services and is in support of the Core Services team in Corporate IT at Enlyte. Core Services includes the management of Active Directory, Microsoft Azure, Exchange O365, DNS, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Identity and Access Management for corporate colleagues and contractors.

  • Engineer, implement, and administer enterprise PAM and PSM solutions
  • Manage privileged account onboarding, credential vaulting, and privileged access workflows

  • Monitor privileged activity through session recording, auditing, and analytics controls
  • Support investigations involving privileged credentials and elevated access
  • Partner with Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to satisfy audit and regulatory requirements

  • Minimum of 5+ years of fundamental experience in DDI, networking, firewall, server, and cloud technologies
  • Minimum of 5+ years of hands-on experience in Windows PowerShell, with ability to develop scripts as need
  • Experience in complex enterprises with a diverse array of unique authentication / authorization requirements

Tool & Technology Skills

  • IAM solutions such as Active Directory, VDS, SSO, SAML, oAuth, OpenID, MFA, and PAM
  • Identity Lifecycle Management and Governance tools (MIM, SailPoint, Saviynt, ForgeRock)
  • Cloud Identity technologies, including Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS, and Google Cloud
  • Microsoft Mail Services (Exchange Server, as well as Microsoft O365)

  • Automation, such as PowerShell, Perl, Python, or .NET development languages
  • AuthX Support for Windows Server, as well as Linux Server
  • Mergers & Acquisitions involving Active Directory and Azure
  • Working in GxP or other regulated environments
  • Documentation for systems management and compliance purposes

Preferred PAM / PSM Skills

  • Experience implementing and administering CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Delinea, ARCON, or similar PAM platforms
  • Experience with Privileged Session Management including session monitoring, recording, and audit controls
  • Credential vaulting and privileged account lifecycle management
  • Just-in-Time access and least-privilege administration models
  • Zero Trust security principles and privileged access governance

Location
Remote in Europe, ideally Zurich or London. Travels up to 30%. Reports to the CEO.

Albatross

Albatross builds perception models: AI that understands human behavior and powers product discovery the way a great salesperson does, by observing the customer and adapting in real time. LLMs understand words. We understand behavior.

Our models power discovery for 50 million+ shoppers a month. The results are public. Wallapop: +119% homepage engagement, +35% overall engagement. OfferUp: +84% homepage engagement, +20% overall engagement.

One platform, four primitives: discovery feed, similar items, playlist, contextual search. A customer goes live in seven weeks. The pipeline is global, we are deployed in 12 countries.

About the Job

Our results sell Albatross. Your job is to get every customer to them, fast, and turn them into revenue. You own everything after signature: the seven weeks to a live A/B test, the result the customer can measure, the conversion to a long-term contract, the renewal, and the growth after it, use case by use case and marketplace by marketplace.

Velocity is the key: a customer who goes live in seven weeks and sees the lift in week eight renews and expands. Until customers see the results, you and your team are the reason they trust us. Maintain that trust and bring them fast to the results.

The platform is the product: four primitives, one platform, configured, not coded. You make sure customers use what we built, as designed. Every customer that goes live without custom code is a customer we can scale to. Your team is what lets us add customers without adding engineers, and it is never the bottleneck.

We want a builder. Today the founders and the data scientists run deployments. You take that over, build the Deployment Strategist team that runs it, and turn it into a machine: one strategist per five customers, every customer on all four primitives.

You own the customer. Sales hands over at signature and does not take it back. You will:

  • Own every customer relationship after signature, as the senior point of contact for their CPO, VP of Data and VP of Engineering.
  • Run every pilot to a result: live A/B test in seven weeks, uplift measured, contract converted.
  • Keep customers on the platform: primitives and platform components as designed, configuration over custom code. When a customer asks for bespoke work, you find the way to do it with what exists, or you say no.
  • Own renewals and upsells: every live customer to all primitives, and group agreements rolled out to every marketplace the group owns. You handle customer QBRs and show impact.
  • Own customer support: one front door, fast answers, incidents handled with the customer informed before they ask.
  • Hire, build and lead the Deployment Strategist team across Europe and the US. The first is already hired.
  • Turn every customer into a reference: case studies, press releases, a CPO who takes the call from the next prospect.

Requirements

Who you are

  • You come from software. You have deployed a SaaS or API product into enterprise customers, and you know the difference between building bespoke solutions and configuring a platform.
  • You have built a customer success, deployment or solutions function from zero at a startup, and you ran it on numbers: time to live, pilot-to-contract conversion, net revenue retention.
  • You have owned renewals and expansion for enterprise customers, with the numbers to show it.
  • You have hired and led a technical, customer-facing team: solutions engineers, implementation consultants, forward deployed engineers or data analysts.
  • You are technical. You can read an A/B test, you know what data a model needs, and you can guide the analysis yourself. Our customers' VPs of Data will test you.
  • You move fast and you hold the line. You do not overpromise, you do not let scope grow, and you get to a strong result fast and iterate from there.
  • You stay calm when the page is down. If we are down, the customer's homepage is down. We own their critical path.
  • You have worked with marketplaces, e-commerce, or search, personalisation or recommendation products. A strong plus, not a must.
  • You like to travel. Human contact is irreplaceable.
  • You are eligible to work in Europe.

The motion is proven. You make it run without the founders, then you make it faster.

What success looks like

3 months:

  • Every live customer and every active pilot knows you as their point of contact, and you have met them in person.
  • The deployment playbook is written: what a strategist does from kickoff to A/B readout, with no custom code in it.
  • Support has one front door and a response time customers can quote.
  • The second Deployment Strategists is hired.

12 months:

  • Pilots convert into long-term contracts at a rate the business can plan on, and deployments go live in less than five weeks.
  • Every live customer runs all four primitives, or has a dated plan to get there.
  • Every production customer is a reference, and at least three are public case studies.
  • The Deployment Strategist team runs customer deployments on its own, and the customer count has grown without your team.

Benefits

  • Europe-based: total at target €180-230k (€140k-€170k gross base salary + €40k - €60k variable at target).
  • Equity, four-year vesting, one-year cliff.
  • Full remote flexibility across Europe.

Company Overview:

Our client is a publicly traded cloud storage company with two flagship products: a personal computer backup solution and a cloud object storage platform often compared to Amazon S3 — but chosen for its pricing and a no-egress-fees policy that has made it a go-to for cost-conscious builders. They run their own physical data centers (4 in the U.S., plus Netherlands and Canada), and their engineering culture is unusually transparent — they publish deep technical blog posts and hardware reliability reports that the industry actually reads. They're expanding globally, with active hiring across LATAM, India, and the Philippines. This isn't a company that abstracts away the hard parts; they own the stack, and it shows.

Your Role:

The Storage Platform team owns the foundational durable storage layer that every product is built on top of. Their job — and yours — is to make sure data doesn't get lost, performance holds at scale, and the architecture is ready for the next decade of growth. This is an open-ended, ambiguous, systems-close-to-the-metal role: you'll be investigating unclear symptoms, optimizing for specific hardware behaviors, improving throughput, and helping redesign components that general-purpose tools can no longer handle well. You'll be fully embedded with the U.S. team — not a satellite — which means deep collaboration, clear communication, and real ownership.

You'll:

  • Build and evolve a storage platform operating at cloud scale — we're talking exabyte-level storage with real durability constraints

  • Optimize for different hard drive and hardware characteristics, improving throughput and reducing error rates across hardware failure modes

  • Troubleshoot ambiguous, symptom-driven problems where the signal is limited and the root cause isn't obvious

  • Contribute to major architectural upgrades that will support the platform for the next 5–10 years — including support for emerging storage technologies

  • Take ownership of parts of the stack where general-purpose components stop being the right fit

  • Improve hardware utilization and efficiency as the business grows upmarket and scale increases

  • Collaborate closely with a distributed team — coordinating, problem-solving, and communicating across time zones daily

You Bring:

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with comfort operating lower in the stack

  • Experience with complex systems where performance, reliability, and cost actually matter

  • A genuine ability to work through ambiguity — you can navigate limited signal and multiple possible causes without getting stuck

  • Solid collaboration and communication skills in English (strong enough for deep technical conversations)

  • Proficiency in Java, or meaningful experience in adjacent languages (C, C++, C#, Rust) — fundamentals matter more than the specific language

  • A track record of shipping in environments where engineering decisions have real downstream consequences

Bonus points:

  • Experience working with hardware or systems tightly coupled to hardware behavior

  • Exposure to Rustor interest in growing into it

  • Breadth across different systems and types of projects over time

What They Offer:

  • Fully remote contractor role based in LATAM (currently focused on Costa Rica, Mexico, Chile, and Colombia)

  • Competitive USD compensation: $50K–$90K base (location/market-adjusted) plus ~10% bonus

  • Full integration with the U.S. engineering team — real ownership, not a satellite setup

  • A chance to work on infrastructure that underpins real customer data at meaningful scale

  • A company with an unusually transparent engineering culture and a strong technical reputation

Interview Process:

1️⃣ Recruiter Screen — behavioral alignment, comp, logistics, and a few targeted questions
2️⃣ Technical Phone Screen — with a lead engineer from the Storage Platform team
3️⃣ Panel Interviews (×3) — ranging from lower-level coding to higher-level system design topics

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

jobs.title: Asset Management Manager – Waterfalls & Reporting
jobs.excerpt: Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Asset Management Manager to support our waterfall modeling and investor reporting function for a growing portfolio of residential and commercial solar assets.
jobs.description:
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Asset Management Manager to support our waterfall modeling and investor reporting function for a growing portfolio of residential and commercial solar assets. This role will serve as a key subject matter expert responsible for the accuracy of cash waterfall models, the integrity of reporting data, and the timely delivery of investor and lender reporting.
The ideal candidate brings strong structured-finance and reporting experience, along with a data-oriented approach to process improvement. This individual will work closely with accounting, tax, legal, operations, and third-party auditors to support accurate distributions, maintain compliance with financing agreements, and enhance reporting processes through stronger controls, improved data management, and thoughtful automation.

Key Responsibilities

Waterfall Modeling & Distributions
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on multi-tranche waterfall models covering debt tranches, equity returns, fees, and reserves.
  • Maintain, review, and enhance waterfall models to support accurate monthly and quarterly distribution calculations, debt-service payments, and equity cures in accordance with contractual waterfalls.
  • Monitor covenant compliance, including LTV, DSCR, and yield tests, and coordinate follow-up actions where needed.
  • Ensure model assumptions, outputs, and calculations are supported by complete and accurate financial and operational data.
Investor & Lender Reporting
  • Prepare, review, and support the delivery of investor reports, distribution statements, and compliance certificates on the required cadence.
  • Improve the consistency, accuracy, and usefulness of investor reporting by strengthening data inputs, validation processes, and reporting controls.
  • Coordinate data from accounting, collections, lease management, and operating performance teams and synthesize it into clear reporting packages, dashboards, and commentary.
  • Respond to investor and lender inquiries with thoughtful variance analysis, reporting support, and clear communication.
  • Support ongoing enhancements to investor reporting materials and processes to improve transparency, timeliness, and overall quality.
Controls, Audit & Data Governance
  • Oversee the collection, validation, and reconciliation of data used in waterfall models and external reporting.
  • Maintain strong model governance standards, version control, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Establish and refine controls and review procedures to improve the completeness, accuracy, and traceability of reporting outputs.
  • Support third-party audits by coordinating data requests, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
Process Improvement & Automation
  • Identify and implement opportunities to automate recurring waterfall, reporting, and data aggregation processes.
  • Use tools such as Excel VBA, Python, Power BI, Tableau, or similar solutions to reduce manual work and improve reporting efficiency and accuracy.
  • Standardize templates, checklists, and procedures across the reporting function.
  • Partner with internal teams to improve data flows, streamline reporting processes, and support more scalable reporting infrastructure.
New Portfolio Onboarding
  • Support the setup of waterfall models and reporting processes for newly acquired or financed assets.
  • Oversee the integration of site-level performance data, historical financials, and contractual terms into existing models and reporting workflows.
  • Coordinate cross-functional inputs from accounting, tax, legal, and operations to support a smooth transition into ongoing asset management.
  • Help establish consistent onboarding processes that support portfolio growth and reporting quality.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 6–8 years of relevant experience in structured-finance modeling, investor reporting, or asset management.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex financial modeling; experience with VBA and other automation tools preferred.
  • Familiarity with BI and reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex analyses clearly to senior internal stakeholders, investors, and lenders.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to maintaining strong controls and high-quality reporting.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Master’s degree in Finance, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Prior experience in renewable-energy finance, infrastructure, or distributed-asset structured finance.
  • Familiarity with data management platforms, ERP systems, or CRM tools such as Salesforce, Argus, or equivalent.
  • Experience supporting process automation or reporting improvements in a finance or asset-management setting.

If that's you, let's build what's next — together.
